This guy isn't the sharpest hammer in the smithy!
entries.translation: 这家伙可不是铁匠铺里最锋利的那把锤子！
entries.sampleRaw: This guy isn't the sharpest hammer in the smithy!

entries.source: Last week they promoted me from guarding the exit to guarding the entrance! Still the same spot but I gladly take that promotion!
entries.translation: 上周他们把我从看守出口提拔成了看守入口！还是同一个地方，但我很乐意接受这次提拔！
entries.sampleRaw: Last week they promoted me from guarding the exit to guarding the entrance! Still the same spot but I gladly take that promotion!

entries.source: I'm guarding the whole kingdom.
I'm guarding the guard on the other side.
entries.translation: 我在守卫另一边的守卫。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm guarding the guard on the other side.

entries.source: I, Murdohr, son of Murdohr the Third, Commander of the Phoenix Forge, and Warden of the Holy Pickaxe, am guarding this wall.
entries.translation: 我，默多赫，默多赫三世之子，凤凰熔炉指挥官，圣镐守护者，正在守卫这面墙。
entries.sampleRaw: I, Murdohr, son of Murdohr the Third, Commander of the Phoenix Forge, and Warden of the Holy Pickaxe, am guarding this wall.

entries.source: I'm a guard.
I'm guarding nothing.
I am guarding the lava.
Things have been getting out of control lately.
entries.translation: 最近事情越来越失控了。
entries.sampleRaw: Things have been getting out of control lately.

entries.source: People are losing their values and other candidates are acting like everything is fine.
entries.translation: 人们正在丧失自己的价值观，而其他候选人却装作一切安好。
entries.sampleRaw: People are losing their values and other candidates are acting like everything is fine.

entries.source: They simply don't have the grip required to lead this great land.
entries.translation: 他们根本没有领导这片伟大土地所需的掌控力。
entries.sampleRaw: They simply don't have the grip required to lead this great land.

entries.source: Values. Progress. Justice
I will stabilize this rapidly declining system, permanently.
entries.translation: 我将永久地稳定这个迅速衰败的体系。
entries.sampleRaw: I will stabilize this rapidly declining system, permanently.

entries.source: I will fix the declining economy, but above all things, safety is my priority.
entries.translation: 我会修复衰退的经济，但最重要的是，安全是我的首要任务。
entries.sampleRaw: I will fix the declining economy, but above all things, safety is my priority.

entries.source: Power needs to be in the right hands.
entries.translation: 权力必须掌握在正确的人手中。
entries.sampleRaw: Power needs to be in the right hands.

entries.source: The people choose leaders, Aura makes sure they choose wisely.
entries.translation: 人民选择领袖，Aura确保他们明智地选择。
entries.sampleRaw: The people choose leaders, Aura makes sure they choose wisely.

entries.source: Aura said to 'work harder,' so I hit a tree until I passed out.
entries.translation: Aura说“更努力地工作”，所以我一直砍树直到昏倒。
entries.sampleRaw: Aura said to 'work harder,' so I hit a tree until I passed out.

entries.source: Ministers are the voice of the people. So all we have to do is control them.
entries.translation: 部长是人民的声音。所以我们只需控制他们就行了。
entries.sampleRaw: Ministers are the voice of the people. So all we have to do is control them.

entries.source: Minister elections... democracy with supervision.
entries.translation: 部长选举……受监督的民主。

entries.source: If a Minister misbehaves, there's always room in the jail.
entries.translation: 如果部长行为不端，监狱里总有空位。
entries.sampleRaw: If a Minister misbehaves, there's always room in the jail.

entries.source: A bribed Minister is a loyal Minister. Efficiency!
entries.translation: 被贿赂的部长就是忠诚的部长。高效！
entries.sampleRaw: A bribed Minister is a loyal Minister. Efficiency!

entries.source: Bribery? No, no. Aura calls them 'motivational perks.'
entries.translation: 贿赂？不不。Aura管这叫“激励性福利”。
entries.sampleRaw: Bribery? No, no. Aura calls them 'motivational perks.'

entries.source: Aura brings order. The rest is just noise.
entries.translation: Aura带来秩序。其余的都只是噪音。
entries.sampleRaw: Aura brings order. The rest is just noise.

entries.source: If it's fair, it's Aura. If it's unfair... well, it's not Aura.
entries.translation: 如果它是公平的，那就是Aura。如果不公平……嗯，那就不是Aura。
entries.sampleRaw: If it's fair, it's Aura. If it's unfair... well, it's not Aura.

entries.source: If Aura told me to mine dirt for a year, I'd ask which shovel.
entries.translation: 如果Aura让我挖一年泥土，我会问用哪把铲子。
entries.sampleRaw: If Aura told me to mine dirt for a year, I'd ask which shovel.

entries.source: Between you and me... Aura always wanted to surpass Dante.
entries.translation: 你我之间说说……Aura一直想超越Dante。
entries.sampleRaw: Between you and me... Aura always wanted to surpass Dante.

entries.source: Aura watched Dante fall and took notes. Lots of notes.
entries.translation: Aura看着Dante倒下，还做了笔记。很多笔记。
entries.sampleRaw: Aura watched Dante fall and took notes. Lots of notes.

entries.source: Dante tried too hard. Aura tries smarter.
entries.translation: Dante太用力了.Aura更聪明地尝试.
entries.sampleRaw: Dante tried too hard. Aura tries §osmarter.

entries.source: Dante lost control. Aura studies control.
entries.sampleRaw: Dante lost control. Aura studies control.

entries.source: Dante feared chaos. Aura just organizes it.
entries.translation: Dante畏惧混乱。Aura只是把它组织起来。
entries.sampleRaw: Dante feared chaos. Aura just organizes it.

entries.source: Dante failed because he underestimated the people. Aura won't.
entries.translation: Dante失败了，因为他低估了人民。Aura不会。
entries.sampleRaw: Dante failed because he underestimated the people. Aura won't.

entries.source: Secret elections overthrew Dante, so Aura made elections... less secret.
entries.translation: 秘密选举推翻了Dante，所以Aura让选举……没那么秘密了。
entries.sampleRaw: Secret elections overthrew Dante, so Aura made elections... less secret.

entries.source: Did you know Aura and Dante trained together? She actually learned from his mistakes.
entries.translation: 你知道Aura和Dante一起训练过吗？她其实是从他的错误中学到了东西。
entries.sampleRaw: Did you know Aura and Dante trained together? She actually learned from his mistakes.

entries.source: Aura was Shen's Elite N°2 once. Dante never acknowledged her.
entries.translation: Aura曾是Shen的精英N°2。Dante从未认可过她。
entries.sampleRaw: Aura was Shen's Elite N°2 once. Dante never acknowledged her.
entries.numericSource: Aura was Shen's Elite N°{{N0}} once. Dante never acknowledged her.
entries.numericTranslation: Aura曾是Shen的精英N°{{N0}}。Dante从未认可过她。

entries.source: When Dante left Shen's team, Aura followed. But she had a plan.
entries.translation: 当Dante离开Shen的队伍时，Aura跟了上去。但她有自己的计划。
entries.sampleRaw: When Dante left Shen's team, Aura followed. But she had a plan.

entries.source: Enjoy your Universal Income. Aura made that happen.
entries.translation: 享受你的全民收入吧。那是Aura促成的。
entries.sampleRaw: Enjoy your Universal Income. Aura made that happen.

entries.source: Universal Income? More like Universal Happiness!
entries.translation: 全民收入？不如说是全民幸福！
entries.sampleRaw: Universal Income? More like Universal Happiness!

entries.source: I love taxes.
Keep spending! Equality depends on your wallet.
entries.translation: 继续花钱吧！平等取决于你的钱包。
entries.sampleRaw: Keep spending! Equality depends on your wallet.

entries.source: Every tax is a step towards equality!
entries.translation: 每一笔税都是迈向平等的一步！
entries.sampleRaw: Every tax is a step towards equality!

entries.source: Aura takes my coins, and yet I feel richer.
entries.translation: Aura拿走了我的硬币，可我却觉得自己更富有了。
entries.sampleRaw: Aura takes my coins, and yet I feel richer.

entries.source: If Aura needs coins, she can have my purse.
entries.translation: 如果Aura需要硬币，她可以拿走我的钱包。
entries.sampleRaw: If Aura needs coins, she can have my purse.

entries.source: I read Aura's rulebook upside down and it still made sense.
entries.translation: 我把Aura的规则书倒过来读，居然还是说得通。
entries.sampleRaw: I read Aura's rulebook upside down and it still made sense.

entries.source: I salute Aura every time I open the Bazaar.
entries.translation: 每次打开集市，我都会向Aura敬礼。
entries.sampleRaw: I salute Aura every time I open the Bazaar.

entries.source: Thanks to Aura, even the lazy contribute something.
entries.translation: 多亏了Aura，连懒人也能做出点贡献。
entries.sampleRaw: Thanks to Aura, even the lazy contribute something.

entries.source: Everyone can vote, but Aura counts the votes.
entries.translation: 人人都能投票，但计票的是Aura。
entries.sampleRaw: Everyone can vote, but Aura counts the votes.

entries.source: Aura lets you vote for anyone! And then supervises them closely.
entries.translation: Aura让你可以投票给任何人！然后再密切监督他们。
entries.sampleRaw: Aura lets you vote for anyone! And then supervises them closely.

entries.source: Hard work makes Aura smile. Don't you want Aura to smile?
entries.translation: 努力工作能让Aura微笑。你不想让Aura微笑吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Hard work makes Aura smile. Don't you want Aura to smile?

entries.source: Honestly, I sleep better knowing Aura might be spying on me.
entries.translation: 说实话，知道Aura可能在监视我，我睡得更香了。
entries.sampleRaw: Honestly, I sleep better knowing Aura might be spying on me.

entries.source: Aura works hard so you don't have to think.
entries.translation: Aura努力工作，就是为了让你不用动脑。
entries.sampleRaw: Aura works hard so you don't have to think.

entries.source: Aura says equality, and we say 'yes, ma'am.'
entries.translation: Aura说平等，我们就说“是的，女士。”
entries.sampleRaw: Aura says equality, and we say 'yes, ma'am.'

entries.source: A fair society starts with a firm hand.
entries.sampleRaw: A fair society starts with a firm hand.

entries.source: Progress feels heavy, that means it's working.
entries.translation: 进步让人感觉沉重，这说明它起作用了。
entries.sampleRaw: Progress feels heavy, that means it's working.

entries.source: Chat responsibly, our ears are everywhere.
entries.translation: 聊天请负责任，我们的耳朵无处不在。
entries.sampleRaw: Chat responsibly, our ears are everywhere.

entries.source: Aura takes, Aura gives.
Aura says jump. I say 'how many times?'
entries.sampleRaw: Aura says jump. I say 'how many times?'

entries.source: When the monsters hit harder, I say thank you.
entries.translation: 当怪物打得更狠时，我会说谢谢。
entries.sampleRaw: When the monsters hit harder, I say thank you.

entries.source: Don't question the plan, the plan questions you.
entries.translation: 别质疑计划,计划会质疑你.
entries.sampleRaw: Don't question the plan, the plan questions §oyou.

entries.source: Trust the system, Aura perfected it.
entries.sampleRaw: Trust the system, Aura perfected it.

entries.source: Stay productive, citizen, Aura is counting on you.
entries.translation: 保持高效，公民，Aura正指望你呢。
entries.sampleRaw: Stay productive, citizen, Aura is counting on you.

entries.source: If Aura leaves, who will monitor my thoughts?
entries.translation: 如果Aura离开，谁来监视我的思想？
entries.sampleRaw: If Aura leaves, who will monitor my thoughts?

entries.source: If Aura goes... who will guide my wallet?
entries.translation: 如果Aura走了……谁来指引我的钱包？
entries.sampleRaw: If Aura goes... who will guide my wallet?

entries.source: She's not going because she failed. She's going because she's honourable.
entries.translation: 她离开不是因为失败。她离开是因为她高尚。
entries.sampleRaw: She's not going because she failed. She's going because she's honourable.

entries.source: Aura deserved better. Much better.
The Ministers didn't support her vision... and now she's leaving. Good job, everyone.
entries.translation: 部长们不支持她的愿景……现在她要走了。干得好，各位。
entries.sampleRaw: The Ministers didn't support her vision... and now she's leaving. Good job, everyone.

entries.source: I hope those Ministers are proud. They shattered her confidence.
entries.translation: 我希望那些部长们感到骄傲。他们击碎了她的信心。
entries.sampleRaw: I hope those Ministers are proud. They shattered her confidence.

entries.source: Aura leaving...? I don't understand. They were doing so well.
entries.translation: Aura要离开……？我不明白。他们明明做得那么好。
entries.sampleRaw: Aura leaving...? I don't understand. They were doing so well.

entries.source: You remove one little thing from her system and suddenly she doubts everything.
entries.translation: 你从她的系统里拿走一个小东西，她突然就怀疑一切了。
entries.sampleRaw: You remove one little thing from her system and suddenly she doubts everything.

entries.source: Dante would've fought. Aura simply bows and walks away... gracefully.
entries.translation: Dante会抗争。Aura只是鞠个躬，然后……优雅地走开。
entries.sampleRaw: Dante would've fought. Aura simply bows and walks away... gracefully.

entries.source: She believed in the people. Maybe too much.
entries.translation: 她相信人民。也许太相信了。
entries.sampleRaw: She believed in the people. Maybe too much.

entries.source: She knows when she isn't wanted. That's what makes her noble.
entries.translation: 她知道什么时候自己不受欢迎。这正是她高贵之处。
entries.sampleRaw: She knows when she isn't wanted. That's what makes her noble.

entries.source: I heard Aura sigh today. Aura never sighs.
entries.translation: 我今天听到Aura叹气了。Aura从不叹气。
entries.sampleRaw: I heard Aura sigh today. Aura never sighs.

entries.source: I didn't think equality would make me cry, but here we are.
entries.translation: 我没想到平等会让我哭，但事实就是如此。
entries.sampleRaw: I didn't think equality would make me cry, but here we are.

entries.source: She trusted us. And we broke her system. Literally.
entries.translation: 她信任我们。而我们弄坏了她的系统。字面意义上的。
entries.sampleRaw: She trusted us. And we broke her system. Literally.

entries.source: She didn't scold me today. Something's wrong.
entries.translation: 她今天没骂我。有点不对劲。
entries.sampleRaw: She didn't scold me today. Something's wrong.

entries.source: Aura isn't the type to cling to power. She's better than that.
entries.translation: Aura不是那种紧抓权力不放的人。她比那更高尚。
entries.sampleRaw: Aura isn't the type to cling to power. She's better than that.

entries.source: Aura stepping down feels illegal. Emotionally, at least.
entries.translation: Aura卸任感觉像是违法的。至少情感上是这样。
entries.sampleRaw: Aura stepping down feels illegal. Emotionally, at least.

entries.source: You didn't deserve Aura, and now she knows it.
entries.translation: 你们不配拥有Aura，现在她知道了。
entries.sampleRaw: You didn't deserve Aura, and now she knows it.

entries.source: I thought she was eternal. Turns out she's humble.
entries.translation: 我以为她是永恒的。原来她只是谦逊。
entries.sampleRaw: I thought she was eternal. Turns out she's humble.

entries.source: Aura saw the signs. And she chose dignity instead of chaos.
entries.translation: Aura看到了征兆。她选择了尊严，而非混乱。
entries.sampleRaw: Aura saw the signs. And she chose dignity instead of chaos.

entries.source: She's too pure to fight for power. She just lets it go.
entries.translation: 她太纯洁了，不会为权力而战。她只是放手。
entries.sampleRaw: She's too pure to fight for power. She just lets it go.

entries.source: Aura gave us everything. And this is how YOU repay her?
entries.translation: Aura给了我们一切。而你们就是这样回报她的？
entries.sampleRaw: Aura gave us everything. And this is how YOU repay her?

entries.source: Somebody hurt her feelings. I won't say who.
entries.translation: 有人伤了她的心。我不会说是谁。
entries.sampleRaw: Somebody hurt her feelings. I won't say who.

entries.source: If Aura wanted to stay, she would've. She's stepping back out of respect.
entries.translation: 如果Aura想留下，她就会留下。她退后是出于尊重。
entries.sampleRaw: If Aura wanted to stay, she would've. She's stepping back out of respect.

entries.source: Violence will not be tolerated!
Try to pull that stunt again and I will not be so lenilent!
entries.translation: 再耍那种花招，我可不会这么宽容了！
entries.sampleRaw: Try to pull that stunt again and I will not be so lenilent!

entries.source: What do you think you're doing?
entries.sampleRaw: What do you think you're doing?

entries.source: Have fun rotting in jail.
dante best
go Dante in community center get Happy Mask!
entries.translation: 去社区中心找 Dante 拿快乐面具！
entries.sampleRaw: go Dante in community center get Happy Mask!

entries.source: you not happy? go get Happy Mask!
entries.translation: 你不开心？去拿快乐面具！
entries.sampleRaw: you not happy? go get Happy Mask!

entries.source: you need wear Happy Mask!
oi, where your Happy Mask?
Go to Dante in the community center to claim your Happy Mask!
entries.translation: 去社区中心找 Dante 领取你的快乐面具！
entries.sampleRaw: Go to Dante in the community center to claim your Happy Mask!

entries.source: Aren't you happy? Go get your Happy Mask!
entries.translation: 你不开心吗？去拿你的快乐面具！
entries.sampleRaw: Aren't you happy? Go get your Happy Mask!

entries.source: You need to wear your Happy Mask!
entries.translation: 你需要戴上你的快乐面具！
entries.sampleRaw: You need to wear your Happy Mask!

entries.source: Oi, where is your Happy Mask?
entries.sampleRaw: Oi, where is your Happy Mask?

entries.source: welcome community center
talk to elizabeth to contribute to community projects, upgrade your account, and other stuff
entries.translation: 找 elizabeth 谈谈，为社区项目做贡献、升级你的账户，还有别的事情
entries.sampleRaw: talk to §delizabeth§f to contribute to community projects, upgrade your account, and other stuff

entries.source: dante best!
no more elections
welcome mayor election
vote favorite dante to keep power where belong
entries.translation: 投票给你最爱的 dante，让权力回到它该在的地方
entries.sampleRaw: vote favorite §6dante§f to keep power where belong

entries.source: dante is order, dante is security, dante is freedom
entries.translation: dante 就是秩序，dante 就是安全，dante 就是自由
entries.sampleRaw: §6dante§f is order, §6dante§f is security, §6dante§f is freedom

entries.source: I don't talk to peasants.
I don't really converse with your kind, but today I'll make an exception.
entries.translation: 我通常不跟你这种人交谈，但今天我破个例。
entries.sampleRaw: I don't really converse with your kind, but today I'll make an exception.

entries.source: This is acceptable. I would never eat this myself, but it's good enough for my servants.
entries.translation: 这还凑合。我自己绝不会吃这个，但给我的仆人们吃足够了。
entries.sampleRaw: This is acceptable. I would never eat this myself, but it's good enough for my servants.

entries.source: My disappointment is immeasurable. What a waste of my valuable time.
entries.translation: 我的失望无法衡量。真是浪费我宝贵的时间。
entries.sampleRaw: My disappointment is immeasurable. What a waste of my valuable time.

entries.source: The sun will rise again!
Oink oink! Pig time! Year of the Pig! It's here, oink oink!
entries.translation: 哼哼！猪猪时间！猪年！它来了，哼哼！
entries.sampleRaw: Oink oink! Pig time! §dYear of the Pig§f! It's here, oink oink!

entries.source: You take Shiny Orb, plop it on pig - oink!
entries.translation: 你拿起闪亮宝珠，啪地放到猪身上——哼！
entries.sampleRaw: You take §6Shiny Orb§f, plop it on pig - §f§ooink!

entries.source: Then you chase piggy, chase piggy!
entries.sampleRaw: Then you chase piggy, chase piggy!

entries.source: Guide piggy back to orb, and poof!
entries.translation: 把猪猪引回宝珠那里，然后噗！
entries.sampleRaw: Guide piggy back to orb, and §f§opoof!

entries.source: Piggy leave shiny treasure for you.
entries.translation: Piggy给你留下了闪亮的宝藏。
entries.sampleRaw: Piggy leave shiny treasure for you.

entries.source: Get shiny stuff, keep shiny stuff! Easy, oink!
entries.translation: 拿到闪亮的东西，留住闪亮的东西！简单，哼哧！
entries.sampleRaw: Get shiny stuff, keep shiny stuff! Easy, oink!

entries.source: Now go, go! Piggy no wait forever!
entries.translation: 现在快走，快走！Piggy可不会永远等你！
entries.sampleRaw: Now go, go! Piggy no wait forever!

entries.source: The 7 Pig Relics have been found, therefore I am.
entries.translation: 7个猪圣物已被找到，因此我得以现身。
entries.sampleRaw: The §d7§f Pig Relics have been found, therefore I am.
entries.numericSource: The {{N0}} Pig Relics have been found, therefore I am.
entries.numericTranslation: {{N0}}个猪圣物已被找到，因此我得以现身。

entries.source: People call me the Ancient Pig, and I bring good fortune in the land.
entries.translation: 人们称我为Ancient Pig，我为这片土地带来好运。
entries.sampleRaw: People call me the Ancient Pig, and I bring good fortune in the land.

entries.source: A random effect will appear every 20 minutes for the next 2 days.
entries.translation: 在接下来的2天里,每20分钟会出现一个随机效果.
entries.sampleRaw: A random effect will appear every §b20§f minutes for the next §b2 days§f.
entries.numericSource: A random effect will appear every {{N0}} minutes for the next {{N1}} days.
entries.numericTranslation: 在接下来的{{N1}}天里,每{{N0}}分钟会出现一个随机效果.

entries.source: The current effect is <current effect>.
Whoops! I lost my good pickaxe again in the mines. That's why I always come prepared with a backup!
entries.translation: 哎呀！我又把好镐子丢在矿洞里了。所以我总是随身带着备用镐！
entries.sampleRaw: Whoops! I lost my good pickaxe again in the mines. That's why I always come prepared with a backup!

entries.source: It's probably down in the mine somewhere. Can you go find it?
entries.translation: 它大概就在矿洞下面的某个地方。你能去找找吗？
entries.sampleRaw: It's probably down in the mine somewhere. Can you go find it?

entries.source: Maybe one day I'll go back down there.
entries.translation: 也许哪天我会再下去一趟。
entries.sampleRaw: Maybe one day I'll go back down there.

entries.source: <Current Month> <Current Day> is my resting day!
entries.sampleRaw: <Current Month> <Current Day> is my resting day!

entries.source: I'd go mining but I'm too lazy.
entries.translation: 我本想去挖矿，但我太懒了。
entries.sampleRaw: I'd go mining but I'm too lazy.

entries.source: Find my pickaxe in the Gold Mine! I'm not going back down there...
entries.translation: 去金矿找我的镐子吧！我可不想再下去了……
entries.sampleRaw: Find my pickaxe in the Gold Mine! I'm not going back down there...

entries.source: Smelting Touch is a really useful enchantment. It automatically smelts ores into ingots!
entries.translation: 熔炼之触是非常有用的附魔。它能自动把矿石熔炼成锭！
entries.sampleRaw: Smelting Touch is a really useful enchantment. It automatically smelts ores into ingots!

entries.source: Collect iron and gold ingots with that pickaxe you found!
entries.translation: 用你找到的那把镐子收集铁锭和金锭！
entries.sampleRaw: Collect iron and gold ingots with that pickaxe you found!

entries.source: ...Or do it the long way and smelt the ore yourself.
entries.translation: ……或者用笨办法，自己熔炼矿石。
entries.sampleRaw: ...Or do it the long way and smelt the ore yourself.

entries.source: The Deep Caverns are full of strange creatures and expensive treasures.
entries.translation: 深层矿洞里满是奇怪的生物和昂贵的宝藏。
entries.sampleRaw: The Deep Caverns are full of strange creatures and expensive treasures.

entries.source: Reach Mining Level V to gain access!
entries.translation: 达到采矿等级 V 即可进入！
entries.sampleRaw: Reach Mining Level V to gain access!

entries.source: Have you spelunked the Deep Caverns?
entries.translation: 你去深层矿洞探过险了吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Have you spelunked the Deep Caverns?

entries.source: They are full of bountiful treasures but watch out for those Lapis Zombies!
entries.translation: 那里满是丰厚的宝藏，但要小心那些青金石僵尸！
entries.sampleRaw: They are full of bountiful treasures but watch out for those Lapis Zombies!

entries.source: It's <real life day of week>, my resting day! I earned myself a little treat, maybe you could bring me some chocolate?
entries.translation: 今天是<real life day of week>，我的休息日！我犒劳了自己一点小甜头，也许你能给我带点巧克力？
entries.sampleRaw: It's §7<real life day of week>§f, my resting day! I earned myself a little treat, maybe you could bring me some chocolate?

entries.source: Mmh! This is really good! I'll be sure to come back again when I'm no longer busy!
entries.translation: 嗯！这真不错！等我不忙了一定会再来的！
entries.sampleRaw: Mmh! This is really good! I'll be sure to come back again when I'm no longer busy!

entries.source: That's really unfortunate, I'll just come back again on my next resting day!
entries.translation: 真不巧，我下个休息日再来吧！
entries.sampleRaw: That's really unfortunate, I'll just come back again on my next resting day!

entries.source: That Jake fellow is a bit suspicious.
entries.sampleRaw: That Jake fellow is a bit suspicious.

entries.source: He says he can't leave his house but I've seen him walking around all the time...
entries.translation: 他说自己不能离开房子，但我总看见他在外面走来走去……
entries.sampleRaw: He says he can't leave his house but I've seen him walking around all the time...

entries.source: I keep thinking about Jake's behavior...
I know I'll catch him doing something!
entries.translation: 我知道我一定能抓到他做些什么！
entries.sampleRaw: §fI know I'll catch him doing something!

entries.source: Did you figure out the meaning of the note yet?
entries.translation: 你弄明白那张纸条的意思了吗？
entries.sampleRaw: §fDid you figure out the meaning of the note yet?

entries.source: Maybe you should go to the cave where I followed him. I remember there were a lot of mushrooms.
entries.translation: 也许你该去我跟踪他时去过的那个洞穴看看。我记得那里有很多蘑菇。
entries.sampleRaw: §fMaybe you should go to the cave where I followed him. I remember there were a lot of mushrooms.

entries.source: Seems that I have misjudged Jake, he might not have been as suspicious as I thought.
entries.translation: 看来我错怪Jake了，他可能没有我想的那么可疑。
entries.sampleRaw: §fSeems that I have misjudged Jake, he might not have been as suspicious as I thought.

entries.source: The plushie he gave me is quite cute actually!
entries.translation: 他送我的毛绒玩具其实挺可爱的！
entries.sampleRaw: §fThe plushie he gave me is quite cute actually!

entries.source: Thanks again for helping me discovering the truth about Jake.
entries.translation: 再次感谢你帮我查明Jake的真相。
entries.sampleRaw: Thanks again for helping me discovering the truth about Jake.

entries.source: Can't believe he had a second secret lab to hide!
entries.translation: 真不敢相信他还藏了第二个秘密实验室！
entries.sampleRaw: Can't believe he had a second secret lab to hide!

entries.source: I think I am really onto something here.
entries.translation: 我觉得我这次真的查到关键了。
entries.sampleRaw: I think I am really onto something here.

entries.source: Jake says he can't walk, but I've seen him walk yesterday.
entries.translation: Jake说他走不了路，可我昨天还看见他走路了。
entries.sampleRaw: Jake says he can't walk, but I've seen him walk yesterday.

entries.source: He also asks strangers to get him some animals, but these animals are nowhere to be found!
entries.translation: 他还让陌生人给他弄些动物来，可这些动物哪儿都找不到！
entries.sampleRaw: He also asks strangers to get him some animals, but these animals are nowhere to be found!

entries.source: I'm getting really close to solving this mystery.
entries.translation: 我马上就要解开这个谜团了。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm getting really close to solving this mystery.

entries.source: I followed him today to where he brings all the animals he catches. He goes down some weird cave...
entries.translation: 今天我跟踪他去了他把他抓到的所有动物都带去的地方。他走进了一个奇怪的洞穴……
entries.sampleRaw: I followed him today to where he brings all the animals he catches. He goes down some weird cave...

entries.source: Unfortunately, I couldn't follow him any further as he almost noticed me, so I backed off for now.
entries.translation: 可惜我没法再跟下去了，他差点发现我，所以我暂时退回来了。
entries.sampleRaw: Unfortunately, I couldn't follow him any further as he almost noticed me, so I backed off for now.

entries.source: I managed to follow him into the cave today, he had a shovel with him and a note fell out of his pocket...
entries.translation: 今天我成功跟着他进了洞穴，他带着一把铲子，还有一张纸条从他口袋里掉了出来……
entries.sampleRaw: I managed to follow him into the cave today, he had a shovel with him and a note fell out of his pocket...

entries.source: The note reads: "175 42 -470"
Not really sure what these numbers mean yet, do you have any ideas?
entries.translation: 我还不太确定这些数字是什么意思，你有什么想法吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Not really sure what these numbers mean yet, do you have any ideas?

entries.source: You found what? A secret lab hidden inside the cave???
entries.translation: 你发现了什么？洞穴里藏着一个秘密实验室？？？
entries.sampleRaw: You found what? A secret lab hidden inside the cave???

entries.source: We need to check this out together. I'll meet you there!
entries.translation: 我们得一起去看看。我会在那里和你碰面！
entries.sampleRaw: We need to check this out together. I'll meet you there!

entries.source: Hey, <player>, I've been thinking a lot about that lab we found... I think there's more to it than just the plushies.
entries.translation: 嘿，<player>，我一直在想我们找到的那个实验室……我觉得事情不只是那些毛绒玩具那么简单。
entries.sampleRaw: Hey, §7<player>§f, I've been thinking a lot about that lab we found... I think there's more to it than just the plushies.

entries.source: Especially with all those strange machines and experiments. I need your help again... let's meet back in the lab.
entries.translation: 尤其是那些奇怪的机器和实验。我又需要你的帮助了……我们回实验室碰面吧。
entries.sampleRaw: Especially with all those strange machines and experiments. I need your help again... let's meet back in the lab.

entries.source: Maybe I was wrong to trust you...
entries.translation: 也许我当初不该相信你……
entries.sampleRaw: Maybe I was wrong to trust you...

entries.source: Hi! I have a quest for a member of your co-op! Tell them to come see me!
entries.translation: 嗨！我有个任务要交给你们合作档里的一名成员！让他来找我！
entries.sampleRaw: Hi! I have a quest for a member of your co-op! Tell them to come see me!

entries.source: This is so strange...
I can't believe this has been down here for all this time... I am speechless.
entries.translation: 真不敢相信这东西一直在这里待了这么久……我都说不出话了。
entries.sampleRaw: I can't believe this has been down here for all this time... I am speechless.

entries.source: WHAT? There are animals inside of here?!?! Jake is doing horrible experiments with these animals that he catches...
entries.translation: 什么？这里面有动物？！？！Jake在拿他抓来的这些动物做可怕的实验……
entries.sampleRaw: WHAT? There are §banimals §finside of here?!?! §cJake §fis doing §chorrible experiments §fwith these §banimals §fthat he catches...

entries.source: He has gone completely mad! He's a psychopath!
entries.translation: 他彻底疯了！他是个变态！
entries.sampleRaw: He has gone completely mad! He's a psychopath!

entries.source: And look at all of these tools he has laying around here... a SAW?... a HAMMER?
entries.translation: 看看他在这儿到处乱放的工具……一把锯子？……一把锤子？
entries.sampleRaw: And look at all of these tools he has laying around here... a SAW?... a HAMMER?

entries.source: What is this psycho doing with these animals???
entries.translation: 这个变态到底在拿这些动物做什么？？？
entries.sampleRaw: What is this psycho doing with these §banimals§f???

entries.source: Jake has a lot of explaining to do!
entries.sampleRaw: §cJake §fhas a lot of explaining to do!

entries.source: ... BETH?? AND &&<capitalized player name>, WHAT ARE YOU GUYS DOING IN HERE???
entries.translation: ……BETH？？还有&&<capitalized player name>，你们在这儿干什么？？？
entries.sampleRaw: ... BETH?? AND &&<capitalized player name>§f, WHAT ARE YOU GUYS DOING IN HERE???

entries.source: IT'S NOT WHAT IT LOOKS LIKE!
entries.sampleRaw: IT'S NOT WHAT IT LOOKS LIKE!

entries.source: WE KNOW WHAT YOU ARE DOING IN HERE, YOU PSYCHO! YOU WILL PAY FOR WHAT YOU ARE DOING TO THESE ANIMALS!
entries.translation: 我们知道你在这里干什么，你这个疯子！你会为你对这些动物所做的一切付出代价！
entries.sampleRaw: WE KNOW WHAT YOU ARE DOING IN HERE, YOU PSYCHO! YOU WILL PAY FOR WHAT YOU ARE DOING TO THESE §bANIMALS§f!

entries.source: ANIMALS? I CAN EXPLAIN, I SWEAR!
entries.translation: 动物？我可以解释，我发誓！

entries.source: WELL GO ON THEN, EXPLAIN YOURSELF!
entries.translation: 那就说吧，解释一下你自己！
entries.sampleRaw: WELL GO ON THEN, EXPLAIN YOURSELF!

entries.source: I don't know what you guys think I am doing here, but this is just my workshop!
entries.translation: 我不知道你们以为我在这里干什么，但这只是我的工坊！
entries.sampleRaw: I don't know what you guys think I am doing here, but this is just my §2workshop§f!

entries.source: I am just making toys for animals...
entries.translation: 我只是在给动物做玩具……

entries.source: Oh really? Do you really think we are that naive?
entries.translation: 哦，真的吗？你真觉得我们那么好骗？
entries.sampleRaw: Oh really? Do you really think we are that naive?

entries.source: We know that you are experimenting with animals down here, how do you explain this tank?
entries.translation: 我们知道你在下面拿动物做实验，这个水箱你怎么解释？
entries.sampleRaw: We know that you are experimenting with §banimals §fdown here, how do you explain this tank?

entries.source: Those are my plushies! I preserve them in Jelly so they stay fresh!
entries.translation: 那些是我的毛绒玩具！我把它们泡在果冻里保鲜！
entries.sampleRaw: Those are my §bplushies§f! I preserve them in Jelly so they stay fresh!

entries.source: They look super realistic, but no animal was harmed when making them!
entries.translation: 它们看起来超级逼真，但制作过程中没有伤害任何动物！
entries.sampleRaw: They look super realistic, but no §banimal §fwas harmed when making them!

entries.source: I can prove it! Here, take this. This is one of the plushies I made, you can have it!
entries.translation: 我可以证明！来，拿着这个。这是我做的毛绒玩具之一，送给你了！
entries.sampleRaw: I can prove it! Here, take this. This is one of the §bplushies §fI made, you can have it!

entries.source: So really, I am not harming them at all!
entries.translation: 所以真的，我根本没有伤害它们！
entries.sampleRaw: So really, I am not harming them at all!

entries.source: Everything makes sense now...I'm sorry I yelled at you Jake. I'm so sorry.
entries.translation: 现在一切都说得通了……对不起，我冲你吼了，Jake。我真的很抱歉。
entries.sampleRaw: Everything makes sense now...I'm sorry I yelled at you Jake. I'm so sorry.

entries.source: It's alright now. I was wrong to lie about it and I should have told you sooner.
entries.translation: 现在没事了。我不该撒谎，我应该早点告诉你的。
entries.sampleRaw: It's alright now. I was wrong to lie about it and I should have told you sooner.

entries.source: <player>, thank you so much for telling me what you saw here. I'll be forever grateful.
entries.translation: <player>，非常感谢你告诉我你在这里看到的一切。我会永远感激你。
entries.sampleRaw: §7<player>§f, thank you so much for telling me what you saw here. I'll be forever grateful.

entries.source: I have to go now, I hope to see you guys soon.
entries.translation: 我得走了，希望很快能再见到你们。
entries.sampleRaw: I have to go now, I hope to see you guys soon.

entries.source: That was a close one, thank you <player> for having my back. Anyway, I need to go back to my business.
entries.translation: 好险，谢谢你挺我，<player>。总之，我得回去忙我的生意了。
entries.sampleRaw: That was a close one, thank you §7<player> §ffor having my back. Anyway, I need to go back to my business.

entries.source: This place still gives me chills... but I'm sure there's more to uncover.
entries.translation: 这地方还是让我毛骨悚然……但我确信还有更多东西有待发掘。
entries.sampleRaw: This place still gives me chills... but I'm sure there's more to uncover.

entries.source: We know Jake's been hiding things, and I think we're getting closer to the truth.
entries.translation: 我们知道Jake一直在隐瞒事情，我觉得我们离真相越来越近了。
entries.sampleRaw: We know Jake's been hiding things, and I think we're getting closer to the truth.

entries.source: Hmm, this corner... I don't think I've noticed this before.
entries.translation: 嗯，这个角落……我觉得我以前没注意到过。
entries.sampleRaw: §fHmm, this corner... I don't think I've noticed this before.

entries.source: There's something strange about this wall. It looks out of place...
entries.translation: 这面墙有点奇怪。它看起来格格不入……
entries.sampleRaw: There's something strange about this wall. It looks out of place...

entries.source: Wait, there's a lever here!
What is this? A hidden passage? I knew Jake was hiding something from me, but this... this is something different.
entries.translation: 这是什么？一条隐藏通道？我就知道Jake有事瞒着我，但这……这不一样。
entries.sampleRaw: What is this? A hidden passage? I knew Jake was hiding something from me, but this... this is something different.

entries.source: I don't know if we should trust this, but we've come this far... Let's see what's behind it.
entries.translation: 我不知道我们该不该相信这个，但我们都走到这一步了……看看后面有什么吧。
entries.sampleRaw: §fI don't know if we should trust this, but we've come this far... Let's see what's behind it.

entries.source: See if you can pull down this lever, it's a bit stuck.
entries.translation: 看看你能不能把这个拉杆拉下来，它有点卡住了。
entries.sampleRaw: §fSee if you can pull down this lever, it's a bit stuck.

entries.source: I... I had no idea this was here. What could Jake be hiding in this secret part of the lab?
entries.translation: 我……我不知道这里有这个。Jake会在实验室这个秘密区域里藏些什么呢？
entries.sampleRaw: I... I had no idea this was here. What could Jake be hiding in this secret part of the lab?

entries.source: It's very dark in here, where's the light-switch in this place?
entries.translation: 这里好黑，这地方的灯开关在哪？
entries.sampleRaw: It's very dark in here, where's the light-switch in this place?

entries.source: Oh... my... what is all of this?
entries.sampleRaw: Oh... my... what is all of this?

entries.source: This is... this isn't just about plushies anymore. Jake's been working on something much bigger.
entries.translation: 这……这已经不只是毛绒玩具的事了。Jake一直在搞一个更大的东西。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThis is... this isn't just about plushies anymore. Jake's been working on something much bigger.

entries.source: Hybridization? Mutation? What is this madness? He's experimenting on something...
entries.translation: 杂交？变异？这到底是什么疯狂的事？他在拿什么东西做实验……
entries.sampleRaw: Hybridization? §cMutation§f? What is this madness? He's experimenting on something...

entries.source: Resilient livestock... enhanced growth rates... Jake, what have you done?
entries.translation: 抗逆的牲畜……加速的生长……Jake，你到底做了什么？
entries.sampleRaw: Resilient livestock... enhanced growth rates... Jake, what have you done?

entries.source: These aren't normal crops. These are mutated... just like the ones we've been finding in the Garden. But why hide all of this down here?
entries.translation: 这些不是普通的作物。这些是变异的……就像我们在花园里一直发现的那样。但为什么要把这一切都藏在这下面？
entries.sampleRaw: §fThese aren't normal §acrops§f. These are §cmutated§f... just like the ones we've been finding in the Garden. But why hide all of this down here?

entries.source: Beth... I told you to stay out of this.
entries.translation: Beth……我告诉过你别掺和这件事。
entries.sampleRaw: Beth... I told you to stay out of this.

entries.source: Jake! You have a lot of explaining to do, once again... What is all of this? What are you doing down here?
entries.translation: Jake！你又有一大堆事情要解释了……这都是什么？你在这下面做什么？
entries.sampleRaw: Jake! You have a lot of explaining to do, once again... What is all of this? What are you doing down here?

entries.source: Please tell me the truth this time Jake, I can't take all these lies anymore!
entries.translation: 这次请告诉我实话，Jake，我再也受不了这些谎言了！
entries.sampleRaw: Please tell me the truth this time Jake, I can't take all these lies anymore!

entries.source: It's... it's not what it looks like. This lab... it's for research. To improve farming techniques, to help both crops and animals adapt to new environments.
entries.translation: 这……这不是看起来那样。这个实验室……是用来做研究的。为了改进耕作技术，帮助作物和动物适应新环境。
entries.sampleRaw: §fIt's... it's not what it looks like. This lab... it's for research. To improve farming techniques, to help both §acrops §fand §eanimals §fadapt to new environments.

entries.source: Research? This doesn't look like research, Jake! This looks like you are playing with life itself. Those tanks, those animals, what are you actually doing to them?
entries.translation: 研究?这看起来可不像研究,Jake!这看起来像是你在玩弄生命本身.那些罐子、那些动物,你到底在对它们做什么?

styleMappings.? This doesn't look like research, Jake!: ?这看起来可不像研究,Jake!这看起来像是你在玩弄生命本身.那些罐子、那些动物,你到底在对它们做什么?

entries.sampleRaw: §bResearch§f? This doesn't look like research, Jake! This looks like you are playing with life itself. Those tanks, those animals, what are you actually doing to them?

entries.source: You don't understand, Beth! Farming as we know is evolving. If we don't adapt, we'll be left behind. The world's demands are growing, and so are the challenges.
entries.translation: 你不明白，Beth！我们所熟知的农业正在进化。如果我们不适应，就会被抛在后面。世界的需求在增长，挑战也在增长。
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou don't understand, Beth! Farming as we know is evolving. If we don't adapt, we'll be left behind. The world's demands are growing, and so are the challenges.

entries.source: That doesn't give you the right to hide this from everyone. What about the risks? The ethics?
entries.translation: 那也不能给你对所有人隐瞒这件事的权利。那风险呢？伦理呢？
entries.sampleRaw: §fThat doesn't give you the right to hide this from everyone. What about the risks? The ethics?

entries.source: You're creating something entirely unnatural.
entries.translation: 你在创造某种完全违背自然的东西。

entries.source: sigh I know it seems... wrong. But these experiments could change everything.
entries.translation: 唉 我知道这看起来……不对.但这些实验能改变一切.

styleMappings.I know it seems... wrong. But these expe: 我知道这看起来……不对.但这些实验能改变一切.

entries.sampleRaw: §f§osigh §fI know it seems... wrong. But these experiments could change everything.

entries.source: Imagine crops that can survive the harshest conditions, or animals that never get sick.
entries.translation: 想象一下能在最严酷条件下存活的作物，或者永远不会生病的动物。
entries.sampleRaw: §fImagine crops that can survive the harshest conditions, or animals that never get sick.

entries.source: It's not just about survival, it's about thriving.
entries.translation: 这不仅仅是为了生存，而是为了繁荣。
entries.sampleRaw: §fIt's not just about survival, it's about thriving.

entries.source: And what about the things you are not telling me? What else are you hiding down here, Jake?
entries.translation: 那那些你没告诉我的事呢？你还在这下面藏着什么，Jake？
entries.sampleRaw: §fAnd what about the things you are not telling me? What else are you hiding down here, Jake?

entries.source: There are some things you're better off not knowing. Not yet at least.
entries.translation: 有些事你还是不知道为好。至少现在是这样。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThere are some things you're better off not knowing. Not yet at least.

entries.source: No, Jake. I've come this far, and I won't stop now. If you won't tell me the truth, I'll find it myself.
entries.translation: 不，Jake。我已经走到这一步，现在不会停下。如果你不肯告诉我真相，我就自己去找。
entries.sampleRaw: §fNo, Jake. I've come this far, and I won't stop now. If you won't tell me the truth, I'll find it myself.

entries.source: Beth, you don't understand, some things aren't ready to be uncovered. It's not about keeping secrets, it's about protecting what I've been working towards.
entries.translation: Beth，你不明白，有些事还没准备好被揭开。这不是为了保守秘密，而是为了保护我一直努力追求的东西。
entries.sampleRaw: §fBeth, you don't understand, some things aren't ready to be uncovered. It's not about keeping secrets, it's about protecting what I've been working towards.

entries.source: Protecting what? Your pride? Your experiments? This isn't just about you, Jake. We have a responsibility to use this lab for good, not to bury it under layers of secrecy.
entries.translation: 保护什么？你的自尊？你的实验？这不只是你一个人的事，Jake。我们有责任把这个实验室用于正途，而不是把它埋在层层秘密之下。
entries.sampleRaw: §fProtecting what? Your pride? Your experiments? This isn't just about you, Jake. We have a responsibility to use this lab for good, not to bury it under layers of secrecy.

entries.source: What's this?
That... is the Crop Analyzer.
The Crop Analyzer? What does it do?
entries.translation: 作物分析仪？它是做什么的？

entries.source: It's a tool I've been developing. It analyzes mutations in crops, helps identify traits that can improve yield, resistance or even flavor.
entries.translation: 这是我一直以来在开发的工具。它能分析作物的变异，帮助识别能提高产量、抗性甚至风味的性状。
entries.sampleRaw: §fIt's a tool I've been developing. It analyzes §cmutations §fin crops, helps identify traits that can improve §6yield§f, §9resistance §for even §dflavor§f.

entries.source: But it's not finished. It's delicate work, Beth. Work that requires precision, and data.
entries.translation: 但它还没完成。这是精细活，Beth。需要精确和数据的活。
entries.sampleRaw: §fBut it's not finished. It's delicate work, Beth. Work that requires precision, and data.

entries.source: Work that shouldn't be done in isolation. Jake, this could change everything for farmers everywhere. Why are you hiding something so revolutionary?
entries.translation: 不该孤立进行的活。Jake，这能改变各地农民的一切。你为什么要藏起这么具有革命性的东西？
entries.sampleRaw: §fWork that shouldn't be done in isolation. Jake, this could change everything for farmers everywhere. Why are you hiding something so revolutionary?

entries.source: Because it's not perfect yet. A mistake could have disastrous consequences. I didn't want to involve anyone until I was sure it was ready.
entries.translation: 因为它还不完美。一个失误可能带来灾难性的后果。在确定它准备好之前，我不想牵扯任何人。
entries.sampleRaw: §fBecause it's not perfect yet. A mistake could have disastrous consequences. I didn't want to involve anyone until I was sure it was ready.

entries.source: Jake, you've done incredible work here. But you don't have to do it alone anymore. Let me and <player> help you.
entries.translation: Jake，你在这里做出了了不起的成果。但你不必再独自承担了。让我和<player>来帮你。
entries.sampleRaw: §fJake, you've done incredible work here. But you don't have to do it alone anymore. Let me and §7<player> §fhelp you.

entries.source: Together, we can finish this and make sure it's used responsibly.
entries.translation: 我们一起就能完成这件事，并确保它被负责任地使用。
entries.sampleRaw: §fTogether, we can finish this and make sure it's used responsibly.

entries.source: Alright. You're right, Beth. I've been trying to carry this burden alone for too long. If we're going to make this work, we'll do it together.
entries.translation: 好吧。你说得对，Beth。我独自承担这个重担已经太久了。如果我们要让这件事成功，就得一起做。
entries.sampleRaw: §fAlright. You're right, Beth. I've been trying to carry this burden alone for too long. If we're going to make this work, we'll do it together.

entries.source: And you, <player>, you've been instrumental in getting us to this point. You should have access to the Crop Analyzer. You've earned my trust.
entries.translation: 还有你，<player>，你对我们走到这一步至关重要。你应该可以使用作物分析仪了。你赢得了我的信任。
entries.sampleRaw: §fAnd you, §7<player>§f, you've been instrumental in getting us to this point. You should have access to the §aCrop Analyzer§f. You've earned my trust.

entries.source: I think the Treasure Hunter is a scammer.
entries.translation: 我觉得那个Treasure Hunter是个骗子。
entries.sampleRaw: I think the Treasure Hunter is a scammer.

entries.source: He's always selling information about treasure locations but I always hear that no one finds treasure.
entries.translation: 他总是在卖宝藏位置的情报，但我总听说没人找到过宝藏。
entries.sampleRaw: He's always selling information about treasure locations but I always hear that no one finds treasure.

entries.source: I paid for one of Treasure Hunter's tips today and again, it only led me to a dirty shoelace. His tips are just not worth it...
entries.translation: 我今天花钱买了Treasure Hunter的一条提示，结果又只让我找到一根脏鞋带。他的提示根本不值……
entries.sampleRaw: I paid for one of Treasure Hunter's tips today and again, it only led me to a dirty shoelace. His tips are just not worth it...

entries.source: Maybe if I continue buying his tips I'll hit the jackpot soon. Just gotta spend a little bit more...
entries.translation: 也许我继续买他的提示，很快就能中大奖。只要再多花一点……
entries.sampleRaw: Maybe if I continue buying his tips I'll hit the jackpot soon. Just gotta spend a little bit more...

entries.source: You're no better than the Treasure Hunter...
entries.translation: 你比那个Treasure Hunter好不到哪去……
entries.sampleRaw: You're no better than the Treasure Hunter...

entries.source: Hello traveler!
Welcome to my keep, my sheep are some of the best in the world.
entries.translation: 欢迎来到我的羊圈，我的羊是世界上最好的羊之一。
entries.sampleRaw: Welcome to my keep, my sheep are some of the best in the world.

entries.source: They have regenerative properties that allow for them to regenerate their wool faster than normal!
entries.translation: 它们具有再生特性，能让它们的羊毛比普通羊更快地重新长出来！
entries.sampleRaw: They have regenerative properties that allow for them to regenerate their wool faster than normal!

entries.source: I'm feeling tired today.
Could you shear all my sheep at once?
entries.translation: 你能一次性剪完我所有羊的羊毛吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Could you shear all my sheep at once?

entries.source: I will have a reward if you do so!
entries.translation: 如果你这么做，我会给你奖励！
entries.sampleRaw: I will have a reward if you do so!

entries.source: You didn't shear enough sheep!
Thanks for helping me out!
Please accept this as a token of my gratitude!
entries.translation: 请收下这个，作为我感激的象征！
entries.sampleRaw: Please accept this as a token of my gratitude!

entries.source: My sheep are some of the best in the world!
entries.translation: 我的羊是世界上最好的羊之一！
entries.sampleRaw: My sheep are some of the best in the world!

entries.source: I'm hunting an Elusive animal.
entries.translation: 我正在猎捕一只稀有动物。

entries.source: If you want to hunt animals too, go talk to Trevor!
entries.translation: 如果你也想猎捕动物，去找Trevor谈谈吧！
entries.sampleRaw: If you want to hunt animals too, go talk to Trevor!

entries.source: You can find him just past the bridge in his den.
entries.translation: 你过了桥就能在他的巢穴里找到他。
entries.sampleRaw: You can find him just past the bridge in his den.

entries.source: Hi I'm Jake. I've been living on this island for 25 years.
entries.translation: 你好，我是Jake。我在这座岛上住了25年了。
entries.sampleRaw: §fHi I'm Jake. I've been living on this island for 25 years.
entries.numericSource: Hi I'm Jake. I've been living on this island for {{N0}} years.
entries.numericTranslation: 你好，我是Jake。我在这座岛上住了{{N0}}年了。

entries.source: I used to study animals from all over the land!
entries.translation: 我以前研究过这片土地上各处的动物！
entries.sampleRaw: I used to study animals from all over the land!

entries.source: Unfortunately, I suffered an injury which restricts me from leaving my house.
entries.translation: 不幸的是，我受了伤，这让我无法离开自己的房子。
entries.sampleRaw: Unfortunately, I suffered an injury which restricts me from leaving my house.

entries.source: I really enjoyed studying animals.
entries.translation: 我真的很喜欢研究动物。

entries.source: Could you bring me an animal? You can find them all over the island!
entries.translation: 你能给我带一只动物来吗？你可以在岛上各处找到它们！
entries.sampleRaw: Could you bring me an animal? You can find them all over the island!

entries.source: Someone already brought me an animal!
entries.translation: 已经有人给我带过一只动物了！
entries.sampleRaw: Someone already brought me an animal!

entries.source: I'm feeling generous, I'll show you my store.
entries.translation: 我今天心情不错，给你看看我的商店。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm feeling generous, I'll show you my store.

entries.source: Someone already brought me this animal recently, but since you put in all the effort I'll open my store for you.
entries.translation: 最近已经有人给我带来过这种动物了，但既然你这么费心费力，我就为你开放我的商店。
entries.sampleRaw: Someone already brought me this animal recently, but since you put in all the effort I'll open my store for you.

entries.source: Wow a cow!
How did you get this over the void? Incredible!
entries.translation: 你是怎么把它带过虚空来的？太不可思议了！
entries.sampleRaw: How did you get this over the void? Incredible!

entries.source: To show you my gratitude, I have a special item to sell you!
entries.translation: 为了表达我的谢意，我有一件特殊物品要卖给你！
entries.sampleRaw: To show you my gratitude, I have a special item to sell you!

entries.source: Wow a mushroom Cow! How did you get it out of the Gorge?
entries.translation: 哇，一头蘑菇牛！你是怎么把它从峡谷里弄出来的？
entries.sampleRaw: Wow a mushroom Cow! How did you get it out of the Gorge?

entries.source: Wow a chicken!
Did it fly over here?
Wow a pig!
How did you get this over the void? You must be really strong.
entries.translation: 你是怎么把它带过虚空来的？你一定非常强壮。
entries.sampleRaw: How did you get this over the void? You must be really strong.

entries.source: Thank you for bringing me this rabbit!
entries.translation: 谢谢你给我带来这只兔子！
entries.sampleRaw: Thank you for bringing me this rabbit!

entries.source: To show my gratitude, I have a special item to sell you!
entries.translation: 为了表达我的谢意，我有一件特殊物品要卖给你！
entries.sampleRaw: To show my gratitude, I have a special item to sell you!

entries.source: Thank you for bringing me this sheep!
entries.translation: 谢谢你给我带来这只羊！
entries.sampleRaw: Thank you for bringing me this sheep!

entries.source: This rabbit looks a little funny, did you fish it out of the Oasis?
entries.translation: 这只兔子看起来有点奇怪，你是从绿洲里把它钓出来的吗？
entries.sampleRaw: This rabbit looks a little funny, did you fish it out of the Oasis?

entries.source: This sheep looks a little funny, did you fish it out of the Oasis?
entries.translation: 这只羊看起来有点奇怪，你是从绿洲里把它钓出来的吗？
entries.sampleRaw: This sheep looks a little funny, did you fish it out of the Oasis?

entries.source: WOW!
The legendary Skeleton Emperor!
I searched all my life to find this creature but was never able to find it!
entries.translation: 我一生都在寻找这种生物，却始终没能找到它！
entries.sampleRaw: I searched all my life to find this creature but was never able to find it!

entries.source: Feel free to analyze any mutations you find!
entries.translation: 随时可以分析你发现的任何变异！
entries.sampleRaw: Feel free to analyze any mutations you find!

entries.source: Hold your horses! You don't even know how this machine works yet, you might break something if you don't pay attention!
entries.translation: 别急！你连这台机器怎么运作都还不知道，要是不留心，可能会弄坏东西的！
entries.sampleRaw: Hold your horses! You don't even know how this machine works yet, you might break something if you don't pay attention!

entries.source: Allow me to introduce you to this machine first.
entries.translation: 先让我给你介绍一下这台机器。
entries.sampleRaw: Allow me to introduce you to this machine first.

entries.source: To help with my research, I need to collect various data samples of special mutated crops.
entries.translation: 为了协助我的研究，我需要收集各种特殊变异作物的数据样本。
entries.sampleRaw: To help with my research, I need to collect various data samples of special mutated crops.

entries.source: Their DNA is quite intriguing, making them a perfect basis for my research!
entries.translation: 它们的DNA相当有趣，是研究的最佳基础！
entries.sampleRaw: Their DNA is quite intriguing, making them a perfect basis for my research!

entries.source: To get started, acquire a Dustgrain first in your Greenhouse and then come back to me.
entries.translation: 首先，在你的温室里获取一份尘粒，然后再回来找我。
entries.sampleRaw: To get started, acquire a §aDustgrain §ffirst in your Greenhouse and then come back to me.

entries.source: Splendid! Now that we have our sample, place it inside the machine to analyze the mutation.
entries.translation: 太好了！既然我们有了样本，就把它放进机器里分析变异吧。
entries.sampleRaw: Splendid! Now that we have our sample, place it inside the machine to analyze the mutation.

entries.source: Good job! We have successfully sequenced the mutation, adding another sample to my collection!
entries.translation: 干得好！我们成功测序了该变异，为我的收藏又增添了一份样本！
entries.sampleRaw: Good job! We have successfully sequenced the mutation, adding another sample to my collection!

entries.source: If you find anymore mutations, I have not yet categorized, please feel free to analyze them here!
entries.translation: 如果你发现了我尚未分类的变异，请随时在这里分析它们！
entries.sampleRaw: If you find anymore mutations, I have not yet categorized, please feel free to analyze them here!

entries.source: Analyzing these mutations will help us understand how we can improve existing crops which will help farmers everywhere!
entries.translation: 分析这些变异将帮助我们了解如何改良现有作物，从而帮助各地的农民！
entries.sampleRaw: Analyzing these mutations will help us understand how we can improve existing crops which will help farmers everywhere!

entries.source: ✆ You want my contact?
✆ I don't give it out often.
✆ I'm still getting calls from that one guy asking if I want to "extend my shovel warranty".
entries.translation: ✆ 我还在接到那个家伙的电话，问我愿不愿意“延长我的铲子保修期”。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fI'm still getting calls from that one guy asking if I want to "extend my shovel warranty".

entries.source: ✆ But if you help me with my research, I can trust you with it.
entries.translation: ✆ 但如果你帮我做研究，我就能放心把它交给你。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fBut if you help me with my research, I can trust you with it.

entries.source: ✆ Bring me a Chocoberry. One sample shall be enough.
entries.translation: ✆ 给我带一颗巧克力浆果来。一份样本就够了。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fBring me a §aChocoberry§f. One sample shall be enough.

entries.source: ✆ I cannot add you yet, I still have to finish my research.
entries.translation: ✆ 我还不能加你，我得先完成我的研究。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fI cannot add you yet, I still have to finish my research.

entries.source: ✆ Bring me a Chocoberry first, and I'll give you my contact!
entries.translation: ✆ 先给我带一颗巧克力浆果来，我就把我的联系方式给你！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fBring me a §aChocoberry §ffirst, and I'll give you my contact!

entries.source: ✆ This Chocoberry looks great, perfect condition even!
entries.translation: ✆ 这颗巧克力浆果看起来很棒，甚至可以说是完美状态！

entries.source: ✆ This gives me everything I need.
✆ You've earned my contact. I'll add you now.
entries.translation: ✆ 你赢得了我的联系方式。我现在就加你。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fYou've earned my contact. I'll add you now.

entries.source: ✆ But don't call me after 8pm, please.
entries.translation: ✆ 但请在 8 点之后不要打给我。
entries.numericSource: ✆ But don't call me after {{N0}}pm, please.
entries.numericTranslation: ✆ 但请在 {{N0}} 点之后不要打给我。

entries.source: Hello adventurer!
I'm the Treasure Hunter, I've been searching for treasure all over this island.
entries.translation: 我是Treasure Hunter，我一直在全岛各处寻找宝藏。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm the Treasure Hunter, I've been searching for treasure all over this island.

entries.source: Rumor has it that there are rare stones and other valuable bounty hidden in the ground all over the island.
entries.translation: 有传言说，全岛各处的地下都藏着稀有石头和其他珍贵的宝物。
entries.sampleRaw: Rumor has it that there are rare stones and other valuable bounty hidden in the ground all over the island.

entries.source: Tell you what, for a small price I'll give you the info I know about.
entries.translation: 这样吧，只要付一点小钱，我就把我所知道的信息告诉你。
entries.sampleRaw: Tell you what, for a small price I'll give you the info I know about.

entries.source: If you change your mind, you know where to find me!
entries.translation: 如果你改变主意了，你知道去哪儿找我！
entries.sampleRaw: If you change your mind, you know where to find me!

entries.source: [hint]
Are you trying to scam me?
entries.sampleRaw: Are you trying to scam me?

entries.source: You don't have enough money.
Come back when you have enough for the tip.
entries.translation: 等你凑够小费再回来吧。
entries.sampleRaw: Come back when you have enough for the tip.

entries.source: Did you forget the tip?
Just for you I'll tell you it again at no charge!
entries.translation: 就冲你，我免费再告诉你一遍！
entries.sampleRaw: Just for you I'll tell you it again at no charge!

entries.source: [previous hint]
Remember, you need to DIG to find the treasure!
entries.translation: 记住，你需要挖掘才能找到宝藏！
entries.sampleRaw: Remember, you need to DIG to find the treasure!

entries.source: Sorry I dont have any more info.
entries.translation: 抱歉，我没有更多信息了。
entries.sampleRaw: Sorry I dont have any more info.

entries.source: Come back in 3 SkyBlock days and I might know something new.
entries.translation: 3 个 SkyBlock 天后再来，我可能就知道新消息了。
entries.sampleRaw: Come back in §93§f SkyBlock days and I might know something new.
entries.numericSource: Come back in {{N0}} SkyBlock days and I might know something new.
entries.numericTranslation: {{N0}} 个 SkyBlock 天后再来，我可能就知道新消息了。

entries.source: Glad to see you again adventurer!
entries.translation: 很高兴再次见到你，冒险者！
entries.sampleRaw: Glad to see you again adventurer!

entries.source: You know the drill, for a small fee I will give you some info on the treasure.
entries.translation: 你懂的，只要付一点小费，我就给你一些关于宝藏的信息。
entries.sampleRaw: You know the drill, for a small fee I will give you some info on the treasure.

entries.source: Hello there, stranger!
I fell down into this ravine a couple days ago and can't climb out.
entries.translation: 几天前我掉进了这个峡谷，爬不出去了。
entries.sampleRaw: I fell down into this ravine a couple days ago and can't climb out.

entries.source: My friend Jake said he would come get me but he hasn't arrived yet.
entries.translation: 我的朋友Jake说他会来接我，但他还没到。
entries.sampleRaw: My friend Jake said he would come get me but he hasn't arrived yet.

entries.source: Could you bring me food until he gets here?
entries.translation: 在他来之前，你能给我带点吃的吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Could you bring me food until he gets here?

entries.source: Could you get me # of this food?
entries.translation: 你能给我拿 # 个这种食物吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Could you get me §7# §fof this food?

entries.source: The food I want is <food>.
This isn't the food I wanted, please get me the correct food.
entries.translation: 这不是我想要的食物，请给我拿正确的食物。
entries.sampleRaw: This isn't the food I wanted, please get me the correct food.

entries.source: I asked for food that is a <food>.
entries.sampleRaw: I asked for food that is a §7<food>§f.

entries.source: This isn't the correct amount I asked for.
entries.translation: 这不是我要的正确数量。
entries.sampleRaw: This isn't the correct amount I asked for.

entries.source: I asked for <amount> of this item.
entries.translation: 我要的是 <amount> 个这种物品。
entries.sampleRaw: I asked for §7<amount>§f of this item.

entries.source: Thanks for the food.
This should fill me up for 144 SkyBlock days.
entries.translation: 这些应该够我撑 144 个 SkyBlock 天了。
entries.sampleRaw: This should fill me up for 144 SkyBlock days.
entries.numericSource: This should fill me up for {{N0}} SkyBlock days.
entries.numericTranslation: 这些应该够我撑 {{N0}} 个 SkyBlock 天了。

entries.source: Come back before then so I don't perish!
entries.translation: 在那之前回来，别让我饿死了！
entries.sampleRaw: Come back before then so I don't perish!

entries.source: I appreciate the effort but you recently gave me food.
entries.translation: 我很感激你的心意，但你最近刚给过我食物。
entries.sampleRaw: I appreciate the effort but you recently gave me food.

entries.source: Come back later with more food!
entries.translation: 晚点再带更多食物来吧！
entries.sampleRaw: Come back later with more food!

entries.source: Thanks for the food!
I think I see Jake on the edge of the ravine!
entries.translation: 我想我在峡谷边缘看到Jake了！
entries.sampleRaw: I think I see Jake on the edge of the ravine!

entries.source: Thank you for feeding me all these days, meet me at the house near the portal and I will give you something to show my gratitude!
entries.translation: 谢谢你这些天一直给我送吃的，到传送门附近的房子来找我，我会给你点东西表达我的谢意！
entries.sampleRaw: Thank you for feeding me all these days, meet me at the house near the portal and I will give you something to show my gratitude!

entries.source: Thank you for feeding me all those days.
entries.translation: 谢谢你那些天一直给我送吃的。
entries.sampleRaw: Thank you for feeding me all those days.

entries.source: To show my gratitude, please have this!
entries.translation: 为了表达我的谢意，请收下这个！
entries.sampleRaw: To show my gratitude, please have this!

entries.source: Hello there, I seem to be stuck here with no good food to eat, could you bring me some square orange fruits?
entries.translation: 你好啊，我好像被困在这里，没有好吃的了，你能给我带些方形的橙色水果吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Hello there, I seem to be stuck here with no good food to eat, could you bring me some square orange fruits?

entries.source: Thanks so much for feeding me, please take this as a token of my gratitude.
entries.translation: 非常感谢你给我送吃的，请收下这个作为我谢意的象征。
entries.sampleRaw: Thanks so much for feeding me, please take this as a token of my gratitude.

entries.source: I guess I'll just go hungry then...
entries.translation: 那我想我只能继续挨饿了……
entries.sampleRaw: I guess I'll just go hungry then...

entries.source: My hiking buddy has been missing for a couple days...
entries.translation: 我的徒步伙伴已经失踪好几天了……
entries.sampleRaw: §fMy hiking buddy has been missing for a couple days...

entries.source: He said he was going to go explore the gorge, but that was a while ago.
entries.translation: 他说要去探索峡谷，但那已经是很久以前的事了。
entries.sampleRaw: §fHe said he was going to go explore the gorge, but that was a while ago.

entries.source: I'm getting worried, could you go check on him?
entries.translation: 我越来越担心了，你能去看看他吗？
entries.sampleRaw: §fI'm getting worried, could you go check on him?

entries.source: Thank you for saving my friend!
entries.sampleRaw: Thank you for saving my friend!

entries.source: My hiking buddy still hasn't returned. I'm afraid the worst has happened and he's starved to death...
entries.translation: 我的徒步伙伴还没回来。我怕最坏的情况发生了，他饿死了……
entries.sampleRaw: My hiking buddy still hasn't returned. I'm afraid the worst has happened and he's starved to death...

entries.source: I'm going to send someone down soon to find him.
entries.translation: 我很快就会派人下去找他。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm going to send someone down soon to find him.

entries.source: My last hiking buddy didn't make it out of the gorge...
entries.translation: 我上一个徒步伙伴没能走出峡谷……
entries.sampleRaw: My last hiking buddy didn't make it out of the gorge...

entries.source: My new hiking buddy went there a couple days ago to explore but he hasn't come back!
entries.translation: 我的新徒步伙伴几天前去那里探索，但到现在还没回来！
entries.sampleRaw: My new hiking buddy went there a couple days ago to explore but he hasn't come back!

entries.source: Could you go check up on him?
entries.sampleRaw: Could you go check up on him?

entries.source: I'm planning to head back into the gorge to fetch my hiker friend, but I'll need some meat to cook before I head in there.
entries.translation: 我打算回到峡谷去接我的徒步伙伴，但进去之前我需要一些肉来做饭。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm planning to head back into the gorge to fetch my hiker friend, but I'll need some meat to cook before I head in there.

entries.source: Thanks! I'll be heading to look for him as soon as possible.
entries.translation: 谢谢！我会尽快出发去找他。
entries.sampleRaw: Thanks! I'll be heading to look for him as soon as possible.

entries.source: That's alright. I can always head into the Oasis to hunt down some sheep.
entries.translation: 没关系。我随时可以去绿洲猎几只羊。
entries.sampleRaw: That's alright. I can always head into the Oasis to hunt down some sheep.

entries.source: You will have 10 minutes to find the mob from when you accept the task.
entries.translation: 从你接受任务起，你将有 10 分钟的时间找到那只怪物。
entries.sampleRaw: You will have 10 minutes to find the mob from when you accept the task.
entries.numericSource: You will have {{N0}} minutes to find the mob from when you accept the task.
entries.numericTranslation: 从你接受任务起，你将有 {{N0}} 分钟的时间找到那只怪物。

entries.source: Any longer than that and the animal will run away!
entries.translation: 超过这个时间，动物就会逃走！
entries.sampleRaw: Any longer than that and the animal will run away!

entries.source: If you change your mind, you know where to find me!
entries.translation: 如果你改变主意，你知道去哪儿找我！
entries.sampleRaw: If you change your mind, you know where to find me!

entries.source: You can find your [animal rarity] animal near the [location].
entries.translation: 你可以在[location]附近找到你的[animal rarity]动物。
entries.sampleRaw: You can find your [animal rarity] animal near the [location].

entries.source: Sorry I don't have any animals for you to hunt.
entries.translation: 抱歉，我目前没有动物供你狩猎。
entries.sampleRaw: Sorry I don't have any animals for you to hunt.

entries.source: Try coming back in [#]s!
You already have a mob spawned! Hunt that mob first!
entries.translation: 你已经生成了一只怪物！先猎杀那只怪物！
entries.sampleRaw: You already have a mob spawned! Hunt that mob first!

entries.source: I couldn't locate any animals. Come back in a little bit!
entries.translation: 我找不到任何动物。过一会儿再来吧！
entries.sampleRaw: I couldn't locate any animals. Come back in a little bit!

entries.source: ✆ Eh, I still have an Abiflip.
entries.sampleRaw: §b ✆§f Eh, I still have an Abiflip.

entries.source: ✆ It has 3 contact slots and I already have Tammy and Tony.
entries.translation: ✆ 它有 3 个联系人槽位,而我已经有 Tammy 和 Tony 了.
entries.sampleRaw: §b ✆§f It has 3 contact slots and I already have Tammy and Tony.
entries.numericSource: ✆ It has {{N0}} contact slots and I already have Tammy and Tony.
entries.numericTranslation: ✆ 它有 {{N0}} 个联系人槽位,而我已经有 Tammy 和 Tony 了.

entries.source: ✆ I heard the new models are nice, but they're too smart for me!
entries.translation: ✆ 我听说新型号很不错,但它们对我来说太智能了!
entries.sampleRaw: §b ✆§f I heard the new models are nice, but they're too smart for me!

entries.source: ✆ I could add you for let's say... 24 Pelts and 1,000,000 coins?
entries.translation: ✆ 我可以把你加进去,价格嘛……24 张兽皮和 1,000,000 枚硬币?
entries.sampleRaw: §b ✆§f I could add you for let's say... §524 Pelts§f and §61,000,000 coins§f?
entries.numericSource: ✆ I could add you for let's say... {{N0}} Pelts and {{N1}} coins?
entries.numericTranslation: ✆ 我可以把你加进去,价格嘛……{{N0}} 张兽皮和 {{N1}} 枚硬币?

entries.source: ✆ That's awesome, but now my Abiflip is full.
entries.translation: ✆ 太棒了,但我的 Abiflip 现在满了.
entries.sampleRaw: §b ✆§f That's awesome, but now my Abiflip is full.

entries.source: ✆ You don't have what it takes!
entries.sampleRaw: §b ✆§f You don't have what it takes!

entries.source: ✆ I'm currently hunting! Don't call again!
entries.translation: ✆ 我正在狩猎！别再打来了！

entries.source: I've been tracking an animal for the past few days. Got anything I could use as bait?
entries.translation: 我追踪一只动物已经好几天了。你有什么能当诱饵的东西吗？
entries.sampleRaw: I've been tracking an animal for the past few days. Got anything I could use as bait?

entries.source: This should do nicely. I'll have plenty of pelts by the end of the day.
entries.translation: 这个正合适。今天结束前我就能收获不少兽皮。
entries.sampleRaw: This should do nicely. I'll have plenty of pelts by the end of the day.

entries.source: Looks like I'll have to catch it the old fashioned way.
entries.translation: 看来我得用老办法抓住它了。
entries.sampleRaw: Looks like I'll have to catch it the old fashioned way.

entries.source: ✆ Yo bro, how's it going?
✆ Such lovely weather in this little ol' cave today, isn't it?
entries.translation: ✆ 今天这个小山洞里的天气真不错，对吧？
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fSuch lovely weather in this little ol' cave today, isn't it?

entries.source: ✆ I guess you want my Abiphone Contact, huh?
entries.translation: ✆ 我猜你是想要我的 Abiphone 联系人吧？
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fI guess you want my §9Abiphone Contact§f, huh?

entries.source: ✆ Well, I'll give you it if you play a game with me.
entries.translation: ✆ 好吧，如果你和我玩个游戏，我就给你。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fWell, I'll give you it if you play a game with me.

entries.source: ✆ Not much else to do around here, really.
entries.translation: ✆ 这附近真没什么别的事可做。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fNot much else to do around here, really.

entries.source: ✆ How about you guess my favorite animal?
entries.translation: ✆ 不如你猜猜我最喜欢的动物是什么？
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fHow about you guess my favorite animal?

entries.source: ✆ I'll let you know if you get it right.
entries.translation: ✆ 你要是猜对了，我会告诉你的。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fI'll let you know if you get it right.

entries.source: ✆ Haha yeah, my favorite animal is a horse.
entries.translation: ✆ 哈哈没错，我最喜欢的动物是马。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fHaha yeah, my favorite animal is a §ahorse§f.

entries.source: ✆ Nice one bro.
✆ Well, I'm a man of my word. Here's my contact.
entries.translation: ✆ 好吧，我说话算话。这是我的联系方式。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fWell, I'm a man of my word. Here's my contact.

entries.source: Different tiers of animals have different sets of abilities.
entries.translation: 不同等级的动物拥有不同的能力组合。
entries.sampleRaw: Different tiers of animals have different sets of abilities.

entries.source: Different animals also have unique abilities too!
entries.translation: 不同的动物也各自拥有独特的能力！
entries.sampleRaw: Different animals also have unique abilities too!

entries.source: Hey there, I'm the Auction Master.
entries.sampleRaw: Hey there, I'm the Auction Master.

entries.source: At the auction house you can put your valuable items up for auction!
entries.translation: 在拍卖行，你可以把你的贵重物品拿去拍卖！
entries.sampleRaw: At the auction house you can put your valuable items up for auction!

entries.source: You may also want to check back here to see what items other players are selling to see if you can get a good deal.
entries.translation: 你也可以常回来看看其他玩家在卖什么，说不定能捡到好价。
entries.sampleRaw: You may also want to check back here to see what items other players are selling to see if you can get a good deal.

entries.source: Talk to me if you would like to start your first auction or if you want to see the items currently being sold.
entries.translation: 如果你想开启你的第一场拍卖，或者想看看当前正在出售的物品，就来找我谈谈。
entries.sampleRaw: Talk to me if you would like to start your first auction or if you want to see the items currently being sold.

entries.source: Hello there, adventurer!
I work as the operator of this windmill.
entries.translation: 我是这座风车的操作员。
entries.sampleRaw: I work as the operator of this windmill.

entries.source: However, I seem to have broken some key components in the structure.
entries.translation: 不过，我好像把结构里的一些关键部件弄坏了。
entries.sampleRaw: However, I seem to have broken some key components in the structure.

entries.source: Could you help me fix it?
entries.sampleRaw: Could you help me fix it?

entries.source: I need a lot of string to fix the pulley system, could you bring me 64 of it?
entries.translation: 我需要大量线来修复滑轮系统，你能给我带64个来吗？
entries.sampleRaw: I need a lot of string to fix the pulley system, could you bring me 64 of it?
entries.numericSource: I need a lot of string to fix the pulley system, could you bring me {{N0}} of it?
entries.numericTranslation: 我需要大量线来修复滑轮系统，你能给我带{{N0}}个来吗？

entries.source: This isn't what I need!
I need some cobblestone to correct the base of the windmill, could you bring me 64 of it?
entries.translation: 我需要一些圆石来校正风车的底座，你能给我带64个来吗？
entries.sampleRaw: I need some cobblestone to correct the base of the windmill, could you bring me 64 of it?
entries.numericSource: I need some cobblestone to correct the base of the windmill, could you bring me {{N0}} of it?
entries.numericTranslation: 我需要一些圆石来校正风车的底座，你能给我带{{N0}}个来吗？

entries.source: Thank you!
Now that my windmill is up and running, I'll open my shop to you so you don't have to go back to the Village.
entries.translation: 既然我的风车已经运转起来了，我就向你开放我的商店，这样你就不用再跑回村庄了。
entries.sampleRaw: Now that my windmill is up and running, I'll open my shop to you so you don't have to go back to the §bVillage§f.

entries.source: During the Spooky Festival, you can collect Candy by killing mobs or fishing.
entries.translation: 在万圣节期间，你可以通过击杀怪物或钓鱼来收集糖果。
entries.sampleRaw: During the §6Spooky Festival§f, you can collect §5Candy§f by killing mobs or fishing.

entries.source: I accept Candy in exchange for exclusively spooky items!
entries.translation: 我收糖果，用来交换专属的万圣节物品！
entries.sampleRaw: I accept Candy in exchange for exclusively spooky items!

entries.source: Each Spooky Festival, the top Candy-collecting players can earn even spookier rewards!
entries.translation: 每届万圣节，收集糖果最多的玩家可以获得更诡异的奖励！
entries.sampleRaw: Each §6Spooky Festival§f, the top Candy-collecting players can earn even spookier rewards!

entries.source: Click me again to open my shop.
entries.translation: 再次点击我即可打开我的商店。
entries.sampleRaw: Click me again to open my shop.

entries.source: ✆ You want to be able to call me anytime?
entries.translation: ✆ 你想随时都能联系到我？
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f You want to be able to call me anytime?

entries.source: ✆ Well that's not possible, I'm only available at night.
entries.translation: ✆ 那可不行，我只在夜间出现。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f Well that's not possible, I'm only available at night.

entries.source: ✆ If you give me 64 Purple Candy and 6 Ectoplasm, I might give you my contact.
entries.translation: ✆ 如果你给我64个紫色糖果和6个灵质，我或许会把联系方式给你。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f If you give me 64 §5Purple Candy§f and 6 §9Ectoplasm§f, I might give you my contact.
entries.numericSource: ✆ If you give me {{N0}} Purple Candy and {{N1}} Ectoplasm, I might give you my contact.
entries.numericTranslation: ✆ 如果你给我{{N0}}个紫色糖果和{{N1}}个灵质，我或许会把联系方式给你。

entries.source: ✆ Mhm... Your face just isn't very scary...
entries.translation: ✆ 嗯……你的脸实在不太吓人啊……
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f Mhm... Your face just isn't very scary...

entries.source: ✆ But it's not your fault I suppose, here take my contact.
entries.translation: ✆ 不过我想这也不能怪你，来，拿着我的联系方式。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f But it's not your fault I suppose, here take my contact.

entries.source: ✆ Listen buddy it's not because I gave you my contact that it gives you the right to wake me up in the middle of the day.
entries.translation: ✆ 听着，伙计，我给了你联系方式，不代表你有权在大白天把我叫醒。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f Listen buddy it's not because I gave you my contact that it gives you the right to wake me up in the middle of the day.

entries.source: ✆ Call me back tonight or I'm blocking you.
entries.translation: ✆ 今晚再打给我，不然我就把你拉黑。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f Call me back tonight or I'm blocking you.

entries.source: Looking to protect yourself or light up some tunnels?
entries.translation: 想保护自己，还是想点亮几条隧道？
entries.sampleRaw: Looking to protect yourself or light up some tunnels?

entries.source: We've got torches, lanterns. Pretty much anything to suit your needs.
entries.translation: 我们有火把、灯笼。几乎能满足你的一切需求。
entries.sampleRaw: We've got torches, lanterns. Pretty much anything to suit your needs.

entries.source: Good doin' business with ya.
I'm looking to make some Jack o' Lanterns to help light up the Crystal Hollows - maybe you can help me out?
entries.translation: 我想做些南瓜灯来帮忙照亮水晶洞窟——也许你能帮我一把？
entries.sampleRaw: I'm looking to make some Jack o' Lanterns to help light up the Crystal Hollows - maybe you can help me out?

entries.source: Nice doin' business with ya! Here's some copper in return.
entries.translation: 跟你做生意真愉快！这些铜是给你的回报。
entries.sampleRaw: Nice doin' business with ya! Here's some copper in return.

entries.source: Not a problem, thanks for your time anyways.
entries.translation: 没问题，还是谢谢你能来。
entries.sampleRaw: Not a problem, thanks for your time anyways.

entries.source: Hop in and we'll be off!
entries.sampleRaw: Hop in and we'll be off!

entries.source: See that empty, weak metal box? Good! That's your cart, hop in!
entries.translation: 看到那个空荡荡、弱不禁风的金属箱子了吗？很好！那就是你的矿车，快上去！
entries.sampleRaw: See that empty, weak metal box? Good! That's your cart, hop in!

entries.source: Hold tight, it's going to be a bump ride!
entries.translation: 抓稳了，这一路可够颠的！
entries.sampleRaw: Hold tight, it's going to be a bump ride!

entries.source: Thanks for choosing Dwarven Mine Co. - we operate 24\/7 across the whole mine!
entries.translation: 感谢您选择矮人矿业公司——我们在整座矿场运营 24\/7！
entries.sampleRaw: Thanks for choosing Dwarven Mine Co. - we operate 24\/7 across the whole mine!
entries.numericSource: Thanks for choosing Dwarven Mine Co. - we operate {{N0}}\/{{N1}} across the whole mine!
entries.numericTranslation: 感谢您选择矮人矿业公司——我们在整座矿场运营 {{N0}}\/{{N1}}！

entries.source: Now, please climb aboard before your cart leaves without you.
entries.translation: 现在，请赶紧上车，别让矿车把你丢下了。
entries.sampleRaw: Now, please climb aboard before your cart leaves without you.

entries.source: Again.
Let's a go!
Ever been in one of these before? No?
entries.translation: 以前坐过这种玩意儿吗？没有？
entries.sampleRaw: Ever been in one of these before? No?

entries.source: Well...
I'm sure you'll be fine!
Last guy who was in this cart didn't feel too well so watch out he might have left a surprise in there.
entries.translation: 上一个坐这辆矿车的人感觉不太舒服，所以小心点，他可能在里面留了个惊喜。
entries.sampleRaw: Last guy who was in this cart didn't feel too well so watch out he might have left a surprise in there.

entries.source: Quickly now the Minecart is leaving!
entries.sampleRaw: Quickly now the Minecart is leaving!

entries.source: Welcome to the Dwarven Village!
Off to the court? I would tell you to talk to the King but I don't know who he is anymore...
entries.translation: 要去王庭？我本想让你去找国王谈谈，可我已经不知道他现在是谁了……
entries.sampleRaw: Off to the court? I would tell you to talk to the King but I don't know who he is anymore...

entries.source: Did you know the Court is almost as old as the throne room, it's got some lovely flower beds too!
entries.translation: 你知道王庭几乎和王座厅一样古老吗？那里还有几片漂亮的花坛呢！
entries.sampleRaw: Did you know the Court is almost as old as the throne room, it's got some lovely flower beds too!

entries.source: See those statues? They are the former Kings, Bunumir Ironbeard and Skordous Pebblebeard, guarding the entrance to the mines.
entries.translation: 看到那些雕像了吗？那是前任国王布努米尔·铁须和斯科杜斯·卵石须，他们守卫着矿场入口。
entries.sampleRaw: See those statues? They are the former Kings, Bunumir Ironbeard and Skordous Pebblebeard, guarding the entrance to the mines.

entries.source: Aristocrat passage ey? Best of luck to you.
entries.translation: 贵族通道是吧？祝你好运。
entries.sampleRaw: Aristocrat passage ey? Best of luck to you.

entries.source: Did you know that the Forge is so big it has to have multiple forging stations.
entries.translation: 你知道锻造所大得必须设好几个锻造台吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Did you know that the Forge is so big it has to have multiple forging stations.

entries.source: You ever seen those Goblins? Some say they lay eggs. How weird.
entries.translation: 你见过那些哥布林吗？有人说它们会下蛋。真奇怪。
entries.sampleRaw: You ever seen those Goblins? Some say they lay eggs. How weird.

entries.source: Goblin's are not the only creatures that dwell here. Rumor has it dirt monsters linger in these parts too...
entries.translation: 哥布林并不是这里唯一的生物。有传言说，泥土怪物也在这片区域徘徊……
entries.sampleRaw: Goblin's are not the only creatures that dwell here. Rumor has it dirt monsters linger in these parts too...

entries.source: Fell into a state of disrepair following an accident.
entries.translation: 在一次事故后便年久失修了。
entries.sampleRaw: Fell into a state of disrepair following an accident.

entries.source: I once stumbled upon a hidden lake in these parts, Some unsavory characters living there robbed me of all my gold!
entries.translation: 我曾在这片区域偶然发现一个隐秘的湖泊，住在那里的几个不三不四的家伙抢走了我所有的金子！
