entries.sampleRaw: I once stumbled upon a hidden lake in these parts, Some unsavory characters living there robbed me of all my gold!

entries.source: You came down the lift? I never thought you could get this far down! Someone should have called this place the Deeper Caverns!
entries.translation: 你是坐升降梯下来的？我没想到你能下到这么深的地方！这地方真该叫更深洞穴！
entries.sampleRaw: You came down the lift? I never thought you could get this far down! Someone should have called this place the Deeper Caverns!

entries.source: Hey, if you find any Titanium down here let me know! I wanted to buy some of that stuff for a new pickaxe.
entries.translation: 嘿，如果你在下面找到钛，告诉我一声！我想买一些来做把新镐子。
entries.sampleRaw: Hey, if you find any Titanium down here let me know! I wanted to buy some of that stuff for a new pickaxe.

entries.source: Hop on in and I'll get you going!
entries.translation: 快上来吧，我这就送你出发！
entries.sampleRaw: Hop on in and I'll get you going!

entries.source: Hop in and we'll be off!
entries.sampleRaw: Hop in and we'll be off!

entries.source: You ever seen those Goblins? Some say they lay eggs. How weird.
entries.translation: 你见过那些哥布林吗？有人说它们会下蛋。真奇怪。
entries.sampleRaw: You ever seen those Goblins? Some say they lay eggs. How weird.

entries.source: Goblin's are not the only creatures that dwell here. Rumor has it dirt monsters linger in these parts too...
entries.translation: 哥布林并不是这里唯一的生物。有传言说，泥土怪物也在这片区域徘徊……
entries.sampleRaw: Goblin's are not the only creatures that dwell here. Rumor has it dirt monsters linger in these parts too...

entries.source: I once stumbled upon a hidden lake in these parts, Some unsavory characters living there robbed me of all my gold!
entries.translation: 我曾在这一带偶然发现一个隐秘的湖泊，住在那里的几个不三不四的家伙抢走了我所有的金子！
entries.sampleRaw: I once stumbled upon a hidden lake in these parts, Some unsavory characters living there robbed me of all my gold!

entries.source: You came down the lift? I never thought you could get this far down! Someone should have called this place the Deeper Caverns!
entries.translation: 你是坐升降梯下来的？我从没想过你能下到这么深的地方！这地方真该叫更深洞穴！
entries.sampleRaw: You came down the lift? I never thought you could get this far down! Someone should have called this place the Deeper Caverns!

entries.source: Hey, if you find any Titanium down here let me know! I wanted to buy some of that stuff for a new pickaxe.
entries.translation: 嘿，如果你在下面找到任何钛，记得告诉我！我想买一些来打造一把新镐子。
entries.sampleRaw: Hey, if you find any Titanium down here let me know! I wanted to buy some of that stuff for a new pickaxe.

entries.source: Thanks for choosing Dwarven Mine Co. - we operate 24/7 across the whole mine!
entries.translation: 感谢您选择矮人矿场公司——我们在整座矿场运营 24/7！
entries.sampleRaw: Thanks for choosing Dwarven Mine Co. - we operate 24/7 across the whole mine!
entries.numericSource: Thanks for choosing Dwarven Mine Co. - we operate {{N0}}/{{N1}} across the whole mine!
entries.numericTranslation: 感谢您选择矮人矿场公司——我们在整座矿场运营 {{N0}}/{{N1}}！

entries.source: Gemstones have magical properties and can be applied to some special items.
entries.translation: 宝石具有魔法特性，可以镶嵌到某些特殊物品上。
entries.sampleRaw: §aGemstones§f have magical properties and can be applied to some special items.

entries.source: There are 12 different Gemstones, all of them having their own unique properties!
entries.translation: 一共有 12 种不同的宝石，每一种都有自己独特的特性！
entries.sampleRaw: There are §a12§f different Gemstones, all of them having their own unique properties!
entries.numericSource: There are {{N0}} different Gemstones, all of them having their own unique properties!
entries.numericTranslation: 一共有 {{N0}} 种不同的宝石，每一种都有自己独特的特性！

entries.source: For example, adding Ruby to armor will increase its ❤ Health, while Jasper increases ❁ Strength.
entries.translation: 例如，给盔甲镶嵌红宝石会增加 ❤ 生命值，而碧玉则会增加 ❁ 力量。
entries.sampleRaw: For example, adding §cRuby§f to armor will increase its §c❤ Health§f, while §dJasper§f increases §c❁ Strength§f.

entries.source: The more pure the Gemstone - the stronger the effect!
entries.translation: 宝石越纯净，效果就越强！
entries.sampleRaw: The more pure the Gemstone - the stronger the effect!

entries.source: Only some items can have Gemstones applied, and you can remove them any time.
entries.translation: 只有部分物品可以镶嵌宝石，而且你可以随时将它们取下。
entries.sampleRaw: Only some items can have Gemstones applied, and you can remove them any time.

entries.source: Use the Gemstone Grinder next to me to apply Gemstones to items!
entries.translation: 使用我旁边的宝石研磨机来给物品镶嵌宝石！
entries.sampleRaw: Use the §dGemstone Grinder§f next to me to apply Gemstones to items!

entries.source: There are several qualities of Gemstone, including Rough, Flawed, and Fine.
entries.translation: 宝石有几种品质，包括粗糙、有瑕和精细。
entries.sampleRaw: There are several qualities of Gemstone, including Rough, §aFlawed§f, and §9Fine§f.

entries.source: The highest quality of Gemstone - Perfect - will increase your stats the most!
entries.translation: 最高品质的宝石——完美——能最大程度提升你的属性！
entries.sampleRaw: The highest quality of Gemstone - §6Perfect§f - will increase your stats the most!

entries.source: Not all items can have Gemstones applied to them.
entries.translation: 并非所有物品都能镶嵌宝石。
entries.sampleRaw: Not all items can have Gemstones applied to them.

entries.source: Check out the Gemstone Grinder menu to check which items work with it!
entries.translation: 查看宝石研磨机菜单，看看哪些物品可以镶嵌！
entries.sampleRaw: Check out the §dGemstone Grinder§f menu to check which items work with it!

entries.source: ✆ Sure I can give you my contact, but first let's play a little game!
entries.translation: ✆ 当然可以给你我的联系方式，不过我们先玩个小游戏吧！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f Sure I can give you my contact, but first let's play a little game!

entries.source: ✆ You have to give me Flawless gemstones in the right order.
entries.translation: ✆ 你得按正确的顺序给我无瑕宝石。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f You have to give me Flawless gemstones in the right order.

entries.source: ✆ And keep in mind, there's no Jasper nor Opal in here!
entries.translation: ✆ 记住，这里面没有碧玉，也没有蛋白石！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f And keep in mind, there's no Jasper nor Opal in here!

entries.source: ✆ That's not the correct gemstone!
✆ You picked the wrong gemstone in our game!
entries.translation: ✆ 你在我们的游戏里选错了宝石！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§c You picked the wrong gemstone in our game!

entries.source: ✆ Now you're on a 20 seconds timeout as
entries.translation: ✆ 现在你被罚时 20 秒，作为
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§c Now you're on a 20 seconds timeout as
entries.numericSource: ✆ Now you're on a {{N0}} seconds timeout as
entries.numericTranslation: ✆ 现在你被罚时 {{N0}} 秒，作为

entries.source: ✆ Yep, ❤ Flawless Ruby Gemstone!
✆ Yep, ⸕ Flawless Amber Gemstone!
✆ Yep, ✧ Flawless Topaz Gemstone!
✆ Yep, ☘ Flawless Jade Gemstone!
✆ Yep, ✎ Flawless Sapphire Gemstone!
✆ Yep, ❈ Flawless Amethyst Gemstone!
✆ That's it!
✆ All gemstones of the rainbow!
✆ Superb!
Ough!
Auch!
Stop that!
This hurts!
You need to be taught some manners.
entries.sampleRaw: You need to be taught some manners.

entries.source: You are going to regret this!
entries.sampleRaw: You are going to regret this!

entries.source: That's enough! Get over here!
Let's settle this.
Hey <player name>!!!
Hello [player]! What brings you to my workshop? I forge the newest and most powerful arrows in all of SkyBlock!
entries.translation: 你好 [player]!是什么风把你吹到我的工坊来了?我锻造的是整个 SkyBlock 最新、最强的箭!

styleMappings.! What brings you to my workshop? I forg: !是什么风把你吹到我的工坊来了?我锻造的是整个 SkyBlock 最新、最强的箭!

entries.sampleRaw: Hello §7[player]§f! What brings you to my workshop? I forge the newest and most powerful arrows in all of SkyBlock!

entries.source: Wow, you can really shoot a bow!
entries.sampleRaw: §fWow, you can really shoot a bow!

entries.source: Well, a deal's a deal! Come to me any time and I'll forge you whatever arrows you need for adventures.
entries.translation: 好吧，一言为定！随时来找我，我会为你锻造冒险所需的任何箭。
entries.sampleRaw: §fWell, a deal's a deal! Come to me any time and I'll forge you whatever arrows you need for adventures.

entries.source: I have only one condition... These are powerful arrows, they can't fall into the wrong hands so keep them in your quiver and don't share them with anyone.
entries.translation: 我只有一个条件……这些箭威力强大，绝不能落入坏人手中，所以把它们留在你的箭袋里，不要和任何人分享。
entries.sampleRaw: §fI have only one condition... These are powerful arrows, they can't fall into the wrong hands so keep them in your quiver and don't share them with anyone.

entries.source: ✆ Uh... maybe before you dare get my contact, you should prove yourself as a real archer first.
entries.translation: ✆ 呃……也许在你敢要我的联系方式之前，你该先证明自己是个真正的弓箭手。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fUh... maybe before you dare get my contact, you should prove yourself as a real archer first.

entries.source: ✆ My Abiphone contact?
entries.translation: ✆ 我的 Abiphone 联系方式？

entries.source: ✆ Listen pal, I've been nice with you but it's strictly business etiquette.
entries.translation: ✆ 听着，伙计，我一直对你很客气，但这可是严格的商业礼仪。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fListen pal, I've been nice with you but it's strictly business etiquette.

entries.source: ✆ I'm freaking Jax the Archer, you see those lanterns? I can clear them all in 11 seconds!
entries.translation: ✆ 我可是大名鼎鼎的弓箭手 Jax，看到那些灯笼了吗？我能在 11 秒内全部射掉！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fI'm freaking Jax the Archer, you see those lanterns? I can clear them all in 11 seconds!
entries.numericSource: ✆ I'm freaking Jax the Archer, you see those lanterns? I can clear them all in {{N0}} seconds!
entries.numericTranslation: ✆ 我可是大名鼎鼎的弓箭手 Jax，看到那些灯笼了吗？我能在 {{N0}} 秒内全部射掉！

entries.source: ✆ I'm just that good!
✆ If you want my contact you'll have to show me you can hit them all in UNDER 11 seconds.
entries.translation: ✆ 如果你想要我的联系方式，你得向我证明你能在 11 秒以内全部射中。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fIf you want my contact you'll have to show me you can hit them all in UNDER 11 seconds.
entries.numericSource: ✆ If you want my contact you'll have to show me you can hit them all in UNDER {{N0}} seconds.
entries.numericTranslation: ✆ 如果你想要我的联系方式，你得向我证明你能在 {{N0}} 秒以内全部射中。

entries.source: ✆ Otherwise you'll have to give me 10M coins to get my contact, no less.
entries.translation: ✆ 否则你就得给我 10M 硬币来换我的联系方式，一分都不能少。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fOtherwise you'll have to give me §610M§f coins to get my contact, no less.
entries.numericSource: ✆ Otherwise you'll have to give me {{N0}}M coins to get my contact, no less.
entries.numericTranslation: ✆ 否则你就得给我 {{N0}}M 硬币来换我的联系方式，一分都不能少。

entries.source: ✆ What do you say, buddy?
✆ Delusional are we today?
✆ Alright let me know when you realize the massive skill gap between us.
entries.translation: ✆ 好吧，等你意识到我们之间巨大的技术差距时再告诉我。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fAlright let me know when you realize the massive skill gap between us.

entries.source: ✆ I unlocked Target Partice IV for you, good luck kiddo.
entries.translation: ✆ 我为你解锁了目标练习 IV，祝你好运，小子。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fI unlocked §4Target Partice IV§f for you, good luck kiddo.

entries.source: ✆ #, really???
✆ Did you...
✆ I mean...
✆ wat. How??
✆ Take my contact and go.
entries.translation: ✆ 拿着我的联系方式，走吧。

entries.source: ✆ You're poor too, huh?
✆ Come back when you have the money.
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fCome back when you have the money.

entries.source: ✆ Yep, that's right, I'm the best.
✆ Consider yourself lucky you only had to pay 10 million, I could easily have added a zero.
entries.translation: ✆ 你只付了 10 百万就该偷着乐了，我完全可以再加个零。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fConsider yourself lucky you only had to pay 10 million, I could easily have added a zero.
entries.numericSource: ✆ Consider yourself lucky you only had to pay {{N0}} million, I could easily have added a zero.
entries.numericTranslation: ✆ 你只付了 {{N0}} 百万就该偷着乐了，我完全可以再加个零。

entries.source: Y'know now that we are getting deeper and deeper a lot of these blocks are getting harder to mine!
entries.translation: 你知道的，现在我们挖得越来越深，很多方块也越来越难挖了！
entries.sampleRaw: Y'know now that we are getting deeper and deeper a lot of these blocks are getting harder to mine!

entries.source: Luckily I have a handy guide right here for you!
entries.translation: 幸运的是，我正好给你准备了一份方便的指南！
entries.sampleRaw: Luckily I have a §ehandy guide§f right here for you!

entries.source: Hey you! Can you bring me the hardest block you can mine?
entries.translation: 嘿，你！你能把你挖得动的最硬的方块带给我吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Hey you! Can you bring me the hardest block you can mine?

entries.source: Cactus? I'm sure you could do better, but I'll take it for now.
entries.translation: 仙人掌？我相信你能做得更好，不过现在我就先收下了。
entries.sampleRaw: Cactus? I'm sure you could do better, but I'll take it for now.

entries.source: Just as I thought...I am talking to a softie!
entries.translation: 果然如我所料……我是在跟一个软蛋说话！
entries.sampleRaw: Just as I thought...I am talking to a softie!

entries.source: This citadel used to be the epicenter of fructuous engineering.
entries.translation: 这座堡垒曾是丰硕工程学的中心。
entries.sampleRaw: This citadel used to be the epicenter of fructuous engineering.

entries.source: The inhabitants, Precursors, as they were once called, laid the foundations for the future.
entries.translation: 这里的居民，曾被称为先驱者，为未来奠定了基础。
entries.sampleRaw: The inhabitants, §bPrecursors§f, as they were once called, laid the foundations for the future.

entries.source: However, they have been extinct for eons - only leaving the remnants of the Automatons behind.
entries.translation: 然而，他们早已灭绝了无数纪元——只留下了自动机的残骸。
entries.sampleRaw: However, they have been extinct for eons - only leaving the remnants of the §cAutomatons§f behind.

entries.source: One rather peculiar discovery is the Automaton Prime - the giant robot towering above me. The exact purpose of it is unknown, although it appears to be guarding something.
entries.translation: 一个相当奇特的发现是自动机首领——那个高耸在我上方的巨型机器人。它的确切用途尚不清楚，不过它似乎在守护着什么。
entries.sampleRaw: One rather peculiar discovery is the §bAutomaton Prime§f - the giant robot towering above me. The exact purpose of it is unknown, although it appears to be guarding something.

entries.source: There seems to be 6 key components to the giant that are missing.
entries.translation: 这个巨人似乎缺少了 6 个关键部件。
entries.sampleRaw: There seems to be §a6§f key components to the giant that are missing.
entries.numericSource: There seems to be {{N0}} key components to the giant that are missing.
entries.numericTranslation: 这个巨人似乎缺少了 {{N0}} 个关键部件。

entries.source: Each part - the Electron Transmitter, FTX 3070, Robotron Reflector, Superlite Motor, Control Switch, and a Synthetic Heart plays a distinctive role in the creation of this behemoth.
entries.translation: 每个部件——电子发射器、FTX 3070、机器人反射器、超轻马达、控制开关和合成之心——在这头巨兽的制造中都扮演着独特的角色。
entries.sampleRaw: Each part - the §9Electron Transmitter§f, §9FTX 3070§f, §9Robotron Reflector§f, §9Superlite Motor§f, §9Control Switch§f, and a §9Synthetic Heart§f plays a distinctive role in the creation of this behemoth.
entries.numericSource: Each part - the Electron Transmitter, FTX {{N0}}, Robotron Reflector, Superlite Motor, Control Switch, and a Synthetic Heart plays a distinctive role in the creation of this behemoth.
entries.numericTranslation: 每个部件——电子发射器、FTX {{N0}}、机器人反射器、超轻马达、控制开关和合成之心——在这头巨兽的制造中都扮演着独特的角色。

entries.source: I think the Automatons nearby are built with similar components. Find them and bring them to me!
entries.translation: 我想附近的自动机就是用类似的部件制造的。找到它们并带给我！
entries.sampleRaw: I think the Automatons nearby are built with similar components. Find them and bring them to me!

entries.source: That's not one of the components I need! Bring me one of the missing components:
entries.translation: 这不是我需要的零件! 请带来下列缺失的零件之一:
entries.sampleRaw: That's not one of the components I need! Bring me one of the missing components:

entries.source: Thanks for bringing me the <Component>! Bring me <missing count> more components to fix the giant!
entries.translation: 谢谢你给我带来 <Component>！再给我带 <missing count> 个部件来修复这个巨人！
entries.sampleRaw: Thanks for bringing me the §9<Component>§f! Bring me <missing count> more components to fix the giant!

entries.source: You have already delivered that part to me! Bring me a unique robot part!
entries.translation: 你已经把那个部件交给我了！给我带一个独特的机器人部件来！
entries.sampleRaw: You have already delivered that part to me! Bring me a unique robot part!

entries.source: You've brought me all of the components!
entries.translation: 你已经带来了所有零件!
entries.sampleRaw: You've brought me all of the components!

entries.source: I have uploaded them to the giant below...it appears it has opened its storage compartment!
entries.translation: 我已经把它们上传到下面的巨人那里了……看来它打开了储存舱！
entries.sampleRaw: I have uploaded them to the giant below...it appears it has opened its storage compartment!

entries.source: Perhaps the long-lost Sapphire Crystal is in there!
entries.translation: 也许失落已久的蓝宝石水晶就在里面！
entries.sampleRaw: Perhaps the long-lost §bSapphire Crystal§f is in there!

entries.source: That's not one of the compon-
entries.sampleRaw: That's not one of the compon-

entries.source: Wait a minute. This will work just fine.
entries.sampleRaw: Wait a minute. This will work just fine.

entries.source: I have uploaded this to the giant below...it appears it has opened its storage compartment!
entries.translation: 我已经把这个上传到下面的巨人那里了……看来它打开了储存舱！
entries.sampleRaw: I have uploaded this to the giant below...it appears it has opened its storage compartment!

entries.source: You've brought me all of the components... I think? To be honest, I kind of lost count...
entries.translation: 你已经把所有部件都带给我了……我想是吧？说实话，我有点数不清了……
entries.sampleRaw: You've brought me all of the components... I think? To be honest, I kind of lost count...

entries.source: You haven't placed the Sapphire Crystal yet!
entries.translation: 你还没放置蓝宝石水晶！
entries.sampleRaw: You haven't placed the §bSapphire Crystal§f yet!

entries.source: Go to the Crystal Nucleus to place it!
entries.sampleRaw: Go to the §5Crystal Nucleus§f to place it!

entries.source: Welcome traveler to our village!
entries.translation: 欢迎来到我们的村庄，旅行者！

entries.source: We have much to offer and explore - but be careful.
entries.translation: 我们有很多东西可以分享和探索——但要小心。
entries.sampleRaw: We have much to offer and explore - but be careful.

entries.source: The Kalhuiki tribe are a friendly people, but protective.
entries.translation: 卡尔胡伊基部落是一个友善的民族，但很有保护欲。
entries.sampleRaw: The Kalhuiki tribe are a friendly people, but protective.

entries.source: Do not attack our young, else we will put you down.
entries.translation: 不要攻击我们的幼崽，否则我们会把你放倒。
entries.sampleRaw: Do not attack our young, else we will put you down.

entries.source: I'm supposed to collect some food for the village, the Kalhuiki people have been through a tough time recently.
entries.translation: 我本该为村庄收集一些食物，卡尔胡伊基人最近经历了一段艰难时期。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm supposed to collect some food for the village, the Kalhuiki people have been through a tough time recently.

entries.source: Perfect! I'll share the good news with my village!
entries.translation: 太好了！我会把这个好消息分享给我的村庄！
entries.sampleRaw: Perfect! I'll share the good news with my village!

entries.source: I guess I'll have to turn up empty-handed.
entries.translation: 看来我只能空手而归了。
entries.sampleRaw: I guess I'll have to turn up empty-handed.

entries.source: THIS OLD MITHRIL IS STALE! DON'T EVER FEED THIS TO ME AGAIN!
entries.translation: 这陈年秘银不新鲜了！别再拿这个喂我！
entries.sampleRaw: THIS OLD MITHRIL IS STALE! DON'T EVER FEED THIS TO ME AGAIN!

entries.source: Hello traveler! Would you like to try my new recipe?
entries.translation: 你好，旅行者！想尝尝我的新配方吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Hello traveler! Would you like to try my new recipe?

entries.source: This meat is a special blend of well... everything.
entries.translation: 这肉是……嗯……各种东西的特别混合。
entries.sampleRaw: This meat is a special blend of well... everything.

entries.source: Ahh you stinky humans must have weak stomach. Maybe you will like my Zog stew?
entries.translation: 啊，你们这些臭人类一定肠胃很弱。也许你会喜欢我的Zog炖菜？
entries.sampleRaw: Ahh you stinky humans must have weak stomach. Maybe you will like my Zog stew?

entries.source: OH well, maybe next time.
Ooooh, what's this? You bring Xalx funny little seed and strange crop?
entries.translation: 哦哦哦，这是什么？你带来了Xalx有趣的小种子和奇怪的作物？
entries.sampleRaw: Ooooh, what's this? You bring Xalx funny little seed and strange crop?

entries.source: Smells... weird. But not bad weird! Good weird! Like stew left in sun for three days.
entries.translation: 闻起来……怪怪的。但不是坏的那种怪！是好怪！就像在太阳下放了三天的炖菜。
entries.sampleRaw: Smells... weird. But not bad weird! Good weird! Like stew left in sun for three days.

entries.source: Hmmm... something missing. Needs... more! More flavor! More stink!
entries.translation: 嗯……少了点什么。需要……更多！更多风味！更多臭味！
entries.sampleRaw: Hmmm... something missing. Needs... more! More flavor! More stink!

entries.source: Here, take this back. Let it... marinate. Yes, marinate! Then it be ready.
entries.translation: 来，把这个拿回去。让它……腌制一下。对，腌制！然后就准备好了。
entries.sampleRaw: Here, take this back. Let it... marinate. Yes, marinate! Then it be ready.

entries.source: Hello gardener, I've been looking for some sugar to grow my new crop. Wanna try it?
entries.translation: 你好，园丁，我一直在找些糖来种我的新作物。想试试吗？
entries.sampleRaw: §fHello gardener, I've been looking for some sugar to grow my new crop. Wanna try it?

entries.source: Darn humans, you don't understand how to use things...
entries.translation: 该死的人类，你们根本不懂怎么用这些东西……
entries.sampleRaw: Darn humans, you don't understand how to use things...

entries.source: Smart choice.
Hmm... I haven't seen you around here before. Do you work here?
entries.translation: 嗯……我以前没见过你在这附近。你在这里工作吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Hmm... I haven't seen you around here before. Do you work here?

entries.source: Pal, you seem a lil' lost over there,
entries.translation: 伙计，你看起来有点迷路了，
entries.sampleRaw: Pal, you seem a lil' lost over there,

entries.source: Why don'tcha come by the fire and sit down anywhere
entries.translation: 不如来火边随便找个地方坐下吧
entries.sampleRaw: Why don'tcha come by the fire and sit down anywhere

entries.source: I gotcha ya a good story piling up, but beware!
entries.translation: 我给你攒了个好故事，但要当心！
entries.sampleRaw: I gotcha ya a good story piling up, but beware!

entries.source: It's the scary story about the big bad bear
entries.translation: 这是关于那只大坏熊的恐怖故事
entries.sampleRaw: It's the scary story about the big bad bear

entries.source: There was once a baby bear, little and cute,
entries.translation: 从前有一只小熊，又小又可爱，
entries.sampleRaw: There was once a baby bear, little and cute,

entries.source: but her parents, oh no!, they were quite the brute
entries.translation: 但她的父母，哦不！他们可真是粗暴
entries.sampleRaw: but her parents, oh no!, they were quite the brute

entries.source: they'd always throw tantrums about what and who,
entries.translation: 他们总是为了什么和谁大发脾气，
entries.sampleRaw: they'd always throw tantrums about what and who,

entries.source: but the lil' bear had enough and said "that's my cue!"
entries.translation: 但小熊受够了，说道“该我上场了！”
entries.sampleRaw: but the lil' bear had enough and said "that's my cue!"

entries.source: so the lil' fellow went out and about into the wood,
entries.translation: 于是这小家伙出门走进了树林，
entries.sampleRaw: so the lil' fellow went out and about into the wood,

entries.source: but what came of that, let me tell you, it didn't end very good
entries.translation: 但后来发生了什么，让我告诉你，结局可不太好
entries.sampleRaw: but what came of that, let me tell you, it didn't end very good

entries.source: she found an empty cabin, rusty and old,
entries.translation: 她发现了一间空木屋，破旧又荒凉，
entries.sampleRaw: she found an empty cabin, rusty and old,

entries.source: "a bit of rest wouldn't hurt" she said very bold
entries.translation: “歇一会儿也无妨”她大胆地说
entries.sampleRaw: "a bit of rest wouldn't hurt" she said very bold

entries.source: "so he sat down by the chimney with paws freezing cold,
entries.translation: “于是他坐在烟囱旁，爪子冻得冰凉，
entries.sampleRaw: "so he sat down by the chimney with paws freezing cold,

entries.source: and threw some wood and watched the fire unfold
entries.translation: 扔进一些木柴，看着火焰蔓延开来
entries.sampleRaw: and threw some wood and watched the fire unfold

entries.source: he tugged himself in and went right to sleep,
entries.translation: 他裹紧身子，直接睡着了，
entries.sampleRaw: he tugged himself in and went right to sleep,

entries.source: but then something happened, the fire went out and he heard a loud creak
entries.translation: 但接着事情发生了，火熄灭了，他听到一声响亮的吱呀声
entries.sampleRaw: but then something happened, the fire went out and he heard a loud creak

entries.source: he got up and looked deep down the darkness
entries.sampleRaw: he got up and looked deep down the darkness

entries.source: but what he then saw...
Horror stories are better when you have something to snack on y'know? If you help us gather some ingredients, we could roast some tasty marshmallows.
entries.translation: 有东西吃的时候恐怖故事才更好听，你懂吧？如果你帮我们收集一些材料，我们就能烤些美味的棉花糖。
entries.sampleRaw: Horror stories are better when you have something to snack on y'know? If you help us gather some ingredients, we could roast some tasty marshmallows.

entries.source: Thanks Pal! Why don't you sit around the campfire with us and enjoy these tasty treats?
entries.translation: 谢了伙计！不如和我们一起围坐在营火旁，享用这些美味点心？
entries.sampleRaw: Thanks Pal! Why don't you sit around the campfire with us and enjoy these tasty treats?

entries.source: No supplies? You wouldn't want to experience what the lil' bear did, would you?
entries.translation: 没有材料？你总不会想体验那只小熊的遭遇吧？
entries.sampleRaw: No supplies? You wouldn't want to experience what the lil' bear did, would you?

entries.source: Take this Metal Detector to scavenge the ground for lost items!
entries.translation: 拿上这个金属探测器，在地面上搜寻失落的物品！
entries.sampleRaw: Take this §cMetal Detector§f to scavenge the ground for lost items!

entries.source: Return the items to their rightful owners to gain a reward!
entries.translation: 把物品归还给它们 rightful 的主人，即可获得奖励！
entries.sampleRaw: Return the items to their rightful owners to gain a reward!

entries.translation: 当你找到一件拾获的<Item>时，来找我谈谈。
entries.sampleRaw: Talk to me when you have found a §cScavenged <Item>§f.

entries.source: Excellent! You have returned the Scavenged <Item> to it's rightful place!
entries.translation: 太棒了！你已经把拾获的<Item>归还到了它应有的位置！
entries.sampleRaw: Excellent! You have returned the §cScavenged <Item> §fto it's rightful place!

entries.source: Use your Metal Detector to find the remaining items!
entries.translation: 用你的金属探测器寻找剩余的物品！
entries.sampleRaw: Use your §cMetal Detector§f to find the remaining items!

entries.source: You have already restored this Dwarf's Scavenged <Item>!
entries.translation: 你已经归还了这位矮人拾获的<Item>！
entries.sampleRaw: You have already restored this Dwarf's §cScavenged <Item>§f!

entries.source: Use your Metal Detector to find the rest of the items!
entries.translation: 用你的金属探测器寻找其余的物品！
entries.sampleRaw: Use your §cMetal Detector§f to find the rest of the items!

entries.source: You found all of the items! Behold... the Jade Crystal!
entries.translation: 你找到了所有物品！看哪……翡翠水晶！
entries.sampleRaw: You found all of the items! Behold... the §aJade Crystal§f!

entries.source: You haven't placed the Jade Crystal yet!
entries.translation: 你还没有放置翡翠水晶！

entries.source: Go to the Crystal Nucleus to place it!
entries.sampleRaw: Go to the §5Crystal Nucleus §fto place it!

entries.source: You have already placed the Jade Crystal!
entries.translation: 你已经放置了翡翠水晶！
entries.sampleRaw: You have already placed the §aJade Crystal§f!

entries.source: Come back when you need to collect it again!
entries.translation: 等你需要再次收集它时再来吧！
entries.sampleRaw: Come back when you need to collect it again!

entries.source: Hey you! Help me I'm stuck!
entries.translation: 嘿，你！帮帮我，我被卡住了！
entries.sampleRaw: Hey you! Help me I'm stuck!

entries.source: I fell asleep and when I woke up I was too large to fit the entrance!
entries.translation: 我睡着了，醒来时发现自己太大，进不了入口了！
entries.sampleRaw: I fell asleep and when I woke up I was too large to fit the entrance!

entries.source: Maybe you can punch me out.
entries.translation: 也许你可以把我打出去。
entries.sampleRaw: Maybe you can punch me out.

entries.source: Wow I wasn't expecting that!
Thank you so much, I stayed there for weeks!
entries.translation: 太感谢你了，我在那里待了好几周！
entries.sampleRaw: Thank you so much, I stayed there for weeks!

entries.source: You freed me, and helped me find the love of my life!
entries.translation: 你解救了我，还帮我找到了此生挚爱！
entries.sampleRaw: You freed me, and helped me find the love of my life!

entries.source: Take this offering in return!
entries.translation: 请收下这份谢礼作为回报！

entries.source: Thank you so much!
Maybe I feel such an intense connection with my other half because, it was literally my other half?
entries.translation: 也许我和我的另一半有如此强烈的联系，是因为它字面上就是我的另一半？
entries.sampleRaw: Maybe I feel such an intense connection with my other half because, it was literally my other half?

entries.translation: 这根本不是我点的东西！现在就把美味秘银给我拿来！
entries.sampleRaw: THIS ISN'T WHAT I ASKED FOR! BRING §lTASTY MITHRIL§f TO ME NOW!

entries.translation: 恶心！给我吃这种垃圾，我要让你被炒鱿鱼！
entries.sampleRaw: DISGUSTING! I'M GONNA GET YOU FIRED FOR FEEDING ME THIS GARBAGE!

I HUNGER
BRING ME EDIBLE MITHRIL
I FORGOT TO BRING A SNACK

entries.sampleRaw: WHAT ARE YOU GUYS WAITING FOR

I MIGHT JUST STAY HERE FOREVER THEN

entries.sampleRaw: MY FATHER WILL HEAR ABOUT THIS

entries.sampleRaw: I DON'T HAVE ALL DAY, I ONLY WANT THE BEST LOOKING MITHRIL PIECES!

entries.source: I AM NOT OKAY WITH THIS

entries.translation: 你们都该为自己感到羞耻
entries.sampleRaw: YOU SHOULD ALL BE ASHAMED OF YOURSELVES

entries.source: FEED ME
I THINK I MIGHT HAVE ROCK POISONING, I NEED TO LAY DOWN!
entries.translation: 我觉得我可能得了岩石中毒，我得躺下！
entries.sampleRaw: I THINK I MIGHT HAVE ROCK POISONING, I NEED TO LAY DOWN!

entries.source: I DON'T FEEL SO GOOD...
This temple is locked, you will need to bring me a key open the door!
entries.translation: 这座神庙是锁着的，你需要给我一把钥匙才能开门！
entries.sampleRaw: This temple is locked, you will need to bring me a key open the door!

entries.translation: 一把丛林钥匙！我这就为你开门。

entries.sampleRaw: This temple does not have the treasure you are seeking at this time.

entries.source: *rumble* *rumble*
Did ya hear that, [player]? That's the sound of an empty stomach.
entries.translation: 你听到了吗，[player]？那是空肚子的声音。
entries.sampleRaw: Did ya hear that, [player]? That's the sound of an empty stomach.

entries.source: I've been so hungry since the Goblin Queen tossed me aside.
entries.translation: 自从哥布林女王把我抛弃后，我一直饿得不行。
entries.sampleRaw: I've been so hungry since the Goblin Queen tossed me aside.

entries.source: Bring me back a Goblin Egg of any type and we can teach her a lesson!
entries.translation: 给我带回来任意类型的哥布林蛋，我们就能给她一个教训！
entries.sampleRaw: Bring me back a Goblin Egg of any type and we can teach her a lesson!

entries.source: Bring me any type of Goblin Egg and we can show the Goblin Queen what it's like to lose something she loves?!
entries.translation: 给我带回来任意类型的哥布林蛋，我们就能让哥布林女王尝尝失去心爱之物的滋味？！
entries.sampleRaw: Bring me any type of Goblin Egg and we can show the Goblin Queen what it's like to lose something she loves?!

entries.source: Dark, right?!
That is certainly not the meal I am looking for! Bring me back a Goblin Egg and you will satiate my hunger.
entries.translation: 这绝对不是我要找的那顿饭！给我带回来一个哥布林蛋，你就能填饱我的肚子。
entries.sampleRaw: That is certainly not the meal I am looking for! Bring me back a §9Goblin Egg§f and you will satiate my hunger.

entries.source: Where is that Goblin Egg? My Chef is waiting!
entries.translation: 那个哥布林蛋在哪？我的厨师还在等着呢！
entries.sampleRaw: Where is that §9Goblin Egg§f? My Chef is waiting!

entries.source: Well done, [player]!
These eggs will help me stomach my pain.
entries.translation: 这些蛋能帮我咽下痛苦。
entries.sampleRaw: These eggs will help me stomach my pain.

entries.source: Now let's hit the Queen where it hurts - by stealing her Amber Crystal!
entries.translation: 现在让我们直击女王的痛处——偷走她的琥珀水晶！
entries.sampleRaw: Now let's hit the Queen where it hurts - by stealing her §6Amber Crystal§f!

entries.source: I'm covering you in my foul stench as we speak. It won't last long before it dissipates!
entries.translation: 就在我们说话的时候,我正在用我的恶臭覆盖你.它撑不了多久就会消散!
entries.sampleRaw: I'm covering you in my §afoul stench §ras we speak. It won't last long before it dissipates!

entries.source: Get to the Queen before my stench goes away and you'll be able to sneak past her imbecile Guards!
entries.translation: 在我的恶臭消失之前赶到女王那里，你就能从她那些愚蠢的守卫身边溜过去！
entries.sampleRaw: Get to the Queen before my stench goes away and you'll be able to sneak past her imbecile Guards!

entries.source: You must hurry! Get to the Goblin Queen before my stench escapes you!
entries.translation: 你必须快点！在我的恶臭从你身上散去之前赶到哥布林女王那里！
entries.sampleRaw: You must hurry! Get to the Goblin Queen before my stench escapes you!

entries.source: And stay away from water!
You need my foul stench again? Bring me a Goblin Egg of any type!
entries.translation: 你又需要我的恶臭了？给我带回来任意类型的哥布林蛋！
entries.sampleRaw: You need my §afoul stench §fagain? Bring me a §9Goblin Egg §fof any type!

entries.source: Sup, [player]? I am Geonathan Greatforge, your one stop shop for refueling and upgrading Drills.
entries.translation: 嗨,[player]?我是Geonathan Greatforge,你为钻头补充燃料和升级的一站式商店.
entries.sampleRaw: Sup, §b[player]§f? I am §2Geonathan Greatforge§f, your one stop shop for refueling and upgrading §aDrills§f.

entries.source: Biofuel is one of such fuels, which applies 3,000 fuel to your Drill!
entries.translation: 生物燃料就是其中一种燃料，可为你的钻头补充3,000点燃料！
entries.sampleRaw: §9Biofuel§f is one of such fuels, which applies §23,000§f fuel to your Drill!
entries.numericSource: Biofuel is one of such fuels, which applies {{N0}} fuel to your Drill!

entries.source: You can also apply Drill Upgrades to Drills, offering various buffs!
entries.translation: 你还可以给钻头安装钻头升级，提供各种增益效果！
entries.sampleRaw: You can also apply §6Drill Upgrades§f to Drills, offering various buffs!

entries.source: I usually only work with Oil Barrels, but I'd like to try making some Biofuel from compost.
entries.translation: 我通常只处理油桶，但我想试试用堆肥制作一些生物燃料。
entries.sampleRaw: I usually only work with Oil Barrels, but I'd like to try making some Biofuel from compost.

entries.source: Oil Barrels are much more superior, but at least this is 100% renewable. Pretty neat!
entries.translation: 油桶要优越得多，但至少这个是100%可再生的。挺不错的！
entries.sampleRaw: Oil Barrels are much more superior, but at least this is 100% renewable. Pretty neat!
entries.numericSource: Oil Barrels are much more superior, but at least this is {{N0}} renewable. Pretty neat!
entries.numericTranslation: 油桶要优越得多，但至少这个是{{N0}}可再生的。挺不错的！

entries.source: Not a problem. I hear that Biofuel is worse anyways.
entries.translation: 没问题。我听说生物燃料反正更差。
entries.sampleRaw: Not a problem. I hear that Biofuel is worse anyways.

entries.source: Drills are sweet! Too bad you don't have one. I hear you can create them in the Forge!
entries.translation: 钻头真棒！可惜你没有。我听说你可以在锻造所里打造它们！
entries.sampleRaw: Drills are sweet! Too bad you don't have one. I hear you can create them in the §6Forge§f!

entries.source: Come back to me when you have a Drill in your inventory!
entries.translation: 等你物品栏里有一把钻头时再来找我！
entries.sampleRaw: Come back to me when you have a §aDrill§f in your inventory!

entries.source: What are you doing talking to me without a Drill? Come back when you have one!
entries.translation: 你没有钻头还来找我干什么？等你有了再来！
entries.sampleRaw: What are you doing talking to me without a §aDrill§f? Come back when you have one!

entries.source: It's not a big issue.
I have a big issue to get rid of.
entries.sampleRaw: I have a big issue to get rid of.

entries.source: That'll do.
I guess I'll have to turn up empty-handed.
entries.translation: 看来我只能空手而归了。
entries.sampleRaw: I guess I'll have to turn up empty-handed.

I'm just a placeholder because apparently no one voted on the previous election.
entries.translation: 我只是个占位符，因为显然没人给上次选举投票。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm just a placeholder because apparently no one voted on the previous election.

I'm just a placeholder because there is no Minister this election.

I love goooold!
Click me again to open the Gold Forger Shop!
entries.translation: 再次点击我打开Gold Forger商店！
entries.sampleRaw: Click me again to open the Gold Forger Shop!

entries.source: Do Golden Carrots taste different than normal ones? I've actually never tried one before so I am pretty curious how they taste.
entries.translation: 金胡萝卜尝起来和普通胡萝卜不一样吗？我其实从没尝过，所以很好奇它们是什么味道。
entries.sampleRaw: §fDo Golden Carrots taste different than normal ones? I've actually never tried one before so I am pretty curious how they taste.

entries.source: Let's taste...THIS IS DISGUSTING!!! Why would anyone waste such precious gold on this? Just like any other fancy food, expensive and gross...
entries.translation: 让我尝尝……太难吃了！！！怎么会有人把这么珍贵的金子浪费在这上面？就像其他花哨的食物一样，又贵又难吃……
entries.sampleRaw: Let's taste...THIS IS DISGUSTING!!! Why would anyone waste such precious gold on this? Just like any other fancy food, expensive and gross...

entries.source: They would've probably tasted bad anyways...
entries.translation: 反正它们大概本来也不会好吃……
entries.sampleRaw: They would've probably tasted bad anyways...

entries.source: That's quite an excessive amount of carrots, but it'll do! Thanks, [username]!
entries.translation: 这胡萝卜也太多了，不过够用了！谢了，[username]！
entries.sampleRaw: That's quite an excessive amount of carrots, but it'll do! Thanks, §6[username]§f!

entries.translation: 我的小麦仆从能产出周围最上等的面粉，但它们跟不上今天的需求……

entries.translation: 你愿意帮我填满博物馆吗？我甚至可以奖励你的贡献！
entries.sampleRaw: Would you like to help me fill the §9Museum§f? I can even reward you for your contributions!
