entries.source: Choose carefully!
I'm here to put a value on your farm. Bring me your fanciest crop.
entries.translation: 我来这里是为了给你的农场估价。把你最稀罕的作物带来给我。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm here to put a value on your farm. Bring me your fanciest crop.

entries.source: Truly Magnificent! I value your farm at a minimum of [value of farm] coins!
entries.translation: 真是壮观！我给你的农场估价至少为[value of farm]硬币！
entries.sampleRaw: Truly Magnificent! I value your farm at a minimum of [value of farm] coins!

entries.source: I value your farm at 0 coins. Horrible service.
entries.translation: 我给你的农场估价为0硬币。糟糕的服务。
entries.sampleRaw: I value your farm at 0 coins. Horrible service.
entries.numericSource: I value your farm at {{N0}} coins. Horrible service.
entries.numericTranslation: 我给你的农场估价为{{N0}}硬币。糟糕的服务。

entries.source: Hmm... I haven't seen you around here before. Do you work here?
entries.translation: 嗯……我以前没见过你。你在这里工作吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Hmm... I haven't seen you around here before. Do you work here?

entries.source: Your incredible contributions have transformed the museum into a landmark of cultural heritage.
entries.translation: 你惊人的贡献已将博物馆转变为文化遗产的地标。
entries.sampleRaw: Your incredible contributions have transformed the museum into a landmark of cultural heritage.

entries.source: The museum is almost complete! Your tireless efforts have brought us to the brink of greatness.
entries.translation: 博物馆几乎完工了！你不懈的努力已将我们带到了伟大的边缘。
entries.sampleRaw: The museum is almost complete! Your tireless efforts have brought us to the brink of greatness.

entries.source: Hmm.. You do not seem experienced enough for what I require.
entries.translation: 嗯……对于我所需要的东西，你似乎还不够有经验。
entries.sampleRaw: Hmm.. You do not seem experienced enough for what I require.

entries.source: Come back to me when you have harmed more than a fly.
entries.translation: 等你伤害过比苍蝇更多的东西后再来找我。
entries.sampleRaw: Come back to me when you have harmed more than a fly.

entries.source: Must you need an explanation? I mean Combat Level 10 and 10 of playtime.
entries.translation: 还需要解释吗？我的意思是战斗等级10和10的游戏时间。
entries.sampleRaw: Must you need an explanation? I mean Combat Level 10 and 10 of playtime.
entries.numericSource: Must you need an explanation? I mean Combat Level {{N0}} and {{N1}} of playtime.
entries.numericTranslation: 还需要解释吗？我的意思是战斗等级{{N0}}和{{N1}}的游戏时间。

entries.source: The Great Spook...
It's THERE!
At least I think. You can never be too sure until it's really happening...
entries.translation: 至少我是这么认为的。在它真正发生之前，你永远无法完全确定……
entries.sampleRaw: At least I think. You can never be too sure until it's really happening...

entries.source: Something has to be done, otherwise things are going to get way too spooky...
entries.translation: 必须采取行动,否则事情会变得太诡异了……
entries.sampleRaw: Something has to be done, otherwise things are going to get way too §5§ospooky§r...

entries.source: Last time my assistant was alright.
entries.translation: 上次我的助手还好好的。
entries.sampleRaw: Last time my assistant was alright.

entries.source: Was it you?
Hum, I see.
Well, last time my strategy worked really well.
entries.translation: 嗯，上次我的策略非常奏效。
entries.sampleRaw: Well, last time my strategy worked really well.

entries.source: It was a genius plan to be fair.
entries.translation: 公平地说，那是个天才的计划。
entries.sampleRaw: It was a genius plan to be fair.

entries.source: So I'll go with a similar strategy this year.
entries.translation: 所以今年我会采用类似的策略。
entries.sampleRaw: So I'll go with a similar strategy this year.

entries.source: Will you help me?
I'll reward you if you give me the proper ingredients.
entries.translation: 如果你给我合适的材料，我会奖励你。
entries.sampleRaw: I'll reward you if you give me the proper ingredients.

entries.source: There is no time to explain.
entries.sampleRaw: There is no time to explain.

entries.source: Anyways, I'll reward you if you give me the proper ingredients.
entries.translation: 总之，只要你给我合适的材料，我就会奖励你。
entries.sampleRaw: Anyways, I'll reward you if you give me the proper ingredients.

entries.source: Oh my!
This is very stressful, I hope my calculations are correct.
entries.translation: 这真是太紧张了，希望我的计算没错。
entries.sampleRaw: This is very stressful, I hope my calculations are correct.

entries.source: Well, here goes nothing!
Hmmm. Well this is quite embarrassing.
entries.sampleRaw: Hmmm. Well this is quite embarrassing.

entries.source: I don't actually understand what just happened.
entries.translation: 我其实也不明白刚才发生了什么。
entries.sampleRaw: I don't actually understand what just happened.

entries.source: You know I've heard these make great pies...
entries.translation: 你知道吗，我听说这些能做出很棒的派……
entries.sampleRaw: You know I've heard these make great pies...

entries.source: Anyway, let's throw this in the cauldron.
entries.translation: 总之，把它扔进炼药锅里吧。
entries.sampleRaw: Anyway, let's throw this in the cauldron.

entries.source: Hmmm. I think this confirms it...
entries.sampleRaw: Hmmm. I think this confirms it...

entries.source: What did you say? Pfft. You wouldn't understand.
entries.translation: 你说什么？噗。你不会懂的。
entries.sampleRaw: What did you say? Pfft. You wouldn't understand.

entries.source: Pfft. Take your reward, this is a Great Spook Helmet.
entries.translation: 噗。拿走你的奖励吧，这是一顶大万圣节头盔。
entries.sampleRaw: Pfft. Take your reward, this is a §5Great Spook Helmet§f.

entries.source: Do you really have feet instead of hands? How hard can it be to get 5 Decayed Bats?
entries.translation: 你真的是用脚而不是用手吗？弄到 5 只腐朽蝙蝠能有多难？
entries.sampleRaw: Do you really have feet instead of hands? How hard can it be to get §e5 §aDecayed Bats§f?
entries.numericSource: Do you really have feet instead of hands? How hard can it be to get {{N0}} Decayed Bats?
entries.numericTranslation: 你真的是用脚而不是用手吗？弄到 {{N0}} 只腐朽蝙蝠能有多难？

entries.source: Come back in 2d 23h 59m 59s and I may have more info about this ingredient.
entries.translation: 2天23小时59分钟59秒后再来,我或许会有关于这种材料的更多信息.
entries.sampleRaw: Come back in §e2d 23h 59m 59s §rand I may have more info about this ingredient.
entries.numericSource: Come back in {{N0}}d {{N1}}h {{N2}}m {{N3}}s and I may have more info about this ingredient.
entries.numericTranslation: {{N0}}天{{N1}}小时{{N2}}分钟{{N3}}秒后再来,我或许会有关于这种材料的更多信息.

entries.source: Decayed Bats! Finally!
Let's add them to the brew...
entries.sampleRaw: Let's add them to the brew...

entries.source: Oof, that's not good. Not good at all.
entries.translation: 哎哟，这可不好。一点都不好。
entries.sampleRaw: Oof, that's not good. Not good at all.

entries.source: Well, here is your reward. It's a Great Spook Chestplate.
entries.translation: 好吧，这是你的奖励。是一件大万圣节胸甲。
entries.sampleRaw: Well, here is your reward. It's a §5Great Spook Chestplate§f.

entries.source: Can you really not find a Poisoned Candy?!? This is basic Alchemy!!!
entries.translation: 你真的连一颗毒糖果都找不到吗？！？这是基础炼金术！！！
entries.sampleRaw: Can you really not find a §aPoisoned Candy§f?!? This is basic Alchemy!!!

entries.source: Come back in 1d 23h 59m 59s and I may have more info about this ingredient.
entries.translation: 1天23小时59分钟59秒后再来,我或许会有关于这种材料的更多信息.
entries.sampleRaw: Come back in §e1d 23h 59m 59s §rand I may have more info about this ingredient.
entries.numericSource: Come back in {{N0}}d {{N1}}h {{N2}}m {{N3}}s and I may have more info about this ingredient.
entries.numericTranslation: {{N0}}天{{N1}}小时{{N2}}分钟{{N3}}秒后再来,我或许会有关于这种材料的更多信息.

entries.source: Amazing!
You know candy is bad for you, works well in potions though.
entries.translation: 你知道糖果对你不好，不过用在药水里倒是很有效。
entries.sampleRaw: You know candy is bad for you, works well in potions though.

entries.source: Wait...
Why were you holding this Poisoned Candy with your bare hands, do you really know NOTHING???
entries.translation: 你为什么用裸手拿着这颗毒糖果，你真的什么都不懂吗？？？
entries.sampleRaw: Why were you holding this §aPoisoned Candy §fwith your bare hands, do you really know NOTHING???

entries.source: Amateurism at its finest!
Moving on, let's add this Poisoned Candy to the brew.
entries.translation: 继续吧，把这颗毒糖果加进药水里。
entries.sampleRaw: Moving on, let's add this §aPoisoned Candy §fto the §dbrew§f.

entries.source: I see...
Here, take these Great Spook Leggings, you earned them!
entries.translation: 给，拿着这条大万圣节护腿，这是你应得的！
entries.sampleRaw: Here, take these §5Great Spook Leggings§f, you earned them!

entries.source: I need 12 Sweet Flesh.
You must bring them to me.
entries.sampleRaw: You must bring them to me.

entries.source: Come back in 0d 23h 59m 59s and I may have more info about this ingredient.
entries.translation: 0天23小时59分钟59秒后再来,我或许会有关于这种材料的更多信息.
entries.sampleRaw: Come back in §e0d 23h 59m 59s §rand I may have more info about this ingredient.
entries.numericSource: Come back in {{N0}}d {{N1}}h {{N2}}m {{N3}}s and I may have more info about this ingredient.
entries.numericTranslation: {{N0}}天{{N1}}小时{{N2}}分钟{{N3}}秒后再来,我或许会有关于这种材料的更多信息.

entries.source: Perfect! Let me put that Sweet Flesh in the cauldron!
entries.translation: 完美！让我把那份甜肉放进炼药锅里！
entries.sampleRaw: Perfect! Let me put that §aSweet Flesh §fin the cauldron!

entries.source: Interesting... Most interesting...
Well... Here, take these Great Spook Boots!
entries.translation: 好吧……来，拿着这双大万圣节靴子！
entries.sampleRaw: Well... Here, take these §5Great Spook Boots§f!

entries.source: You're already having trouble finding a simple Rogue Flesh?
entries.translation: 你连找一份简单的叛徒血肉都遇到麻烦了？
entries.sampleRaw: You're already having trouble finding a simple §aRogue Flesh§f?

entries.source: It's quite simple really, you are just lacking patience.
entries.translation: 其实很简单，你只是缺乏耐心。
entries.sampleRaw: It's quite simple really, you are just lacking patience.

entries.source: Let's toss this right in.
entries.translation: 我们直接把这个扔进去。

entries.source: Rogue Flesh isn't really an ingredient I use often.
entries.translation: 叛徒血肉并不是我常用的材料。
entries.sampleRaw: Rogue Flesh isn't really an ingredient I use often.

entries.source: In fact, this is my first time using it.
entries.translation: 事实上，这是我第一次用它。
entries.sampleRaw: In fact, this is my first time using it.

entries.source: I would say that went... well?
entries.translation: 我得说，这进行得……还算顺利？
entries.sampleRaw: I would say that went... well?

entries.source: How to obtain a Precious? Well...
Just need to throw this right here...
entries.translation: 只需要把这个扔到这里……
entries.sampleRaw: Just need to throw this right here...

entries.source: Hum, impressive...
Oh sorry, not you. I meant the experiment.
entries.translation: 哦抱歉，不是说你。我指的是这个实验。
entries.sampleRaw: Oh sorry, not you. I meant the experiment.

entries.source: It's...very peculiar...
Wow, if I were you I wouldn't stay too close to this cauldron!
entries.translation: 哇，如果我是你，我就不会离这个炼药锅太近！
entries.sampleRaw: Wow, if I were you I wouldn't stay too close to this cauldron!

entries.source: If we have to work together, you may as well learn the basic safety procedures...
entries.translation: 既然我们得合作，你最好也学学基本的安全规程……
entries.sampleRaw: If we have to work together, you may as well learn the basic safety procedures...

entries.source: I guess, to be fair, we'll probably both die when The Great Spook comes.
entries.translation: 不过说句公道话，大万圣节来临时，我们大概都会死。
entries.sampleRaw: I guess, to be fair, we'll probably both die when §8The Great Spook §fcomes.

entries.source: Here we go.
I hope this cow didn't suffer.
entries.sampleRaw: I hope this cow didn't suffer.

entries.source: Knowing you, I don't know what to expect anymore.
entries.translation: 以我对你的了解，我已经不知道还能期待什么了。
entries.sampleRaw: Knowing you, I don't know what to expect anymore.

entries.source: Of course I am.
Look! Brown slashes!
We are going in the right direction.
entries.translation: 我们正朝着正确的方向前进。
entries.sampleRaw: We are going in the right direction.

entries.source: Ok, this looked better in my head.
entries.translation: 好吧，这在我想象中看起来更好。
entries.sampleRaw: Ok, this looked better in my head.

entries.source: Still... progress.
We are only a few more terrible ideas away from success.
entries.translation: 我们离成功只差几个糟糕的点子了。
entries.sampleRaw: We are only a few more terrible ideas away from success.

entries.source: Fairy Wings are some of the most important ingredients!
entries.translation: 仙女之翼是最重要的材料之一！
entries.sampleRaw: §5Fairy Wings §fare some of the most important ingredients!

entries.source: Come on, I need them quick!
entries.sampleRaw: Come on, I need them quick!

entries.source: Come back in 4d 23h 59m 59s and I may have more info about this ingredient.
entries.translation: 4天23小时59分钟59秒后再来,我或许会有关于这种材料的更多信息.
entries.sampleRaw: Come back in §e4d 23h 59m 59s §rand I may have more info about this ingredient.
entries.numericSource: Come back in {{N0}}d {{N1}}h {{N2}}m {{N3}}s and I may have more info about this ingredient.
entries.numericTranslation: {{N0}}天{{N1}}小时{{N2}}分钟{{N3}}秒后再来,我或许会有关于这种材料的更多信息.

entries.source: Fairy Wings, perfect.
This is probably a good time to mention that what we are doing is not exactly... legal.
entries.translation: 现在大概是个好时机提一下，我们正在做的事并不完全……合法。
entries.sampleRaw: This is probably a good time to mention that what we are doing is not exactly... legal.

entries.source: At least where I'm from it's not legal.
entries.translation: 至少在我老家那边是不合法的。
entries.sampleRaw: At least where I'm from it's not legal.

entries.source: But I think we have a good dynamic together.
entries.translation: 但我觉得我们配合得挺默契。
entries.sampleRaw: But I think we have a good dynamic together.

entries.source: Furthermore, if I go down, you'll also go down with me. Understand?
entries.translation: 而且，如果我栽了，你也会跟我一起栽。明白吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Furthermore, if I go down, you'll also go down with me. Understand?

entries.source: Well well well.
Looks like I saved the world once again.
entries.translation: 看来我又一次拯救了世界。
entries.sampleRaw: Looks like I saved the world once again.

entries.source: This should give us enough time to prepare for The Great Spook.
entries.translation: 这应该能给我们足够的时间准备大万圣节。
entries.sampleRaw: This should give us enough time to prepare for §8The Great Spook§f.

entries.source: Done?
Oh, no no no.
The Great Spook will come, it cannot be stopped.
entries.translation: 大万圣节终将到来，无法阻止。
entries.sampleRaw: §8The Great Spook §fwill come, it cannot be stopped.

entries.source: I simply delayed it.
entries.translation: 我只是把它推迟了而已。

entries.source: This time I'm going to need a burger.
entries.sampleRaw: This time I'm going to need a burger.

entries.source: It's, hmm, quite important you see.
entries.sampleRaw: It's, hmm, quite important you see.

entries.source: No no, not cook, just bring me the ingredients.
entries.translation: 不不，不是让你做，只要把食材带给我就行。
entries.sampleRaw: No no, not cook, just bring me the ingredients.

entries.source: Oh and no tomatoes please, and no pickles, I hate them.
entries.translation: 哦还有，请不要番茄，也不要酸黄瓜，我讨厌它们。
entries.sampleRaw: Oh and no tomatoes please, and no pickles, I hate them.

entries.source: Who asked?
You know, all things considered, I've had worse assistants before.
entries.translation: 你知道吗，总的来说，我以前有过更差的助手。
entries.sampleRaw: You know, all things considered, I've had worse assistants before.

entries.source: You did an alright job, Robyn.
entries.sampleRaw: You did an alright job, Robyn.

entries.source: That's your name, right?
Anyhow, I have to prepare for the next Great Spook.
entries.translation: 总之，我得为下一个大万圣节做准备了。
entries.sampleRaw: Anyhow, I have to prepare for the next §8Great Spook§f.

entries.source: I'm going to need Ephemeral Gratitude x2.
entries.translation: 我需要转瞬即逝的感激 x2。
entries.numericSource: I'm going to need Ephemeral Gratitude x{{N0}}.
entries.numericTranslation: 我需要转瞬即逝的感激 x{{N0}}。

entries.source: If you have enough resources in your sacks it should be very easy.
entries.translation: 如果你的 sacks 里有足够的资源，那应该非常容易。
entries.sampleRaw: If you have enough resources in your sacks it should be very easy.

entries.source: Come back in 0d 11h 59m 59s and I may have more info about this ingredient.
entries.translation: 0天11小时59分钟59秒后再来,我或许会有关于这种材料的更多信息.
entries.sampleRaw: Come back in §e0d 11h 59m 59s §rand I may have more info about this ingredient.
entries.numericSource: Come back in {{N0}}d {{N1}}h {{N2}}m {{N3}}s and I may have more info about this ingredient.
entries.numericTranslation: {{N0}}天{{N1}}小时{{N2}}分钟{{N3}}秒后再来,我或许会有关于这种材料的更多信息.

entries.source: Ephemeral Gratitude x2...
Didn't I ask for 3?
Anyways, this will work, hold on...
entries.sampleRaw: Anyways, this will work, hold on...

entries.source: It did work, but 3 would have been better.
entries.translation: 确实成功了，但 3 个会更好。
entries.sampleRaw: It did work, but 3 would have been better.
entries.numericSource: It did work, but {{N0}} would have been better.
entries.numericTranslation: 确实成功了，但 {{N0}} 个会更好。

entries.source: Here, take this Great Spook Pet!
entries.translation: 给，拿着这个万圣节宠物！
entries.sampleRaw: Here, take this Great Spook Pet!

entries.source: His nickname is Eerie.
Sewer Fish x10, oof those stink...
entries.translation: 下水道鱼 x10，呃，这些可真臭……
entries.numericSource: Sewer Fish x{{N0}}, oof those stink...
entries.numericTranslation: 下水道鱼 x{{N0}}，呃，这些可真臭……

entries.source: Hold on, I need to throw them one by one.
entries.translation: 等等，我得一条一条地把它们扔进去。
entries.sampleRaw: Hold on, I need to throw them one by one.

entries.source: This was embarrassing.
If you tell anyone that you saw me doing this, the Great Spook will be the least of your worries...
entries.translation: 如果你告诉任何人你看到我这么做，大万圣节将是你最不用担心的事……
entries.sampleRaw: If you tell anyone that you saw me doing this, the Great Spook will be the least of your worries...

entries.source: Let's not talk about this anymore.
entries.sampleRaw: Let's not talk about this anymore.

entries.source: A Nightmare Nullifier! Great!
entries.translation: 一个梦魇消除器！太好了！

entries.source: Let's sloooooowly put that bad boy in there.
entries.translation: 让我们慢——慢——地——把那家伙放进去。
entries.sampleRaw: Let's sloooooowly put that bad boy in there.

entries.source: Now we just wait.
I think this should be enough, but it's always hard to tell with experiments like this.
entries.translation: 我觉得这应该够了，但像这样的实验总是很难说。
entries.sampleRaw: I think this should be enough, but it's always hard to tell with experiments like this.

entries.source: In the meantime, take this Eerie Toy.
entries.translation: 在此期间，拿着这个诡异玩具。
entries.sampleRaw: In the meantime, take this §5Eerie Toy§f.

entries.source: As it turns out, the Great Spook isn't technically a nightmare.
entries.translation: 事实证明，大万圣节严格来说并不是一场噩梦。
entries.sampleRaw: As it turns out, the Great Spook isn't §otechnically §fa nightmare.

entries.source: So the Nightmare Nullifier didn't work, at all.
entries.translation: 所以梦魇消除器根本就没起作用。

entries.source: It's really just a small change in horror nomenclature they did a little while ago.
entries.translation: 这其实只是他们不久前对恐怖命名法做的一点小改动。
entries.sampleRaw: It's really just a small change in horror nomenclature they did a little while ago.

entries.source: Honestly I don't even know who makes those decisions.
entries.translation: 说实话，我甚至不知道是谁做的这些决定。
entries.sampleRaw: Honestly I don't even know who makes those decisions.

entries.source: It's a shame though, a few years ago this would have been the solution.
entries.translation: 不过真可惜，几年前这本来会是解决办法。
entries.sampleRaw: It's a shame though, a few years ago this would have been the solution.

entries.source: I have another idea though, it's a little far-fetched however.
entries.translation: 不过我还有另一个主意，只是有点牵强。
entries.sampleRaw: I have another idea though, it's a little far-fetched however.

entries.source: I need The Soup.
A sad painting, perfect.
This should do the trick.
WOW!
Alright this did some work. But it's not enough it seems.
entries.translation: 好吧，这确实起了一些作用。但看来还不够。
entries.sampleRaw: Alright this did some work. But it's not enough it seems.

entries.source: I need to think some more, but take this.
entries.translation: 我还得再想想，但拿着这个。
entries.sampleRaw: I need to think some more, but take this.

entries.source: The painting indeed got us some massive progress.
entries.translation: 那幅画确实让我们取得了巨大的进展。
entries.sampleRaw: The painting indeed got us some massive progress.

entries.source: So I do have another idea, I think this should be it.
entries.translation: 所以我确实还有另一个主意，我觉得应该就是这个了。
entries.sampleRaw: So I do have another idea, I think this should be it.

entries.source: It's so close, that I think just a few drops from a Potion of Secrets will get us there.
entries.translation: 就差这么一点了,我觉得只要几滴秘密药水就能让我们成功.
entries.sampleRaw: It's so close, that I think just a few drops from a §5Potion of Secrets §rwill get us there.

entries.source: A Potion of Secrets!
You must be a decent Alchemist too!
entries.translation: 你一定也是个不错的炼金术士！
entries.sampleRaw: You must be a decent Alchemist too!

entries.source: Even though this brew is far from perfect, I've seen worse ones.
entries.translation: 虽然这锅药水远非完美，但我见过更糟的。
entries.sampleRaw: Even though this brew is far from perfect, I've seen worse ones.

entries.source: Ah ha!
The secrets are getting revealed.
This is the final step.
I thought about it a lot and I know exactly what we need.
entries.translation: 我仔细考虑了很久,我完全清楚我们需要什么.
entries.sampleRaw: I thought about it a lot and I know §oexactly §rwhat we need.

entries.source: Once again, it's a little far-fetched, but when I get creative it usually works out.
entries.translation: 再说一次，这有点牵强，但当我发挥创意时，通常都能成功。
entries.sampleRaw: Once again, it's a little far-fetched, but when I get creative it usually works out.

entries.source: For this final ingredient, we are going to need a Shadows indicate riddles, illuminating unseen stars.
entries.translation: 对于这最后一种材料，我们需要一个阴影暗示谜题，照亮未见之星。

styleMappings.Shadows indicate riddles, illuminating u: 阴影暗示谜题，照亮未见之星

entries.sampleRaw: §fFor this final ingredient, we are going to need a §5Shadows indicate riddles, illuminating unseen stars§f.

entries.source: Good luck.
A painful book, oh my.
entries.translation: 一本令人痛苦的书，天哪。

entries.source: You probably don't want to read this by the way.
entries.translation: 顺便说一句，你大概不会想读这个。
entries.sampleRaw: You probably don't want to read this by the way.

entries.source: That's it!
I did it!
The Great Spook!
There is no time to explain. I need Pumpkins, fast.
entries.translation: 没时间解释了。我需要南瓜，快。
entries.sampleRaw: §r§fThere is no time to explain. I need Pumpkins, fast.

entries.source: With this, there is a chance.
A fate worse than death itself will befall us now.
entries.translation: 比死亡本身更可怕的命运现在将降临到我们头上。
entries.sampleRaw: §r§fA fate worse than death itself will befall us now.

entries.source: It's close, way too close.
The Great Spook is near, it has never been closer.
entries.translation: 大万圣节临近了，从未如此之近。
entries.sampleRaw: §8The Great Spook§f is near, it has never been closer.

entries.source: We have to do something about it.
entries.translation: 我们必须对此采取行动。
entries.sampleRaw: We have to do something about it.

entries.source: And when I say "we", I mean "I".
entries.translation: 当我说“我们”时，我指的是“我”。
entries.sampleRaw: And when I say "we", I mean "I".

entries.source: I'm the only one who can do anything about it.
entries.translation: 我是唯一能对此做些什么的人。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm the only one who can do anything about it.

entries.source: Everyone else is profoundly useless.
entries.translation: 其他所有人都毫无用处。

entries.source: Anyways, I'm going to need a list of ingredients.
entries.translation: 总之，我需要一份材料清单。
entries.sampleRaw: Anyways, I'm going to need a list of ingredients.

entries.source: Last time, I tried to combat Spook with more Spook.
entries.translation: 上次，我试图用更多万圣气息来对抗万圣气息。
entries.sampleRaw: Last time, I tried to combat Spook with more Spook.

entries.source: This time I am going with a different approach.
entries.translation: 这次我要采取不同的方法。
entries.sampleRaw: This time I am going with a different approach.

entries.source: Furthermore, if I go down, you'll go down with me. Understand?
entries.translation: 此外，如果我倒下了，你也会跟我一起倒下。明白吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Furthermore, if I go down, you'll go down with me. Understand?

entries.source: Well, well, well.
Honestly, I would get that ingredient myself but my legs are not as good anymore.
entries.translation: 说实话，我会自己去拿那个材料，但我的腿脚已经不如从前了。
entries.sampleRaw: Honestly, I would get that ingredient myself but my legs are not as good anymore.

entries.source: And I'm also a nyctophobe, which is why I need to stop The Great Spook from happening.
entries.translation: 而且我还是个恐夜症患者，这就是为什么我必须阻止大万圣节发生。
entries.sampleRaw: And I'm also a nyctophobe, which is why I need to stop §8The Great Spook§f from happening.

entries.source: It's quite simple.
You just have to kill a Zombie with a Sweet item!
entries.translation: 你只需要用甜味物品杀死一只僵尸！
entries.sampleRaw: You just have to kill a §aZombie§f with a §aSweet§f item!

entries.source: Well, here, take these Great Spook Boots!
entries.translation: 好吧，给，拿着这双大万圣节靴子！
entries.sampleRaw: Well, here, take these §5Great Spook Boots§f!

entries.source: Quick! I really need you to craft me a Poisoned Candy.
entries.translation: 快！我真的需要你帮我制作一颗毒糖果。
entries.sampleRaw: Quick! I really need you to craft me a §aPoisoned Candy§f.

entries.source: Amateurism at it's finest!
I see..
You still haven't managed to make a bat wither?
entries.translation: 你还是没能让蝙蝠枯萎吗？
entries.sampleRaw: You still haven't managed to make a bat §7wither§f?

entries.source: Have you not been using those sub-zero materials? Go on and fetch those Decayed Bats!
entries.translation: 你难道没用那些零下材料吗？快去抓那些腐朽蝙蝠！
entries.sampleRaw: Have you not been using those §bsub-zero§f materials? Go on and fetch those §aDecayed Bats§f!

entries.source: Well, here's your reward. It's a Great Spook Chestplate.
entries.translation: 好吧，这是你的奖励。是一件大万圣节胸甲。
entries.sampleRaw: Well, here's your reward. It's a §5Great Spook Chestplate§f.

entries.source: Nice, we are finally getting somewhere!
entries.translation: 不错，我们终于有进展了！
entries.sampleRaw: Nice, we are finally getting somewhere!

entries.source: You know, I've heard these make great pies...
entries.translation: 你知道吗，我听说这些能做出很棒的派……
entries.sampleRaw: You know, I've heard these make great pies...

entries.source: Pfft. Take your rewards, this is a Great Spook Helmet.
entries.translation: 啧。拿走你的奖励吧，这是一顶大万圣节头盔。
entries.sampleRaw: Pfft. Take your rewards, this is a §5Great Spook Helmet§f.

entries.source: Please hurry up and fish up those 10 Frozen Spiders.
entries.translation: 请快点钓上那 10 只冰冻蜘蛛。
entries.sampleRaw: Please hurry up and fish up those §e10 §aFrozen Spiders§f.
entries.numericSource: Please hurry up and fish up those {{N0}} Frozen Spiders.
entries.numericTranslation: 请快点钓上那 {{N0}} 只冰冻蜘蛛。

entries.source: Oh my! The final ingredient.
I will need to study this brew back in my laboratory.
entries.translation: 我需要回实验室研究这瓶药水。
entries.sampleRaw: I will need to study this brew back in my laboratory.

entries.source: I really hope I won't have to work with you ever again, but here. Take your Great Spook Staff.
entries.translation: 我真希望以后再也不用和你合作了，不过给。拿走你的大万圣节法杖。
entries.sampleRaw: I really hope I won't have to work with you ever again, but here. Take your §5Great Spook Staff§f.

entries.source: Despite your complete lack of talent, I thank you for your help.
entries.translation: 尽管你完全毫无天赋，我还是感谢你的帮助。
entries.sampleRaw: Despite your complete lack of talent, I thank you for your help.

entries.source: I have to go back to work now.
entries.sampleRaw: I have to go back to work now.

entries.source: Hmm... you do not seem experienced enough for what I require.
entries.translation: 嗯……你似乎还不够有经验，达不到我的要求。
entries.sampleRaw: Hmm... you do not seem experienced enough for what I require.

entries.source: Hey you! Have you ever heard of the Great Spook?
entries.translation: 嘿，你！你听说过大万圣节吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Hey you! Have you ever heard of the §5Great Spook§f?

entries.source: Well, don't worry about it, but I need to do some research.
entries.translation: 好吧，别担心，但我需要做些研究。
entries.sampleRaw: Well, don't worry about it, but I need to do some research.

entries.source: If you bring me the items I need for my brew I'll reward you with armor and a staff!
entries.translation: 如果你把我酿造药水所需的物品带来，我会奖励你护甲和一根法杖！
entries.sampleRaw: If you bring me the items I need for my brew I'll reward you with armor and a staff!

entries.source: The first ingredient required is a Sweet Flesh.
entries.translation: 所需的第一种原料是甜肉。
entries.sampleRaw: The first ingredient required is a §aSweet Flesh§f.

entries.source: I need 12 of them.
Really? Still nothing?
entries.translation: 真的吗？还是什么都没有？

entries.source: It's quite simple though.
I said Sweet Flesh... Find them.
entries.translation: 我说的是甜肉……去找它们。
entries.sampleRaw: I said Sweet Flesh... Find them.

entries.source: That's not enough! I need 12 Sweet Flesh!
entries.translation: 这还不够！我需要 12 个甜肉！
entries.sampleRaw: That's not enough! I need §e12 §aSweet Flesh§f!
entries.numericSource: That's not enough! I need {{N0}} Sweet Flesh!
entries.numericTranslation: 这还不够！我需要 {{N0}} 个甜肉！

entries.source: My sweet tooth is acting up again...
entries.sampleRaw: My sweet tooth is acting up again...

entries.source: I know! Obviously a Poisoned Candy will take care of that. Find one for me.
entries.translation: 我知道！显然一颗毒糖果就能解决。帮我找一颗来。
entries.sampleRaw: I know! Obviously a §aPoisoned Candy§f will take care of that. Find one for me.

entries.source: Now, look here. I obviously need 5 Decayed Bat pronto!
entries.translation: 听着。我显然需要 5 只腐朽蝙蝠，马上！
entries.sampleRaw: Now, look here. I obviously need §e5§f §aDecayed Bat§f pronto!
entries.numericSource: Now, look here. I obviously need {{N0}} Decayed Bat pronto!
entries.numericTranslation: 听着。我显然需要 {{N0}} 只腐朽蝙蝠，马上！

entries.source: I need those Decayed Bats for YESTERDAY!!!
entries.translation: 我昨天就要那些腐朽蝙蝠了！！！
entries.sampleRaw: I need those §aDecayed Bats§f for YESTERDAY!!!

entries.source: That's not enough! I need 5 Decayed Bat!
entries.translation: 这还不够！我需要 5 只腐朽蝙蝠！
entries.sampleRaw: That's not enough! I need §e5§f §9Decayed Bat§f!
entries.numericSource: That's not enough! I need {{N0}} Decayed Bat!
entries.numericTranslation: 这还不够！我需要 {{N0}} 只腐朽蝙蝠！

entries.source: Wet! It needs to be wet! Pumpkins!
entries.sampleRaw: Wet! It needs to be wet! Pumpkins!

entries.source: Actually just one...
Yes! A single Wet Pumpkin! Go now!
entries.sampleRaw: Yes! A single §aWet Pumpkin§f! Go now!

entries.source: Needs more of a bite... Hmmm.
entries.sampleRaw: Needs more of a bite... Hmmm.

entries.source: Spiders! Oh but wait... Ice... Hmm.
entries.sampleRaw: Spiders! Oh but wait... Ice... Hmm.

entries.source: Quite clearly, the last ingredient I need is 10 Frozen Spiders...
entries.translation: 很明显，我需要的最后一种材料是 10 只冰冻蜘蛛……
entries.sampleRaw: Quite clearly, the last ingredient I need is §e10 §aFrozen Spiders§f...
entries.numericSource: Quite clearly, the last ingredient I need is {{N0}} Frozen Spiders...
entries.numericTranslation: 很明显，我需要的最后一种材料是 {{N0}} 只冰冻蜘蛛……

entries.source: Frozen Spiders! Yup that's it. I need that next. Go fetch.
entries.translation: 冰冻蜘蛛！对，就是它。我接下来需要那个。去拿来吧。
entries.sampleRaw: §aFrozen Spiders§f! Yup that's it. I need that next. Go fetch.

entries.source: That's not enough! I need 10 Frozen Spider!
entries.translation: 这还不够！我需要 10 只冰冻蜘蛛！
entries.sampleRaw: That's not enough! I need §e10 §6Frozen Spider§f!
entries.numericSource: That's not enough! I need {{N0}} Frozen Spider!
entries.numericTranslation: 这还不够！我需要 {{N0}} 只冰冻蜘蛛！

entries.source: Hmm? Oh you.
Thanks for all that. I guess.
entries.translation: 谢谢你做的这一切。大概吧。
entries.sampleRaw: Thanks for all that. I guess.

entries.source: In the future I may need you again, but for now that is all.
entries.translation: 以后我可能还会需要你，但目前就这些了。
entries.sampleRaw: In the future I may need you again, but for now that is all.

entries.source: Hmmm. I'm going to need some time to decide which ingredient I need next.
entries.translation: 嗯。我需要些时间来决定下一种材料是什么。
entries.sampleRaw: Hmmm. I'm going to need some time to decide which ingredient I need next.

entries.source: Come back in #d #h #m #s!
You... Look familiar.
I've seen you before...
You may wear different clothes but I recognise that face anywhere.
entries.translation: 你也许换了身衣服，但那张脸我绝不会认错。
entries.sampleRaw: You may wear different clothes but I recognise that face §a§oanywhere§f.

entries.source: I will not work with you here.
entries.translation: 我不会在这里和你合作。
entries.sampleRaw: I will not work with you here.

entries.source: I'm sorry, I'm not ready for you yet...
entries.translation: 抱歉，我还没准备好接待你……
entries.sampleRaw: I'm sorry, I'm not ready for you yet...

entries.source: Come back in 3-5 business days and I will have something for you.
entries.translation: 请在 3-5 个工作日后回来，我会给你准备好东西。
entries.sampleRaw: Come back in 3-5 business days and I will have something for you.
entries.numericSource: Come back in {{N0}}-{{N1}} business days and I will have something for you.
entries.numericTranslation: 请在 {{N0}}-{{N1}} 个工作日后回来，我会给你准备好东西。

entries.source: Please, I really need your help! I need a Poisoned Candy as soon as possible!
entries.translation: 拜托，我真的需要你的帮助！我需要一颗毒糖果，越快越好！
entries.sampleRaw: Please, I really need your help! I need a §aPoisoned Candy§f as soon as possible!

entries.source: Can you really not find a Poisoned Candy?!? This is basic Alchemy!
entries.translation: 你真的找不到一颗毒糖果吗？！？这是基础炼金术！
entries.sampleRaw: Can you really not find a §aPoisoned Candy§f?!? This is basic Alchemy!

entries.source: Quick! I really need you to craft me a Poisoned Candy!
entries.translation: 快！我真的需要你帮我制作一颗毒糖果！
entries.sampleRaw: Quick! I really need you to craft me a §aPoisoned Candy§f!

entries.source: I can't finish my work without those Decayed Bats!
entries.translation: 没有那些腐朽蝙蝠，我就没法完成我的工作！
entries.sampleRaw: I can't finish my work without those §aDecayed Bats§f!

entries.source: Do I really need to repeat? I need a Wet Pumpkin!
entries.translation: 我真的需要重复一遍吗?我需要一个湿南瓜!
entries.sampleRaw: Do I really need to repeat? I need a §aWet Pumpkin!

entries.source: Repeat after me. WET. PUMPKIN.
I don't appreciate your nonchalant attitude, these Frozen Spiders are extremely important.
entries.translation: 我不欣赏你这种漫不经心的态度，这些冰冻蜘蛛极其重要。
entries.sampleRaw: I don't appreciate your nonchalant attitude, these Frozen Spiders are extremely important.

entries.source: You clearly don't realize the gravity of the situation, come back once you found 10 Frozen Spider.
entries.translation: 你显然没有意识到情况的严重性，等你找到 10 只冰冻蜘蛛后再回来。
entries.sampleRaw: You clearly don't realize the gravity of the situation, come back once you found §e10 §aFrozen Spider§f.
entries.numericSource: You clearly don't realize the gravity of the situation, come back once you found {{N0}} Frozen Spider.
entries.numericTranslation: 你显然没有意识到情况的严重性，等你找到 {{N0}} 只冰冻蜘蛛后再回来。

entries.source: Hey there! I'm looking for a new type of flower to plant in my Garden.
entries.translation: 你好啊！我正在找一种新的花，想种在我的花园里。
entries.sampleRaw: Hey there! I'm looking for a new type of flower to plant in my Garden.

entries.source: This'll do nicely! Ciao!
If you ever change your mind, you know where to find me!
entries.translation: 如果你改变主意了，你知道去哪儿找我！
entries.sampleRaw: If you ever change your mind, you know where to find me!

entries.source: You need to unlock Heart of the Mountain Tier 2 to access the Forge!
entries.translation: 你需要解锁山峰之心 2 级才能使用锻造所！
entries.sampleRaw: You need to unlock Heart of the Mountain Tier 2 to access the Forge!
entries.numericSource: You need to unlock Heart of the Mountain Tier {{N0}} to access the Forge!
entries.numericTranslation: 你需要解锁山峰之心 {{N0}} 级才能使用锻造所！

entries.source: Boy do I have everything you could ever need!
entries.translation: 天哪，你需要的一切我都有！
entries.sampleRaw: Boy do I have everything you could ever need!

entries.source: As long as you need equipment that is anyway...
entries.translation: 只要你是需要装备的话……
entries.sampleRaw: As long as you need equipment that is anyway...

entries.source: They're even exclusive to the Alpha Network. Enjoy!
entries.translation: 它们甚至是 Alpha 网络专属的。玩得开心！
entries.sampleRaw: They're even exclusive to the Alpha Network. Enjoy!

entries.source: Nice! I have a Tier X Wheat Minion of my own, maybe one day you can be like me!
entries.translation: 不错！我自己也有一台 X 级小麦仆从，也许有一天你也能像我一样！
entries.sampleRaw: §fNice! I have a §9Tier X Wheat Minion §fof my own, maybe one day you can be like me!

entries.source: That Chicken Pet gives you  Farming Fortune, which gives you a chance to drop additional crops!
entries.translation: 那只鸡宠物会给你  农业幸运，让你有机会掉落额外的作物！
entries.sampleRaw: §fThat Chicken Pet gives you §6 Farming Fortune§f, which gives you a chance to drop additional crops!

entries.source: You can unlock access by leveling up your Farming Skill to Level V.
entries.translation: 你可以通过将农业技能提升到 V 级来解锁访问权限。
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou can unlock access by leveling up your §aFarming Skill §fto Level V.

entries.source: Reach Farming Skill Level V to unlock access to the Mushroom Desert.
entries.translation: 达到农业技能 V 级即可解锁蘑菇沙漠的访问权限。
entries.sampleRaw: §fReach §aFarming Skill §fLevel V §fto unlock access to the §eMushroom Desert§f.

entries.source: ✆ You want to have my number?
✆ I'd love to give you my number!
entries.translation: ✆ 我很乐意把我的号码给你！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fI'd love to give you my number!

entries.source: ✆ However, Bingo requests that you have completed at least 4 Bingo Goals before I can give you my number.
entries.translation: ✆ 不过,宾果要求你至少完成 4 个宾果目标,我才能把我的号码给你.
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fHowever, §6Bingo §frequests that you have completed at least §64 Bingo Goals §fbefore I can give you my number.
entries.numericSource: ✆ However, Bingo requests that you have completed at least {{N0}} Bingo Goals before I can give you my number.
entries.numericTranslation: ✆ 不过,宾果要求你至少完成 {{N0}} 个宾果目标,我才能把我的号码给你.

entries.source: ✆ That's a bunch of Bingo Goals you've completed!
entries.translation: ✆ 你完成的宾果目标可真不少！

entries.source: ✆ I'll gladly give you my number!
entries.translation: ✆ 我很乐意把我的号码给你！

entries.source: ✆ Hi! Did your potions run out?
✆ I'm not sure how well this works over the phone...
entries.translation: ✆ 我不确定这样通过电话效果如何……
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fI'm not sure how well this works over the phone...

entries.source: ✆ Hold your phone close to your ear, I'll throw the potions into my phone.
entries.translation: ✆ 把手机贴近耳朵，我会把药水扔进我的手机里。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fHold your phone close to your ear, I'll throw the potions into my phone.

entries.source: ✆ Wow!
✆ Potions travel much faster by phone!
entries.translation: ✆ 药水通过电话传输快多了！

entries.source: ✆ Good luck with the Bingo!
✆ I gave you potions recently! Give me some time to prepare new ones!
entries.translation: ✆ 我最近刚给过你药水！给我点时间准备新的！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fI gave you potions recently! Give me some time to prepare new ones!

entries.source: I hate Blazes. Blazes are terrible. Blazes hurt. Blazes make me cry.
entries.translation: 我恨烈焰人。烈焰人太可怕了。烈焰人很疼。烈焰人让我哭。
entries.sampleRaw: I hate Blazes. Blazes are terrible. Blazes hurt. Blazes make me cry.

entries.source: Ah, who are you?
Hmmm well, are you powerful? I enjoy watching entities display their power... or die in a pit of fire trying!
entries.translation: 嗯……那么，你强吗？我喜欢看实体展示他们的力量……或者试图这样做时死在火坑里！
entries.sampleRaw: Hmmm well, are you powerful? I enjoy watching entities display their power... or die in a pit of fire trying!

entries.source: Talk to me again, and I'll give you some challenges to entertain me... I mean, prove yourself.
entries.translation: 再跟我说话，我就给你一些挑战来取悦我……我是说，证明你自己。
entries.sampleRaw: Talk to me again, and I'll give you some challenges to entertain me... I mean, prove yourself.

entries.source: In fact, here's a little gift to encourage you to give it a try.
entries.translation: 事实上，这里有一份小礼物，鼓励你试一试。
entries.sampleRaw: In fact, here's a little gift to encourage you to give it a try.

entries.source: You were not good enough. Come back when you've trained more.
entries.translation: 你还不够好。多训练一段时间再来吧。
entries.sampleRaw: You were not good enough. Come back when you've trained more.

entries.source: Hardly skilled, but I'll let it pass. Come talk to me for your next challenge, and do better in the future.
entries.translation: 技术勉强，但我让你过关。来找我接受下一个挑战，以后要做得更好。
entries.sampleRaw: Hardly skilled, but I'll let it pass. Come talk to me for your next challenge, and do better in the future.

entries.source: Rather average, I'd say. Speak to me again to try a new challenge, or improve on this one!
entries.translation: 要我说，相当一般。再跟我说话来尝试新挑战，或者在这个挑战上做得更好！
entries.sampleRaw: Rather average, I'd say. Speak to me again to try a new challenge, or improve on this one!

entries.source: That was pretty good! Please come by again for a new challenge.
entries.translation: 那相当不错！请再来接受新挑战。
entries.sampleRaw: That was pretty good! Please come by again for a new challenge.

entries.source: Wow, that was really impressive. Come talk to me to view your next challenge.
entries.translation: 哇，那真是令人印象深刻。来找我查看你的下一个挑战。
entries.sampleRaw: Wow, that was really impressive. Come talk to me to view your next challenge.

entries.source: That was a remarkable performance! I look forward to giving you your next challenge.
entries.translation: 那真是出色的表现！我期待给你下一个挑战。
entries.sampleRaw: That was a remarkable performance! I look forward to giving you your next challenge.

entries.source: Ahhh, here we go! Let's get you into the Arena.
entries.translation: 啊哈，来了！让我把你送进竞技场。
entries.sampleRaw: Ahhh, here we go! Let's get you into the Arena.

entries.source: Have patience, I'm getting you in right now!
entries.translation: 耐心点，我现在就送你进去！
entries.sampleRaw: Have patience, I'm getting you in right now!

entries.source: It is not safe to do that challenge right now. Come back later!
entries.translation: 现在进行那个挑战不安全。晚点再来！
entries.sampleRaw: It is not safe to do that challenge right now. Come back later!

entries.source: I only test people who use their bare skills. No extra help allowed! Come back to me once you've stored your items away.
entries.translation: 我只考验那些凭自身本领的人。不允许额外帮助！把你的物品收好后再来找我。
entries.sampleRaw: I only test people who use their bare skills. No extra help allowed! Come back to me once you've §estored your items away§f.

entries.source: Your inventory includes your equipment too! Make sure that is cleared!
entries.translation: 你的物品栏也包括你的装备！确保也清空它！
entries.sampleRaw: Your inventory includes your §eequipment §ftoo! Make sure that is cleared!

entries.source: No pets allowed in the dojo! Get off of your pet.
entries.translation: 道场内不允许携带宠物！把你的宠物收起来。
entries.sampleRaw: No pets allowed in the dojo! Get off of your pet.

entries.source: Ugo is that you?
You missed yesterday's lesson.
And the one before that.
So today you'll have to do three lessons.
entries.translation: 所以今天你得完成三节课。
entries.sampleRaw: So today you'll have to do §7three §flessons.

entries.source: The first one is a Test of Force.
entries.sampleRaw: The first one is a §2Test of Force§f.

entries.source: Go in the Arena.
Humph. This will do for now.
entries.sampleRaw: Humph. This will do for now.

entries.source: Onto the next Test, Stamina this time.
entries.translation: 进入下一个试炼，这次是耐力。

entries.source: You are not performing that well today, but I'll accept that score for today.
entries.translation: 你今天表现不太好，但我接受今天的这个分数。
entries.sampleRaw: You are not performing that well today, but I'll accept that score for today.

entries.source: One more test before I let you go. The Test of Mastery.
entries.translation: 放你走之前还有一个试炼。精通试炼。
entries.sampleRaw: One more test before I let you go. The §2Test of Mastery§f.

entries.source: Well done Ugo, you finished your training for today.
entries.translation: 干得好，Ugo，你完成了今天的训练。
entries.sampleRaw: Well done Ugo, you finished your training for today.

entries.source: Remember Ugo, I can show you the path but I can not walk it for you.
entries.translation: 记住，Ugo，我可以为你指路，但我不能替你走。
entries.sampleRaw: Remember Ugo, I can show you the path but I can not walk it for you.

entries.source: If you want to make your father proud you will have to train more than it is expected of you.
entries.translation: 如果你想让你父亲骄傲，你就必须付出超出预期的努力去训练。
entries.sampleRaw: If you want to make your father proud you will have to train more than it is expected of you.

entries.source: Respect your training and you will respect yourself.
entries.translation: 尊重你的训练，你就会尊重你自己。
entries.sampleRaw: Respect your training and you will respect yourself.

entries.source: Go now.
Make sure you empty your inventory entirely before you enter.
entries.translation: 进入之前，务必把背包彻底清空。
entries.sampleRaw: Make sure you empty your inventory entirely before you enter.

entries.source: Ugo! You know very well you need to store all your items away before you enter the Arena.
entries.translation: Ugo！你很清楚，进入竞技场之前必须把所有物品都存放好。
entries.sampleRaw: Ugo! You know very well you need to store all your items away before you enter the Arena.

entries.source: This isn't good enough Ugo! Your father would be very annoyed if I told him the score you got!
entries.translation: 这还不够好，Ugo！要是我把你得到的分数告诉你父亲，他会非常恼火的！
entries.sampleRaw: This isn't good enough Ugo! Your father would be very annoyed if I told him the score you got!

entries.source: Go back inside and do better!
entries.sampleRaw: Go back inside and do better!

entries.source: You can use \/guides to view all of the guides you've learned about.
entries.translation: 你可以使用 \/guides 查看你已学会的所有指南。
entries.sampleRaw: You can use §b\/guides§f to view all of the guides you've learned about.

entries.source: It's time to play SkyBlock Bingo!
entries.translation: 是时候来玩 SkyBlock 宾果了！

entries.source: If you join, you have 7 days to complete as many tasks as you can on a fresh, temporary profile!
entries.translation: 如果你加入,你将有 7 天时间在一个全新的临时档上尽可能多地完成任务!
entries.sampleRaw: If you join, you have §a7 days§f to complete as many tasks as you can on a §afresh, temporary profile§f!
entries.numericSource: If you join, you have {{N0}} days to complete as many tasks as you can on a fresh, temporary profile!
entries.numericTranslation: 如果你加入,你将有 {{N0}} 天时间在一个全新的临时档上尽可能多地完成任务!

entries.source: Check back soon to join the <month> <year> Bingo Event!
entries.translation: 稍后再来看看，加入 <month> <year> 宾果活动！
entries.sampleRaw: Check back soon to join the §a<month> <year> Bingo Event§f!

entries.source: Welcome to the <month> <year> SkyBlock Bingo event!
entries.translation: 欢迎来到 <month> <year> SkyBlock 宾果活动！

entries.source: The <month> <year> Bingo Event has concluded!
I will stick around for a bit longer, but then I'll be gone until next event at the start of the month!
entries.translation: 我还会再待一会儿，但之后我就会离开，直到下个月初的下一次活动！
entries.sampleRaw: I will stick around for a bit longer, but then I'll be gone until next event at the start of the month!

entries.source: Check out the Bingo Shop to spend Bingo Points while supplies last!
entries.translation: 趁库存还在，去宾果商店花掉宾果点数吧！
entries.sampleRaw: Check out the §bBingo Shop§f to spend §6Bingo Points§f while supplies last!

entries.source: I want to be like Jerry some day...
entries.translation: 我希望有一天能像 Jerry 一样……
entries.sampleRaw: I want to be like Jerry some day...

entries.source: Long live Jerry!
This is a beautiful rendition of such a perfect Jerry!
entries.translation: 这是对如此完美的 Jerry 的绝妙演绎！
entries.sampleRaw: This is a beautiful rendition of such a perfect Jerry!

entries.source: Jerry is so beautiful!
Jerry Best!
I love Jerry!
I hope I get to meet Jerry some day.
entries.translation: 我希望有一天能见到 Jerry。
entries.sampleRaw: I hope I get to meet Jerry some day.

entries.source: Check it out!
[Player], that's an excellent power!
I'm not so sure about this power, it's used by some dark wizards.
entries.translation: 我对这种力量不太确定，它被一些黑暗巫师使用。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm not so sure about this power, it's used by some dark wizards.

entries.source: A wise choice, [Player]!
I've learned this power myself, [Player].
entries.translation: 我自己也学会了这个力量，[Player]。

entries.source: ✆ You want my Abiphone contact?
entries.translation: ✆ 你想要我的 Abiphone 联系方式？

entries.source: ✆ Don't you know you are supposed to walk all the way here every single time?
entries.translation: ✆ 你难道不知道每次都得亲自走这么远的路过来吗？
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f Don't you know you are supposed to walk all the way here every single time?

entries.source: ✆ Plus it's a magical object, so it's not that bad.
entries.translation: ✆ 再说它是个魔法物品，所以也没那么糟。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f Plus it's a magical object, so it's not that bad.

entries.source: ✆ What about some more Luxurious Spool, hum?
entries.translation: ✆ 再来点华丽线轴怎么样，嗯？
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f What about some more §aLuxurious Spool§f, hum?

entries.source: ✆ You don't have what I need! Nice try!
entries.translation: ✆ 你没有我需要的东西！想得美！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fYou don't have what I need! Nice try!

entries.source: Wealth consists not in having great possessions, but in having few wants.
entries.translation: 财富不在于拥有大量财产，而在于欲望寥寥。
entries.sampleRaw: Wealth consists not in having great possessions, but in having few wants.

entries.source: Coins isn't everything, but everything needs coins.
entries.translation: 金币不是一切，但一切都需要金币。
entries.sampleRaw: Coins isn't everything, but everything needs coins.

entries.source: It's not the Steve who has too little, but the Steve who craves more, who is poor.
entries.translation: 贫穷的不是拥有太少的史蒂夫，而是渴望更多的史蒂夫。
entries.sampleRaw: It's not the Steve who has too little, but the Steve who craves more, who is poor.

entries.source: You must gain control over your coins or the lack of it will forever control you.
entries.translation: 你必须掌控你的金币，否则金币的匮乏将永远掌控你。
entries.sampleRaw: You must gain control over your coins or the lack of it will forever control you.

entries.source: Coins don't buy happiness, but it helps.
entries.translation: 金币买不到幸福，但能帮上忙。
entries.sampleRaw: Coins don't buy happiness, but it helps.

entries.source: Click me again to open the Builder Shop!
entries.sampleRaw: Click me again to open the Builder Shop!

entries.source: ✆ Oh?
✆ Yes... I could give you my contact... However, may I ask a favor in return?
entries.translation: ✆ 是的……我可以把我的联系方式给你……不过，我能请你帮个忙作为回报吗？
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f Yes... I could give you my contact... However, may I ask a favor in return?

entries.source: ✆ For a builder to not have a Builder's Wand is quite uncommon.
entries.translation: ✆ 一个建筑工没有建筑魔杖，这可不太常见。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f For a builder to not have a §6Builder's Wand§f is quite uncommon.

entries.source: ✆ If you give me one I'll gladly give you my contact!
entries.translation: ✆ 如果你给我一个，我会很乐意把我的联系方式给你！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f If you give me one I'll gladly give you my contact!

entries.source: ✆ A Builder's Wand! This is a dream come true!
entries.translation: ✆ 一根建筑魔杖！梦想成真了！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f A §6Builder's Wand§f! This is a dream come true!

entries.source: ✆ You don't have what I need! Nice try!
entries.translation: ✆ 你没有我需要的东西！想得美！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f You don't have what I need! Nice try!

entries.sampleRaw: Hey if you really want to know…

Welcome to my Den!
I'm a spider, I eat humans, I'm evil, etc... Just bear with me.
entries.translation: 我是一只蜘蛛，我吃人，我很邪恶，等等……请多担待。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm a spider, I eat humans, I'm evil, etc... Just bear with me.

entries.source: I can't eat people wearing armor like you are.
entries.translation: 我可吃不了像你这样穿着盔甲的人。
entries.sampleRaw: I can't eat people wearing armor like you are.

entries.source: So why don't we make a deal?
entries.translation: 所以我们何不做个交易？
entries.sampleRaw: So why don't we make a deal?

entries.source: You bring me a delicious meal, one without any armor. I'll take them out and you get a reward!
entries.translation: 你给我带来一顿美味的大餐，一个没穿盔甲的。我把他解决掉，你就能得到奖励！
entries.sampleRaw: You bring me a delicious §cmeal§f, one without any armor. I'll take them out and you get a reward!

entries.source: What say you? Are you in?
entries.sampleRaw: What say you? Are you in?

entries.source: ✆ Hey you! Psst!
✆ I'm hungry again and I need a meal.
entries.translation: ✆ 我又饿了，我需要一顿饭。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fI'm hungry again and I need a §cmeal§f.

entries.source: ✆ Could you come help me out at my Den? And bring a friend. ;)
entries.translation: ✆ 你能来我的巢穴帮帮我吗？再带个朋友来。;)
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fCould you come help me out at my Den? And bring a friend. §a;)

entries.source: Yummy yummy in my tummy!
What a feast!
You are quite unscrupulous! Maybe we can be friends!
entries.translation: 你可真是肆无忌惮！也许我们能成为朋友！
entries.sampleRaw: You are quite unscrupulous! Maybe we can be friends!

entries.source: I mean that works too!
Nom nom nom.
Mmmm, mmm, MMMMM!
I'll give you something pretty useful. You'll see.
entries.translation: 我会给你一些相当有用的东西。你等着瞧吧。
entries.sampleRaw: I'll give you something pretty useful. You'll see.

entries.source: It has to be a human, and they cannot be wearing any armor. That's all I'm asking!
entries.translation: 必须是人类，而且他们不能穿任何盔甲。我就这点要求！
entries.sampleRaw: It has to be a human, and they cannot be wearing any armor. That's all I'm asking!

entries.source: ✆ I am famished! Bring me a meal and I will reward you!
entries.translation: ✆ 我饿坏了！给我带一顿饭来，我会奖励你的！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fI am famished! Bring me a §cmeal §fand I will reward you!

entries.source: ✆ Bring me a human meal. No armor! Thank you!
entries.translation: ✆ 给我带一顿人类的饭来。不许穿盔甲！谢谢！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fBring me a §chuman meal§f. No armor! Thank you!

entries.source: ✆ Hey, just the one I needed to hear from!
entries.translation: ✆ 嘿，正是我想听到的那个人！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fHey, just the one I needed to hear from!

entries.source: Maybe you can lure another unsuspecting meal when I'm hungry again?
entries.translation: 等我下次饿了，也许你可以再引诱一个毫无防备的猎物来？
entries.sampleRaw: Maybe you can lure another unsuspecting meal when I'm hungry again?

entries.source: I dunno, just a though.
entries.translation: 我不知道，只是随便想想。

entries.source: I'm full!
I was famished! Thanks!
There is no time...
I need to prepare.
Ahhhh!
Don't kill me!!!!
Excuse me. You really scared me!
entries.translation: 打扰一下。你真的吓到我了！
entries.sampleRaw: Excuse me. You really scared me!

entries.source: I'm not a gambler, but if I had to bet on a faction to win this war, I wouldn't bet on us.
entries.translation: 我不是赌徒，但如果非要我押哪个阵营能赢得这场战争，我不会押我们。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm not a gambler, but if I had to bet on a faction to win this war, I wouldn't bet on us.

entries.source: Soon enough I'll barricade myself in my basement.
entries.translation: 很快我就会把自己封死在地下室里。

styleMappings.barricade myself in my basement: 把自己封死在地下室里

entries.sampleRaw: Soon enough I'll §2barricade myself in my basement§f.

entries.source: I have enough provisions to last at least 7 months.
entries.translation: 我的储备足够撑至少 7 个月。
entries.sampleRaw: I have enough provisions to last at least 7 months.
entries.numericSource: I have enough provisions to last at least {{N0}} months.
entries.numericTranslation: 我的储备足够撑至少 {{N0}} 个月。

entries.source: That's not enough...no that's far from enough.
entries.translation: 那还不够……不，那远远不够。
entries.sampleRaw: That's not enough...no that's far from enough.

entries.source: What I need the most right now is a Heavy Pearl.
entries.translation: 我现在最需要的就是一颗重型珍珠。
entries.sampleRaw: What I need the most right now is a §2Heavy Pearl§f.

entries.source: If you bring one to me I'll reward you handsomely.
entries.translation: 如果你带一颗给我，我会给你丰厚的奖励。
entries.sampleRaw: If you bring one to me I'll reward you handsomely.

entries.source: There is only one way to obtain Heavy Pearls.
entries.translation: 获取重型珍珠只有一种方法。
entries.sampleRaw: There is only one way to obtain §2Heavy Pearls§f.

entries.source: First you have to go down in that giant cave below the Volcano.
entries.translation: 首先，你得下到火山下方那个巨大的洞穴里。

styleMappings.giant cave below the Volcano: 火山下方那个巨大的洞穴

entries.sampleRaw: First you have to go down in that §2giant cave below the Volcano§f.

entries.source: From there you need to enter the cave that goes North-West.
entries.translation: 从那里，你需要进入朝西北方向延伸的洞穴。
entries.sampleRaw: From there you need to enter the cave that goes §cNorth-West§f.

entries.source: Inside that cave lives very rare creatures called Hellwisps.
entries.translation: 那个洞穴里住着一种非常稀有的生物，叫做地狱幽魂。
entries.sampleRaw: Inside that cave lives very rare creatures called §cHellwisps§f.

entries.source: If you keep going down and down, you'll find another cave, which leads to The Matriarch.
entries.translation: 如果你一直往下走，会发现另一个洞穴，通往女族长。
entries.sampleRaw: If you keep going down and down, you'll find another cave, which leads to §cThe Matriarch§f.

entries.source: That creature is much larger than the other ones and has been there for decades, if not centuries.
entries.translation: 那只生物比其他生物大得多，已经在那里待了几十年，甚至几百年。
entries.sampleRaw: That creature is much larger than the other ones and has been there for decades, if not centuries.

entries.source: To get a Heavy Pearl, you need to let the Matriarch eat you alive.
entries.translation: 要获得重型珍珠，你需要让女族长把你活活吃掉。
entries.sampleRaw: To get a §2Heavy Pearl§f, you need to let the §cMatriarch §feat you alive.

entries.source: Once you are inside its stomach, you can steal a few pearls.
entries.translation: 一旦你进入它的胃里，就可以偷走几颗珍珠。
entries.sampleRaw: Once you are inside its stomach, you can §2steal a few pearls§f.

entries.source: Then all you have to do is escape before the acid kills you, I think there is a way but I'm not so sure how.
entries.translation: 然后你只需要在酸液杀死你之前逃出去，我想应该有办法，但我不太确定怎么逃。

styleMappings.escape before the acid kills you: 在酸液杀死你之前逃出去

entries.sampleRaw: Then all you have to do is §2escape before the acid kills you§f, I think there is a way but I'm not so sure how.

entries.source: You have to get the pearls on your first try because the Matriarch won't eat you again.
entries.translation: 你必须在第一次尝试时就拿到珍珠，因为女族长不会再吃你一次。
entries.sampleRaw: You have to get the pearls on your first try because the §cMatriarch §fwon't eat you again.

entries.source: Usually it takes at least a day before she forgets your scent and eats you again.
entries.translation: 通常至少要过一天，她才会忘记你的气味并再次吃掉你。
entries.sampleRaw: Usually it takes at least a day before she forgets your scent and eats you again.

entries.source: Please bring me back one of those Heavy Pearls.
entries.translation: 请给我带回来一颗重型珍珠。
entries.sampleRaw: Please bring me back one of those §2Heavy Pearls§f.

entries.source: I think the best way to get out is for The Matriarch to spit you out, but I'll admit I don't know how.
entries.translation: 我觉得最好的出去办法是让女族长把你吐出来，但我得承认我不知道怎么做。
entries.sampleRaw: I think the best way to get out is for §cThe Matriarch §fto spit you out, but I'll admit I don't know how.

entries.source: Heavy Pearls have many, many properties.
entries.translation: 重型珍珠有许许多多的特性。

entries.translation: 呀啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！

entries.translation: 你差点把我吓出心脏病！！！

entries.translation: 哦，你竟然弄到了一颗重型珍珠！

entries.sampleRaw: Now that you mention it, I remember how to escape the belly of §fthe §cMatriarch§f!

entries.translation: 你只需要打它的悬雍垂！
entries.sampleRaw: All you have to do it punch its uvula!

entries.source: In a way they are not so different than us.
entries.translation: 从某种意义上说，它们和我们并没有那么不同。
entries.sampleRaw: In a way they are not so different than us.

entries.translation: 非常感谢，这些金币你拿着。
entries.sampleRaw: Thank you very much, here take these §6Coins§f.

✆ Contanct. For you. Here.
I've been studying the ancient artifacts of Kuudra.
entries.translation: 我一直在研究库德拉的古代神器。
entries.sampleRaw: I've been studying the ancient artifacts of Kuudra.

entries.source: I found this artifact that had some weird writing on it.
entries.translation: 我找到了这件神器，上面有一些奇怪的文字。
entries.sampleRaw: I found this artifact that had some weird writing on it.

entries.source: It seems to be missing some information so I can't figure out what it means.
entries.translation: 它似乎缺少了一些信息，所以我弄不明白它是什么意思。
entries.sampleRaw: It seems to be missing some information so I can't figure out what it means.

entries.source: There has to be information somewhere that can fill in the blanks.
entries.translation: 肯定有某处的信息能填补这些空白。
entries.sampleRaw: There has to be information somewhere that can fill in the blanks.

entries.source: If you want to take a look here is what it says.
entries.translation: 如果你想看看，上面写的是这些。
entries.sampleRaw: If you want to take a look here is what it says.

entries.source: Is that a Kuudra relic?
Where did you find it?
Whatever, it doesn't matter.
Since you brought this to me, I'll give you something to show my appreciation.
entries.translation: 既然你把它带给了我，我就给你点东西以表谢意。
entries.sampleRaw: Since you brought this to me, I'll give you something to show my appreciation.

entries.source: Thanks for showing me the Kuudra relic!
entries.translation: 谢谢你给我看库德拉圣物！
entries.sampleRaw: Thanks for showing me the Kuudra relic!

entries.source: You never did tell me how you found it...
entries.translation: 你一直没告诉我你是怎么找到它的……
entries.sampleRaw: You never did tell me how you found it...

entries.source: Ah yes the Exquisite Kuudra Teeth Plaque!
entries.translation: 啊对，精美的库德拉牙齿徽章！

styleMappings.Exquisite Kuudra Teeth Plaque: 精美的库德拉牙齿徽章

entries.source: I'll go ahead and help break that down for you!
entries.translation: 我来帮你把它拆解一下吧！
entries.sampleRaw: §r§fI'll go ahead and help break that down for you!

entries.source: You know... this item can be very helpful to unlock something special!
entries.translation: 你知道吗……这件物品对解锁某个特别的东西非常有帮助！
entries.sampleRaw: §r§fYou know... this item can be very helpful to unlock something special!

entries.source: I am a conqueror. I've defeated everything from the Nether to the End and back.
entries.translation: 我是一名征服者。从下界到末地，再回来，我击败了一切。
entries.sampleRaw: I am a conqueror. I've defeated everything from the Nether to the End and back.

entries.source: There's something about you I don't like. Perhaps it is your lack of fear for the great beast that is the Nether.
entries.translation: 你身上有某种我不喜欢的东西。也许是你对下界这头巨兽缺乏恐惧吧。
entries.sampleRaw: There's something about you I don't like. Perhaps it is your lack of fear for the great beast that is the Nether.

entries.source: Go forth and conquer, [Player's Name]. And don't come crying to me when you fail.
entries.translation: 去征服吧，[Player's Name]。失败的时候别跑来向我哭诉。
entries.sampleRaw: Go forth and conquer, [Player's Name]. And don't come crying to me when you fail.

entries.source: I told you not to come crying to me.
entries.translation: 我告诉过你别跑来向我哭诉。
entries.sampleRaw: I told you not to come crying to me.

entries.source: Collect nether wart and defeat blaze to collect blaze rods!
entries.translation: 收集下界疣并击败烈焰人，收集烈焰棒！
entries.sampleRaw: Collect nether wart and defeat blaze to collect blaze rods!

entries.source: Collect glowstone, nether quartz, and magma cream to become a true master of the Nether.
entries.translation: 收集荧石、下界石英和岩浆膏，成为真正的下界大师。
entries.sampleRaw: Collect glowstone, nether quartz, and magma cream to become a true master of the Nether.

entries.source: I have defeated the Magma Boss more times than I can count!
entries.translation: 我击败岩浆Boss的次数多到数不清！
entries.sampleRaw: I have defeated the Magma Boss more times than I can count!

entries.source: Many of the creatures on this island drop useful brewing ingredients. Use them in a Brewing Stand to brew strong potions that will aid to your journey.
entries.translation: 这座岛上的许多生物都会掉落有用的酿造材料。把它们放进酿造台，酿出能助你旅途一臂之力的强力药水。
entries.sampleRaw: Many of the creatures on this island drop useful brewing ingredients. Use them in a Brewing Stand to brew strong potions that will aid to your journey.

entries.source: I don't know what would I do without my Fire Resistance Potions. Probably burn.
entries.translation: 没有我的抗火药水，我真不知道该怎么办。大概会被烧死吧。
entries.sampleRaw: I don't know what would I do without my Fire Resistance Potions. Probably burn.

entries.source: Use them in a Brewing Stand to brew strong potions that will aid in your journey.
entries.translation: 把它们放进酿造台，酿出能助你旅途一臂之力的强力药水。
entries.sampleRaw: Use them in a Brewing Stand to brew strong potions that will aid in your journey.

entries.source: Hello there, adventurer!
You look like someone who could help me with my research!
entries.translation: 你看起来像是能帮我做研究的人！
entries.sampleRaw: You look like someone who could help me with my research!

entries.source: If you join our faction I might have some tasks for you.
entries.translation: 如果你加入我们的阵营，我或许有些任务交给你。
entries.sampleRaw: If you join our faction I might have some tasks for you.

entries.source: I'll make it worth your while.
entries.translation: 我会让你觉得不虚此行的。
entries.sampleRaw: I'll make it worth your while.

entries.source: You have no business talking to me.
entries.sampleRaw: You have no business talking to me.

entries.source: I'm the local alchemist, I do research on different types of gold.
entries.translation: 我是本地的炼金术士，我研究不同种类的黄金。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm the local alchemist, I do research on different types of gold.

entries.source: If you have some time maybe you could help me with some tasks.
entries.translation: 如果你有时间，也许可以帮我完成一些任务。
entries.sampleRaw: If you have some time maybe you could help me with some tasks.

entries.source: I'll make sure it's worth your time.
entries.translation: 我会确保这值得你花时间。
entries.sampleRaw: I'll make sure it's worth your time.

entries.source: Talk to me again if you want to help out.
entries.translation: 如果你想帮忙，就再来找我谈谈。
entries.sampleRaw: Talk to me again if you want to help out.

entries.source: To start out I'll need some generic gold to experiment on, could you get me a stack?
entries.translation: 首先我需要一些普通黄金来做实验，你能给我拿一组吗？
entries.sampleRaw: To start out I'll need some generic gold to experiment on, could you get me a stack?

entries.source: Next I need some flat gold to test how reflective gold is, could you try forging gold into 5 gold plates?
entries.translation: 接下来我需要一些扁平的金子来测试黄金的反射性，你能试着把黄金锻造成 5 块金板吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Next I need some flat gold to test how reflective gold is, could you try forging gold into 5 gold plates?
entries.numericSource: Next I need some flat gold to test how reflective gold is, could you try forging gold into {{N0}} gold plates?
entries.numericTranslation: 接下来我需要一些扁平的金子来测试黄金的反射性，你能试着把黄金锻造成 {{N0}} 块金板吗？

entries.source: I heard there exist golden boots that helps you swim faster in water. I would like to test their magical properties, could you bring me them?
entries.translation: 我听说有一种金靴子能帮你在水里游得更快。我想测试它们的魔法特性，你能把它们带来给我吗？
entries.sampleRaw: I heard there exist golden boots that helps you swim faster in water. I would like to test their magical properties, could you bring me them?

entries.source: It seems like the first piece you brought me is only 25% of the magical power, could you get me the leggings?
entries.translation: 看来你带给我的第一件只有 25% 的魔法力量，你能再给我拿条护腿吗？
entries.sampleRaw: It seems like the first piece you brought me is only 25% of the magical power, could you get me the leggings?
entries.numericSource: It seems like the first piece you brought me is only {{N0}} of the magical power, could you get me the leggings?
entries.numericTranslation: 看来你带给我的第一件只有 {{N0}} 的魔法力量，你能再给我拿条护腿吗？

entries.source: Now I need a lot of compacted gold, it has to be extremely dense. A half stack should do.
entries.translation: 现在我需要大量压缩黄金，它必须极其致密。半组应该就够了。
entries.sampleRaw: Now I need a lot of compacted gold, it has to be extremely dense. A half stack should do.

entries.source: There is a fine-grained gold substance somewhere in the Hub, I'll need 5 of that.
entries.translation: 中心岛某处有一种细粒黄金物质，我需要 5 个。
entries.sampleRaw: There is a fine-grained gold substance somewhere in the Hub, I'll need 5 of that.
entries.numericSource: There is a fine-grained gold substance somewhere in the Hub, I'll need {{N0}} of that.
entries.numericTranslation: 中心岛某处有一种细粒黄金物质，我需要 {{N0}} 个。

entries.source: Next I'm going to need a vegetable that is made out of solid gold. I want to experiment with how gold interacts with organics, maybe you could find some, like a half stack?
entries.translation: 接下来我需要一种由纯金制成的蔬菜。我想实验黄金与有机物如何相互作用，也许你能找到一些，比如半组？
entries.sampleRaw: Next I'm going to need a vegetable that is made out of solid gold. I want to experiment with how gold interacts with organics, maybe you could find some, like a half stack?

entries.source: I just need one last thing, there's an extremely dangerous scientist who sells an assortment of items, he has a special rounded type of gold. Try to convince him to sell you it.
entries.translation: 我只需要最后一样东西，有个极其危险的科学家出售各种物品，他有一种特殊的圆形黄金。试着说服他卖给你。
entries.sampleRaw: I just need one last thing, there's an extremely dangerous scientist who sells an assortment of items, he has a special rounded type of gold. Try to convince him to sell you it.

entries.source: Finally, my research is complete!
You have single-handedly sped up my research by several years.
entries.translation: 你单枪匹马把我的研究推进了好几年。
entries.sampleRaw: You have single-handedly sped up my research by several years.

entries.source: As promised, here is your reward.
entries.translation: 如约而至，这是你的奖励。
entries.sampleRaw: As promised, here is your reward.

entries.source: If I ever need your help, I will be sure to let you know!
entries.translation: 如果我需要你的帮助，我一定会通知你！
entries.sampleRaw: If I ever need your help, I will be sure to let you know!

entries.source: This isn't the correct amount of the item I asked for.
entries.translation: 这可不是我要的物品数量。
entries.sampleRaw: This isn't the correct amount of the item I asked for.

entries.source: I need the EXACT amount I asked for!
entries.translation: 我需要的是我要求的精确数量！
entries.sampleRaw: I need the EXACT amount I asked for!

entries.source: Exploring the whole wide world makes me hungry, I could take some fresh potatoes.
entries.translation: 探索广阔世界让我饿了，我可以拿些新鲜马铃薯。
entries.sampleRaw: Exploring the whole wide world makes me hungry, I could take some fresh potatoes.

entries.source: Thanks man, that should be enough food for my travels.
entries.translation: 谢了兄弟，这些食物应该够我旅行了。
entries.sampleRaw: Thanks man, that should be enough food for my travels.

entries.source: Darn it, I'll have to find another farmer then.
entries.translation: 该死，那我得另找一个农夫了。
entries.sampleRaw: Darn it, I'll have to find another farmer then.

entries.source: I learned more than I could have from success alone.
entries.translation: 我从失败中学到的比单靠成功学到的还多。
entries.sampleRaw: I learned more than I could have from success alone.

entries.source: And I've been taking notes.
Next time, things will be different, you will see.
entries.translation: 下次，情况会不一样的，你等着瞧。
entries.sampleRaw: Next time, things will be different, you will see.

entries.source: I'm going back to the drawing boards.
entries.sampleRaw: I'm going back to the drawing boards.

entries.source: I've noticed how many people have been stopping by.
entries.translation: 我注意到有很多人一直在过来。
entries.sampleRaw: I've noticed how many people have been stopping by.

entries.source: My lab doesn't feel very secret anymore.
entries.translation: 我的实验室感觉已经没那么隐秘了。
entries.sampleRaw: My lab doesn't feel very secret anymore.

entries.source: I do not take any visitors at the moment.
entries.translation: 我目前不接待任何访客。
entries.sampleRaw: I do not take any visitors at the moment.

entries.source: Feel free to visit my laboratory.
entries.translation: 欢迎随时参观我的实验室。
entries.sampleRaw: Feel free to visit my laboratory.

entries.source: I am currently working on my evil plan.
entries.translation: 我目前正在筹备我的邪恶计划。
entries.sampleRaw: I am currently working on my evil plan.

entries.source: A few more years and I should be ready.
entries.translation: 再过几年我就应该准备好了。
entries.sampleRaw: A few more years and I should be ready.

entries.source: Make yourself at home.
I wish I could serve you some tea.
entries.sampleRaw: I wish I could serve you some tea.

entries.source: Sorry, I'm a terrible host.
entries.translation: 抱歉，我是个糟糕的主人。

entries.source: Plotting an evil plan is actually a lot of work.
entries.translation: 策划邪恶计划其实挺费功夫的。
entries.sampleRaw: Plotting an evil plan is actually a lot of work.

entries.source: Careful, don't stand in my way please.
entries.sampleRaw: Careful, don't stand in my way please.

entries.source: I'm not ready to show my face to the world yet.
entries.translation: 我还没准备好向世人露面。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm not ready to show my face to the world yet.

entries.source: Who are you and who gave you the code?
entries.translation: 你是谁，是谁给了你代码？
entries.sampleRaw: Who are you and who gave you the code?

entries.source: You are not supposed to be here.
entries.sampleRaw: You are not supposed to be here.

entries.source: To be fair, I'm not supposed to be here either.
entries.translation: 说实话，我也不该出现在这里。
entries.sampleRaw: To be fair, I'm not supposed to be here either.

entries.source: If you are here for business then it makes no difference to me.
entries.translation: 如果你是来做生意的，那对我来说没什么区别。
entries.sampleRaw: If you are here for business then it makes no difference to me.

entries.source: I sell Abiphones straight from the Mage faction.
entries.translation: 我直接出售来自法师阵营的Abiphone。
entries.sampleRaw: I sell §5Abiphones§f straight from the §5Mage§f faction.

entries.source: Morning, adventurer!
Wait, is it? I'm not sure; it's always so dark here...
entries.translation: 等等，是吗？我不确定；这里总是这么黑……
entries.sampleRaw: §fWait, is it? I'm not sure; it's always so dark here...

entries.source: Oh well, anyway, I can provide all manners of fun minions to you!
entries.translation: 好吧，总之，我可以为你提供各种有趣的仆从！
entries.sampleRaw: §fOh well, anyway, I can provide all manners of fun minions to you!

entries.source: Evening, adventurer!
Wait, is it? I'm not sure; it's always so bright in here...
entries.translation: 等等，是吗？我不确定；这里总是这么亮……
entries.sampleRaw: §fWait, is it? I'm not sure; it's always so bright in here...

entries.source: Oh well, anyway, I can sell all kinds of functional minions to you!
entries.translation: 好吧，总之，我可以卖给你各种实用的仆从！
entries.sampleRaw: §fOh well, anyway, I can sell all kinds of functional minions to you!

entries.source: A week...I only have a week...
entries.sampleRaw: A week...I only have a week...

entries.source: I have beef with a mage and we agreed to have a duel in a week.
entries.translation: 我和一个法师结了梁子，我们约好一周后决斗。
entries.sampleRaw: I have beef with a mage and we agreed to have a duel in a week.

entries.source: Why did I agree to this? I've never fought in my life!
entries.translation: 我为什么要答应这个？我这辈子从没打过架！
entries.sampleRaw: Why did I agree to this? I've never fought in my life!

entries.source: Would you mind helping me train? You would save my life!
entries.translation: 你愿意帮我训练吗？你会救我一命的！
entries.sampleRaw: Would you mind helping me train? You would save my life!

entries.source: I'm ready to fight again, are you also ready?
entries.translation: 我准备好再次战斗了，你也准备好了吗？
entries.sampleRaw: I'm ready to fight again, are you also ready?

entries.source: I'm ready for my lesson, are you?
entries.sampleRaw: I'm ready for my lesson, are you?

entries.source: I can tell I'm improving, let's keep going, shall we?
entries.translation: 我能感觉到自己在进步，我们继续吧，好吗？
entries.sampleRaw: I can tell I'm improving, let's keep going, shall we?

entries.source: Only 3 more training sessions, are you ready?
entries.translation: 只剩 3 次训练了，你准备好了吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Only 3 more training sessions, are you ready?
entries.numericSource: Only {{N0}} more training sessions, are you ready?
entries.numericTranslation: 只剩 {{N0}} 次训练了，你准备好了吗？

entries.source: I had a good night's sleep. I'm so ready for this session, are you?
entries.translation: 我昨晚睡得很好。我太期待这次训练了，你呢？
entries.sampleRaw: I had a good night's sleep. I'm so ready for this session, are you?

entries.source: 7 days, 7 lessons.
Are you ready for my last training session?
entries.translation: 你准备好参加我最后一次训练了吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Are you ready for my last training session?

entries.source: Great! Let's do this then!
Don't go easy on me, I'm very bad but I only have a week to improve.
entries.translation: 别对我手下留情，我很差劲，但我只有一周时间来提升。
entries.sampleRaw: Don't go easy on me, I'm very bad but I only have a week to improve.

entries.source: Let's fight!
Heck, I'm in trouble then.
I got one tapped...
That's disturbing.
Please come back tomorrow and help me train again!
entries.translation: 请明天再来帮我训练吧！
entries.sampleRaw: Please come back tomorrow and help me train again!

entries.source: You are beating me too easily, this isn't helping with my insecurity...
entries.translation: 你太轻松就打败我了，这对我的不自信可没什么帮助……
entries.sampleRaw: You are beating me too easily, this isn't helping with my insecurity...

entries.source: Please come back tomorrow.
My lord...
Just how weak am I?
You are the best teacher I could have hoped for...
entries.translation: 你是我能期望的最好的老师……
entries.sampleRaw: You are the best teacher I could have hoped for...

entries.source: I really hope I'll be ready on time.
entries.translation: 我真希望我能按时准备好。
entries.sampleRaw: I really hope I'll be ready on time.

entries.source: I'm getting better! Let's go!!
We are getting there!
What a match, I truly enjoy sparring with you.
entries.translation: 好一场对决，我真的很享受和你切磋。
entries.sampleRaw: What a match, I truly enjoy sparring with you.

entries.source: I am so happy with the improvements I've made this week, and it's all thanks to you.
entries.translation: 我对自己这周取得的进步非常满意，这全都多亏了你。
entries.sampleRaw: I am so happy with the improvements I've made this week, and it's all thanks to you.

entries.source: Just a week ago I was feeling insecure, now I'm going to this duel with confidence.
entries.translation: 就在一周前我还很不自信，现在我要满怀信心地去参加这场决斗了。
entries.sampleRaw: Just a week ago I was feeling insecure, now I'm going to this duel with confidence.

entries.source: I am finally ready for my duel.
entries.translation: 我终于准备好参加决斗了。
entries.sampleRaw: I am finally ready for my duel.

entries.source: Please accept this, I can't thank you enough.
entries.translation: 请收下这个，我感激不尽。
entries.sampleRaw: Please accept this, I can't thank you enough.

entries.source: I'll prepare for my duel now.
entries.translation: 我现在要为决斗做准备了。
entries.sampleRaw: I'll prepare for my duel now.

entries.source: I think I'll become a motivational speaker.
entries.translation: 我想我会成为一名励志演说家。
entries.sampleRaw: I think I'll become a motivational speaker.

entries.source: Crazy to think I could improve so much in a week.
entries.translation: 想想我一周内能进步这么多，真是不可思议。
entries.sampleRaw: Crazy to think I could improve so much in a week.

entries.source: I want to improve every day, for the rest of my life.
entries.translation: 我想在我余生中的每一天都不断进步。
entries.sampleRaw: I want to improve every day, for the rest of my life.

entries.source: Hello!
I went to the duel yesterday but we both agreed not to fight.
entries.translation: 我昨天去决斗了，但我们双方都同意不动手。
entries.sampleRaw: I went to the duel yesterday but we both agreed not to fight.

entries.source: We both became much stronger during the last week, but strength should not be used for violence.
entries.translation: 上周我们俩都变得强多了，但力量不该用来施暴。
entries.sampleRaw: We both became much stronger during the last week, but strength should not be used for violence.

entries.source: I spent a week training my body, but I think my mind improved even more.
entries.translation: 我花了一周锻炼身体，但我觉得我的心智进步更大。
entries.sampleRaw: I spent a week training my body, but I think my mind improved even more.

entries.source: I feel so much more sure of myself! I've grown beyond my old futile conflicts.
entries.translation: 我现在对自己有把握多了！我已经超越了从前那些无谓的冲突。
entries.sampleRaw: I feel so much more sure of myself! I've grown beyond my old futile conflicts.

entries.source: This was a life changing experience.
entries.translation: 这是一次改变人生的经历。
entries.sampleRaw: This was a life changing experience.

entries.source: Ohh man I'm in trouble! If you were part of my faction, maybe you could help me.
entries.translation: 哎呀，我有麻烦了！如果你是我阵营的一员，也许你能帮帮我。
entries.sampleRaw: Ohh man I'm in trouble! If you were part of my §efaction§f, maybe you could help me.

entries.source: Eek, you remind me of someone I need to duel in a week! If you weren't in his faction, maybe you could help me...
entries.translation: 呃，你让我想起了一周后要和我决斗的某个人！如果你不是他阵营的，也许你能帮帮我……
entries.sampleRaw: Eek, you remind me of someone I need to duel in a week! If you weren't in his §efaction§f, maybe you could help me...

entries.source: Why aren't you on my side anymore? I don't want to embarrass myself; come back and help me.
entries.translation: 你为什么不再站在我这边了？我不想让自己丢脸；回来帮帮我吧。
