entries.sampleRaw: Why aren't you on my side anymore? I don't want to embarrass myself; come back and help me.

entries.source: Wait you're not on my my side? Even after all that training? I am so dead...
entries.translation: 等等，你不是站在我这边的？就算经过了那么多训练？我死定了……
entries.sampleRaw: Wait you're not on my my side? Even after all that training? I am so dead...

entries.source: I am really stressing out...
Yesterday I had a heated argument with a Piglin and we agreed to have a duel in a week.
entries.translation: 昨天我和一个猪灵激烈争吵，我们约定一周后决斗。
entries.sampleRaw: Yesterday I had a heated argument with a Piglin and we agreed to have a duel in a week.

entries.source: The problem is that I'm not a fighter, at ALL!
entries.translation: 问题是我根本就不是个战斗者，完全不是！
entries.sampleRaw: The problem is that I'm not a fighter, at ALL!

entries.source: Would you mind helping me train a little bit? You look like a seasoned veteran, no offense.
entries.translation: 你介意帮我训练一下吗？你看起来像个经验丰富的老手，无意冒犯。
entries.sampleRaw: Would you mind helping me train a little bit? You look like a seasoned veteran, no offense.

entries.source: I'm ready to be defeated again... Are you ready?
entries.translation: 我准备好再次被打败了……你准备好了吗？
entries.sampleRaw: I'm ready to be defeated again... Are you ready?

entries.source: I barely recovered from the last training session but I'm ready, are you?
entries.translation: 我上次训练才勉强恢复过来，但我准备好了，你呢？
entries.sampleRaw: I barely recovered from the last training session but I'm ready, are you?

entries.source: I can feel that I'm slowly growing stronger, are you ready for today's training session?
entries.translation: 我能感觉到自己在慢慢变强，你准备好今天的训练了吗？
entries.sampleRaw: I can feel that I'm slowly growing stronger, are you ready for today's training session?

entries.source: Only 3 days left to train, are you ready?
entries.translation: 只剩 3 天可以训练了，你准备好了吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Only 3 days left to train, are you ready?
entries.numericSource: Only {{N0}} days left to train, are you ready?
entries.numericTranslation: 只剩 {{N0}} 天可以训练了，你准备好了吗？

entries.source: I feel so strong today, are you ready?
entries.translation: 我今天感觉好强，你准备好了吗？
entries.sampleRaw: I feel so strong today, are you ready?

entries.source: It has already been a week, time flies!
entries.translation: 已经过了一周了，时间过得真快！
entries.sampleRaw: It has already been a week, time flies!

entries.source: Are you ready for my last training session?
entries.translation: 你准备好参加我最后一次训练了吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Are you ready for my last training session?

entries.source: In that case, please show me your fighting moves.
entries.translation: 既然这样，请让我看看你的战斗招式。
entries.sampleRaw: In that case, please show me your fighting moves.

entries.source: Don't go easy on me, I'm very bad but I only have a week to improve.
entries.translation: 别对我手下留情，我很差劲，但我只有一周时间来进步。
entries.sampleRaw: Don't go easy on me, I'm very bad but I only have a week to improve.

entries.source: En garde!
Welp, no hard feelings, I guess.
entries.translation: 唉，我想这没什么好记恨的。
entries.sampleRaw: Welp, no hard feelings, I guess.

entries.source: Holy crap you are strong.
That was embarrassing.
Please come back tomorrow and help me train again!
entries.translation: 请明天再来帮我训练吧！
entries.sampleRaw: Please come back tomorrow and help me train again!

entries.source: That really hurts, but I need to get stronger at ALL COST!
entries.translation: 这真的很疼，但我必须不惜一切代价变强！
entries.sampleRaw: That really hurts, but I need to get stronger at ALL COST!

entries.source: Please come back tomorrow.
Wow!
You are truly on another level...
entries.translation: 你真是另一个层次的存在……
entries.sampleRaw: You are truly on another level...

entries.source: You still beat me effortlessly...
entries.translation: 你还是毫不费力地打败了我……

entries.source: I really hope I'll be ready on time.
entries.translation: 我真希望我能按时准备好。
entries.sampleRaw: I really hope I'll be ready on time.

entries.source: That was intense!
We are getting there!
I really don't deserve such a skilled trainer.
entries.translation: 我真不配拥有这么厉害的教练。
entries.sampleRaw: I really don't deserve such a skilled trainer.

entries.source: I've grown so much over the last week thanks to you.
entries.translation: 多亏了你，我在过去一周里成长了很多。
entries.sampleRaw: I've grown so much over the last week thanks to you.

entries.source: Just a week ago I was stressed and scared, now I feel confident.
entries.translation: 就在一周前，我还紧张又害怕，现在我感觉很自信。
entries.sampleRaw: Just a week ago I was stressed and scared, now I feel confident.

entries.source: I am finally ready for my duel.
entries.translation: 我终于准备好迎接我的决斗了。
entries.sampleRaw: I am finally ready for my duel.

entries.source: Please accept this, I can't thank you enough.
entries.translation: 请收下这个，我感激不尽。
entries.sampleRaw: Please accept this, I can't thank you enough.

entries.source: I'll prepare for my duel now.
entries.translation: 我现在要去准备我的决斗了。
entries.sampleRaw: I'll prepare for my duel now.

entries.source: I think I'll become a motivational speaker.
entries.translation: 我想我会成为一名励志演说家。
entries.sampleRaw: I think I'll become a motivational speaker.

entries.source: Crazy to think I could improve so much in a week.
entries.translation: 想想我一周内能进步这么多，真是不可思议。
entries.sampleRaw: Crazy to think I could improve so much in a week.

entries.source: I want to improve every day, for the rest of my life.
entries.translation: 我想在余生中每天都变得更好。
entries.sampleRaw: I want to improve every day, for the rest of my life.

entries.source: Hello!
I went to the duel yesterday but we both agreed not to fight.
entries.translation: 我昨天去决斗了，但我们俩都同意不动手。
entries.sampleRaw: I went to the duel yesterday but we both agreed not to fight.

entries.source: We both became much stronger during the last week, but strength should not be used for violence.
entries.translation: 过去一周里我们俩都变强了很多，但力量不应该用来施暴。
entries.sampleRaw: We both became much stronger during the last week, but strength should not be used for violence.

entries.source: I spent a week training my body, but I think my mind improved even more.
entries.translation: 我花了一周时间锻炼身体，但我觉得我的心智进步得更多。
entries.sampleRaw: I spent a week training my body, but I think my mind improved even more.

entries.source: I feel so much more sure of myself! I've grown beyond my old futile conflicts.
entries.translation: 我对自己有把握多了！我已经超越了从前那些无谓的冲突。
entries.sampleRaw: I feel so much more sure of myself! I've grown beyond my old futile conflicts.

entries.source: This was a life changing experience.
entries.translation: 这是一次改变人生的经历。
entries.sampleRaw: This was a life changing experience.

entries.source: Ohh man I'm in trouble! If you were part of my faction, maybe you could help me.
entries.translation: 哎呀，我有麻烦了！如果你是我阵营的一员，也许你能帮帮我。
entries.sampleRaw: Ohh man I'm in trouble! If you were part of my §efaction§f, maybe you could help me.

entries.source: Eek, you remind me of someone I need to duel in a week! If you weren't in his faction, maybe you could help me...
entries.translation: 呃,你让我想起了一个我一周后要决斗的人!如果你不是他那一边的,也许你能帮帮我……
entries.sampleRaw: Eek, you remind me of someone I need to duel in a week! If you weren't in his §efaction§f, maybe you could help me...

entries.source: Why aren't you on my side anymore? I don't want to embarrass myself; come back and help me.
entries.translation: 你为什么不再站在我这边了？我不想让自己丢脸；回来帮帮我吧。
entries.sampleRaw: Why aren't you on my side anymore? I don't want to embarrass myself; come back and help me.

entries.source: Wait you're not on my my side? Even after all that training? I am so dead...
entries.translation: 等等，你不是站在我这边吗？就算经过了那么多训练？我死定了……
entries.sampleRaw: Wait you're not on my my side? Even after all that training? I am so dead...

entries.source: I'm busy working on my coop.
entries.translation: 我正忙着打理我的合作档。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm busy working on my coop.

entries.source: Every. Single. One.
I wake up this morning and all my chickens are GONE.
entries.translation: 我今天早上醒来，发现我所有的鸡都不见了。
entries.sampleRaw: I wake up this morning and all my chickens are GONE.

entries.source: I finally found animals immune to Sulphur mutations but breeding them is a misery.
entries.translation: 我终于找到了对硫磺变异免疫的动物，但繁殖它们简直是场灾难。
entries.sampleRaw: I finally found animals immune to Sulphur mutations but breeding them is a misery.

entries.source: Could you help me getting them back inside?
entries.translation: 你能帮我把它们赶回里面吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Could you help me getting them back inside?

entries.source: I quit my previous job for this. It HAS to work.
entries.translation: 我为了这个辞掉了之前的工作。它必须成功。
entries.sampleRaw: I quit my previous job for this. It HAS to work.

entries.source: My chickens can't be that far, I have 5 of them.
entries.translation: 我的鸡不可能跑那么远，我有 5 只。
entries.sampleRaw: My chickens can't be that far, I have 5 of them.
entries.numericSource: My chickens can't be that far, I have {{N0}} of them.
entries.numericTranslation: 我的鸡不可能跑那么远，我有 {{N0}} 只。

entries.source: Oh [chicken] was missing too? Wondered why it was so peaceful.
entries.translation: 哦，[chicken] 也不见了？难怪这么安静。
entries.sampleRaw: Oh [chicken] was missing too? Wondered why it was so peaceful.

entries.source: [chicken] Jr., what time to do you call this?
entries.translation: [chicken] 小宝贝，你看看现在几点了？
entries.sampleRaw: [chicken] Jr., what time to do you call this?

entries.source: Oh [chicken], I'm so glad to have you back!
entries.translation: 哦 [chicken]，你回来了我太高兴了！
entries.sampleRaw: Oh [chicken], I'm so glad to have you back!

entries.source: Finally! [chicken] has been returned to me!
entries.translation: 终于！[chicken] 回到我身边了！
entries.sampleRaw: Finally! [chicken] has been returned to me!

entries.source: Oh there they are! Nice to see you again Regi... I mean [chicken].
entries.translation: 哦，它们在那儿！很高兴再次见到你，Regi……我是说 [chicken]。
entries.sampleRaw: Oh there they are! Nice to see you again Regi... I mean [chicken].

entries.source: I don't know how to thank you!
entries.translation: 我都不知道该怎么感谢你！
entries.sampleRaw: I don't know how to thank you!

entries.source: You just saved my business!
Come back in a few days and I'll reward you with my first chicken!
entries.translation: 过几天再来，我会用我的第一只鸡奖励你！
entries.sampleRaw: Come back in a few days and I'll reward you with my first chicken!

entries.source: A SUPER CHICKEN!
I was wrong!! My chickens are not immune to Sulphur!
entries.translation: 我错了！！我的鸡对硫磺并不免疫！
entries.sampleRaw: I was wrong!! My chickens are not immune to Sulphur!

entries.source: One of my chickens mutated into an abomination.
entries.translation: 我的一只鸡变异成了一个怪物。
entries.sampleRaw: One of my chickens mutated into an abomination.

entries.source: I don't know what to do, it's way to strong for me!
entries.translation: 我不知道该怎么办，它对我来说太强了！
entries.sampleRaw: I don't know what to do, it's way to strong for me!

entries.source: I can't believe you managed to slay this creature of nightmares.
entries.translation: 真不敢相信你竟然杀死了这个噩梦般的生物。
entries.sampleRaw: I can't believe you managed to slay this creature of nightmares.

entries.source: I wish I could reward you but I am completely ruined.
entries.translation: 我希望能奖励你，但我已经彻底破产了。
entries.sampleRaw: I wish I could reward you but I am completely ruined.

entries.source: I am never going to financially recover from this...
entries.translation: 我永远都无法从经济上恢复过来了……
entries.sampleRaw: I am never going to financially recover from this...

entries.source: ✆ HELP!!!!!
✆ MY CHICKENS... THEY MUTATED!
✆ COME TO THE CHICKEN COOP QUICKLY!!!!!
I'll be more careful from now on!
entries.sampleRaw: I'll be more careful from now on!

entries.source: If you have an Abiphone you should add me to your contacts!
entries.translation: 如果你有 Abiphone，应该把我加到你的联系人里！
entries.sampleRaw: If you have an Abiphone you should add me to your contacts!

entries.source: Maybe come back when you are more experienced for more.
entries.translation: 也许等你经验更丰富后再回来，能拿到更多。
entries.sampleRaw: Maybe come back when you are more experienced for more.

entries.source: Build yourself some reputation first, then we can talk again.
entries.translation: 先给自己积累些声望，然后我们再谈。
entries.sampleRaw: Build yourself some reputation first, then we can talk again.

entries.source: Come back later and I will have more for you to see.
entries.translation: 晚点再来，我会有更多东西给你看。
entries.sampleRaw: Come back later and I will have more for you to see.

entries.source: What am I going to do? My business is finished!
entries.translation: 我该怎么办？我的生意完了！
entries.sampleRaw: What am I going to do? My business is finished!

entries.source: Are you strong enough to defeat it?
entries.sampleRaw: Are you strong enough to defeat it?

entries.source: Maybe I should try to get my old job back...
entries.translation: 也许我该试着找回以前的工作……
entries.sampleRaw: Maybe I should try to get my old job back...

entries.source: I will never forget Chickzilla.
entries.translation: 我永远不会忘记鸡斯拉。

entries.source: Sorry, I only work with Mages...
entries.sampleRaw: Sorry, I only work with Mages...

entries.source: I don't recognise you stranger, clear off.
entries.translation: 我不认识你，陌生人，走开。
entries.sampleRaw: I don't recognise you stranger, clear off.

entries.source: Guards! Stranger danger! Keep them away from my chickens!
entries.translation: 卫兵！有陌生人危险！别让他们靠近我的鸡！
entries.sampleRaw: Guards! Stranger danger! Keep them away from my chickens!

entries.source: Can't stop, won't stop!
I was probably a rabbit in another life!
entries.translation: 我上辈子大概是只兔子！
entries.sampleRaw: I was probably a rabbit in another life!

entries.source: I love running and jumping.
Are you sure you wanna do this?
entries.sampleRaw: Are you sure you wanna do this?

entries.source: You better run.
You did NOT just do that.
entries.sampleRaw: You did NOT just do that.

entries.source: You are making a big mistake.
entries.sampleRaw: You are making a big mistake.

entries.source: Ouch!
You've had enough!
That's enough!
I am war!
Hey! Stop it!
Guards, get em!
That hurt!
Get ready for a slapping.
I make cute lamps!
They emit light without any combustible.
entries.translation: 它们不需要任何燃料就能发光。
entries.sampleRaw: They emit light without any combustible.

entries.source: Revolutionary!
I don't sell my items to players who don't work with us.
entries.translation: 我不会把物品卖给不与我们合作的人。
entries.sampleRaw: I don't sell my items to players who don't work with us.

entries.source: ✆ You want my contact? Sure.
entries.translation: ✆ 你想要我的联系方式？当然可以。

entries.source: ✆ Let's see...
✆ My Axe could do with an upgrade...
entries.translation: ✆ 我的斧头该升级一下了……
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fMy Axe could do with an upgrade...

entries.source: ✆ That's right! A Spruce Axe is what I desire!
entries.translation: ✆ 没错！我想要的正是云杉斧！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fThat's right! A §aSpruce Axe §fis what I desire!

entries.source: ✆ You don't have what I need! Nice try!
entries.translation: ✆ 你没有我需要的东西！想得美！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fYou don't have what I need! Nice try!

entries.source: ✆ A Spruce Axe! I sure owe you one!
entries.translation: ✆ 一把云杉斧！我欠你一个人情！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fA §aSpruce Axe§f! I sure owe you one!

entries.source: ✆ A deal is a deal and I'm a man of my word. Here's my contact.
entries.translation: ✆ 交易就是交易，我说话算话。这是我的联系方式。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fA deal is a deal and I'm a man of my word. Here's my contact.

entries.source: After completed a dungeon run, you get a selection of treasure chests.
entries.translation: 完成一次地牢挑战后，你会获得一批可供选择的宝箱。
entries.sampleRaw: After completed a dungeon run, you get a selection of §6treasure chests§f.

entries.source: If you don't open any, I collect and hoard them for you!
entries.translation: 如果你一个都不打开，我会替你收集并保管它们！
entries.sampleRaw: If you §cdon't open §fany, I collect and hoard them for you!

entries.source: Did you know, I used to live in the catacombs before they moved in all the zombies?
entries.translation: 你知道吗，在那些僵尸搬进来之前，我曾住在地牢里。
entries.sampleRaw: Did you know, I used to live in the catacombs before they moved in all the zombies?

entries.source: It's always best to keep a handle on things!
entries.translation: 凡事最好都掌握在手中！
entries.sampleRaw: It's always best to keep a §f§ohandle §fon things!

entries.source: The Wither King now lives in the deepest floor of the Catacombs, but where is the Wither Prince?
entries.translation: 凋灵之王现在住在地牢的最深层，但凋灵王子在哪里呢？
entries.sampleRaw: The Wither King now lives in the deepest floor of the Catacombs, but where is the Wither Prince?

entries.source: I wonder if they'll ever open more doors in here.
entries.translation: 不知道他们会不会在这里再开几扇门。
entries.sampleRaw: I wonder if they'll ever open more doors in here.

entries.source: Hello adventurer!
Are you a believer in the return of Kuudra?
entries.translation: 你相信库德拉会归来吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Are you a believer in the return of Kuudra?

entries.source: If you are, why don't you offer up some coin to show your belief.
entries.translation: 如果你相信，何不献上一些硬币来表达你的信仰。
entries.sampleRaw: If you are, why don't you offer up some coin to show your belief.

entries.source: It is said that Kuudra once blessed this lavapool.
entries.translation: 据说库德拉曾祝福过这片熔岩池。
entries.sampleRaw: It is said that Kuudra once blessed this lavapool.

entries.source: Maybe Kuudra will show favor upon you.
entries.sampleRaw: Maybe Kuudra will show favor upon you.

entries.source: Disappointing, maybe one day you will believe.
entries.translation: 真令人失望，也许有一天你会相信的。
entries.sampleRaw: Disappointing, maybe one day you will believe.

entries.source: Thank you for your offering. Kuudra will be pleased.
entries.translation: 感谢你的供奉。库德拉会很高兴的。
entries.sampleRaw: Thank you for your offering. Kuudra will be pleased.

entries.source: What a great offering. Kuudra will be pleased.
entries.translation: 多么丰厚的供奉。库德拉会很高兴的。
entries.sampleRaw: What a great offering. Kuudra will be pleased.

entries.source: Wow.
You truly are a believer.
Kuudra will bless you.
ADVENTURER
it seems like Kuudra has shown favour upon you!
entries.translation: 看来库德拉已经眷顾你了！
entries.sampleRaw: it seems like Kuudra has shown favour upon you!

entries.source: This item surfaced from the lavapool
entries.translation: 这件物品从熔岩池中浮出
entries.sampleRaw: This item surfaced from the lavapool

entries.source: You must believe in Kuudra's return!
entries.translation: 你必须相信库德拉会归来！

entries.source: I know this as you have that intriguing item!
entries.translation: 我知道这一点，因为你带着那件有趣的物品！
entries.sampleRaw: §rI know this as you have that intriguing item!

entries.source: You don't have to offer some coin...
entries.sampleRaw: §rYou don't have to offer some coin...

entries.source: Just tell me how to help you!
entries.translation: 直接告诉我该怎么帮你！
entries.sampleRaw: §rJust tell me how to help you!

entries.source: Oh so you want me to help you!
entries.sampleRaw: §rOh so you want me to help you!

entries.source: I can definitely do that for you adventurer!
entries.translation: 我绝对可以为你办到，冒险者！
entries.sampleRaw: §rI can definitely do that for you adventurer!

entries.source: There, go and hope for his return.
entries.translation: 好了，去期盼他的归来吧。
entries.sampleRaw: §rThere, go and hope for his return.

entries.source: Welcome to my humble workshop, [player]!
entries.translation: 欢迎来到我简陋的工坊,[player]!

entries.source: I will upgrade and salvage items for a cost!
entries.translation: 我可以付费为你升级和回收物品！

entries.source: Hello there, adventurer!
You look like someone who could help me with my research!
entries.translation: 你看起来像是能帮我做研究的人！
entries.sampleRaw: You look like someone who could help me with my research!

entries.source: If you join our faction I might have some tasks for you.
entries.translation: 如果你加入我们的阵营，我或许有些任务交给你。
entries.sampleRaw: If you join our faction I might have some tasks for you.

entries.source: I'll make it worth your while.
entries.translation: 我会让你觉得不虚此行。
entries.sampleRaw: I'll make it worth your while.

entries.source: You have no business talking to me.
entries.sampleRaw: You have no business talking to me.

entries.source: I'm the local alchemist, I do research on different types of gold.
entries.translation: 我是本地的炼金术士，我研究不同种类的黄金。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm the local alchemist, I do research on different types of gold.

entries.source: If you have some time maybe you could help me with some tasks.
entries.translation: 如果你有时间，也许可以帮我做些任务。
entries.sampleRaw: If you have some time maybe you could help me with some tasks.

entries.source: I'll make sure it's worth your time.
entries.translation: 我会确保你不白费时间。
entries.sampleRaw: I'll make sure it's worth your time.

entries.source: Talk to me again if you want to help out.
entries.translation: 如果你想帮忙，再来找我谈谈。
entries.sampleRaw: Talk to me again if you want to help out.

entries.source: To start out I'll need some generic gold to experiment on, could you get me a stack?
entries.translation: 首先我需要一些普通黄金来做实验，你能给我拿一组吗？
entries.sampleRaw: To start out I'll need some generic gold to experiment on, could you get me a stack?

entries.source: Next I need some flat gold to test how reflective gold is, could you try forging gold into 5 gold plates?
entries.translation: 接下来我需要一些扁平黄金来测试黄金的反射性，你能试着把黄金锻造成5块金板吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Next I need some flat gold to test how reflective gold is, could you try forging gold into 5 gold plates?
entries.numericSource: Next I need some flat gold to test how reflective gold is, could you try forging gold into {{N0}} gold plates?
entries.numericTranslation: 接下来我需要一些扁平黄金来测试黄金的反射性，你能试着把黄金锻造成{{N0}}块金板吗？

entries.source: I heard there exists a golden helmet that helps you swim faster in water. I would like to test its magical properties, could you bring me one?
entries.translation: 我听说有一顶金头盔能帮你在水中游得更快。我想测试它的魔法特性，你能给我带一顶来吗？
entries.sampleRaw: I heard there exists a golden helmet that helps you swim faster in water. I would like to test its magical properties, could you bring me one?

entries.source: It seems like the first piece you brought me is only 25% of the magical power, could you get me the leggings?
entries.translation: 看来你带来的第一件只有25%的魔法力量，你能给我弄来护腿吗？
entries.sampleRaw: It seems like the first piece you brought me is only 25% of the magical power, could you get me the leggings?
entries.numericSource: It seems like the first piece you brought me is only {{N0}} of the magical power, could you get me the leggings?
entries.numericTranslation: 看来你带来的第一件只有{{N0}}的魔法力量，你能给我弄来护腿吗？

entries.source: Now I need a lot of compacted gold, it has to be extremely dense. A half stack should do.
entries.translation: 现在我需要大量压缩黄金，它必须极其致密。半组应该就够了。
entries.sampleRaw: Now I need a lot of compacted gold, it has to be extremely dense. A half stack should do.

entries.source: There is a fine-grained gold substance somewhere in the Hub, I'll need 5 of that.
entries.translation: 中心岛某处有一种细粒黄金物质，我需要5个。
entries.sampleRaw: There is a fine-grained gold substance somewhere in the Hub, I'll need 5 of that.
entries.numericSource: There is a fine-grained gold substance somewhere in the Hub, I'll need {{N0}} of that.
entries.numericTranslation: 中心岛某处有一种细粒黄金物质，我需要{{N0}}个。

entries.source: Next I'm going to need a vegetable that is made out of solid gold. I want to experiment with how gold interacts with organics, maybe you could find some, like a half stack?
entries.translation: 接下来我需要一种由纯金制成的蔬菜。我想实验黄金与有机物如何相互作用，也许你能找到一些，比如半组？
entries.sampleRaw: Next I'm going to need a vegetable that is made out of solid gold. I want to experiment with how gold interacts with organics, maybe you could find some, like a half stack?

entries.source: I just need one last thing, there's an extremely dangerous scientist who sells an assortment of items, he has a special rounded type of gold. Try to convince him to sell you it.
entries.translation: 我只需要最后一样东西，有个极其危险的科学家出售各种物品，他有一种特殊的圆形黄金。试着说服他卖给你。
entries.sampleRaw: I just need one last thing, there's an extremely dangerous scientist who sells an assortment of items, he has a special rounded type of gold. Try to convince him to sell you it.

entries.source: Finally, my research is complete!
You have single-handedly sped up my research by several years.
entries.translation: 你单枪匹马把我的研究加速了好几年。
entries.sampleRaw: You have single-handedly sped up my research by several years.

entries.source: As promised, here is your reward.
entries.translation: 如约而至，这是你的奖励。
entries.sampleRaw: As promised, here is your reward.

entries.source: If I ever need your help, I will be sure to let you know!
entries.translation: 如果我需要你的帮助，我一定会告诉你的！
entries.sampleRaw: If I ever need your help, I will be sure to let you know!

entries.source: This isn't the correct amount of the item I asked for.
entries.translation: 这可不是我要的物品数量。
entries.sampleRaw: This isn't the correct amount of the item I asked for.

entries.source: I need the EXACT amount I asked for!
entries.translation: 我需要的是我要求的精确数量！
entries.sampleRaw: I need the EXACT amount I asked for!

entries.source: I miscalculated, I need more for my research.
entries.translation: 我算错了，我的研究需要更多。
entries.sampleRaw: I miscalculated, I need more for my research.

entries.source: You have single-handedly slowed down my research by several years.
entries.translation: 你单枪匹马把我的研究拖慢了好几年。
entries.sampleRaw: You have single-handedly slowed down my research by several years.

entries.source: Deposit your Coins before the Mushroom Bulls get to you!
entries.translation: 在蘑菇公牛找上你之前，先把你的金币存起来！
entries.sampleRaw: Deposit your §6Coins §fbefore the §cMushroom Bulls §fget to you!

entries.source: Deposit your Coins before the Flaming Spiders get to you!
entries.translation: 在烈焰蜘蛛找上你之前，先把你的金币存起来！
entries.sampleRaw: Deposit your §6Coins §fbefore the §cFlaming Spiders §fget to you!

entries.source: Are you sure you wanna do this?
entries.sampleRaw: Are you sure you wanna do this?

entries.source: You better watch out!
You did NOT just do that.
entries.sampleRaw: You did NOT just do that.

entries.source: You are making a big mistake.
entries.sampleRaw: You are making a big mistake.

entries.source: Ouch!
You've had enough!
That's enough!
I am war!
Hey! Stop it!
Guards, get em!
What do you think you are doing?
entries.sampleRaw: What do you think you are doing?

entries.source: I'll turn you to dust!
How did you find me?
I don't even have an entrance to my house.
entries.translation: 我的房子甚至连个入口都没有。
entries.sampleRaw: I don't even have an entrance to my house.

entries.source: You are paparazzi, right?
I am very, very famous. I can't blame you.
entries.translation: 我非常、非常出名。这不能怪你。
entries.sampleRaw: I am very, very famous. I can't blame you.

entries.source: If you want to take a picture of me, you'll have to pay 10,000 Coins.
entries.translation: 如果你想给我拍照,你得付 10,000 金币.
entries.sampleRaw: If you want to take a picture of me, you'll have to pay §610,000 Coins§f.
entries.numericSource: If you want to take a picture of me, you'll have to pay {{N0}} Coins.
entries.numericTranslation: 如果你想给我拍照,你得付 {{N0}} 金币.

entries.source: You don't have enough scratch, pal. Get outta here!
entries.translation: 你的钱不够，伙计。滚出去！
entries.sampleRaw: You don't have enough scratch, pal. Get outta here!

entries.source: Fine, you can take a picture of me now.
entries.translation: 好吧，你现在可以给我拍照了。
entries.sampleRaw: Fine, you can take a picture of me now.

entries.source: So you gonna pay me, or?
entries.translation: 那你打算付钱给我吗，还是？
entries.sampleRaw: So you gonna pay me, or?

entries.source: Pay me, please. I need this.
entries.translation: 请付钱给我吧。我需要这笔钱。
entries.sampleRaw: Pay me, please. I need this.

entries.source: How 'bout that payment?
People have told me I'm very photogenic.
entries.sampleRaw: People have told me I'm very photogenic.

entries.source: Take all of the pictures you want of me!
entries.translation: 你想给我拍多少张照片都行！
entries.sampleRaw: Take all of the pictures you want of me!

entries.source: Get your photos in while you can!
entries.sampleRaw: Get your photos in while you can!

entries.source: Oh, you must be [player]! My cousin told me you'd come by my place.
entries.translation: 哦,你一定是[player]吧!我表亲跟我说过你会来我这儿.
entries.sampleRaw: Oh, you must be §7[player]§f! My cousin told me you'd come by my place.

entries.source: The friends of the Dean are my friends too!
entries.sampleRaw: The friends of the Dean are my friends too!

entries.source: I'll give you a 1.5% cost reduction on all the items in my shop!!
entries.translation: 我店里所有物品都给你降价1.5%！！
entries.sampleRaw: I'll give you a §b1.5% §fcost reduction on all the items in my shop!!
entries.numericSource: I'll give you a {{N0}} cost reduction on all the items in my shop!!
entries.numericTranslation: 我店里所有物品都给你降价{{N0}}！！

entries.source: I have a wide range of Abiphones, from the Abiphone X+ to the Abiphone XIII Pro Giga!
entries.translation: 我这里有各式各样的Abiphone，从Abiphone X+到Abiphone XIII Pro Giga都有！
entries.sampleRaw: I have a wide range of Abiphones, from the Abiphone X+ to the Abiphone XIII Pro Giga!

entries.source: Great! I'll let you know when I have a more expensive version of the same Abiphone available!
entries.translation: 太好了！等同一款Abiphone有更贵的版本时，我会通知你！
entries.sampleRaw: Great! I'll let you know when I have a more expensive version of the same Abiphone available!

entries.source: Sorry I mean a more powerful version of the Abiphone for the same price.
entries.translation: 抱歉，我是说同一价格下功能更强的Abiphone版本。
entries.sampleRaw: Sorry I mean a more powerful version of the Abiphone for the same price.

entries.source: Anyways, Abiphones are magical devices that allow you to send sounds towards another Abiphone.
entries.translation: 总之，Abiphone是一种魔法设备，能让你把声音传送到另一台Abiphone上。
entries.sampleRaw: Anyways, Abiphones are magical devices that allow you to send sounds towards another Abiphone.

entries.source: It might be hard for you to wrap your head around that concept, but you'll get used to it. Trust me.
entries.translation: 这个概念你可能一时难以理解，但你会习惯的。相信我。
entries.sampleRaw: It might be hard for you to wrap your head around that concept, but you'll get used to it. Trust me.

entries.source: Most people around here have an Abiphone, and some of them might let you add them to your contacts.
entries.translation: 这附近大多数人都有Abiphone，其中一些人可能会让你把他们加到你的联系人里。
entries.sampleRaw: Most people around here have an Abiphone, and some of them might let you add them to your §acontacts§f.

entries.source: If you have someone's contact you can call them at any time, and they can also call you whenever.
entries.translation: 如果你有某人的联系方式，你随时都能打给他们，他们也能随时打给你。
entries.sampleRaw: If you have someone's §acontact§f you can call them at any time, and they can also call you whenever.

entries.source: I took the liberty to add Dean to your contacts already. I made sure you couldn't remove it, accidents happen!
entries.translation: 我已经擅自把Dean加到你的联系人里了。我确保你没法删掉它，毕竟意外总会发生！
entries.sampleRaw: I took the liberty to add §cDean§f to your contacts already. I made sure you couldn't remove it, accidents happen!

entries.source: Have a good day! Make sure you come back later to check my stock!
entries.translation: 祝你今天愉快！记得晚点回来看看我的库存！
entries.sampleRaw: Have a good day! Make sure you come back later to check my stock!

entries.source: Shh!
I'm in the middle of presenting the new Abiphone!
entries.sampleRaw: §7I'm in the middle of presenting the new Abiphone!

entries.source: Hello fellow customer!
I am glad you could make it!
entries.sampleRaw: §eI am glad you could make it!

entries.source: Today, I am unveiling the newest technology in Abiphones.
entries.translation: 今天，我将揭晓Abiphone的最新技术。
entries.sampleRaw: §eToday, I am unveiling the newest technology in Abiphones.

entries.source: We are proud to present:
ABIPHONE XIV
Our latest addition to the Abiphone line has space for an extra contact!
entries.translation: 我们Abiphone系列的最新成员多了一个联系人位！
entries.sampleRaw: §eOur latest addition to the Abiphone line has space for an extra contact!

entries.source: And with the latest technology, you can add FIVE more music discs!
entries.translation: 借助最新技术，你还能多添加五张音乐唱片！
entries.sampleRaw: §eAnd with the latest technology, you can add FIVE more music discs!

entries.source: It would be better if they were playable...
entries.translation: 要是它们能播放就更好了……
entries.sampleRaw: §7§oIt would be better if they were playable...

entries.source: Ahum.
Our new model comes in 3 atunning colors!
entries.translation: 我们的新款有 3 种惊艳配色！
entries.sampleRaw: §eOur new model comes in 3 atunning colors!
entries.numericSource: Our new model comes in {{N0}} atunning colors!
entries.numericTranslation: 我们的新款有 {{N0}} 种惊艳配色！

entries.source: The Abiphone XIV is our best model yet.
entries.translation: Abiphone XIV 是我们迄今最好的型号。

entries.source: And the price is still only 100m coins!
entries.translation: 而且价格依然只要 100m 硬币!
entries.sampleRaw: §eAnd the price is still only §6100m coins§e!
entries.numericSource: And the price is still only {{N0}}m coins!
entries.numericTranslation: 而且价格依然只要 {{N0}}m 硬币!

entries.source: On top of that, if you own an old Abiphone XIII, you can trade it in!
entries.translation: 此外，如果你有一台旧的 Abiphone XIII，还可以折价换购！
entries.sampleRaw: §eOn top of that, if you own an old §5Abiphone XIII§e, you can trade it in!

entries.source: The future of Abiphones is TODAY!
The Abiphone XIV is now for sale!
entries.sampleRaw: §eThe Abiphone XIV is now for sale!

entries.source: Hello customers!
I am so glad you could make it to my keynote!
entries.translation: 很高兴大家能来参加我的主题演讲！
entries.sampleRaw: §eI am so glad you could make it to my keynote!

entries.source: In the past 72 years, my minions have worked hard to make a new Abiphone model.
entries.translation: 在过去 72 年里，我的仆从们辛勤工作，打造出了一款新的 Abiphone 型号。
entries.sampleRaw: §eIn the past 72 years, my minions have worked hard to make a new Abiphone model.
entries.numericSource: In the past {{N0}} years, my minions have worked hard to make a new Abiphone model.
entries.numericTranslation: 在过去 {{N0}} 年里，我的仆从们辛勤工作，打造出了一款新的 Abiphone 型号。

entries.source: I've obviously been working hard directing my minions!
entries.translation: 显然，我一直在努力指挥我的仆从们！
entries.sampleRaw: §eI've obviously been working hard directing my minions!

entries.source: I have made great technological leaps since our last model.
entries.translation: 自上一款型号以来，我取得了巨大的技术飞跃。
entries.sampleRaw: §eI have made great technological leaps since our last model.

entries.source: So without further ado, I am proud to present:
entries.translation: 那么闲话少说，我很荣幸地为大家展示：
entries.sampleRaw: §eSo without further ado, I am proud to present:

entries.source: Hello?
No, I'm in the middle of my keynote!
entries.translation: 不行，我正在做主题演讲！
entries.sampleRaw: §7§oNo, I'm in the middle of my keynote!

entries.source: Yes, I'll call you back.
Ahem.
Sorry about that, I forgot to put my Abiphone on vibrate.
entries.translation: 抱歉，我忘了把 Abiphone 调成振动。
entries.sampleRaw: §eSorry about that, I forgot to put my Abiphone on vibrate.

entries.source: Anyways, I am proud to present:
entries.translation: 总之，我很荣幸地为大家展示：

entries.source: ABIPHONE FLIP
This stunning new model has a brand-new speaker system.
entries.translation: 这款惊艳的新型号配备了全新的扬声器系统。
entries.sampleRaw: §eThis stunning new model has a brand-new speaker system.

entries.source: Allowing you to choose a ringtone from our built-in selection!
entries.translation: 让你可以从内置铃声库中选择铃声！
entries.sampleRaw: §eAllowing you to choose a ringtone from our built-in selection!

entries.source: Through sheer determination, I have also managed to find enough space for 1 extra contact!
entries.translation: 凭借十足的毅力，我还设法腾出了足够空间，多容纳 1 个联系人！
entries.sampleRaw: §eThrough sheer determination, I have also managed to find enough space for 1 extra contact!
entries.numericSource: Through sheer determination, I have also managed to find enough space for {{N0}} extra contact!
entries.numericTranslation: 凭借十足的毅力，我还设法腾出了足够空间，多容纳 {{N0}} 个联系人！

entries.source: To satisfy my shareholders, I had to double the price of this new Abiphone.
entries.translation: 为了满足我的股东，我不得不把这款新 Abiphone 的价格翻倍。
entries.sampleRaw: §eTo satisfy my shareholders, I had to double the price of this new Abiphone.

entries.source: To satisfy my customers, I am giving everyone 50% off on their new Abiphone purchase!
entries.translation: 为了满足我的顾客,我给大家购买新 Abiphone 时优惠 50%!
entries.sampleRaw: §eTo satisfy my customers, I am giving everyone §a50% off§e on their new Abiphone purchase!
entries.numericSource: To satisfy my customers, I am giving everyone {{N0}} off on their new Abiphone purchase!
entries.numericTranslation: 为了满足我的顾客,我给大家购买新 Abiphone 时优惠 {{N0}}!

entries.source: This way, everyone is happy!
entries.translation: 这样一来，大家都开心了！

entries.source: You can trade in your old Abiphone XIV for an even bigger discount!
entries.translation: 你还可以用旧的 Abiphone XIV 折价换购，享受更大的折扣！
entries.sampleRaw: §eYou can trade in your old §5Abiphone XIV§e for an even bigger discount!

entries.source: The Abiphone Flip is now for sale!
First, I would like to apologize for this one being a little later ðan usual.
entries.translation: 首先,我想为这一款比往常稍晚推出而道歉.
entries.sampleRaw: §eFirst, I would like to apologize for this one being a §e§olittle later ðan usual.

entries.source: There is an ongoing lawsuit between myself and a counterfeit Abiphone, which has been taking up most of my time.
entries.translation: 我和一台假冒的Abiphone之间正在进行一场诉讼，这占用了我大部分时间。
entries.sampleRaw: §eThere is an ongoing lawsuit between myself and a counterfeit Abiphone, which has been taking up most of my time.

entries.source: However, I am here, and so are you, so let's begin!
entries.translation: 不过，我在这里，你也在，那就开始吧！
entries.sampleRaw: §eHowever, I am here, and so are you, so let's begin!

entries.source: Since my previous keynote, my minions and I have been even harder at work trying to find something even more innovative than the Abiphone Flip.
entries.translation: 自从上次主题演讲以来，我和我的仆从们更加努力地工作，试图找到比Abiphone Flip更具创新性的东西。
entries.sampleRaw: §eSince my previous keynote, my minions and I have been even harder at work trying to find something even more innovative than the §6Abiphone Flip§e.

entries.source: We thought and thought and then thought some more before I, and only I, had an incredible breakthrough.
entries.translation: 我们想了又想，又想了更多，然后我，只有我，取得了不可思议的突破。
entries.sampleRaw: §eWe thought and thought and then thought some more before I, and only I, had an §oincredible breakthrough§e.

entries.source: What if our latest model could save you, like, a second, whenever you wanted to call someone?
entries.translation: 如果我们的最新型号能在你想给别人打电话时，帮你省下，比如，一秒钟呢？
entries.sampleRaw: §eWhat if our latest model could save you, like, a second, whenever you wanted to call someone?

entries.source: After all, less downtime for my clientele means I get more uptime on my all-inclusive holidays!
entries.translation: 毕竟，我的客户停机时间越少，我就能在全包度假上拥有更多在线时间！
entries.sampleRaw: §eAfter all, less downtime for my clientele means I get more uptime on my all-inclusive holidays!

entries.source: So, without further ado, I am proud to present:
entries.translation: 那么，废话不多说，我很荣幸地介绍：
entries.sampleRaw: §eSo, without further ado, I am proud to present:

entries.source: PLUS!
The most cutting edge technology around today, this new model comes with the Speed Dial feature!
entries.translation: 这是当今最前沿的技术，这款新机型配备了快速拨号功能！
entries.sampleRaw: §eThe most cutting edge technology around today, this new model comes with the §bSpeed Dial §efeature!

entries.source: This allows you to call your favorite contact with just a single click!
entries.translation: 这让你只需单击一下就能呼叫你最喜欢的联系人！
entries.sampleRaw: §eThis allows you to call your favorite contact with just a single click!

entries.source: Also, in my infinite generosity, I have given this model an additional contact slot!
entries.translation: 另外，出于我无限的慷慨，我给这款机型增加了一个额外的联系人槽位！
entries.sampleRaw: §eAlso, in my infinite generosity, I have given this model an §aadditional contact slot§e!

entries.source: That's all for this year. Udel's Abiphone Services appreciate your continued support during the ongoing lawsuit!
entries.translation: 今年的内容就到这里。Udel的Abiphone服务感谢你在诉讼期间一直以来的支持！
entries.sampleRaw: §eThat's all for this year. §bUdel's Abiphone Services §eappreciate your continued support during the ongoing lawsuit!

entries.source: So, without further ado...
The Abiphone Flip+ is now for sale!
Ahh...I don't know what I'm going to do...
entries.translation: 唉……我不知道我该怎么办……
entries.sampleRaw: Ahh...I don't know what I'm going to do...

entries.source: This is rough to be honest, my potatoes...
entries.translation: 说实话这太难了，我的马铃薯……
entries.sampleRaw: This is rough to be honest, my potatoes...

entries.source: I just want to eat something other than nether wart for once in my life...
entries.translation: 我这辈子就只想吃一次下界疣以外的东西……
entries.sampleRaw: I just want to eat something other than nether wart for once in my life...

entries.source: And potatoes look so yummy and juicy...but water...instantly evaporates around here...
entries.translation: 而且马铃薯看起来那么美味多汁……但水……在这里会瞬间蒸发……
entries.sampleRaw: And potatoes look so yummy and juicy...but water...instantly evaporates around here...

entries.source: I'm just...so sad...
Oh sulfur! It worked! Potatoes!
entries.translation: 哦硫磺啊！成功了！马铃薯！

entries.source: But how? I've been trying for years, and you just did it so easily...
entries.translation: 但怎么会？我试了好多年，你却这么轻松就做到了……
entries.sampleRaw: But how? I've been trying for years, and you just did it so easily...

entries.source: Maybe I'm just...that bad...I'm worthless...
entries.translation: 也许我就是……那么差劲……我一无是处……

entries.source: Why can't I be successful like everyone else...
entries.translation: 为什么我不能像其他人一样成功……
entries.sampleRaw: Why can't I be successful like everyone else...

entries.source: And I keep complaining...I'm so annoying...
entries.translation: 而且我一直抱怨……我太烦人了……
entries.sampleRaw: And I keep complaining...I'm so annoying...

entries.source: I lost the Enchanted Bone Meal... of course...
entries.translation: 我把附魔骨粉弄丢了……当然了……
entries.sampleRaw: I lost the Enchanted Bone Meal... of course...

entries.source: Don't feel pressured to give me any more... I don't deserve this...
entries.translation: 别觉得有压力要再给我什么……我不配得到这些……
entries.sampleRaw: Don't feel pressured to give me any more... I don't deserve this...

entries.source: Oh thanks, I really appreciate you! You are a hero to me.
entries.translation: 哦谢谢，我真的很感激你！你对我来说是个英雄。
entries.sampleRaw: Oh thanks, I really appreciate you! You are a hero to me.

entries.source: You help me like someone would help an insect stuck in a puddle.
entries.translation: 你帮我，就像有人会帮一只困在水坑里的昆虫一样。
entries.sampleRaw: You help me like someone would help an insect stuck in a puddle.

entries.source: I don't know...
What can I do, this is agony...
entries.translation: 我能怎么办，这太痛苦了……
entries.sampleRaw: What can I do, this is agony...

entries.source: If only I were smarter...
entries.translation: 要是我能更聪明一点就好了……

entries.source: I tried everything.
sob
Another day without potatoes...I can't handle it...
entries.translation: 又一天没有马铃薯了……我受不了了……
entries.sampleRaw: Another day without potatoes...I can't handle it...

entries.source: Feels bad man, this is just terrible.
entries.translation: 感觉真糟糕，这简直太可怕了。
entries.sampleRaw: Feels bad man, this is just terrible.

entries.source: I'm so untalented, I'll probably burn the potatoes when I cook them.
entries.translation: 我太没天赋了，煮马铃薯的时候大概会把它烧焦。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm so untalented, I'll probably burn the potatoes when I cook them.

entries.source: I hope I won't lose this Enchanted Bone Meal...
entries.translation: 希望我不会弄丢这瓶附魔骨粉……
entries.sampleRaw: I hope I won't lose this Enchanted Bone Meal...

entries.source: Why did I not think of this...
entries.sampleRaw: Why did I not think of this...

entries.source: Hey there, I'm the Auction Master.
entries.sampleRaw: Hey there, I'm the Auction Master.

entries.source: At the auction house you can put your valuable items up for auction!
entries.translation: 在拍卖行，你可以把你的贵重物品拿去拍卖！
entries.sampleRaw: At the auction house you can put your valuable items up for auction!

entries.source: You may also want to check back here to see what items other players are selling to see if you can get a good deal.
entries.translation: 你也可以常回来看看其他玩家在卖什么，说不定能捡到好价钱。
entries.sampleRaw: You may also want to check back here to see what items other players are selling to see if you can get a good deal.

entries.source: Talk to me if you would like to start your first auction or if you want to see the items currently being sold.
entries.translation: 如果你想开始你的第一次拍卖，或者想看看当前正在出售的物品，就来找我谈谈吧。
entries.sampleRaw: Talk to me if you would like to start your first auction or if you want to see the items currently being sold.

entries.source: Have you noticed how everyone around here kind of resembles a Vampire?
entries.translation: 你有没有注意到这附近的人都有点像吸血鬼？
entries.sampleRaw: Have you noticed how everyone around here kind of resembles a Vampire?

entries.source: It would be a pretty convenient place for a Vampire to hide.
entries.translation: 对吸血鬼来说，这地方藏身可太方便了。
entries.sampleRaw: It would be a pretty convenient place for a Vampire to hide.

entries.source: Not that I'm a Vampire of course - I am definitely not.
entries.translation: 当然我不是吸血鬼——绝对不是。
entries.sampleRaw: Not that I'm a Vampire of course - I am definitely not.

entries.source: A Cup of Blood? What a strange present, I'm sure a Vampire would like that.
entries.translation: 一杯血？真是奇怪的礼物，我敢说吸血鬼会喜欢的。
entries.sampleRaw: A Cup of Blood? What a strange present, I'm sure a Vampire would like that.

entries.source: Thanks for the gift. I really appreciate it. Of course I won't be drinking that.
entries.translation: 谢谢你的礼物。我真的很感激。当然，我是不会喝那个的。
entries.sampleRaw: Thanks for the gift. I really appreciate it. Of course I won't be drinking that.

entries.source: My thirst is quenched!
Err, from water and other non-Vampire liquids that is.
entries.translation: 呃，我是说靠水和其它非吸血鬼的液体。
entries.sampleRaw: Err, from water and other non-Vampire liquids that is.

entries.source: Thank you for the gesture though!
entries.translation: 不过还是谢谢你的心意！
entries.sampleRaw: Thank you for the gesture though!

entries.source: I can't be seen conversing with you right now!
entries.translation: 我现在不能被人看到在跟你说话！
entries.sampleRaw: I can't be seen conversing with you right now!

entries.source: I am quite thirsty all the time, it's a rare condition.
entries.translation: 我一直都很渴，这是种罕见的病症。
entries.sampleRaw: I am quite thirsty all the time, it's a rare condition.

entries.source: Why are you looking at me that way? I am not a Vampire, you are!
entries.translation: 你为什么那样看着我？我不是吸血鬼，你才是！
entries.sampleRaw: Why are you looking at me that way? I am not a Vampire, you are!

entries.source: There is no sunlight either, it would be quite accommodating for a Vampire.
entries.translation: 这里也没有阳光，对吸血鬼来说可太舒适了。
entries.sampleRaw: There is no sunlight either, it would be quite accommodating for a Vampire.

entries.source: Good tidings, [player]!
For a price, I can upgrade and salvage your items!
entries.translation: 只要付点钱，我就能升级和回收你的物品！

entries.source: We store a great deal of knowledge about the history of this island in this Cathedral.
entries.translation: 这座大教堂里保存着大量关于这座岛屿历史的知识。
entries.sampleRaw: §fWe store a great deal of knowledge about the history of this island in this §5Cathedral§f.

entries.source: Every single book is imbued so that only true mages can pull them out.
entries.translation: 每一本书都被施加了魔法，只有真正的法师才能将它们取出。
entries.sampleRaw: §fEvery single book is imbued so that only true mages can pull them out.

entries.source: Even if you possessed that power, I doubt someone like you could read our texts.
entries.translation: 就算你拥有那种力量，我也怀疑像你这样的人能否读懂我们的典籍。
entries.sampleRaw: §fEven if you possessed that power, I doubt someone like you could read our texts.

entries.source: I don't have anything to sell you right now.
entries.translation: 我现在没有什么可以卖给你的。
entries.sampleRaw: I don't have anything to sell you right now.

entries.source: Come back later and I might be able to sell you something!
entries.translation: 晚点再来吧，说不定我就能卖你点东西了！
entries.sampleRaw: Come back later and I might be able to sell you something!

entries.source: Ahh, I see you've been reading the wiki!
entries.translation: 啊哈，看来你一直在读 wiki！
entries.sampleRaw: Ahh, I see you've been reading the wiki!

entries.source: I read it too from time to time. It gives me valuable insights into my experiments!
entries.translation: 我偶尔也会读一读。它给我的实验带来了宝贵的启发！
entries.sampleRaw: I read it too from time to time. It gives me valuable insights into my experiments!

entries.source: Leave me to my experiments, stranger!
entries.translation: 别打扰我做实验，陌生人！
entries.sampleRaw: Leave me to my experiments, stranger!

entries.source: I'm on the verge of inventing a new enchantment!
entries.translation: 我马上就要发明出一种新的附魔了！
entries.sampleRaw: I'm on the verge of inventing a new enchantment!

entries.source: So close...so close...
Azax?
Where is Azax?
I need more bottles! More!
This experiment is close to succeeding, it could be my new Scarlet Prize!
entries.translation: 这个实验快要成功了，它可能成为我新的猩红奖！
entries.sampleRaw: This experiment is close to succeeding, it could be my new Scarlet Prize!

entries.source: Yes! The table. it speaks to me!
entries.translation: 没错！这张桌子。它在对我说话！
entries.sampleRaw: Yes! The table. it speaks to me!

entries.source: It's not quite there yet...
We are on the right track...
entries.sampleRaw: We are on the right track...

entries.source: But we need something stronger!
entries.translation: 但我们需要更强的东西！

entries.source: That's it!
Eureka!
I created a new Enchantment!
entries.translation: 我创造了一种新的附魔！

entries.source: As you helped greatly with this achievement, let me bestow upon you the first imbued book!
entries.translation: 既然你在这项成就中帮了大忙，就让我把第一本注魔书赐予你吧！
entries.sampleRaw: As you helped greatly with this achievement, let me bestow upon you the first imbued book!

entries.source: Just because it worked before doesn't mean it will work again.
entries.translation: 以前成功过，不代表以后还会成功。
entries.sampleRaw: Just because it worked before doesn't mean it will work again.

entries.source: Please splash your experience onto someone who is less busy!
entries.translation: 请把你的经验水花泼向没那么忙的人吧！
entries.sampleRaw: Please splash your experience onto someone who is less busy!

entries.source: Is that how you behave in that other faction?
entries.translation: 你在另一个阵营里就是这副德行吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Is that how you behave in that other faction?

entries.source: Simply rude!
My next work will be even more grandiose!
entries.translation: 我的下一件作品会更加宏伟！
entries.sampleRaw: My next work will be even more grandiose!

entries.source: Yes, yes...mhm...yes...interesting...
The more I look into the fire, the more I understand.
entries.translation: 我越是凝视火焰，就越能领悟。
entries.sampleRaw: The more I look into the fire, the more I understand.

entries.source: I knew you would come, I saw it in the flames a few minutes ago.
entries.translation: 我就知道你会来，几分钟前我在火焰中看到了。
entries.sampleRaw: I knew you would come, I saw it in the flames a few minutes ago.

entries.source: Do you know why we can see the future inside the flames?
entries.translation: 你知道为什么我们能在火焰中看到未来吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Do you know why we can see the future inside the flames?

entries.source: I know!
It's because fire is eternal.
I could extinguish it now and light it back up in a year. It would still be the same flames.
entries.translation: 我现在可以把它熄灭，一年后再重新点燃。它仍会是同样的火焰。
entries.sampleRaw: I could extinguish it now and light it back up in a year. It would still be the same flames.

entries.source: If you want, I can read your future. Are you interested?
entries.translation: 如果你愿意，我可以为你解读未来。你有兴趣吗？
entries.sampleRaw: If you want, I can read your future. Are you interested?

entries.source: Well? Shall I read your future in the flames?
entries.translation: 怎么样？要我在火焰中为你解读未来吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Well? Shall I read your future in the flames?

entries.source: The flames are dancing strangely...
I see... I see you... Fighting... The vision is quite blurry...
entries.translation: 我看到了……我看到你……在战斗……画面相当模糊……
entries.sampleRaw: I see... I see you... Fighting... The vision is quite blurry...

entries.source: You are holding a sword... But how...
entries.translation: 你握着一把剑……但这怎么可能……
entries.sampleRaw: You are holding a sword... But how...

entries.source: That sword, the emblems on it...
entries.sampleRaw: That sword, the emblems on it...

entries.source: This future... Impossible...
I see that one day you will join our faction... You shall will become a great asset...
entries.translation: 我看到有一天你会加入我们的阵营……你会成为一笔巨大的财富……
entries.sampleRaw: I see that one day you will join our faction... You shall will become a great asset...

entries.source: I see that you will betray us one day, and join the Barbarian faction...
entries.translation: 我看到有一天你会背叛我们，加入蛮族阵营……
entries.sampleRaw: I see that you will betray us one day, and join the Barbarian faction...

entries.source: Ohh... I see you... Fighting a monstrous creature... With giant tentacles...
entries.translation: 哦……我看到你……在与一只怪物战斗……长着巨大的触手……
entries.sampleRaw: Ohh... I see you... Fighting a monstrous creature... With giant tentacles...

entries.source: I knew you would say that.
entries.sampleRaw: I knew you would say that.

entries.source: You just wanted to see what I would say, and then ask again.
entries.translation: 你只是想看看我会说什么，然后再问一遍。
entries.sampleRaw: You just wanted to see what I would say, and then ask again.

entries.source: How predictable.
In any case, I'll read your future.
entries.translation: 无论如何，我会为你解读未来。
entries.sampleRaw: In any case, I'll read your future.

entries.source: Disturbing... the visions must have been wrong.
entries.translation: 令人不安……那些幻象一定是错的。
entries.sampleRaw: Disturbing... the visions must have been wrong.

entries.source: But the flames are never wrong...
entries.sampleRaw: But the flames are never wrong...

entries.source: I also saw some pretty embarrassing stuff...
entries.translation: 我还看到了一些相当尴尬的东西……
entries.sampleRaw: I also saw some pretty embarrassing stuff...

entries.source: Not everyone wants to see their future, but they should.
entries.translation: 不是每个人都想看到自己的未来，但他们应该看。
entries.sampleRaw: Not everyone wants to see their future, but they should.

entries.source: Welcome to the Tourist Office!
This town was built four centuries ago, or more!
entries.translation: 这座小镇建于四个世纪前，甚至更早！
entries.sampleRaw: This town was built four centuries ago, or more!

entries.source: Visitors come from all around the world to visit our Cathedral.
entries.translation: 游客们从世界各地前来参观我们的大教堂。
entries.sampleRaw: Visitors come from all around the world to visit our §5Cathedral§f.

entries.source: But maybe you are more interested in our famous floating water fountain?
entries.translation: 但也许你对我们著名的漂浮喷泉更感兴趣？
entries.sampleRaw: But maybe you are more interested in our famous floating water fountain?

entries.source: Or the Statue of the Hero?
There is so much to see!
entries.sampleRaw: There is so much to see!

entries.source: If you have any tourist-related questions, I'll be right here!
entries.translation: 如果你有任何与游客相关的问题，我就在这儿！
entries.sampleRaw: §fIf you have any tourist-related questions, I'll be right here!

entries.source: Enjoy your time in Scarleton!
entries.translation: 祝你在斯卡雷顿玩得开心！

entries.source: Inhale...exhale...
I'm trying to gather enough courage to go upstairs.
entries.translation: 我正在努力鼓起勇气上楼。
entries.sampleRaw: §fI'm trying to gather enough courage to go upstairs.

entries.source: This apartment is very cozy but it triggers something in me.
entries.translation: 这间公寓非常舒适，但它会触发我内心的某些东西。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThis apartment is very cozy but it triggers something in me.

entries.source: I think I might be claustrophobic.
entries.translation: 我想我可能有幽闭恐惧症。

entries.source: Alwin says we don't need more space, I wish I could agree...
entries.translation: Alwin 说我们不需要更多空间，我希望我能同意……
entries.sampleRaw: Alwin says we don't need more space, I wish I could agree...

entries.source: My husband works all the time.
entries.sampleRaw: My husband works all the time.

entries.source: Try some of Scarleton's finest spirits!
entries.translation: 来尝尝斯卡雷顿最上等的烈酒吧!

entries.source: Hello.
I am a modest painter.
Painting is a way to escape the harsh reality; I can create my own flawless world.
entries.translation: 绘画是逃离残酷现实的一种方式；我可以创造属于自己的完美世界。
entries.sampleRaw: Painting is a way to escape the harsh reality; I can create my own flawless world.

entries.source: I paint all sorts of things, but it costs a lot of colored dyes.
entries.translation: 我画各种各样的东西，但这需要大量彩色染料。
entries.sampleRaw: I paint all sorts of things, but it costs a lot of colored dyes.

entries.source: Could you help me and bring me some flowers? Most flowers cannot spawn on the Crimson Isle.
entries.translation: 你能帮帮我，给我带些花来吗？大多数花无法在绯红之岛生成。
entries.sampleRaw: Could you help me and bring me some flowers? Most flowers cannot spawn on the §cCrimson Isle§f.

entries.source: I need a [item].
Could you bring me a [item]?
That is not the correct flower I'm looking for.
entries.translation: 那不是我正在找的那种花。
entries.sampleRaw: That is not the correct flower I'm looking for.

entries.source: Bring me that [item] as soon as you can!
entries.sampleRaw: Bring me that [item] as soon as you can!

entries.source: These paintings don't paint themselves!
entries.translation: 这些画可不会自己画出来！

entries.source: Thank you for supporting my passion.
entries.sampleRaw: Thank you for supporting my passion.

entries.source: I often need flowers, feel free to come back in a few days.
entries.translation: 我经常需要花，过几天随时可以再来。
entries.sampleRaw: I often need flowers, feel free to come back in a few days.

entries.source: Great, back to painting!
I can sense a great deal of virtue in you. You are a source of inspiration.
entries.translation: 我能感觉到你身上有极大的美德。你是灵感的源泉。
entries.sampleRaw: I can sense a great deal of virtue in you. You are a source of inspiration.

entries.source: I need quiet, please.
Sorry, but I need to concentrate.
entries.translation: 抱歉，但我需要集中注意力。
entries.sampleRaw: Sorry, but I need to concentrate.

entries.source: ✆ Hello, [player]!
✆ Are you available? I desperately need a <item> today.
entries.translation: ✆ 你现在有空吗？我今天急需一朵<item>。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f Are you available? I desperately need a <item> today.

entries.source: ✆ Please meet me at my house if you have one. I would greatly appreciate it!
entries.translation: ✆ 如果你有的话，请到我家来见我。我会非常感激的！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f Please meet me at my house if you have one. I would greatly appreciate it!

entries.source: ✆ Bring me that [flower] as soon as you can!
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f Bring me that [flower] as soon as you can!

entries.source: ✆ These paintings don't paint themselves!
entries.translation: ✆ 这些画可不会自己画出来！

entries.source: ✆ I don't need any flowers at the moment!
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f I don't need any flowers at the moment!

entries.source: Thank you so much.
Here, I want you to have another painting.
entries.translation: 来，我想让你再拿一幅画。
entries.sampleRaw: Here, I want you to have another painting.

entries.source: Do not talk to me, we are not the same.
entries.translation: 别跟我说话，我们不一样。
entries.sampleRaw: Do not talk to me, we are not the same.

entries.source: I have seen many adventurers challenge Kuudra, but they don't understand what they're doing.
entries.translation: 我见过许多冒险者挑战库德拉，但他们根本不明白自己在做什么。
entries.sampleRaw: I have seen many adventurers challenge Kuudra, but they don't understand what they're doing.

entries.source: There are many ways to find Kuudra, you just have to think.
entries.translation: 找到库德拉的方法有很多，你只需要动动脑子。
entries.sampleRaw: There are many ways to find Kuudra, you just have to think.

entries.source: You might be someone worth taking to, but the condition isn't right.
entries.translation: 你也许是个值得交谈的人，但条件还不合适。
entries.sampleRaw: You might be someone worth taking to, but the condition isn't right.

entries.source: You seem like someone of similar interests.
entries.translation: 你看起来像是个志趣相投的人。
entries.sampleRaw: You seem like someone of similar interests.

entries.source: I have a shop of some unique items that may interest you.
entries.translation: 我有一家店，里面有些独特的物品，也许你会感兴趣。
entries.sampleRaw: I have a shop of some unique items that may interest you.

entries.source: Have a look and see if theres anything you like.
entries.translation: 看看吧，看看有没有你喜欢的。
entries.sampleRaw: Have a look and see if theres anything you like.

entries.source: You know, adventurer, I can help you with something else.
entries.translation: 你知道吗，冒险者，我还能帮你做点别的事。
entries.sampleRaw: You know, adventurer, I can help you with something else.

entries.source: In order to do so, I need something special...
entries.translation: 不过要这么做，我需要一件特别的东西……
entries.sampleRaw: In order to do so, I need something special...

entries.source: Bring it to me and I will be ready to assist!
entries.translation: 把它带来给我，我就准备好帮你了！
entries.sampleRaw: Bring it to me and I will be ready to assist!

entries.source: Adventurer!
I see you have something in your inventory...
entries.translation: 我看到你的物品栏里有点东西……
entries.sampleRaw: I see you have something in your inventory...

entries.source: I feel as though I've seen it before...
entries.translation: 我感觉我好像以前见过它……
entries.sampleRaw: I feel as though I've seen it before...

entries.source: Ah yes, I can see it clearer in your hand.
entries.translation: 啊，没错，在你手里我看得更清楚了。
entries.sampleRaw: Ah yes, I can see it clearer in your hand.

entries.source: I definitely seem to recognize this item!
entries.sampleRaw: I definitely seem to recognize this item!

entries.source: Do you mind if you give it to me so I can inspect it?
entries.translation: 你介意把它交给我，让我仔细看看吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Do you mind if you give it to me so I can inspect it?

entries.source: Don't worry! I'll give you something in return of course!
entries.translation: 别担心！作为回报，我当然会给你点东西！
entries.sampleRaw: Don't worry! I'll give you something in return of course!

entries.source: You should find this item I give you of value.
entries.translation: 你应该会觉得我给你的这件物品很有价值。
entries.sampleRaw: You should find this item I give you of value.

entries.source: It may seem uninteresting, but I'm sure you can find a way to use it for good.
entries.translation: 它看起来也许没什么意思，但我相信你能找到办法把它用在正道上。
entries.sampleRaw: It may seem uninteresting, but I'm sure you can find a way to use it for good.

entries.source: You might be someone worth taking to, but the time isn't right.
entries.translation: 你也许是个值得交谈的人，但时机还不对。
entries.sampleRaw: You might be someone worth taking to, but the time isn't right.

entries.source: I could talk to you, but the conditions don't seem right.
entries.translation: 我本可以跟你谈谈，但条件似乎还不合适。
entries.sampleRaw: I could talk to you, but the conditions don't seem right.

entries.source: Hello traveler!
Kuudra will return one day but we must first put aside our differences and be ready.
entries.translation: 库德拉终有一天会归来，但我们必须先放下分歧，做好准备。
entries.sampleRaw: Kuudra will return one day but we must first put aside our differences and be ready.

entries.source: We must show Kuudra that we stand united for its return.
entries.translation: 我们必须向库德拉表明，我们团结一致，迎接它的归来。
entries.sampleRaw: We must show Kuudra that we stand united for its return.

entries.source: That's a very impressive armor set you are wearing, Kuudra would be impressed!
entries.translation: 你身上穿的这套盔甲真是令人印象深刻，库德拉一定会为之赞叹！
entries.sampleRaw: That's a very impressive armor set you are wearing, Kuudra would be impressed!

entries.source: We are united! Kuudra SHOW YOURSELF TO US.
entries.translation: 我们团结一致！库德拉，现身吧！
entries.sampleRaw: We are united! Kuudra SHOW YOURSELF TO US.

entries.source: Why didn't it show itself...
Maybe it won't ever return...
entries.translation: 也许它再也不会回来了……

entries.source: Thank you for your dedication adventurer, here is a token of my gratitude.
entries.translation: 感谢你的付出，冒险者，这是我的一点心意。
entries.sampleRaw: Thank you for your dedication adventurer, here is a token of my gratitude.

entries.source: I see you holding something there...
entries.translation: 我看到你手里拿着什么东西……

entries.source: And it seems as though you need some assistance.
entries.translation: 而且看起来你需要一些帮助。
entries.sampleRaw: §rAnd it seems as though you need some assistance.

entries.source: I would be able to provide it, but you came without the correct friend.
entries.translation: 我本可以提供帮助，但你带来的同伴不对。
entries.sampleRaw: §rI would be able to provide it, but you came without the correct friend.

entries.source: Ah yes! You are here with the right companion.
entries.translation: 啊，没错！你带来了正确的同伴。
entries.sampleRaw: §rAh yes! You are here with the right companion.

entries.source: It seems as though I can now properly assist you.
entries.translation: 看来我现在可以正式帮助你了。
entries.sampleRaw: §rIt seems as though I can now properly assist you.

entries.source: Let me go ahead and help you break down that item.
entries.translation: 让我来帮你拆解那件物品吧。
entries.sampleRaw: §rLet me go ahead and help you break down that item.

entries.source: I wish you luck on your journey, adventurer!
entries.translation: 祝你在旅途中好运，冒险者！
entries.sampleRaw: §rI wish you luck on your journey, adventurer!

entries.source: Hold it right there!
I have a Fairy Soul inside my property. If you want it you will have to pay!
entries.translation: 我的地盘里有一个仙女之魂。想要的话，你得付钱！
entries.sampleRaw: I have a §dFairy Soul §finside my property. If you want it you will have to pay!

entries.source: You can get access to my house for 1,000,000 coins!
entries.translation: 你可以花 1,000,000 枚硬币进入我的房子!
entries.sampleRaw: You can get access to my house for §61,000,000 coins!
entries.numericSource: You can get access to my house for {{N0}} coins!
entries.numericTranslation: 你可以花 {{N0}} 枚硬币进入我的房子!

entries.source: Do you want access?
Congratulations! You can now come and go as you please!
entries.translation: 恭喜！现在你可以随意进出了！
entries.sampleRaw: Congratulations! You can now come and go as you please!

entries.source: In that case you better get off my property before I call the guards!
entries.translation: 既然这样，你最好在我叫守卫之前离开我的地盘！
entries.sampleRaw: In that case you better get off my property before I call the guards!

entries.source: Are you trying to scam me, bruh? Get off my property!
entries.translation: 兄弟，你是想骗我吗？离开我的地盘！
entries.sampleRaw: Are you trying to scam me, bruh? Get off my property!

entries.source: Nice try, bruh! Pay the toll to get the soul!
entries.translation: 想得美，兄弟！付了过路费才能拿到灵魂！
entries.sampleRaw: Nice try, bruh! Pay the toll to get the soul!

entries.source: Once I found this Fairy Soul I decided to build my house around it.
entries.translation: 当初发现这个仙女之魂后，我就决定把房子建在它周围。
entries.sampleRaw: Once I found this Fairy Soul I decided to build my house around it.

entries.source: I actually use the Fairy Soul as a lamp. They kinda glow in the dark a bit.
entries.translation: 我其实把仙女之魂当灯用。它们在黑暗中会微微发光。
entries.sampleRaw: I actually use the Fairy Soul as a lamp. They kinda glow in the dark a bit.

entries.source: I have a business deal to propose to you. I have something that you need, and you have something that I need. Let's make a deal, shall we?
entries.translation: 我有个生意想跟你谈。我有你需要的东西，而你有我需要的东西。我们做个交易，怎么样？
entries.sampleRaw: I have a business deal to propose to you. I have something that you need, and you have something that I need. Let's make a deal, shall we?

entries.source: Yo.
I knew you would come to terms. Pleasure doing business with you.
entries.translation: 我就知道你会同意的。很高兴与你做生意。
entries.sampleRaw: I knew you would come to terms. Pleasure doing business with you.

entries.source: Thanks.
Are you trying to scam me, bruh? Get out of here! Oh wait, this is your house...I'll get out of here!
entries.translation: 兄弟，你是想骗我吗？滚出去！哦等等，这是你家……我滚出去！
entries.sampleRaw: Are you trying to scam me, bruh? Get out of here! Oh wait, this is your house...I'll get out of here!

entries.source: Okay, bye.
Lava fishing is the best, it is my favorite pastime.
entries.translation: 熔岩钓鱼最棒了，这是我最喜欢的消遣。
entries.sampleRaw: Lava fishing is the best, it is my favorite pastime.

entries.source: Do you like my collection of Trophies?
entries.translation: 你喜欢我收藏的奖杯吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Do you like my collection of Trophies?

entries.source: Some fishes can only be caught under specific conditions, and it requires great focus.
entries.translation: 有些鱼只能在特定条件下才能钓到，而且需要高度专注。
entries.sampleRaw: Some fishes can only be caught under specific conditions, and it requires great focus.

entries.source: My name is Odexar! I have quite the reputation around here.
entries.translation: 我叫Odexar！我在这附近可是相当有名气的。
entries.sampleRaw: My name is Odexar! I have quite the reputation around here.

entries.source: You see, I'm the best lava fisher in the world.
entries.translation: 你看，我是世界上最好的熔岩钓手。
entries.sampleRaw: You see, I'm the best lava fisher in the world.

entries.source: Recently I fished a magnificent Volcanic Stonefish from a secret spot I won't reveal.
entries.translation: 最近我在一个不会透露的秘密地点钓到了一条壮观的火山石鱼。
entries.sampleRaw: Recently I fished a magnificent Volcanic Stonefish from a secret spot I won't reveal.

entries.source: I would like to show it to Odger but I hurt my feet badly.
entries.translation: 我想把它拿给Odger看，但我的脚伤得很重。
entries.sampleRaw: I would like to show it to Odger but I hurt my feet badly.

entries.source: Would you mind taking my Volcanic Stonefish to Odger's house on top of the Volcano?
entries.translation: 你愿意帮我把我的火山石鱼送到火山上Odger的家里吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Would you mind taking my Volcanic Stonefish to Odger's house on top of the Volcano?

entries.source: Thanks, I'm sure Odger will be proud, that is the best Trophy Fish I got in a long time!
entries.translation: 谢谢，我相信Odger会为我骄傲的，这是我很久以来钓到的最好的奖杯鱼！
entries.sampleRaw: Thanks, I'm sure Odger will be proud, that is the best Trophy Fish I got in a long time!

entries.source: Odger lives in a house inside the Volcano at the very top, you can't miss it.
entries.translation: Odger住在火山最顶端里面的一栋房子里，你不会错过的。
entries.sampleRaw: Odger lives in a house inside the Volcano at the very top, you can't miss it.

entries.source: Trophy Fishing is my passion, and Odger is the local specialist.
entries.translation: 奖杯钓鱼是我的热情所在，而Odger是当地的专家。
entries.sampleRaw: Trophy Fishing is my passion, and Odger is the local specialist.

entries.source: Marvelous! The Fish looks even better than I remembered!
entries.translation: 太棒了！这条鱼看起来比我记忆中还要好！
entries.sampleRaw: Marvelous! The Fish looks even better than I remembered!

entries.source: Odger has delicate hands, this is really top quality work!
entries.translation: Odger的手真巧，这真是顶级的手艺！
entries.sampleRaw: Odger has delicate hands, this is really top quality work!

entries.source: What do you say? Odger said I was a bad fisherman?
entries.translation: 你说什么？Odger说我是个糟糕的渔夫？
entries.sampleRaw: What do you say? Odger said I was a bad fisherman?

entries.source: Hahaha!! What a jokester this Odger, love that goblin.
entries.translation: 哈哈哈！！这个Odger真会开玩笑，我喜欢那个哥布林。
entries.sampleRaw: Hahaha!! What a jokester this Odger, love that goblin.

entries.source: Thanks a lot friend, here take those 80 coins. Don't spend them all in one go!
entries.translation: 非常感谢你，朋友，这些80硬币你拿着。别一下子全花光了！
entries.sampleRaw: Thanks a lot friend, here take those 80 coins. Don't spend them all in one go!
entries.numericSource: Thanks a lot friend, here take those {{N0}} coins. Don't spend them all in one go!
entries.numericTranslation: 非常感谢你，朋友，这些{{N0}}硬币你拿着。别一下子全花光了！

entries.source: My fishing rod is quite amazing but I'm still saving up for a better one, I can't wait!
entries.translation: 我的钓鱼竿相当不错，但我还在攒钱买更好的，我等不及了！
entries.sampleRaw: My fishing rod is quite amazing but I'm still saving up for a better one, I can't wait!

entries.source: The largest fish in my collection is almost a meter long, and weighs close to 100 lb!
entries.translation: 我收藏中最大的鱼将近一米长，重约100磅！
entries.sampleRaw: The largest fish in my collection is almost a meter long, and weighs close to 100 lb!
entries.numericSource: The largest fish in my collection is almost a meter long, and weighs close to {{N0}} lb!
entries.numericTranslation: 我收藏中最大的鱼将近一米长，重约{{N0}}磅！

entries.source: The largest fish in my collection is almost a meter long, and weighs close to 100 lb.
entries.translation: 我收藏中最大的鱼将近一米长，重约100磅。
entries.sampleRaw: The largest fish in my collection is almost a meter long, and weighs close to 100 lb.
entries.numericSource: The largest fish in my collection is almost a meter long, and weighs close to {{N0}} lb.
entries.numericTranslation: 我收藏中最大的鱼将近一米长，重约{{N0}}磅。

entries.source: Wait, that Loudmouth Bass of yours is <mass> lbs...
entries.translation: 等等，你那条大嘴鲈鱼有<mass>磅……
entries.sampleRaw: Wait, that §aLoudmouth Bass §fof yours is <mass> lbs...

entries.source: HOW???
I really thought I was finally good at something for a while, you know?
entries.translation: 我一度真的以为我终于有一样擅长的东西了，你知道吗？
entries.sampleRaw: I really thought I was finally good at something for a while, you know?

entries.source: And then you came on over here and trampled on my dreams.
entries.translation: 然后你跑过来，践踏了我的梦想。
entries.sampleRaw: And then you came on over here and trampled on my dreams.

entries.source: Hope you feel real good about yourself, loudmouth.
entries.translation: 希望你对自己感觉真的很好，大嘴巴。
entries.sampleRaw: Hope you feel real good about yourself, loudmouth.

entries.source: I like to drag my feet because it's more time out of the house.
entries.translation: 我喜欢拖着脚走路，因为这样能多在外面待一会儿。
entries.sampleRaw: I like to drag my feet because it's more time out of the house.

entries.source: Fetch this, fetch that...
Is that really all I'm good for?
entries.translation: 难道我就只配干这些吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Is that really all I'm good for?

entries.source: How many times do I have to go to the shop every day...
entries.translation: 我每天到底要跑多少趟商店啊……
entries.sampleRaw: How many times do I have to go to the shop every day...

entries.source: She should really just wholesale at this rate. Cut out the middle mage.
entries.translation: 照这速度，她真该直接批发。省掉中间那个法师。
entries.sampleRaw: She should really just wholesale at this rate. Cut out the middle mage.

entries.source: More Bottles, please. sigh
Same order as always. Thanks.
Double order today. She's onto something big.
entries.translation: 今天要双份。她肯定在搞什么大动作。
entries.sampleRaw: Double order today. She's onto something big.

entries.source: How are the experiments going?
...ok good talk.
The store was super busy today!
entries.sampleRaw: The store was super busy today!

entries.source: ...just kidding I'm the only one ever there!
entries.translation: ……开玩笑的，店里一直只有我一个人！
entries.sampleRaw: ...just kidding I'm the only one ever there!

entries.source: Here are your bottles, Mollim.
Do you like my cats?
My favorite cat? I love them all.
entries.translation: 我最喜欢的猫？我全都喜欢。
entries.sampleRaw: My favorite cat? I love them all.

entries.source: I like to study cats, and I think they sometimes study me.
entries.translation: 我喜欢研究猫，我觉得它们有时也在研究我。
entries.sampleRaw: I like to study cats, and I think they sometimes study me.

entries.source: I think all cats teleport to the same spiritual world when they dream.
entries.translation: 我觉得所有猫做梦时都会传送到同一个精神世界。
entries.sampleRaw: I think all cats teleport to the same spiritual world when they dream.

entries.source: Cats are the only known animals that are gifted with magic, except they are too lazy to use their powers.
entries.translation: 猫是已知唯一拥有魔法天赋的动物，只不过它们太懒了，懒得使用自己的力量。
entries.sampleRaw: Cats are the only known animals that are gifted with magic, except they are too lazy to use their powers.

entries.source: My dear Leo is on his 9th life, I give him all the care in the world.
entries.translation: 我亲爱的 Leo 已经活到第 9 条命了，我给了他无微不至的照顾。
entries.sampleRaw: My dear Leo is on his 9th life, I give him all the care in the world.
entries.numericSource: My dear Leo is on his {{N0}}th life, I give him all the care in the world.
entries.numericTranslation: 我亲爱的 Leo 已经活到第 {{N0}} 条命了，我给了他无微不至的照顾。

entries.source: Meow.
Meeow.
Meeeow.
Wow! That is a classic. It's great to meet a fellow follower of Kuudra.
entries.translation: 哇！这可是经典。能遇到同为库德拉信徒的人真是太好了。
entries.sampleRaw: Wow! That is a classic. It's great to meet a fellow follower of Kuudra.

entries.source: I wish I could give you something to commemorate meeting you, but I don't have that much anymore.
entries.translation: 我希望能给你点东西纪念我们的相遇，但我已经没有那么多东西了。
entries.sampleRaw: I wish I could give you something to commemorate meeting you, but I don't have that much anymore.

entries.source: Maybe if we met in the past I would have something for you.
entries.translation: 要是我们在过去相遇，也许我还能给你点东西。
entries.sampleRaw: Maybe if we met in the past I would have something for you.

entries.source: Have I met you before? I am getting some dejavu.
entries.translation: 我们以前见过吗？我有点似曾相识的感觉。
entries.sampleRaw: Have I met you before? I am getting some dejavu.

entries.source: Wow that's a lot of resources!
entries.sampleRaw: Wow that's a lot of resources!

entries.source: Too bad you didn't put in the effort to collect them yourselves.
entries.translation: 可惜你们没花力气自己去收集。
entries.sampleRaw: Too bad you didn't put in the effort to collect them yourselves.

entries.source: Wow how did you know I liked these items!
entries.translation: 哇，你怎么知道我喜欢这些物品！
entries.sampleRaw: Wow how did you know I liked these items!

entries.source: I'm lucky to have met you.
entries.translation: 能遇见你真是我的幸运。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm lucky to have met you.

entries.source: Here, take this to commemorate our meeting!
entries.translation: 来，收下这个，纪念我们的相遇！
entries.sampleRaw: Here, take this to commemorate our meeting!

entries.source: I don't know, adventurer, is it his real lair???
entries.translation: 我不知道，冒险者，那真的是他的巢穴吗？？？
entries.sampleRaw: §rI don't know, adventurer, is it his real lair???

entries.source: Speaking of layers, I see you have Repulsive Kuudra Teeth Plaque!
entries.translation: 说到层数,我看到你拥有令人反感的库德拉 牙齿徽章!

styleMappings.Repulsive Kuudra Teeth Plaque: 令人反感的库德拉 牙齿徽章

entries.sampleRaw: §rSpeaking of layers, I see you have §aRepulsive Kuudra Teeth Plaque§f!

entries.source: You can definitely use that to take some layers off Kuudra's teeth!
entries.translation: 你完全可以用它来削掉库德拉牙齿上的几层！
entries.sampleRaw: §rYou can definitely use that to take some layers off Kuudra's teeth!

entries.source: There, I'll help you get it broken down!
entries.translation: 好了，我来帮你把它拆解掉！
entries.sampleRaw: §rThere, I'll help you get it broken down!

entries.source: I know so many things about Kuudra.
entries.translation: 我知道很多关于库德拉的事情。
entries.sampleRaw: I know so many things about Kuudra.

entries.source: They are quite interesting.
I've been studying the ancient texts of Kuudra.
entries.translation: 我一直在研究库德拉的古老文献。
entries.sampleRaw: I've been studying the ancient texts of Kuudra.

entries.source: When I was much younger, I used to collect so much Magma Cream and Netherrack.
entries.translation: 我年轻得多的时候，曾收集过大量的岩浆膏和下界岩。
entries.sampleRaw: When I was much younger, I used to collect so much Magma Cream and Netherrack.

entries.source: Unfortunately, those days are behind me.
entries.translation: 不幸的是，那些日子已经离我远去了。
entries.sampleRaw: Unfortunately, those days are behind me.

entries.source: I now spend my days learning about Kuudra.
entries.translation: 我现在每天都在研究库德拉。
entries.sampleRaw: I now spend my days learning about Kuudra.

entries.source: The Academy was great today, learned a lot of important things.
entries.translation: 今天学院很棒，学到了很多重要的东西。
entries.sampleRaw: The Academy was great today, learned a lot of important things.

entries.source: I'm just waiting for my friend to arrive so we can walk back home together.
entries.translation: 我只是在等我的朋友来，这样我们就能一起走回家了。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm just waiting for my friend to arrive so we can walk back home together.

entries.source: My friend should be here any minute now.
entries.translation: 我的朋友随时都该到了。
entries.sampleRaw: My friend should be here any minute now.

entries.source: Annyyyyy minute now...
entries.translation: 随时随时随时随时随时……

entries.source: This is absurd!
Everyone knows time travel is a myth!
entries.translation: 大家都知道时间旅行是无稽之谈！
entries.sampleRaw: Everyone knows time travel is a myth!

entries.source: Excuse me, can't you see we are trying to have a conversation here?
entries.translation: 打扰一下，你没看到我们正在谈话吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Excuse me, can't you see we are trying to have a conversation here?

entries.source: Please leave us alone!
Just because you don't understand something doesn't mean it's not possible!
