entries.translation: 你不理解某件事，并不意味着它不可能！
entries.sampleRaw: Just because you don't understand something doesn't mean it's not possible!

entries.source: Not even a century ago teleportation was thought to be impossible!
entries.translation: 就在不到一个世纪前，传送还被认为是不可实现的！
entries.sampleRaw: Not even a century ago teleportation was thought to be impossible!

entries.source: And you yourself are capable of telepathy and telekinesis, which nobody knew were even possible recently!
entries.translation: 而你自己就能使用心灵感应和念力，这些能力不久前还没人知道是可能的！
entries.sampleRaw: And you yourself are capable of telepathy and telekinesis, which nobody knew were even possible recently!

entries.source: Oh, who are you?
Can you not disturb our conversation?
entries.translation: 你能不能不要打扰我们的谈话？
entries.sampleRaw: Can you not disturb our conversation?

entries.source: Don't disrespect your elders.
Stop eavesdropping!!!
Please leave us alone.
You are being very rude.
I like to use this path to go to the Cathedral.
entries.translation: 我喜欢走这条路去大教堂。
entries.sampleRaw: I like to use this path to go to the §5Cathedral§f.

entries.source: It's much more quiet around here, I can clear my head.
entries.translation: 这附近安静多了，我可以理清思绪。
entries.sampleRaw: It's much more quiet around here, I can clear my head.

entries.source: Nonsense...
The appearance of that strange disturbance on the nearby island might have nothing to do with time travel.
entries.translation: 附近岛屿上那奇怪扰动的出现，也许和时间旅行毫无关系。
entries.sampleRaw: The appearance of that strange disturbance on the nearby island might have nothing to do with time travel.

entries.source: That doesn't mean we should ignore it, someone needs to...
entries.translation: 但这不代表我们该无视它，得有人去……
entries.sampleRaw: That doesn't mean we should ignore it, someone needs to...

entries.source: Can't you see we are busy?
entries.translation: 你没看到我们正忙着吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Can't you see we are busy?

entries.source: Don't disrespect your elders.
Stop eavesdropping!!!
Please leave us alone.
You are being very rude.
I don't sell my items to people who don't work with us.
entries.translation: 我不会把东西卖给不和我们共事的人。
entries.sampleRaw: I don't sell my items to people who don't work with us.

entries.source: Someone just bought up my entire stock of Nether Wart! Could you help me replenish my supply?
entries.translation: 有人刚把我所有的下界疣存货都买光了！你能帮我补充货源吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Someone just bought up my entire stock of Nether Wart! Could you help me replenish my supply?

entries.source: Thanks. Hopefully I won't run out again.
entries.translation: 谢谢。希望我不会再断货了。
entries.sampleRaw: Thanks. Hopefully I won't run out again.

entries.source: Looks like I'll have to find something else to sell.
entries.translation: 看来我得找点别的东西来卖了。
entries.sampleRaw: Looks like I'll have to find something else to sell.

entries.source: Hey there, I'm the Auction Master.
entries.sampleRaw: Hey there, I'm the Auction Master.

entries.source: At the auction house you can put your valuable items up for auction!
entries.translation: 在拍卖行，你可以把自己的贵重物品拿去拍卖！
entries.sampleRaw: At the auction house you can put your valuable items up for auction!

entries.source: You may also want to check back here to see what items other players are selling to see if you can get a good deal.
entries.translation: 你也可以常回来看看其他玩家在卖什么，说不定能捡到好价。
entries.sampleRaw: You may also want to check back here to see what items other players are selling to see if you can get a good deal.

entries.source: Talk to me if you would like to start your first auction or if you want to see the items currently being sold.
entries.translation: 如果你想开始你的第一场拍卖，或者想看看当前正在出售的物品，就来找我谈谈。
entries.sampleRaw: Talk to me if you would like to start your first auction or if you want to see the items currently being sold.

entries.source: Why is there so much hate in the world?
entries.translation: 为什么世界上有这么多仇恨？
entries.sampleRaw: Why is there so much hate in the world?

entries.source: You discover a new species and your first reaction is to kill them?
entries.translation: 你发现了一个新物种，第一反应却是杀掉它们？
entries.sampleRaw: You discover a new species and your first reaction is to kill them?

entries.source: Have you even tried to understand them?
entries.translation: 你哪怕尝试过去理解它们吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Have you even tried to understand them?

entries.source: Don't you think what you are doing is wrong?
entries.translation: 你不觉得自己的所作所为是错的吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Don't you think what you are doing is wrong?

entries.source: Kuudra is just like us.
Sulphur is life - if there is enough for us there is enough for them.
entries.translation: 硫磺就是生命——如果够我们用的，也就够它们用的。
entries.sampleRaw: Sulphur is life - if there is enough for us there is enough for them.

entries.source: I would gladly share my Sulphur with them!
entries.translation: 我很乐意和它们分享我的硫磺！
entries.sampleRaw: I would gladly share my Sulphur with them!

entries.source: Please give them a chance!
You don't look like a Mage to me!
entries.translation: 在我看来你可不像个法师！

entries.source: Welcome new Faction Member!
I provide the faction with important items.
entries.translation: 我为阵营提供重要物品。
entries.sampleRaw: I provide the faction with important items.

entries.source: You may need more reputation to unlock all of my supplies!
entries.translation: 你可能需要更多声望才能解锁我的全部补给！
entries.sampleRaw: You may need more reputation to unlock all of my supplies!

entries.source: You don't look like a Barbarian to me!
entries.translation: 在我看来你可不像个野蛮人！

entries.source: Welcome to the Barbarian Faction, [player]!
I provide the Piglins with important items.
entries.translation: 我为猪灵提供重要物品。
entries.sampleRaw: I provide the Piglins with important items.

entries.source: You may need more reputation to unlock all of my supplies!
entries.translation: 你可能需要更多声望才能解锁我的全部补给！
entries.sampleRaw: You may need more §areputation§f to unlock all of my supplies!

entries.source: WHY ARE YOU HERE?
WHY ARE YOU HERE?
FINE, YOU MAY PASS!
FINE, YOU MAY PASS!
DO YOU WANT TO BE PULVERIZED?
entries.sampleRaw: DO YOU WANT TO BE PULVERIZED?

entries.source: DO YOU WANT TO BE PULVERIZED?
entries.sampleRaw: DO YOU WANT TO BE PULVERIZED?

entries.source: WHAT DO YOU WANT?
WHAT DO YOU WANT?
WE HAVE OUR EYES ON YOU.
entries.sampleRaw: WE HAVE OUR EYES ON YOU.

entries.source: WE HAVE OUR EYES ON YOU.
entries.sampleRaw: WE HAVE OUR EYES ON YOU.

entries.source: Pst, hey [player]! You must be the one they sent to get our guy back.
entries.translation: 嘘，嘿 [player]！你一定就是他们派来救我们的人吧。
entries.sampleRaw: Pst, hey [player]! You must be the one they sent to get our guy back.

entries.source: Here's what you need to do.
entries.sampleRaw: Here's what you need to do.

entries.source: You need to sneak through this area and avoid the guards.
entries.translation: 你需要潜行穿过这片区域，避开守卫。
entries.sampleRaw: You need to sneak through this area and avoid the guards.

entries.source: You need to stay out of their sight.
entries.translation: 你需要避开他们的视线。
entries.sampleRaw: You need to stay out of their §esight§f.

entries.source: They also have remarkable hearing. Sneaking will be much harder for them to detect than sprinting.
entries.translation: 他们的听觉也异常敏锐。潜行比冲刺更难被他们察觉。
entries.sampleRaw: They also have remarkable §ehearing§f. §eSneaking §fwill be much harder for them to detect than §esprinting§f.

entries.source: If you're observant, you might be able to distract some of them.
entries.translation: 如果你够细心，也许能分散他们中一些人的注意力。
entries.sampleRaw: If you're observant, you might be able to §edistract §fsome of them.

entries.source: If it's too dangerous for you, tell me. If you leave the area, we'll assume you've abandoned the mission and find someone else instead.
entries.translation: 如果对你来说太危险，就告诉我。如果你离开这片区域，我们会认为你放弃了任务，另找他人。
entries.sampleRaw: If it's too dangerous for you, tell me. If you leave the area, we'll assume you've abandoned the mission and find someone else instead.

entries.source: Good luck out there!
It's too dangerous for you?
Oh well, we'll find someone else. Leave before you're captured too.
entries.translation: 那好吧，我们会另找他人。在被抓之前赶紧离开。
entries.sampleRaw: Oh well, we'll find someone else. Leave before you're captured too.

entries.source: You want to help us rescue a hostage from those filthy brutes over there?
entries.translation: 你想帮我们从那边那些肮脏的畜生手里救出一名人质吗？
entries.sampleRaw: You want to help us rescue a hostage from those filthy brutes over there?

entries.source: Perfect! Go see our Undercover Agent at the Cathedral area in Mage territory to get started.
entries.translation: 太好了!去法师领地的Undercover Agent大教堂区域找我们的卧底特工开始吧.
entries.sampleRaw: Perfect! Go see our §eUndercover Agent §fat the §5Cathedral §farea in §5Mage territory to get started.

entries.source: Perfect! Go see our Undercover Agent at the The Bastion area in Barbarian territory to get started.
entries.translation: 太好了!去蛮族领地的Undercover Agent堡垒区域找我们的卧底特工开始吧.
entries.sampleRaw: Perfect! Go see our §eUndercover Agent §fat the §2The Bastion §farea in §cBarbarian §fterritory to get started.

entries.source: Thank you for your help! Go see the Undercover Agent for details.
entries.translation: 感谢你的帮助！详情请去找Undercover Agent卧底特工。
entries.sampleRaw: Thank you for your help! Go see the §eUndercover Agent §ffor details.

entries.source: You look suspicious. I have my eyes on you...
entries.translation: 你看起来很可疑。我会盯着你的……
entries.sampleRaw: You look suspicious. I have my eyes on you...

entries.source: You have a rescue with the enemy? I KNEW they were spying on us!
entries.translation: 你和敌人有救援往来？我就知道他们在监视我们！
entries.sampleRaw: You have a rescue with the enemy? I KNEW they were spying on us!

entries.source: Oink.
What, when? Oh.
How long have I been gone?
entries.sampleRaw: How long have I been gone?

entries.source: I keep on forgetting about Sulphur...
entries.sampleRaw: I keep on forgetting about Sulphur...

entries.source: Nowadays I live as a recluse, focusing on my work.
entries.translation: 如今我过着隐居生活，专注于我的工作。
entries.sampleRaw: Nowadays I live as a recluse, focusing on my work.

entries.source: I'm a writer, so I need calm to concentrate on my new novel.
entries.translation: 我是个作家，所以我需要安静来专心写我的新小说。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm a writer, so I need calm to concentrate on my new novel.

entries.source: I really need to get back to work.
entries.sampleRaw: I really need to get back to work.

entries.source: The name of my new novel? Hmm...
entries.sampleRaw: The name of my new novel? Hmm...

entries.source: I haven't decided yet.
I mostly write fictions. Because you helped me, I'll tell you some of the plot.
entries.translation: 我主要写小说。因为你帮了我，我就告诉你一些情节。
entries.sampleRaw: I mostly write fictions. Because you helped me, I'll tell you some of the plot.

entries.source: The story takes place in a dystopian Crimson Isle where the lava of the Volcano is turning into water.
entries.translation: 故事发生在一个反乌托邦的绯红之岛，那里火山的熔岩正在变成水。
entries.sampleRaw: The story takes place in a dystopian Crimson Isle where the lava of the Volcano is turning into water.

entries.source: We Piglins always dream of water. This book will be about showing that water also brings pain and struggle.
entries.translation: 我们猪灵总是梦想着水。这本书将展现水也会带来痛苦与挣扎。
entries.sampleRaw: We Piglins always dream of water. This book will be about showing that water also brings pain and struggle.

entries.source: Again...
I get so absorbed by my work...
entries.sampleRaw: I get so absorbed by my work...

entries.source: Time really flies when you work on something you love.
entries.translation: 当你做自己热爱的事时，时间过得真快。
entries.sampleRaw: Time really flies when you work on something you love.

entries.source: Thanks for the Sulphur! I'll finish my new novel now.
entries.translation: 谢谢你的硫磺！我现在就写完我的新小说。
entries.sampleRaw: Thanks for the Sulphur! I'll finish my new novel now.

entries.source: My new novel?
It's about an old hero that everyone still considers as the strongest.
entries.translation: 讲的是一个老英雄，大家仍然认为他是最强的。
entries.sampleRaw: It's about an old hero that everyone still considers as the strongest.

entries.source: But he himself knows very well that his prime is over and that his next fight will be his last.
entries.translation: 但他自己很清楚，他的巅峰已过，下一场战斗将是他的最后一战。
entries.sampleRaw: But he himself knows very well that his prime is over and that his next fight will be his last.

entries.source: It's be a sad story about how the expectations of others can force you to do things that hurt you.
entries.translation: 这是一个悲伤的故事，讲述他人的期望如何迫使你去做伤害自己的事。
entries.sampleRaw: It's be a sad story about how the expectations of others can force you to do things that hurt you.

entries.source: My new novel is about someone who has a strange power that allows him to inspect the memories of others.
entries.translation: 我的新小说讲的是一个拥有奇怪能力的人，他能窥视他人的记忆。
entries.sampleRaw: My new novel is about someone who has a strange power that allows him to inspect the memories of others.

entries.source: The first part shows him having fun with his powers and exploring ways to use memories to his advantage.
entries.translation: 第一部分讲他玩转自己的能力，并探索如何利用记忆为自己谋利。
entries.sampleRaw: The first part shows him having fun with his powers and exploring ways to use memories to his advantage.

entries.source: But one day he finds a strange character, and in their memories he sees things he should have never seen...
entries.translation: 但有一天他遇到了一个奇怪的角色，在他们的记忆里，他看到了本不该看到的东西……
entries.sampleRaw: But one day he finds a strange character, and in their memories he sees things he should have never seen...

entries.source: That's it! I won't tell you more than that!
entries.translation: 就这样！我不会再多告诉你了！
entries.sampleRaw: That's it! I won't tell you more than that!

entries.source: I'm currently working on a complex love story.
entries.translation: 我目前正在写一个复杂的爱情故事。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm currently working on a complex love story.

entries.source: A smart and beautiful girl is forced to marry someone they have never met before.
entries.translation: 一个聪明美丽的女孩被迫嫁给一个素未谋面的人。
entries.sampleRaw: A smart and beautiful girl is forced to marry someone they have never met before.

entries.source: She's apprehensive at first but when she meets him they end up surpassing all expectations.
entries.translation: 她起初很不安，但当她见到他后，他们最终超越了所有期望。
entries.sampleRaw: She's apprehensive at first but when she meets him they end up surpassing all expectations.

entries.source: She falls in love quickly but he doesn't and for the first time in her life she has to deal with that emotional pain.
entries.translation: 她很快坠入爱河，但他没有，而她人生中第一次不得不面对这种情感上的痛苦。
entries.sampleRaw: She falls in love quickly but he doesn't and for the first time in her life she has to deal with that emotional pain.

entries.source: It's a simple story but it touches a lot of interesting subjects.
entries.translation: 这是个简单的故事，但它触及了许多有趣的主题。
entries.sampleRaw: It's a simple story but it touches a lot of interesting subjects.

entries.source: I'm writing a fictional story about Kaeman and his wife Sarah, before the Calamity.
entries.translation: 我正在写一个关于 Kaeman 和他的妻子 Sarah 在灾厄之前的虚构故事。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm writing a fictional story about Kaeman and his wife Sarah, before the Calamity.

entries.source: Most people know Kaeman as the Wither King, but I think it's important to remind people that he once was a human.
entries.translation: 大多数人都知道 Kaeman 是凋灵之王，但我认为提醒人们他曾经也是个人类很重要。
entries.sampleRaw: Most people know Kaeman as the Wither King, but I think it's important to remind people that he once was a human.

entries.source: The tragedy of his life isn't very known. He had an idyllic relationship with his wife, up until their daughter was born.
entries.translation: 他人生中的悲剧并不广为人知。他和妻子曾有着田园诗般的关系，直到他们的女儿出生。
entries.sampleRaw: The tragedy of his life isn't very known. He had an idyllic relationship with his wife, up until their daughter was born.

entries.source: I'm trying to show how pain and sorrow turned this well respected man into an evil doer.
entries.translation: 我试图展现痛苦与悲伤是如何让这个备受尊敬的人变成了一个作恶者。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm trying to show how pain and sorrow turned this well respected man into an evil doer.

entries.source: My new book is a different take on the battle royale stories.
entries.translation: 我的新书对大逃杀故事做了另一种诠释。
entries.sampleRaw: My new book is a different take on the battle royale stories.

entries.source: Every 10 years there is a global tournament to the death with all the strongest warriors in the world.
entries.translation: 每 10 年都会举办一场全球生死锦标赛，汇聚世上最强的战士。
entries.sampleRaw: Every 10 years there is a global tournament to the death with all the strongest warriors in the world.
entries.numericSource: Every {{N0}} years there is a global tournament to the death with all the strongest warriors in the world.
entries.numericTranslation: 每 {{N0}} 年都会举办一场全球生死锦标赛，汇聚世上最强的战士。

entries.source: The winner of the tournament becomes immortal.
entries.translation: 锦标赛的获胜者将获得永生。
entries.sampleRaw: The winner of the tournament becomes immortal.

entries.source: Every 250 years there is a special battle royale tournament with the previous 24 winners.
entries.translation: 每 250 年都会举办一场特别的大逃杀锦标赛，参赛者是之前的 24 位获胜者。
entries.sampleRaw: Every 250 years there is a special battle royale tournament with the previous 24 winners.
entries.numericSource: Every {{N0}} years there is a special battle royale tournament with the previous {{N1}} winners.
entries.numericTranslation: 每 {{N0}} 年都会举办一场特别的大逃杀锦标赛，参赛者是之前的 {{N1}} 位获胜者。

entries.source: The twist is that those battle veterans are accustomed to their immortality, which has impacted their views and personalities over time.
entries.translation: 转折在于，这些战斗老手已经习惯了他们的永生，而随着时间的推移，这影响了他们的观念和性格。
entries.sampleRaw: The twist is that those battle veterans are accustomed to their immortality, which has impacted their views and personalities over time.

entries.source: It's a bit cheesy, but you gotta make money sometimes.
entries.translation: 有点俗套，但有时候你总得赚钱嘛。
entries.sampleRaw: It's a bit cheesy, but you gotta make money sometimes.

entries.source: I think this new story will be my masterpiece.
entries.translation: 我觉得这个新故事会成为我的杰作。
entries.sampleRaw: I think this new story will be my masterpiece.

entries.source: It's a thriller about a genius serial killer who's obsessed with framing police inspectors with his murders.
entries.translation: 这是一部惊悚小说，讲述一个天才连环杀手痴迷于用自己的谋杀案陷害警探。
entries.sampleRaw: It's a thriller about a genius serial killer who's obsessed with framing police inspectors with his murders.

entries.source: But this time the inspector he framed escaped the justice system and hunts him down.
entries.translation: 但这一次，被他陷害的警探逃脱了司法系统，并反过来追捕他。
entries.sampleRaw: But this time the inspector he framed escaped the justice system and hunts him down.

entries.source: It's an incredible battle of wits between two brilliant minds.
entries.translation: 这是两个绝顶头脑之间一场不可思议的智斗。
entries.sampleRaw: It's an incredible battle of wits between two brilliant minds.

entries.source: Oink?
✆ I'm pretty busy right now, sorry.
✆ I know you are worried about me but I'm feeling fine right now.
entries.translation: ✆ 我知道你担心我，但我现在感觉挺好的。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fI know you are worried about me but I'm feeling fine right now.

entries.source: ✆ I need to finish my book.
✆ Is this urgent? I'm working on my new novel at the moment.
entries.translation: ✆ 这事急吗？我目前正在写我的新小说。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fIs this urgent? I'm working on my new novel at the moment.

entries.source: I am busy right now.
Sorry, I only work with Mages...
entries.sampleRaw: Sorry, I only work with Mages...

entries.source: You... are not one of my students!
entries.sampleRaw: You... are not one of my students!

entries.source: I hope you are not here to rob me, I could still take on a dozen of young guns like you!
entries.translation: 我希望你不是来抢劫我的，我还能对付十几个像你这样的年轻人！
entries.sampleRaw: I hope you are not here to rob me, I could still take on a dozen of young guns like you!

entries.source: Oh, that's not why you are here? Then why are you here? Speak up I don't have all day!
entries.translation: 哦，你不是为这个来的？那你来干什么？快说，我可没一整天时间！
entries.sampleRaw: Oh, that's not why you are here? Then why are you here? Speak up I don't have all day!

entries.source: You again, what do you want this time?
entries.translation: 又是你，这次你想要什么？
entries.sampleRaw: You again, what do you want this time?

entries.source: Oh, where did you find this? This looks like an older, simpler version of our Ability Phones, in a way this is remarkable.
entries.translation: 哦，你在哪找到这个的？这看起来像是我们能力手机的旧版简化款，某种意义上这真是了不起。
entries.sampleRaw: Oh, where did you find this? This looks like an older, simpler version of our §2Ability Phones§f, in a way this is remarkable.

entries.source: But why do you have this, are you interested in that kind of magical technology?
entries.translation: 但你怎么会有这个，你对那种魔法技术感兴趣吗？
entries.sampleRaw: But why do you have this, are you interested in that kind of magical technology?

entries.source: Oh, you mean...you are more interested in advanced magical technology right?
entries.translation: 哦，你的意思是……你对高级魔法技术更感兴趣，对吧？
entries.sampleRaw: Oh, you mean...you are more interested in advanced magical technology right?

entries.source: Have you changed your mind?
In that case thanks for the gift, and have a great life.
entries.translation: 既然这样，谢谢你的礼物，祝你生活愉快。
entries.sampleRaw: In that case thanks for the gift, and have a great life.

entries.source: Perfect, well then you are at the right place, let me write you a letter of recommendation!
entries.translation: 太好了，那你来对地方了，让我给你写一封推荐信！
entries.sampleRaw: Perfect, well then you are at the right place, let me write you a §2letter of recommendation§f!

entries.source: Hold on...
Here take this!
First you should go to the Queen with it, we have a very strict code around here and you won't go far without the Queen's approval.
entries.translation: 首先你应该带着它去见女王，我们这里规矩很严，没有女王的批准你走不了多远。
entries.sampleRaw: First you should go to the §cQueen §fwith it, we have a very strict code around here and you won't go far without the §cQueen§f's approval.

entries.source: Hopefully the Queen will grant you access to some parts of the city.
entries.translation: 希望女王能允许你进入城市的部分区域。
entries.sampleRaw: Hopefully the §cQueen §fwill grant you access to some parts of the city.

entries.source: Once that's done, go visit my cousin Udel in his shop in the plaza.
entries.translation: 办完那件事后，去广场上我表弟Udel的店里找他。
entries.sampleRaw: Once that's done, go visit my cousin §cUdel §fin his shop in the plaza.

entries.source: I'll let him know you are coming and he'll make you a price for your own Abiphone.
entries.translation: 我会告诉他你要来，他会给你自己的Abiphone报个价。
entries.sampleRaw: I'll let him know you are coming and he'll make you a price for your own §2Abiphone§f.

entries.source: You should bring that letter to the Queen ASAP. Did you lose the letter?
entries.translation: 你应该尽快把那封信带给女王。你把信弄丢了吗？
entries.sampleRaw: You should bring that letter to the §cQueen §fASAP. Did you lose the letter?

entries.source: Alright, if you are struggling to find the Queen, she is usually in the throne room, or in her quarters.
entries.translation: 好吧，如果你找不到女王，她通常在王座厅，或者在她的寝宫。
entries.sampleRaw: Alright, if you are struggling to find the §cQueen§f, she is usually in the §2throne room§f, or in her quarters.

entries.source: ✆ Hello?
✆ Oh, it's you! So the Queen welcomed you in our Faction? That's great
entries.translation: ✆ 哦，是你！所以女王欢迎你加入我们的阵营了？太好了
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fOh, it's you! So the Queen welcomed you in our Faction? That's great

entries.source: ✆ Listen, I don't have a ton of time right now, the object of my current research has just been stolen!
entries.translation: ✆ 听着，我现在时间不多，我当前研究的对象刚刚被偷了！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fListen, I don't have a ton of time right now, the object of my current research has just been stolen!

entries.source: ✆ I'm sorry, but I'll have to call you back later. Enjoy your Abiphone!
entries.translation: ✆ 抱歉，我稍后再打给你。好好享受你的Abiphone吧！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fI'm sorry, but I'll have to call you back later. Enjoy your Abiphone!

entries.source: ✆ Oh <player> is that you again?
✆ I am still really stressed out about the long research.
entries.translation: ✆ 我还在为这项漫长的研究感到压力很大。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fI am still really stressed out about the long research.

entries.source: ✆ It's a long story but in short, we believe the Piglins stole it, it's a real problem.
entries.translation: ✆ 说来话长，但简而言之，我们相信是猪灵偷走了它，这真是个麻烦。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fIt's a long story but in short, we believe the Piglins stole it, it's a real problem.

entries.source: ✆ What did you just say? You recovered it? And they didn't even see you?
entries.translation: ✆ 你刚才说什么？你把它找回来了？而且他们甚至没发现你？
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fWhat did you just say? You recovered it? And they didn't even see you?

entries.source: ✆ I can't believe it, you are truly a hero! I'm currently near the Community Center, please come here and bring the research back.
entries.translation: ✆ 我简直不敢相信，你真是个英雄！我现在在社区中心附近，请过来把研究带回来。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fI can't believe it, you are truly a hero! I'm currently near the Community Center, please come here and bring the research back.

entries.source: Oh, <player> is here! They're the one who retrieved the research!
entries.translation: 哦，<player>来了！就是他们找回了研究！
entries.sampleRaw: Oh, §7<player> §fis here! They're the one who retrieved the research!

entries.source: I see, we owe you adventurer, this object is of great value to us.
entries.translation: 我明白了，我们欠你一个人情，冒险者，这件物品对我们价值重大。
entries.sampleRaw: I see, we owe you adventurer, this object is of great value to us.

entries.source: Yes indeed! With it we are able to extract salt from Netherrack, it will be a massive asset when cooking.
entries.translation: 没错！有了它，我们就能从下界岩中提取盐，这在烹饪时会是极大的助力。
entries.sampleRaw: Yes indeed! With it we are able to extract salt from Netherrack, it will be a massive asset when cooking.

entries.source: You see, while we evolved past the need for crops and cattle, the quality of our food remains low.
entries.translation: 你看，虽然我们已经进化到不再需要农作物和牲畜，但我们的食物质量依然很低。
entries.sampleRaw: You see, while we evolved past the need for crops and cattle, the quality of our food remains low.

entries.source: I would say close to 50% of our research is still spent on food artifacts and machines.
entries.translation: 我敢说我们研究中有接近 50% 仍然花在食物神器和机器上。
entries.sampleRaw: I would say close to 50% of our research is still spent on food artifacts and machines.
entries.numericSource: I would say close to {{N0}} of our research is still spent on food artifacts and machines.
entries.numericTranslation: 我敢说我们研究中有接近 {{N0}} 仍然花在食物神器和机器上。

entries.source: And once again those Piglins stole our research.
entries.translation: 而那些猪灵又一次偷走了我们的研究成果。
entries.sampleRaw: And once again those Piglins stole our research.

entries.source: They believe we are working on war engines.
entries.translation: 他们以为我们在研制战争机器。
entries.sampleRaw: They believe we are working on war engines.

entries.source: The tension is rising and soon we might have to cross swords with them.
entries.translation: 局势越来越紧张，很快我们可能就要和他们兵戎相见了。
entries.sampleRaw: The tension is rising and soon we might have to cross swords with them.

entries.source: Captain Ahone, this isn't a conversation we should have right now.
entries.translation: Captain Ahone，这不是我们现在该谈的话题。
entries.sampleRaw: Captain Ahone, this isn't a conversation we should have right now.

entries.source: Thank you very much, <player>. Would you mind leaving us now, we have matters to discuss.
entries.translation: 非常感谢你，<player>。你介意现在先离开吗，我们有事要商议。
entries.sampleRaw: Thank you very much, §7<player>§f. Would you mind leaving us now, we have matters to discuss.

entries.source: <player> please meet me back at the Academy, we have a lot to talk about!
entries.translation: <player>，请回学院找我，我们有很多事要谈！
entries.sampleRaw: §7<player> §fplease meet me back at the Academy, we have a lot to talk about!

entries.source: Salt is immensely important, this is quite the revolution for us!
entries.translation: 盐极其重要，这对我们来说是一场真正的革命！
entries.sampleRaw: Salt is immensely important, this is quite the revolution for us!

entries.source: I can't thank you enough, what you did was heroic!
entries.translation: 我感激不尽，你所做的堪称英雄之举！
entries.sampleRaw: I can't thank you enough, what you did was heroic!

entries.source: You are probably aware but we used to be Pig farmers but Sulphur turned our pigs into Piglins.
entries.translation: 你大概知道，我们以前是养猪的，但硫磺把我们的猪变成了猪灵。
entries.sampleRaw: You are probably aware but we used to be Pig farmers but Sulphur turned our pigs into Piglins.

entries.source: For decades we had to survive with almost nothing to eat, until we learned magic.
entries.translation: 几十年来我们几乎没什么可吃，只能勉强生存，直到我们学会了魔法。
entries.sampleRaw: For decades we had to survive with almost nothing to eat, until we learned magic.

entries.source: Piglins can eat nether warts, but we certainly can't!
entries.translation: 猪灵能吃下界疣，但我们当然不行！
entries.sampleRaw: Piglins can eat nether warts, but we certainly can't!

entries.source: Anyways, if you want to learn more about that, there are books in the Academy regarding the Dark Ages.
entries.translation: 总之，如果你想了解更多，学院里有关于黑暗时代的书。
entries.sampleRaw: Anyways, if you want to learn more about that, there are books in the Academy regarding the Dark Ages.

entries.source: I am trying to finish my work on this machine but my Apprentice is missing.
entries.translation: 我正想完成这台机器的工作，但我的Apprentice不见了。
entries.sampleRaw: I am trying to finish my work on this machine but my §cApprentice §fis missing.

entries.source: He is out there in the wild looking for precious ingredients and he should have been back a long time ago.
entries.translation: 他在野外寻找珍贵的材料，早就该回来了。
entries.sampleRaw: He is out there in the wild looking for precious ingredients and he should have been back a long time ago.

entries.source: Their Abiphone doesn't seem to be working, I am starting to get worried.
entries.translation: 他们的 Abiphone 似乎坏了，我开始担心了。
entries.sampleRaw: Their Abiphone doesn't seem to be working, I am starting to get worried.

entries.source: Would you be so kind to look for them, they are probably North of that Red Sand Desert.
entries.translation: 你能否好心去找找他们，他们大概在那片红沙沙漠以北。
entries.sampleRaw: Would you be so kind to look for them, they are probably §2North of that Red Sand Desert§f.

entries.source: Please find my apprentice, he should be North of the Burning Desert.
entries.translation: 请找到我的学徒，他应该在灼热沙漠以北。
entries.sampleRaw: Please find my apprentice, he should be North of the Burning Desert.

entries.source: You found my Apprentice and he WHAT?!
entries.translation: 你找到了我的Apprentice，然后他怎么了？！
entries.sampleRaw: You found my Apprentice and he WHAT?!

entries.source: SULPHUR! This is catastrophic!!
My poor Apprentice, it is my vault, I shouldn't send him on difficult missions.
entries.translation: 我可怜的Apprentice，都怪我，我不该派他去执行困难的任务。
entries.sampleRaw: My poor Apprentice, it is my vault, I shouldn't send him on difficult missions.

entries.source: This will also delay my work considerably, how am I going to obtain all those precious materials now...
entries.translation: 这也会大大耽误我的工作，我现在要怎么弄到那些珍贵的材料……
entries.sampleRaw: This will also delay my work considerably, how am I going to obtain all those precious materials now...

entries.source: Oh, you are willing to help?
entries.sampleRaw: Oh, you are willing to help?

entries.source: Well in that case, I will send you the list of items I need.
entries.translation: 既然这样，我会把需要的物品清单发给你。
entries.sampleRaw: Well in that case, I will send you the list of items I need.

entries.source: Thank you very much you are a life savior, quite literally.
entries.translation: 非常感谢你，你真是名副其实的救命恩人。
entries.sampleRaw: Thank you very much you are a life savior, quite literally.

entries.source: Let me know when you obtained the 10 Magma Chunks and 5 Burning Eyes.
entries.translation: 等你拿到 10 个岩浆块和 5 个燃烧之眼后告诉我。
entries.sampleRaw: Let me know when you obtained the 10 Magma Chunks and 5 Burning Eyes.
entries.numericSource: Let me know when you obtained the {{N0}} Magma Chunks and {{N1}} Burning Eyes.
entries.numericTranslation: 等你拿到 {{N0}} 个岩浆块和 {{N1}} 个燃烧之眼后告诉我。

entries.source: Magma Chunks and Burning Eyes, perfect!
entries.translation: 岩浆块和燃烧之眼，太棒了！
entries.sampleRaw: Magma Chunks and Burning Eyes, perfect!

entries.source: That should be enough to finish my work.
entries.translation: 这些应该足够我完成工作了。
entries.sampleRaw: That should be enough to finish my work.

entries.source: I will call you once I'm done.
entries.sampleRaw: I will call you once I'm done.

entries.source: Thank you very much <player>, I will call you when I'm done
entries.translation: 非常感谢你，<player>，等我完成后会叫你的
entries.sampleRaw: Thank you very much §7<player>§f, I will call you when I'm done

entries.source: Oh, I was just about to call you!
entries.sampleRaw: Oh, I was just about to call you!

entries.source: I have almost completed my research, however I need a few extra components.
entries.translation: 我的研究几乎完成了，不过我还需要几个额外的组件。
entries.sampleRaw: I have almost completed my research, however I need a few extra components.

entries.source: Those ones are going to be tougher to obtain though.
entries.translation: 不过那些东西会更难获得。
entries.sampleRaw: Those ones are going to be tougher to obtain though.

entries.source: You will have to defeat mighty opponents.
entries.translation: 你必须击败强大的对手。
entries.sampleRaw: You will have to defeat mighty opponents.

entries.source: The first ingredient I need is a Hallowed Skull, which is obtained from a Bladesoul.
entries.translation: 我需要的第一个材料是神圣头骨，可以从剑魂身上获得。
entries.sampleRaw: The first ingredient I need is a §2Hallowed Skull§f, which is obtained from a §cBladesoul§f.

entries.source: This creature can be found inside the Stronghold, south of the island.
entries.translation: 这种生物可以在岛屿南部的要塞里找到。
entries.sampleRaw: This creature can be found inside the §cStronghold§f, south of the island.

entries.source: Hallowed Skulls can be obtained from Bladesoul inside the Stronghold.
entries.translation: 神圣头骨可以从要塞里的剑魂身上获得。
entries.sampleRaw: Hallowed Skulls can be obtained from §cBladesoul §finside the Stronghold.

entries.source: The Stronghold was built by Blazes and Wither Skeletons, they are still expanding it slowly, quite fascinating.
entries.translation: 要塞是由烈焰人和凋灵骷髅建造的，它们仍在缓慢地扩建它，真是相当有趣。
entries.sampleRaw: The Stronghold was built by Blazes and Wither Skeletons, they are still expanding it slowly, quite fascinating.

entries.source: A Hallowed Skull! Splendid!
I need a couple more components, the next one is a Lumino Fiber.
entries.translation: 我还需要几个组件，下一个是夜光纤维。
entries.sampleRaw: I need a couple more components, the next one is a §2Lumino Fiber§f.

entries.source: Only the strongest of Blazes can create those, and there is a terrifying Blaze in the North West.
entries.translation: 只有最强大的烈焰人才能制造出那些，而西北方有一只可怕的烈焰人。
entries.sampleRaw: Only the strongest of Blazes can create those, and there is a terrifying Blaze in the §cNorth West§f.

entries.source: If you can defeat them, I'm sure you'll obtain a Lumino Fiber.
entries.translation: 如果你能击败它们，我相信你就能获得夜光纤维。
entries.sampleRaw: If you can defeat them, I'm sure you'll obtain a §2Lumino Fiber§f.

entries.source: The reason why I need a Lumino Fiber? Well...it's hard to explain.
entries.translation: 我为什么需要夜光纤维？嗯……这很难解释。
entries.sampleRaw: The reason why I need a §2Lumino Fiber§f? Well...it's hard to explain.

entries.source: I have reasons to believe there is a lot of Sulphur in the North, it would explain the appearance of those Blaze species.
entries.translation: 我有理由相信北方有大量的硫磺，这可以解释那些烈焰人变种的出现。
entries.sampleRaw: I have reasons to believe there is a lot of Sulphur in the §cNorth§f, it would explain the appearance of those Blaze species.

entries.source: Thanks! I almost have all the components I need now.
entries.translation: 谢谢！我现在几乎拥有所有需要的组件了。
entries.sampleRaw: Thanks! I almost have all the components I need now.

entries.source: The last one is a Leather Cloth, and not just any kind.
entries.translation: 最后一个是皮革布料，而且不是普通的那种。
entries.sampleRaw: The last one is a §2Leather Cloth§f, and not just any kind.

entries.source: There is a rogue Barbarian going by the name of Duke X.
entries.translation: 有一个名叫Duke X的叛变野蛮人。
entries.sampleRaw: There is a rogue Barbarian going by the name of §cDuke X§f.

entries.source: He owns all the Leather Cloth on the island, find him and you'll find the items.
entries.translation: 他拥有岛上所有的皮革布料，找到他你就能找到那些物品。
entries.sampleRaw: He owns all the §2Leather Cloth §fon the island, find him and you'll find the items.

entries.source: Piglins can grow incredibly strong if they consume large amounts of Sulphur, but they lose their sanity in the process.
entries.translation: 如果猪灵摄入大量硫磺，它们会变得极其强大，但在此过程中会失去理智。
entries.sampleRaw: Piglins can grow incredibly strong if they consume large amounts of Sulphur, but they lose their sanity in the process.

entries.source: Last I heard, they are located near the Barbarian Faction.
entries.translation: 据我最近所知，它们位于野蛮人阵营附近。
entries.sampleRaw: Last I heard, they are located near the Barbarian Faction.

entries.source: I knew I could count on you.
entries.sampleRaw: I knew I could count on you.

entries.source: This strong Cloth will be able to contain the skull and the lumino fibers together.
entries.translation: 这种结实的布料能够把头骨和夜光纤维装在一起。
entries.sampleRaw: This strong Cloth will be able to contain the skull and the lumino fibers together.

entries.source: In theory this should help refining Sulphur, if I can get it to work.
entries.translation: 理论上这应该有助于提纯硫磺，如果我能让它奏效的话。
entries.sampleRaw: In theory this should help refining Sulphur, if I can get it to work.

entries.source: Would you mind talking to Captain Ahone?
entries.translation: 你介意去和Captain Ahone谈谈吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Would you mind talking to §cCaptain Ahone§f?

entries.source: Please tell him I need a full backpack worth of Sulphur.
entries.translation: 请告诉他我需要一整背包的硫磺。
entries.sampleRaw: Please tell him I need a full backpack worth of Sulphur.

entries.source: Captain Ahone should be below the Community Center.
entries.translation: Captain Ahone应该在社区中心下面。
entries.sampleRaw: Captain Ahone should be below the Community Center.

entries.source: There is still so much to learn about Sulphur.
entries.translation: 关于硫磺，还有太多东西要学。
entries.sampleRaw: There is still so much to learn about Sulphur.

entries.source: Hello <player>?
You found who stole our Sulphur?
entries.translation: 你找到是谁偷了我们的硫磺？
entries.sampleRaw: You found who stole our Sulphur?

entries.source: A giant magma creature with massive tentacles?
entries.translation: 一只长着巨大触手的巨型岩浆生物？
entries.sampleRaw: A giant magma creature with massive tentacles?

entries.source: Well that explains a lot, my Apprentice just awoken from his coma, he described the same creature.
entries.translation: 这下就说得通了，我的Apprentice刚从昏迷中醒来，他描述的也是同一种生物。
entries.sampleRaw: Well that explains a lot, my Apprentice just awoken from his coma, he described the same creature.

entries.source: In a way it is good that the Piglins were not behind this.
entries.translation: 从某种角度来说，猪灵不是幕后黑手是件好事。
entries.sampleRaw: In a way it is good that the Piglins were not behind this.

entries.source: We need to learn more about that monster, where it is from and what it wants.
entries.translation: 我们需要更多地了解那只怪物，它来自哪里，想要什么。
entries.sampleRaw: We need to learn more about that monster, where it is from and what it wants.

entries.source: I will call you later!
This monster probably feeds itself with Sulphur.
entries.translation: 这只怪物大概是以硫磺为食。
entries.sampleRaw: This monster probably feeds itself with Sulphur.

entries.source: If left unchecked, it is possible that the powers of this creature will grow.
entries.translation: 如果放任不管，这只生物的力量可能会增长。
entries.sampleRaw: If left unchecked, it is possible that the powers of this creature will grow.

entries.source: My kid has been crying for hours.
entries.translation: 我的孩子已经哭了好几个小时了。
entries.sampleRaw: My kid has been crying for hours.

entries.source: We just came back from our walk and a monster ate his favorite toy.
entries.translation: 我们刚散完步回来，一只怪物吃掉了他的最爱玩具。
entries.sampleRaw: We just came back from our walk and a monster ate his favorite toy.

entries.source: One of the Magma Cube Riders out there did it!
entries.translation: 是外面的一只岩浆怪骑手干的！
entries.sampleRaw: One of the §cMagma Cube Riders§f out there did it!

entries.source: You found his toy!
Thank you so much [player]!
My little Turd has such a lovely voice, I don't mind hearing him cry.
entries.translation: 我的小Turd声音真好听，我不介意听他哭。
entries.sampleRaw: My little Turd has such a lovely voice, I don't mind hearing him cry.

entries.source: Such an expensive toy, I am glad you found it for him!
entries.translation: 这么贵的玩具，真高兴你帮他找回来了！
entries.sampleRaw: Such an expensive toy, I am glad you found it for him!

entries.source: Thanks for finding his toy again, [player]!
entries.translation: 谢谢你又找到了他的玩具,[player]!
entries.sampleRaw: Thanks for finding his toy again, §7[player]§f!

entries.source: He keeps losing it...
✆ The monsters ate his toy again! I don't know what to do!
entries.translation: ✆ 怪物们又把他的玩具吃掉了！我不知道该怎么办了！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fThe monsters ate his toy again! I don't know what to do!

entries.source: ✆ This time it was a [Mob]!
✆ Can you come back here and help?
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fCan you come back here and help?

entries.source: Get away from my child!
Step away from my child, stranger!
entries.translation: 离我的孩子远点，陌生人！
entries.sampleRaw: Step away from my child, stranger!

entries.source: Don't talk to strangers, little Turd.
entries.sampleRaw: Don't talk to strangers, little Turd.

entries.source: Stop harassing me and my child!
entries.translation: 别再骚扰我和我的孩子了！
entries.sampleRaw: Stop harassing me and my child!

entries.source: I don't think he will ever calm down until he gets his toy back.
entries.translation: 我觉得在拿回他的玩具之前，他是不会冷静下来的。
entries.sampleRaw: I don't think he will ever calm down until he gets his toy back.

entries.source: This kid is a handful.
Maybe one of the Magma Cube Riders out there will have his toy.
entries.translation: 也许外面的某个岩浆怪骑手会有他的玩具。
entries.sampleRaw: Maybe one of the §cMagma Cube Riders §fout there will have his toy.

entries.source: waaaaaaaaa
WAAAAAAAHHH
waaaaaaaaaaaaaa
entries.translation: 哇啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊

entries.source: waaaaaa
WAAAAAAAAAAAAH
entries.translation: 哇啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊

entries.source: My toy. MINE!
I don't want to play with you.
entries.sampleRaw: I don't want to play with you.

entries.source: Mom!!!! Tell the weird stranger that it's MY toy!
entries.translation: 妈妈！！！！告诉那个奇怪的陌生人，那是我的玩具！
entries.sampleRaw: Mom!!!! Tell the weird stranger that it's MY toy!

entries.source: I love Rhanora's cats, but she wont let me play with any of them!
entries.translation: 我喜欢Rhanora的猫，但她一只都不让我玩！
entries.sampleRaw: §fI love §5Rhanora's §fcats, but she wont let me play with any of them!

entries.source: I wonder if she will notice if one goes missing...
entries.translation: 我在想如果有一只不见了，她会不会发现……
entries.sampleRaw: I wonder if she will notice if one goes missing...

entries.source: Why can't there be peace in the world?
entries.translation: 为什么世界上不能有和平呢？
entries.sampleRaw: Why can't there be peace in the world?

entries.source: I feel like people in power are so disconnected from reality.
entries.translation: 我觉得掌权的人跟现实脱节太严重了。
entries.sampleRaw: I feel like people in power are so disconnected from reality.

entries.source: The regular population just wants to have a calm and happy life.
entries.translation: 普通民众只是想过上平静快乐的生活。
entries.sampleRaw: The regular population just wants to have a calm and happy life.

entries.source: Literally, who cares?
I'm sorry for venting, but is that even a hot take?
entries.translation: 抱歉我发牢骚了，但这算什么惊世骇俗的观点吗？
entries.sampleRaw: I'm sorry for venting, but is that even a hot take?

entries.source: If the principal objective of a leader isn't the well being of their population, there is a problem.
entries.translation: 如果领导者的首要目标不是民众的福祉，那就出问题了。
entries.sampleRaw: If the principal objective of a leader isn't the well being of their population, there is a problem.

entries.source: Are you a tourist?
This is my favorite site, I know everything about the great Dragons.
entries.translation: 这是我最喜欢的景点，我对伟大的龙无所不知。
entries.sampleRaw: This is my favorite site, I know everything about the great §5Dragons§f.

entries.source: This is of course Jythar, the Eternal One.
entries.sampleRaw: This is of course §5Jythar§f, the Eternal One.

entries.source: The dragon army attacked our dimension many centuries ago and sent the world into pieces.
entries.translation: 几个世纪前，龙族大军袭击了我们的维度，把世界打得四分五裂。
entries.sampleRaw: The dragon army attacked our dimension many centuries ago and sent the world into pieces.

entries.source: The skeleton of Chozon can be seen on the island south of here. He was one of the generals of Jythar.
entries.translation: 在这里南边的岛上可以看到Chozon的骸骨。他是Jythar的将军之一。
entries.sampleRaw: The skeleton of §5Chozon§f can be seen on the island south of here. He was one of the generals of Jythar.

entries.source: Dogen, Kirva, and Daydro perished and fell in the void, to my knowledge.
entries.translation: 据我所知，Dogen、Kirva和Daydro都阵亡了，坠入了虚空。
entries.sampleRaw: Dogen, Kirva, and Daydro perished and fell in the void, to my knowledge.

entries.source: The 4 generals were so huge that their reach could cover the sun and bring shadows upon entire cities.
entries.translation: 4位将军体型巨大，他们的臂展能遮住太阳，让整座城市陷入阴影。
entries.sampleRaw: The 4 generals were so huge that their reach could cover the sun and bring shadows upon entire cities.
entries.numericSource: The {{N0}} generals were so huge that their reach could cover the sun and bring shadows upon entire cities.
entries.numericTranslation: {{N0}}位将军体型巨大，他们的臂展能遮住太阳，让整座城市陷入阴影。

entries.source: Thousands of Dragons attacked that day and all were defeated, but did they fail?
entries.translation: 那天成千上万条龙发起攻击，全都被击败了，但他们真的失败了吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Thousands of Dragons attacked that day and all were defeated, but did they fail?

entries.source: What even was their purpose?
entries.translation: 他们的目的到底是什么？

entries.source: I think they decided to break the world to weaken us, and by us I mean everyone in this dimension.
entries.translation: 我认为他们决定摧毁这个世界来削弱我们，而我们指的是这个维度里的所有人。
entries.sampleRaw: I think they decided to break the world to weaken us, and by us I mean everyone in this dimension.

entries.source: Despite the wars raging at the time, we were still able to unite and beat this common enemy.
entries.translation: 尽管当时战火纷飞，我们仍然能够团结起来击败这个共同的敌人。
entries.sampleRaw: Despite the wars raging at the time, we were still able to unite and beat this common enemy.

entries.source: Jythar knew there would be no path to victory against us for as long as we could unite.
entries.translation: Jythar 知道，只要我们能够团结，他们就永远没有战胜我们的可能。
entries.sampleRaw: Jythar knew there would be no path to victory against us for as long as we could unite.

entries.source: But why not retreat?
Why did he keep attacking us until his death?
entries.translation: 为什么他直到死都一直在攻击我们？
entries.sampleRaw: Why did he keep attacking us until his death?

entries.source: I doubt it was madness. Dragons live for millennia, their Emperor surely wasn't mad.
entries.translation: 我怀疑那不是疯狂。龙能活上千年，他们的皇帝肯定不疯。
entries.sampleRaw: I doubt it was madness. Dragons live for millennia, their Emperor surely wasn't mad.

entries.source: So why would he give up his life to guarantee a potential victory in the future?
entries.translation: 那他为什么要牺牲自己的生命，去保证未来可能取得的胜利？
entries.sampleRaw: So why would he give up his life to guarantee a potential victory in the future?

entries.source: It's impossible for us to know, but we can theorize.
entries.translation: 我们不可能知道，但我们可以推测。
entries.sampleRaw: It's impossible for us to know, but we can theorize.

entries.source: It is known from the Dragons summoned nowadays that they worship their Queen.
entries.translation: 从如今被召唤的龙来看，众所周知它们崇拜它们的女王。
entries.sampleRaw: It is known from the Dragons summoned nowadays that they worship their §5Queen§f.

entries.source: Queen, Empress - the exact word might have been lost in translation.
entries.translation: 女王、女皇——确切的词可能在翻译中丢失了。
entries.sampleRaw: Queen, Empress - the exact word might have been lost in translation.

entries.source: I think Jythar did it for her.
entries.translation: 我认为 Jythar 是为了她这么做的。
entries.sampleRaw: I think Jythar did it for her.

entries.source: I think the reason is love.
Maybe I am wrong, but I choose to believe it.
entries.translation: 也许我错了，但我选择相信。
entries.sampleRaw: Maybe I am wrong, but I choose to believe it.

entries.source: This titan next to us is known by many names, some call them the Calamity.
entries.translation: 我们身边的这个泰坦有许多名字，有人称他们为灾厄。
entries.sampleRaw: This titan next to us is known by many names, some call them the §5Calamity§f.

entries.source: They are the enemies, but if they are motivated by love, maybe we can communicate with them.
entries.translation: 他们是敌人，但如果他们的动机是爱，也许我们可以与他们沟通。
entries.sampleRaw: They are the enemies, but if they are motivated by love, maybe we can communicate with them.

entries.source: What do you think? Am I too romantic, or did my explanation make sense?
entries.translation: 你怎么看？是我太浪漫了，还是我的解释有道理？
entries.sampleRaw: What do you think? Am I too romantic, or did my explanation make sense?

entries.source: You are not from around here.
entries.sampleRaw: You are not from around here.

entries.source: My kids are a handful, but I love them so.
entries.translation: 我的孩子们很让人头疼，但我太爱他们了。
entries.sampleRaw: My kids are a handful, but I love them so.

entries.source: Please don't play with my kids.
entries.translation: 请不要和我的孩子们玩。
entries.sampleRaw: Please don't play with my kids.

entries.source: What? I didn't say anything!
Stop spying on us...
You are intruding.
So do you know if they got the new Abiphones?
entries.translation: 那你知道他们拿到新的 Abiphone 了吗？
entries.sampleRaw: So do you know if they got the new Abiphones?

entries.source: Ya, they got all of them. It's a bit expensive though.
entries.translation: 是啊，他们全都拿到了。不过有点贵。
entries.sampleRaw: Ya, they got all of them. It's a bit expensive though.

entries.source: Incredible and do you know the code..?
entries.translation: 太不可思议了，那你知道密码吗……？
entries.sampleRaw: Incredible and do you know the code..?

entries.source: Yep, but keep it to yourself.
entries.sampleRaw: Yep, but keep it to yourself.

entries.source: Of course.
Today's code is <####>.
Ok, got it.
Shhhh!
Someone is listening to us!
Are you selling something?
No, forget what I just said.
entries.translation: 不，忘了我刚才说的话吧。
entries.sampleRaw: No, forget what I just said.

entries.source: Get away from us.
Me Grog, you thirsty. Buy drink!
entries.sampleRaw: Me Grog, you thirsty. Buy drink!

entries.source: I enjoy long strolls in Scarleton.
entries.translation: 我喜欢在斯卡雷顿悠闲地散步。

entries.source: It's so refreshing to see some new faces in the town!
entries.translation: 在镇上看到几张新面孔真是令人耳目一新！
entries.sampleRaw: It's so refreshing to see some new faces in the town!

entries.source: Humm, the sound of fire...
Music to my ears.
Just listen to the fire with me, what a delightful melody.
entries.translation: 就和我一起听听火焰的声音吧，多么美妙的旋律。
entries.sampleRaw: Just listen to the fire with me, what a delightful melody.

entries.source: I could stay here for hours just listening to this exquisite harmony.
entries.translation: 我可以在这里待上几个小时，就为了听这绝妙的和谐之音。
entries.sampleRaw: I could stay here for hours just listening to this exquisite harmony.

entries.source: Shikshrishrikts...you know?
entries.translation: 希克什里什里克茨……你懂吗？

entries.source: This is...magnificent...
Close your eyes and listen, it's so subtle and clean...
entries.translation: 闭上眼睛听，它是如此细腻而纯净……
entries.sampleRaw: Close your eyes and listen, it's so subtle and clean...

entries.source: Hello!
I'm a young and ambitious architect.
entries.translation: 我是一名年轻有为的建筑师。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm a young and ambitious architect.

entries.source: Let me know if you need a house, I'll quote you a price!
entries.translation: 如果你需要房子，告诉我，我会给你报个价！
entries.sampleRaw: Let me know if you need a house, I'll quote you a price!

entries.source: Clients? No, I never had any. But soon surely!
entries.translation: 客户？没有，我从来没有过。但很快一定会有的！
entries.sampleRaw: Clients? No, I never had any. But soon surely!

entries.source: I designed my own house. You like?
entries.translation: 我自己设计了自己的房子。你喜欢吗？
entries.sampleRaw: I designed my own house. You like?

entries.source: The view from my window is amazing.
entries.sampleRaw: The view from my window is amazing.

entries.source: That's the main reason why I bought this place.
entries.translation: 这就是我买下这个地方的主要原因。
entries.sampleRaw: That's the main reason why I bought this place.

entries.source: Sigh... What a beautiful view...
The layout of our village is so complex...
entries.translation: 我们村庄的布局太复杂了……
entries.sampleRaw: The layout of our village is so complex...

entries.source: I just got a new job, but I don't know how to find the address.
entries.translation: 我刚找到一份新工作，但我不知道该怎么找到那个地址。
entries.sampleRaw: I just got a new job, but I don't know how to find the address.

entries.source: Navigating around here is really tough...
entries.translation: 在这附近认路真的很难……
entries.sampleRaw: Navigating around here is really tough...

entries.source: I haven't managed to find the place yet, but soon!
entries.translation: 我还没找到那个地方，但快了！
entries.sampleRaw: I haven't managed to find the place yet, but soon!

entries.source: Hopefully I'll find the way tomorrow.
entries.sampleRaw: Hopefully I'll find the way tomorrow.

entries.source: I think this is the way?
entries.sampleRaw: I think this is the way?

entries.source: It should be right here.
I hope I won't be late.
entries.sampleRaw: I hope I won't be late.

entries.source: I got the wrong address again...
entries.sampleRaw: I got the wrong address again...

entries.source: Looks like I'm lost.
Oh boy...this isn't it.
I don't think this is it...
entries.sampleRaw: I don't think this is it...

entries.source: You are not ready for this fight.
entries.translation: 你还没准备好打这场仗。
entries.sampleRaw: You are not ready for this fight.

entries.source: Finish the Crimson Isle Factions questline before talking to me again.
entries.translation: 在再次和我说话之前，先完成绯红之岛阵营任务线。
entries.sampleRaw: §fFinish the §cCrimson Isle §fFactions questline before talking to me again.

entries.source: ✆ Huh? you want to add my contact to your Abiphone?
entries.translation: ✆ 嗯？你想把我的联系方式加到你的阿比电话里？
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f Huh? you want to add my contact to your Abiphone?

entries.source: ✆ I guess we can come to an agreement.
entries.translation: ✆ 我想我们可以达成一致。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f I guess we can come to an agreement.

entries.source: ✆ I'm far too weak to take on Kuudra myself, but maybe one day...
entries.translation: ✆ 我太弱了，没法独自对付库德拉，但也许有一天……
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f I'm far too weak to take on Kuudra myself, but maybe one day...

entries.source: ✆ Bring me a Bezal Shard, and I'll give you my contact.
entries.translation: ✆ 给我带一个贝扎尔碎片来,我就把我的联系方式给你.
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f Bring me a §eBezal Shard§7, and I'll give you my contact.

entries.source: ✆ You don't have what I need! Nice try!
entries.translation: ✆ 你没有我需要的东西！想得美！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fYou don't have what I need! Nice try!

entries.source: ✆ Ah, that is what I asked for. Thanks.
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f Ah, that is what I asked for. Thanks.

entries.source: ✆ Here is my contact. Give me a call if you wish to take on the one they call 'Kuudra.'
entries.translation: ✆ 这是我的联系方式。如果你想挑战那个叫“库德拉”的家伙，就给我打电话。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆§f Here is my contact. Give me a call if you wish to take on the one they call 'Kuudra.'

entries.source: Hello!
Have you tried lava fishing before?
entries.translation: 你以前试过熔岩钓鱼吗？

entries.source: Us Piglins believe lava fishes are sacred beasts.
entries.translation: 我们猪灵相信熔岩鱼是神圣的野兽。

entries.source: However recently something strange has been happening to the fishes.
entries.translation: 不过最近这些鱼身上发生了一些奇怪的事。
entries.sampleRaw: However recently something strange has been happening to the fishes.

entries.source: I am trying to understand the cause of this turmoil.
entries.translation: 我正在试图弄清这场骚动的原因。
entries.sampleRaw: I am trying to understand the cause of this turmoil.

entries.source: My beliefs prevent me from fishing, but I cannot investigate without seeing some specimens myself.
entries.translation: 我的信仰让我不能钓鱼，但如果不亲眼看看一些样本，我就无法调查。
entries.sampleRaw: My beliefs prevent me from fishing, but I cannot investigate without seeing some specimens myself.

entries.source: Could you please bring me 1 Flyfish and 1 Skeleton Fish.
entries.translation: 你能给我带 1 条飞鱼和 1 条骷髅鱼来吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Could you please bring me §21 Flyfish §fand §21 Skeleton Fish§f.
entries.numericSource: Could you please bring me {{N0}} Flyfish and {{N1}} Skeleton Fish.
entries.numericTranslation: 你能给我带 {{N0}} 条飞鱼和 {{N1}} 条骷髅鱼来吗？

entries.source: I don't know myself how to find those, but there is an expert who lives at the top of the volcano.
entries.translation: 我自己也不知道该怎么找到它们，但有一位专家住在火山顶上。
entries.sampleRaw: I don't know myself how to find those, but there is an expert who lives at the §2top of the volcano§f.

entries.source: Their name is Odger.
I don't want to point fingers at anyone, but if anyone is messing with the lava, it's certainly not our faction.
entries.translation: 我不想指责任何人，但如果有人在动熔岩，那肯定不是我们阵营。
entries.sampleRaw: I don't want to point fingers at anyone, but if anyone is messing with the lava, it's certainly not our faction.

entries.source: Odger is a Goblin. I think he eats the fishes, raw...
entries.translation: Odger 是个哥布林。我觉得他生吃那些鱼……
entries.sampleRaw: §cOdger §fis a Goblin. I think he eats the fishes, raw...

entries.source: Thank you very much!
I am glad we can count you in our ranks!
entries.translation: 很高兴你能加入我们的行列！
entries.sampleRaw: I am glad we can count you in our ranks!

entries.source: I'll be studying those Fishes now.
entries.translation: 我现在要去研究那些鱼了。
entries.sampleRaw: I'll be studying those Fishes now.

entries.source: See you around.
We Piglins send our deads in the lava of the Volcano for their final journey.
entries.translation: 我们猪灵会将逝者送入火山的熔岩中，完成他们最后的旅程。
entries.sampleRaw: We §cPiglins§f send our deads in the lava of the §cVolcano§f for their final journey.

entries.source: The Volcano is everything to us, its Sulphur made us who we are, so it's only normal that we give everything back to the Volcano.
entries.translation: 火山对我们来说就是一切，它的硫磺造就了我们，所以我们把一切归还给火山也是理所当然的。
entries.sampleRaw: The §cVolcano§f is everything to us, its §2Sulphur§f made us who we are, so it's only normal that we give everything back to the §cVolcano§f.

entries.source: A long long time ago, when we cremated the corpse of our great Chief Malak, the Volcano erupted.
entries.translation: 很久很久以前，当我们火化伟大的酋长 Malak 的遗体时，火山爆发了。
entries.sampleRaw: A long long time ago, when we cremated the corpse of our great §cChief Malak§f, the §cVolcano§f erupted.

entries.source: It was the largest eruption we have ever seen. As if the Volcano was talking to us.
entries.translation: 那是我们见过的最大的喷发。就好像火山在和我们说话。
entries.sampleRaw: It was the largest eruption we have ever seen. As if the §cVolcano §fwas talking to us.

entries.source: And from that burst, thousands of lava fishes fell from the sky onto Dragontail.
entries.translation: 从那场喷发中，成千上万的熔岩鱼从天而降，落到了龙尾镇。
entries.sampleRaw: And from that burst, thousands of §2lava fishes §ffell from the sky onto §cDragontail§f.

entries.source: We believe Malak and our ancestors found a new life inside the creatures of the lava.
entries.translation: 我们相信 Malak 和我们的祖先在熔岩生物中获得了新生。
entries.sampleRaw: We believe §cMalak §fand our ancestors found a new life inside the creatures of the lava.

entries.source: Ugo why are you limping?
My le-
Have you found the evil wizard machine?
entries.translation: 你找到那个邪恶巫师的机器了吗？
entries.sampleRaw: §f§lHave you found the evil wizard machine?

entries.source: Y-
Give it to the guards, we will investigate it.
entries.translation: 把它交给卫兵，我们会调查的。
entries.sampleRaw: §f§lGive it to the guards, we will investigate it.

entries.source: Enough with the mages and their shenanigans.
entries.translation: 受够那些法师和他们的鬼把戏了。
entries.sampleRaw: §f§lEnough with the mages and their shenanigans.

entries.source: Alri-
The Town Board is filling up and you are late on your Training Ugo.
entries.translation: 城镇公告板都快满了，而你的训练已经迟到了，Ugo。
entries.sampleRaw: §lThe Town Board is filling up and §lyou are late on your Training Ugo.

entries.source: What have you been doing?
You-
Hurry up, failure isn't an option.
Newest member of the Faction!
The entire stash of Sulphur of the Piglin Faction has been stolen this morning.
entries.translation: 今天早上，猪灵阵营的全部硫磺储备都被偷了。
entries.sampleRaw: §f§lThe entire stash of Sulphur of the Piglin Faction has been stolen this morning.

entries.source: I sent my son Ugo on a mission to recover the Sulphur.
entries.translation: 我派我的儿子 Ugo 去执行夺回硫磺的任务。
entries.sampleRaw: §f§lI sent my son Ugo on a mission to recover the Sulphur.

entries.source: He might be fighting the Mage Faction as we speak.
entries.translation: 说不定此刻他正在与法师阵营交战。
entries.sampleRaw: §f§lHe might be fighting the Mage Faction as we speak.

entries.source: I implore you. Please assist Ugo in this operation.
entries.translation: 我恳求你。请协助 Ugo 完成这次行动。
entries.sampleRaw: §f§lI implore you. Please assist Ugo in this operation.

entries.source: I don't know what I would do without my son. My only son.
entries.translation: 我不知道没有我儿子我该怎么办。我唯一的儿子。
entries.sampleRaw: §f§lI don't know what I would do without my son. My only son.

entries.source: They have followed the traces of the Sulphur all the way to the Forgotten Skull in the North.
entries.translation: 他们沿着硫磺的踪迹一路追到了北方的遗忘之颅。
entries.sampleRaw: §f§lThey have followed the traces of the Sulphur all the way to the Forgotten Skull in the North.

entries.source: Please help Ugo.
You finally retrieved the Sulphur.
entries.translation: 你终于把硫磺取回来了。

entries.source: What took you so long?
A gian-
You even needed the help of those adventurers.
entries.translation: 你甚至还需要那些冒险者的帮助。
entries.sampleRaw: §f§lYou even needed the help of those adventurers.

entries.source: Do you have no shame?
I didn't-
Look at the time. You are late to your training.
entries.translation: 看看都什么时辰了。你训练要迟到了。
entries.sampleRaw: §f§lLook at the time. You are late to your training.

entries.source: Guards, escort my son out of the hut.
entries.translation: 卫兵，把我儿子带出小屋。
entries.sampleRaw: §f§lGuards, escort my son out of the hut.

entries.source: <player> I am in your debt.
I cherish Ugo more than anything else in this world.
entries.translation: 我珍视Ugo胜过这世上的任何东西。
entries.sampleRaw: §f§lI cherish Ugo more than anything else in this world.

entries.source: A father could not be prouder of his son.
entries.translation: 没有哪个父亲能比我对儿子更骄傲了。
entries.sampleRaw: §f§lA father could not be prouder of his son.

entries.source: My mind is at peace knowing you are by his side.
entries.translation: 知道有你在他的身边，我便心安了。
entries.sampleRaw: §f§lMy mind is at peace knowing you are by his side.

entries.source: More importantly, I am glad he finally met someone he can consider his friend.
entries.translation: 更重要的是，我很高兴他终于遇到了一个可以当作朋友的人。
entries.sampleRaw: §f§lMore importantly, I am glad he finally met someone he can consider his friend.

entries.source: I taught him everything I could, but there are things only friends can teach.
entries.translation: 我把能教的都教给他了，但有些东西只有朋友才能教。
entries.sampleRaw: §f§lI taught him everything I could, but there are things only friends can teach.

entries.source: I won't hold you any longer.
Good luck in your adventures.
I have an important meeting to attend.
entries.translation: 我有个重要的会议要参加。
entries.sampleRaw: §f§lI have an important meeting to attend.

entries.source: I am very busy right now.
Greetings, I am in dire need of my favorite snack.
entries.translation: 你好，我急需我最爱的点心。
entries.sampleRaw: Greetings, I am in dire need of my favorite snack.

entries.source: I lied about having an important meeting just to be here, glad it was worth it!
entries.translation: 我谎称有个重要会议，只是为了来这里，很高兴这值得！
entries.sampleRaw: I lied about having an important meeting just to be here, glad it was worth it!

entries.source: That is...not ideal!
This is the Statue of the Hero. I come here every day to pray.
entries.translation: 这是英雄雕像。我每天都来这里祈祷。
entries.sampleRaw: This is the §9Statue of the Hero§f. I come here every day to pray.

entries.source: The legend says that a Hero arrived centuries ago, and helped us in times of need.
entries.translation: 传说在几个世纪前，一位英雄来到这里，在我们需要帮助时伸出了援手。
entries.sampleRaw: The legend says that a Hero arrived centuries ago, and helped us in times of need.

entries.source: Some of us still believe that the Hero will come back one day.
entries.translation: 我们中的一些人仍然相信，英雄终有一天会回来。
entries.sampleRaw: Some of us still believe that the Hero will come back one day.

entries.source: Do you want me to tell the story?
entries.translation: 你想听我讲这个故事吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Do you want me to tell the story?

entries.source: I could tell you were not very interested.
entries.translation: 我看得出来你不太感兴趣。
entries.sampleRaw: I could tell you were not very interested.

entries.source: I will go back to my prayers.
entries.sampleRaw: I will go back to my prayers.

entries.source: There are three different beliefs among the Taika.
entries.translation: 泰卡人之间有三种不同的信仰。
entries.sampleRaw: There are three different beliefs among the §aTaika§f.

entries.source: After we started learning magic centuries ago, most people stopped praying in the Cathedral.
entries.translation: 几个世纪前我们开始学习魔法之后，大多数人就不再在大教堂祈祷了。
entries.sampleRaw: After we started learning magic centuries ago, most people stopped praying in the §5Cathedral§f.

entries.source: They were too busy to learn and create new spells, and even turned the Cathedral into an Academy.
entries.translation: 他们忙于学习和创造新法术，甚至把大教堂变成了一所学院。
entries.sampleRaw: They were too busy to learn and create new spells, and even turned the §5Cathedral §finto an Academy.

entries.source: Those people will say that they believe in knowledge and magic.
entries.translation: 那些人会说他们信仰知识与魔法。
entries.sampleRaw: Those people will say that they believe in knowledge and magic.

entries.source: Some others still believe that it was our prayers that gave us our powers.
entries.translation: 另一些人仍然相信，是我们的祈祷赋予了我们力量。
entries.sampleRaw: Some others still believe that it was our prayers that gave us our powers.

entries.source: They believe it was the Sky's plan to make us independent through Sulphur, and that the Sky is good and fair.
entries.translation: 他们相信天空的计划是通过硫磺让我们独立，并且天空是善良而公正的。
entries.sampleRaw: They believe it was the Sky's plan to make us independent through §aSulphur§f, and that the Sky is good and fair.

entries.source: And finally there are still very few people like me, who hold their faith in the Hero.
entries.translation: 最后，还有极少数像我这样的人，把信仰寄托在英雄身上。
entries.sampleRaw: And finally there are still very few people like me, who hold their faith in the §9Hero§f.

entries.source: The Hero was humble, yet they saved us all from doom.
entries.translation: 英雄谦逊低调，却将我们从毁灭中拯救出来。
entries.sampleRaw: The Hero was humble, yet they saved us all from doom.

entries.source: I must pray at home, for it is late.
entries.translation: 我得在家祈祷了，因为已经很晚了。
entries.sampleRaw: I must pray at home, for it is late.

entries.source: The town may never sleep, but I do.
entries.translation: 这座城镇也许从不入睡，但我会。
entries.sampleRaw: The town may never sleep, but I do.

entries.source: Rise and shine! Pray from dusk til dawn!
entries.translation: 起床啦！从黄昏祈祷到黎明！
entries.sampleRaw: Rise and shine! Pray from dusk til dawn!

entries.source: Are you coming to pray with me?
entries.translation: 你要来和我一起祈祷吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Are you coming to pray with me?

entries.source: I'm trying to sleep.
It is very late.
What do you think? Do you believe in the Hero too?
entries.translation: 你怎么想？你也信仰英雄吗？
entries.sampleRaw: What do you think? Do you believe in the Hero too?

entries.source: Do you think the Hero was a man or a woman? There is so little information that remains...
entries.translation: 你觉得英雄是男人还是女人？留存下来的信息太少了……
entries.sampleRaw: Do you think the Hero was a man or a woman? There is so little information that remains...

entries.source: What does a stranger have to do with the Taika people? Speak!
entries.translation: 一个陌生人和泰卡人有什么关系？说话！
entries.sampleRaw: What does a stranger have to do with the §cTaika §fpeople? Speak!

entries.source: A letter of recommendation from the Dean, let me read this.
entries.translation: 一封来自Dean的推荐信，让我读读。
entries.sampleRaw: A letter of recommendation from the §cDean§f, let me read this.

entries.source: Intriguing to say the least.
I have the upmost faith in our Dean, if they value your company then I'll welcome you to our faction.
entries.translation: 我对我们的Dean抱有最大的信任，如果他们看重你的陪伴，那我就欢迎你加入我们的阵营。
entries.sampleRaw: I have the upmost faith in our §cDean§f, if they value your company then I'll welcome you to our faction.

entries.source: But if you are up to no good, I'll revoke this access immediately.
entries.translation: 但如果你图谋不轨，我会立即撤销这项权限。
entries.sampleRaw: But if you are up to no good, I'll revoke this access immediately.

entries.source: Now go, and enjoy our great city, new Faction member!
entries.translation: 现在去吧，尽情享受我们伟大的城市吧，新的阵营成员！
entries.sampleRaw: Now go, and enjoy our great city, new Faction member!

entries.source: You are a little bit too close to me, keep your distances.
entries.translation: 你离我有点太近了，保持距离。
entries.sampleRaw: You are a little bit too close to me, keep your distances.

entries.source: ✆ My contact?
✆ Maybe if you reach enough reputation...but maybe not...
entries.translation: ✆ 也许等你达到足够的声望……但也许不会……
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fMaybe if you reach enough §areputation§f...but maybe not...

entries.source: ✆ You have quite the reputation around here!
entries.translation: ✆ 你在这附近的名声可真不小！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fYou have quite the reputation around here!

entries.source: ✆ I suppose you have more than earned my contact! Here you go!
entries.translation: ✆ 我想你早已挣得了我的联系方式！给你！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fI suppose you have more than earned my contact! Here you go!

entries.source: ✆ I didn't give you my contact for this reason.
entries.translation: ✆ 我给你联系方式可不是为了这个。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fI didn't give you my contact for this reason.

entries.source: ✆ Only call me if you have something urgent to talk about.
entries.translation: ✆ 除非有急事，否则别来找我。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fOnly call me if you have something urgent to talk about.

entries.source: Us Taika people love the taste of Melon Juice so much that we'd go just about anywhere to get some.
entries.translation: 我们泰卡人太爱西瓜汁的味道了，为了喝到它，我们愿意跑遍天涯海角。
entries.sampleRaw: Us Taika people love the taste of Melon Juice so much that we'd go just about anywhere to get some.

entries.source: Normally I'd send somebody else to do my bidding for me, but this is an urgent matter.
entries.translation: 平时我都会派别人替我办事，但这次事关紧急。
entries.sampleRaw: Normally I'd send somebody else to do my bidding for me, but this is an urgent matter.

entries.source: Do you have the faintest idea who you're talking to? I won't forget this!
entries.translation: 你知不知道你在跟谁说话？我不会忘记这件事的！
entries.sampleRaw: Do you have the faintest idea who you're talking to? I won't forget this!

entries.source: The Mage Faction is growing, we will soon uncover all the secrets of Mana.
entries.translation: 法师阵营正在壮大，我们很快就会揭开法力所有的秘密。
entries.sampleRaw: The Mage Faction is growing, we will soon uncover all the secrets of Mana.

entries.source: I can sense great power in you.
entries.translation: 我能感觉到你体内蕴藏着强大的力量。
entries.sampleRaw: I can sense great power in you.

entries.source: Our relations with the Piglins is getting worse, things are spiraling out of control.
entries.translation: 我们与猪灵的关系越来越糟，局势正在失控。
entries.sampleRaw: Our relations with the Piglins is getting worse, things are spiraling out of control.

entries.source: You are looking for the Dean's Apprentice?
entries.sampleRaw: You are looking for the Dean's Apprentice?

entries.source: I'm afraid he might be in great danger, I just found his backpack and there is some blood on it...
entries.translation: 我怕他可能身处险境，我刚找到他的背包，上面还有血迹……
entries.sampleRaw: I'm afraid he might be in great danger, I just found his backpack and there is some §cblood §fon it...

entries.source: We must find him at once, I really hope this isn't the Piglin's doing.
entries.translation: 我们必须立刻找到他，我真希望这不是猪灵干的。
entries.sampleRaw: We must find him at once, I really hope this isn't the Piglin's doing.

entries.source: Let's separate. Take my contact and call me if you find anything.
entries.translation: 我们分头行动吧。拿着我的联系方式，一有发现就联系我。
entries.sampleRaw: Let's separate. Take my §acontact §fand call me if you find anything.

entries.source: He might be nearby, let me know if you find anything.
entries.translation: 他可能就在附近，有发现就告诉我。
entries.sampleRaw: He might be nearby, let me know if you find anything.

entries.source: ✆ You found the Apprentice?
✆ Good work. We will come to you at once!
entries.translation: ✆ 干得好。我们马上赶到你那里！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fGood work. We will come to you at once!

entries.source: Looks like we found him just in time, he will live, but he needs medical attention.
entries.translation: 看来我们及时找到了他，他能活下来，但需要医疗救治。
entries.sampleRaw: Looks like we found him just in time, he will live, but he needs medical attention.

entries.source: I know the Dean's Apprentice, they would never take that much damage from the monsters around here.
entries.translation: 我了解Dean的Apprentice，他们绝不会被这一带的怪物伤成这样。
entries.sampleRaw: I know the Dean's Apprentice, they would never take that much damage from the monsters around here.

entries.source: Once they wake up from their coma we will know what happened to them, but I have my suspicions.
entries.translation: 等他们从昏迷中醒来，我们就能知道发生了什么，但我已有怀疑。
entries.sampleRaw: Once they wake up from their coma we will know what happened to them, but I have my suspicions.

entries.source: The guards and I will bring him back to the city, please explain the situation to the Dean.
entries.translation: 我和卫兵会把他带回城里，请向Dean说明情况。
entries.sampleRaw: The guards and I will bring him back to the city, please explain the situation to the Dean.

entries.source: <player>! Perfect timing
Our entire stash of Sulphur got stolen. I have no idea how "they" did it.
entries.translation: 我们全部的硫磺储备都被偷了。我完全不知道“他们”是怎么做到的。
entries.sampleRaw: §fOur entire stash of Sulphur got stolen. I have no idea how "they" did it.

entries.source: The Queen is warning me against hasty conclusions, but enough is enough.
entries.translation: 女王警告我不要草率下结论，但我已经忍无可忍了。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThe Queen is warning me against hasty conclusions, but enough is enough.

entries.source: We cannot let the Barbarians trespass our borders without retaliation.
entries.translation: 我们不能让野蛮人侵犯我们的边境而不予反击。
entries.sampleRaw: §fWe cannot let the Barbarians trespass our borders without retaliation.

entries.source: My scouts told me they sighted Barbarian activities in the North, near the Forgotten Skull.
entries.translation: 我的斥候告诉我，他们在北方、遗忘之颅附近发现了野蛮人的活动。
entries.sampleRaw: §fMy scouts told me they sighted Barbarian activities in the §cNorth, near the Forgotten Skull§f.

entries.source: Let's meet again there, and be prepared for combat.
entries.translation: 我们在那里再会合，做好战斗准备。
entries.sampleRaw: §fLet's meet again there, and be prepared for combat.

entries.source: The Forgotten Skull in the North is close to the Barbarian borders, they are probably hiding the stolen Sulphur there.
entries.translation: 北方的遗忘之颅靠近野蛮人的边境，他们很可能把偷来的硫磺藏在那里。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThe Forgotten Skull in the North is close to the Barbarian borders, they are probably hiding the stolen Sulphur there.

entries.source: Some matters cannot be solved peacefully.
entries.translation: 有些事情无法和平解决。

entries.source: ✆ Thank you for helping with the tentacle monster.
entries.translation: ✆ 感谢你帮忙对付那只触手怪物。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fThank you for helping with the tentacle monster.

entries.source: ✆ We owe the Piglins an apology.
✆ I will stay in Scarleton and prepare for the next battle!
entries.translation: ✆ 我会留在斯卡雷顿，为下一场战斗做好准备！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fI will stay in Scarleton and prepare for the next battle!

entries.source: I use the top bed, because I'm the strongest.
entries.sampleRaw: §fI use the top bed, because I'm the strongest.

entries.source: When I'm older, I'll travel the world.
entries.translation: 等我长大了，我要环游世界。
entries.sampleRaw: §fWhen I'm older, I'll travel the world.

entries.source: I was born last.
Sulphurcare is our proposal - no taxes on Sulphur!
entries.translation: 我们的主张是硫磺关怀——硫磺免税！
entries.sampleRaw: Sulphurcare is our proposal - no taxes on Sulphur!

entries.source: Any Piglin should have access to their share of the stash.
entries.translation: 任何猪灵都应该能分到属于自己的那份储备。
entries.sampleRaw: Any Piglin should have access to their share of the stash.

entries.source: I'm pooped! Full days of protesting will do that to ya.
entries.translation: 我累坏了！整天抗议就会这样。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm pooped! Full days of protesting will do that to ya.

entries.source: Time for bed!
Up and at 'em! Let's do this!
entries.sampleRaw: Up and at 'em! Let's do this!

entries.source: Follow the movement! Sulphur for all!
entries.translation: 跟随这场运动！硫磺属于所有人！
entries.sampleRaw: Follow the movement! Sulphur for all!

entries.source: Make yourself at home!
Sharing is caring!
Protesting sure takes a lot out of you. I need to rest!
entries.translation: 抗议确实很消耗精力。我需要休息！
entries.sampleRaw: Protesting sure takes a lot out of you. I need to rest!

entries.source: Help spread our message! Sulphur for all!
entries.translation: 帮忙传播我们的主张！硫磺属于所有人！
entries.sampleRaw: Help spread our message! Sulphur for all!

entries.source: There is plenty Sulphur for everyone.
entries.translation: 硫磺多得是，每个人都有份。
entries.sampleRaw: There is plenty Sulphur for everyone.

entries.source: I can barely buy enough for my kids.
entries.translation: 我几乎买不起足够的东西给孩子们。
entries.sampleRaw: I can barely buy enough for my kids.

entries.source: I'm pooped! Full days of protesting will do that to ya.
entries.translation: 我累坏了！整天抗议就会这样。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm pooped! Full days of protesting will do that to ya.

entries.source: Up and at 'em! Let's do this!
entries.sampleRaw: Up and at 'em! Let's do this!

entries.source: It takes all of us to enact change!
entries.translation: 要促成改变，需要我们所有人！
entries.sampleRaw: It takes all of us to enact change!

entries.source: Feel free to look around!
It's not much, but Keran and I love it here!
entries.translation: 虽然不算什么，但 Keran 和我很喜欢这里！
entries.sampleRaw: It's not much, but Keran and I love it here!

entries.source: Back to the old grind tomorrow! For now...time to rest!
entries.translation: 明天又要继续老一套的苦干了！现在……该休息了！
entries.sampleRaw: Back to the old grind tomorrow! For now...time to rest!

entries.source: Hey, this is a restricted area. Leave now!
entries.translation: 嘿，这里是限制区域。马上离开！
entries.sampleRaw: Hey, this is a restricted area. Leave now!

entries.source: Welcome, [player] to the Regalia Room.
In this room, Shen is selling three items for you.
entries.translation: 在这个房间里，Shen 正在为你出售三件物品。
entries.sampleRaw: In this room, Shen is selling three items for you.

entries.source: These items can be purchased at any time...
entries.translation: 这些物品可以随时购买……
entries.sampleRaw: These items can be purchased at any time...

entries.source: But be careful as you can only purchase so many in a day!
entries.translation: 但要小心，你一天只能购买这么多！
entries.sampleRaw: But be careful as you can only purchase so many in a day!

entries.source: Also, be mindful that not all items will stick around forever.
entries.translation: 另外请注意，并非所有物品都会永远保留。
entries.sampleRaw: Also, be mindful that not all items will stick around forever.

entries.source: Anyways, get to buying!
Did you know that Shen is auctioning one more special edition item this year?
entries.translation: 你知道Shen今年还会再拍卖一件特别版物品吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Did you know that Shen is auctioning one more special edition item this year?
