entries.source: Go talk to Damia, she'll show you it.
entries.translation: 去找Damia谈谈，她会给你看的。
entries.sampleRaw: Go talk to Damia, she'll show you it.

entries.source: How did you manage to get in here???
entries.sampleRaw: How did you manage to get in here???

entries.source: Keep the trapdoors closed!
Magma Cube pets are forbidden in Dragontail!
entries.translation: 龙尾镇禁止携带岩浆怪宠物！

entries.source: Please don't tell anyone!!!
He's so cute when he sleeps. Or she? I don't even know.
entries.translation: 他睡觉的时候真可爱。还是她？我都不知道。
entries.sampleRaw: §fHe's so cute when he sleeps. Or she? I don't even know.

entries.source: I don't know what I would do without Maggie.
entries.translation: 没有Maggie，我不知道自己该怎么办。
entries.sampleRaw: §fI don't know what I would do without §cMaggie§f.

entries.source: Maggie was so tiny when I got them, they grow up so fast.
entries.translation: Maggie刚到我身边时那么小，他们长得真快。
entries.sampleRaw: §cMaggie §fwas so tiny when I got them, they grow up so fast.

entries.source: If anything happened to Maggie I would go nuts.
entries.translation: 如果Maggie出了什么事，我会发疯的。
entries.sampleRaw: §fIf anything happened to §cMaggie §fI would go nuts.

entries.source: I don't know where Maggie went! I'm freaking out!
entries.translation: 我不知道Maggie去哪了！我快急疯了！
entries.sampleRaw: §fI don't know where §cMaggie §fwent! I'm freaking out!

entries.source: Someone came and took Maggie away from me!
entries.translation: 有人来把Maggie从我身边带走了！

entries.source: I would have stopped it, but I don't move very well.
entries.translation: 我本来会阻止的，但我行动不太方便。
entries.sampleRaw: §fI would have stopped it, but I don't move very well.

entries.source: People always seem to take Maggie away from me, but they always come back!
entries.translation: 人们似乎总是把Maggie从我身边带走，但他们总会回来的！
entries.sampleRaw: §fPeople always seem to take §cMaggie §faway from me, but they always come back!

entries.source: Maggie.
I...feel...alive.
I...am...free.
Refined.
There is an absence of prosperity within you.
entries.sampleRaw: There is an absence of §dprosperity §fwithin you.

entries.source: Enchant. Combine. Reforge. Upgrade.
The Hex is only bound by what the human can understand.
entries.translation: 六芒星只受限于人类所能理解的事物。
entries.sampleRaw: §dThe Hex§f is only bound by what the human can understand.

entries.source: The Hex will go so far as to communicate with the Bazaar for you.
entries.translation: 六芒星甚至会替你与集市沟通。
entries.sampleRaw: §dThe Hex§f will go so far as to communicate with the §6Bazaar §ffor you.

entries.source: The Hex knows of inventory, of Storage, of Ender Chest.
entries.translation: 六芒星知晓物品栏、存储和末影箱。
entries.sampleRaw: §dThe Hex§f knows of §ainventory§f, of §aStorage§f, of §5Ender Chest§f.

entries.source: To upgrade the item, The Hex will take from wherever it must.
entries.translation: 为了升级物品，六芒星会从任何必要之处取用。
entries.sampleRaw: To upgrade the item, §dThe Hex §fwill take from wherever it must.

entries.source: The Hex has given me everything.
It is all one could ever need.
entries.translation: 这就是一个人所能需要的一切。
entries.sampleRaw: It is §dall§f one could ever need.

entries.source: The Hex will be so kind as to upgrade the items in any way imaginable.
entries.translation: 六芒星会非常乐意以任何能想到的方式升级物品。
entries.sampleRaw: §dThe Hex§f will be so kind as to upgrade the items in any way imaginable.

entries.source: Stand back, I'm tinkering with a new necklace.
entries.translation: 退后点，我正在摆弄一条新项链。
entries.sampleRaw: Stand back, I'm tinkering with a new §dnecklace§f.

entries.source: Looks like there isn't enough Magic left in this universe to complete my project.
entries.translation: 看来这个宇宙里剩下的魔力不足以完成我的项目了.
entries.sampleRaw: §rLooks like there isn't enough §5Magic §fleft in this universe to complete my project.

entries.source: I'll have to talk to Barry...
It's very complicated! Only great enchanteresses may understand.
entries.translation: 这非常复杂！只有伟大的女附魔师才能理解。
entries.sampleRaw: It's very complicated! Only great §3enchanteresses§f may understand.

entries.source: Go away, I'm extremely busy.
I can't focus when blockheads keep interrupting me!
entries.translation: 笨蛋们一直打断我，我根本没法集中精神！
entries.sampleRaw: I can't focus when §9blockheads §fkeep interrupting me!

entries.source: Look buddy, I don't know who you think you are, but back off okay?
entries.translation: 听着，伙计，我不知道你自认为是谁，但退后点行吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Look buddy, I don't know who you think you are, but back off okay?

entries.source: You're annoying me!
What? What is that even supposed to mean?
entries.translation: 什么？那到底是什么意思？
entries.sampleRaw: What? What is that even supposed to mean?

entries.source: Wait, do you have some?
Then go away!
Wooooaaah.
If you know this keyword, it means there's a me out there who figured out how to power the necklace.
entries.translation: 如果你知道这个关键词，那就说明在某个地方有一个我，已经弄明白了如何为项链供能。
entries.sampleRaw: If you know this keyword, it means there's a §ome §fout there who figured out how to §5power §fthe §dnecklace§f.

entries.source: But since I never stepped into the portal...
entries.translation: 但既然我从未踏入过传送门……
entries.sampleRaw: But since I never stepped into the §dportal§f...

entries.source: It means that other me must be a future version of my past self, before Barry opened the portal.
entries.translation: 这意味着那个我一定是过去的我在Barry打开传送门之前的未来版本。
entries.sampleRaw: It means that §oother me §fmust be a future version of my past self, before §9Barry §fopened the §dportal§f.

entries.source: I do NOT understand the multi-dimensional journey I must have taken to reach this point...
entries.translation: 我完全不理解我究竟经历了怎样的多维旅程才走到这一步……
entries.sampleRaw: I do §cNOT §funderstand the multi-dimensional journey I must have taken to reach this point...

entries.source: * snaps back to reality *
Yes.
I need some time to figure out how to empower the necklace...
entries.translation: 我需要一些时间来弄清楚如何为项链注入力量……
entries.sampleRaw: I need some time to figure out how to empower the §dnecklace§r...

entries.source: You breathing down my neck does NOT help.
entries.translation: 你在我旁边盯着我，一点忙都帮不上。
entries.sampleRaw: You breathing down my neck does §cNOT §fhelp.

entries.source: Sure I haven't personally figured out the necklace...
entries.translation: 当然,我本人还没弄明白这条项链……

entries.source: ... but it's close enough to get credit for it!
entries.translation: ……但这已经足够接近，可以算作我的功劳了！
entries.sampleRaw: ... but it's close enough to get credit for it!

entries.source: Plus, I actually need to finish it to avoid a paradox!
entries.translation: 而且，我实际上必须完成它，才能避免悖论！
entries.sampleRaw: Plus, I actually need to finish it to avoid a paradox!

entries.source: I'm ready to do whatever is needed to finish this work.
entries.translation: 我准备好做任何需要做的事来完成这项工作。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm ready to do whatever is needed to finish this work.

entries.source: People are remembered by their greatest work, so everything else doesn't matter.
entries.translation: 人们会因最伟大的作品而被铭记，所以其他一切都不重要。
entries.sampleRaw: People are remembered by their greatest work, so everything else doesn't matter.

entries.source: Sorry, I'm busy tinkering.
entries.translation: 抱歉，我正忙着捣鼓东西。

entries.source: Welcome to Shen's Auction!
Down here we strive to provide you with the best value--
entries.translation: 在下面这里，我们努力为您提供最超值的——
entries.sampleRaw: Down here we strive to provide you with the best value--

entries.source: Oh don't you worry about that!
entries.sampleRaw: Oh don't you worry about that!

entries.source: I'm sure you will meet him one day!
entries.translation: 我相信你总有一天会见到他的！
entries.sampleRaw: I'm sure you will meet him one day!

entries.source: (boy he is quite a character...)
Anyway, do you want to see some of the special auctions we have in store?
entries.translation: 总之，你想看看我们店里的一些特别拍卖吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Anyway, do you want to see some of the §bspecial auctions§f we have in store?

entries.source: Alright! Well, all around us in this room are the best auctions from the Auction House upstairs!
entries.translation: 好！嗯，我们这间屋子里四周摆放的都是楼上拍卖行里最好的拍卖品！
entries.sampleRaw: Alright! Well, all around us in this room are the §ebest auctions §ffrom the §6Auction House §fupstairs!

entries.source: I'm glad you asked! There are three special displays at the head of the room.
entries.translation: 很高兴你问了！房间最前方有三个特别展示台。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm glad you asked! There are §bthree special displays §fat the head of the room.

entries.source: Shen is holding 3 special auctions each SkyBlock year...
entries.translation: Shen每个 SkyBlock 年都会举办 3 场特别拍卖……
entries.numericSource: Shen is holding {{N0}} special auctions each SkyBlock year...
entries.numericTranslation: Shen每个 SkyBlock 年都会举办 {{N0}} 场特别拍卖……

entries.source: And you can access them through those displays!
entries.translation: 你可以通过那些展示台进入拍卖！
entries.sampleRaw: And you can access them through those displays!

entries.source: Careful though, only the richest of the rich may be able to obtain those items!
entries.translation: 不过要小心，只有最富有的人才能获得那些物品！
entries.sampleRaw: Careful though, only the §erichest of the rich §fmay be able to obtain those items!

entries.source: Ah yes! There is one more thing!
entries.sampleRaw: Ah yes! There is one more thing!

entries.source: Shen is auctioning off one more special item every SkyBlock year.
entries.translation: Shen每个 SkyBlock 年还会拍卖一件特别物品。
entries.sampleRaw: §6Shen§f is auctioning off one more special item every SkyBlock year.

entries.source: These are special edition items that rotate every year!
entries.translation: 这些是每年轮换的特别版物品！
entries.sampleRaw: These are special edition items that rotate every year!

entries.source: Anyway! That's about everything I know.
entries.translation: 总之！我知道的差不多就这些了。
entries.sampleRaw: Anyway! That's about everything I know.

entries.source: If you have any more questions, feel free to talk to me again!
entries.translation: 如果你还有任何问题，随时再来找我！
entries.sampleRaw: If you have any more questions, feel free to talk to me again!

entries.source: Well, there are three special displays behind you...
entries.translation: 嗯，你身后有三个特别展示台……
entries.sampleRaw: Well, there are §bthree special displays §fbehind you...

entries.source: But... you don't seem to be popular enough to Shen to access them...
entries.translation: 但是……你似乎还不够受欢迎，无法让Shen允许你访问它们……
entries.sampleRaw: But... you §cdon't§f seem to be popular enough to §6Shen§f to access them...

entries.source: But don't worry! I'm sure you could catch up in no time!
entries.translation: 但别担心！我相信你很快就能赶上！
entries.sampleRaw: But don't worry! I'm sure you could catch up in no time!

entries.source: Nope! Nothing... Nothing at all!
entries.translation: 没有！什么都没有……什么都没有！

entries.source: Ok fine! There is ONE more thing... but you aren't popular enough yet to Shen!
entries.translation: 好吧！还有一件事……但你还不够受欢迎，无法让Shen允许你参与！
entries.sampleRaw: Ok fine! There is ONE more thing... but you aren't popular enough yet to §6Shen§f!

entries.source: Go and unlock Museum Milestone 10 and talk to me again!
entries.translation: 去解锁博物馆里程碑 10,然后再来找我!
entries.sampleRaw: Go and unlock §6Museum Milestone 10 §fand talk to me again!
entries.numericSource: Go and unlock Museum Milestone {{N0}} and talk to me again!
entries.numericTranslation: 去解锁博物馆里程碑 {{N0}},然后再来找我!

entries.source: I told you that you aren't popular enough yet to Shen to participate in his auctions!
entries.translation: 我告诉过你，你还不够受欢迎，无法让Shen允许你参与他的拍卖！
entries.sampleRaw: I told you that you aren't popular enough yet to §6Shen§f to participate in his auctions!

entries.source: I said don't worry about that!
entries.sampleRaw: I said don't worry about that!

entries.source: I have told you time and time again you aren't popular enough for Shen yet!
entries.translation: 我已经一次又一次地告诉过你，你还不够受欢迎，无法让Shen允许你参与！
entries.sampleRaw: I have told you time and time again you aren't popular enough for Shen yet!

entries.source: Yet you still try to get through!
entries.sampleRaw: Yet you still try to get through!

entries.source: You must not be very fond of rules are you?
entries.translation: 你一定不太喜欢遵守规则，对吧？
entries.sampleRaw: You must not be very fond of rules are you?

entries.source: Anyway, unlock Museum Milestone 20 and I MIGHT let you see that!
entries.translation: 总之，解锁博物馆里程碑 20，我或许会让你看看那个！
entries.sampleRaw: Anyway, unlock Museum Milestone 20 and I MIGHT let you see that!
entries.numericSource: Anyway, unlock Museum Milestone {{N0}} and I MIGHT let you see that!
entries.numericTranslation: 总之，解锁博物馆里程碑 {{N0}}，我或许会让你看看那个！

entries.source: You don't need to take part in Shen's Auction to complete the Bingo.
entries.translation: 你不需要参与沈的拍卖行就能完成宾果。
entries.sampleRaw: You don't need to take part in §6Shen's Auction §fto complete the Bingo.

entries.source: I grow my own Nether Warts!
entries.sampleRaw: I grow my own Nether Warts!

entries.source: That way I can save a lot of money on food!
entries.translation: 这样我就能在食物上省下很多钱！
entries.sampleRaw: That way I can save a lot of money on food!

entries.source: I like watching Nether Warts grow. If you look closely you can see it grow, I think.
entries.translation: 我喜欢看着下界疣生长。我觉得，如果你仔细看，就能看到它在长。
entries.sampleRaw: I like watching Nether Warts grow. If you look closely you can see it grow, I think.

entries.source: The house on the other side is also mine, that's what saving money does.
entries.translation: 对面的那栋房子也是我的，省钱就是这么回事。
entries.sampleRaw: The house on the other side is also mine, that's what saving money does.

entries.source: Thank you!
Elise really wanted this but she is shy.
entries.translation: Elise真的很想要这个，但她很害羞。
entries.sampleRaw: §dElise§f really wanted this but she is shy.

entries.source: I'm selecting books for her.
Anything to do with the Calamity or the Riftway at the top of the mountain.
entries.translation: 任何与灾厄或山顶裂隙通道有关的东西。
entries.sampleRaw: Anything to do with the §4Calamity §for the §dRiftway§f at the top of the mountain.

entries.source: Did you even agree to do this?
entries.translation: 你到底答应过要做这件事吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Did you even agree to do this?

entries.source: Thanks for helping out, and good luck!
entries.translation: 感谢你的帮忙，祝你好运！
entries.sampleRaw: Thanks for helping out, and good luck!

entries.source: You actually did it, I can't thank you enough!
entries.translation: 你真的做到了，我感激不尽！
entries.sampleRaw: You actually did it, I can't thank you enough!

entries.source: Let's show it to my father.
entries.translation: 我们把它拿给我父亲看看吧。
entries.sampleRaw: Let's show it to my father.

entries.source: Oh and hum...
Please don't mention that I didn't get it myself.
entries.translation: 请别提这不是我自己弄到的。
entries.sampleRaw: Please don't mention that I didn't get it myself.

entries.source: Ugh
I completely forgot about my Training.
entries.sampleRaw: I completely forgot about my Training.

entries.source: I have to go to the Town Board.
entries.sampleRaw: I have to go to the Town Board.

entries.source: I'm right here, don't get lost.
entries.sampleRaw: I'm right here, don't get lost.

entries.source: Hey are you following?
What's taking so long?
Did you get lost?
Are you a snail?
Hello
Get a move on.
This is our Town Board.
Whenever someone needs something they put a request here and anyone can fulfill it.
entries.translation: 每当有人需要什么东西，他们就会在这里留下请求，任何人都可以完成它。
entries.sampleRaw: Whenever someone needs something they put a request here and anyone can fulfill it.

entries.source: Not enough people are doing them so I usually have to do most requests myself.
entries.translation: 做这些的人不够多，所以我通常得自己完成大部分请求。
entries.sampleRaw: Not enough people are doing them so I usually have to do most requests myself.

entries.source: There are also Dojo requests, those are my training sessions...
entries.translation: 还有道场请求，那些是我的训练课程……
entries.sampleRaw: There are also §cDojo§f requests, those are my training sessions...

entries.source: I don't think I can do my training with my bad leg.
entries.translation: 我觉得我这条伤腿没法完成训练了。
entries.sampleRaw: I don't think I can do my training with my bad leg.

entries.source: Master Tao has terrible sight, maybe you could go to the Dojo and pretend to be me?
entries.translation: Master Tao的视力很差，也许你可以去道场假装成我？
entries.sampleRaw: §cMaster Tao§f has terrible sight, maybe you could go to the §cDojo§f and pretend to be me?

entries.source: I'll wait for you here.
The Dojo is on the opposite side of the island, south of Scarleton, the Mage city.
entries.translation: 道场在岛的另一边，位于法师之城斯卡雷顿的南边。
entries.sampleRaw: The §cDojo§f is on the opposite side of the island, south of §5Scarleton§f, the Mage city.

entries.source: How was the training? Not too bad?
entries.translation: 训练怎么样？还不算太糟吧？
entries.sampleRaw: How was the training? Not too bad?

entries.source: I'm sorry you had to go through this.
entries.sampleRaw: I'm sorry you had to go through this.

entries.source: My father wants me to become the next Chief one day.
entries.translation: 我父亲希望我有一天能成为下一任首领。
entries.sampleRaw: My father wants me to become the next Chief one day.

entries.source: I don't really have a choice.
entries.translation: 我其实没有选择的余地。
entries.sampleRaw: I don't really have a choice.

entries.source: The Town Board missions get harder the higher your Reputation gets.
entries.translation: 你的声望越高,城镇公告板的任务就越难.
entries.sampleRaw: The §cTown Board §fmissions get harder the higher your Reputation gets.

entries.source: If that's fine with you, I'll give you a couple of my missions, but they are quite tough.
entries.translation: 如果你不介意的话，我可以把我的几个任务交给你，不过它们相当难。
entries.sampleRaw: If that's fine with you, I'll give you a couple of my missions, but they are quite tough.

entries.source: The first one requires eliminating a Mage Outlaw.
entries.translation: 第一个任务需要消灭一名法师逃犯。
entries.sampleRaw: The first one requires eliminating a §cMage Outlaw§f.

entries.source: They are technically Mages, but not part of the Mage Faction, they constantly cause problems.
entries.translation: 他们严格来说也是法师，但不属于法师阵营，总是不断制造麻烦。
entries.sampleRaw: They are technically Mages, but not part of the Mage Faction, they constantly cause problems.

entries.source: Mage Outlaws often attack Piglins, the Wizards don't really want to deal with them so we have to do it ourself.
entries.translation: 法师逃犯经常袭击猪灵，巫师们不太想处理他们，所以我们只能自己动手。
entries.sampleRaw: Mage Outlaws often attack Piglins, the Wizards don't really want to deal with them so we have to do it ourself.

entries.source: The Courtyard is a bit hidden, it is north-west of Scarleton, just outside of the city.
entries.translation: 庭院有点隐蔽，它在斯卡雷顿的西北方向，就在城外。
entries.sampleRaw: The Courtyard is a bit hidden, it is north-west of §5Scarleton§f, just outside of the city.

entries.source: You dealt with it? Great!
You are quite competent, those Mages are usually quite strong, they also think very highly of themselves.
entries.translation: 你相当能干，那些法师通常都很强，而且他们还非常自视甚高。
entries.sampleRaw: You are quite competent, those Mages are usually quite strong, they also think very highly of themselves.

entries.source: The next mission is to kill the Magma Boss.
entries.translation: 下一个任务是击杀岩浆首领。
entries.sampleRaw: The next mission is to kill the §cMagma Boss§f.

entries.source: He's an overgrown Magma Cube that keeps on growing infinitely.
entries.translation: 他是一只不断无限生长的巨型岩浆怪。
entries.sampleRaw: He's an overgrown Magma Cube that keeps on growing infinitely.

entries.source: We have to defeat him every few weeks to keep it in check, otherwise it can grow out of control.
entries.translation: 我们每隔几周就得击败他一次来控制他，否则他会失控生长。
entries.sampleRaw: We have to defeat him every few weeks to keep it in check, otherwise it can grow out of control.

entries.source: It's very easy to find the Magma Boss, simply take any of the tunnels below the Volcano and descend until you reach the center.
entries.translation: 找到岩浆首领非常容易，只要走火山下方的任意一条隧道，一直往下走到中心就行。

styleMappings.tunnels below the Volcano: 火山下方的任意一条隧道

entries.sampleRaw: It's very easy to find the §cMagma Boss§f, simply take any of the §7tunnels below the Volcano §fand descend until you reach the center.

entries.source: Don't feel too bad about killing those Magma Cubes, they will be born again.
entries.translation: 别为杀死那些岩浆怪太难过，它们会重生的。
entries.sampleRaw: Don't feel too bad about killing those Magma Cubes, they will be born again.

entries.source: Once you find the large room below the Volcano, you'll be able to see it.
entries.translation: 一旦你找到火山下方的大房间，就能看到他了。
entries.sampleRaw: Once you find the large room below the Volcano, you'll be able to see it.

entries.source: I am glad you are back.
entries.sampleRaw: I am glad you are back.

entries.source: You completed all my missions, I am very grateful.
entries.translation: 你完成了我所有的任务，我非常感激。
entries.sampleRaw: You completed all my missions, I am very grateful.

entries.source: Now if you will excuse me, it's time for me to take care of my leg.
entries.translation: 现在请恕我失陪，我该去处理我的腿了。
entries.sampleRaw: Now if you will excuse me, it's time for me to take care of my leg.

entries.source: See you around <player>.
Time to focus on myself.
entries.translation: 该把注意力放在自己身上了。

entries.source: What...? Where...? Why...?
<player>, you there! Where am I?
What is... 'The Hub Island'?
I seem to be very lost...
entries.sampleRaw: I seem to be very lost...

entries.source: Can you help me find my way home?
entries.translation: 你能帮我找到回家的路吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Can you help me find my way home?

entries.source: I can feel my home so close, it's here... and yet... it's not.
entries.translation: 我能感觉到家就在附近，就在这里……可是……又不在。
entries.sampleRaw: I can feel my home so close, it's here... and yet... it's not.

entries.source: It feels like yesterday, but perhaps... it has been longer.
entries.translation: 感觉就像昨天一样，但也许……已经过去更久了。
entries.sampleRaw: It feels like yesterday, but perhaps... it has been longer.

entries.source: You seem smart... where should I go to find my home?
entries.translation: 你看起来很聪明……我该去哪里才能找到我的家？
entries.sampleRaw: You seem smart... where should I go to find my home?

entries.source: As smart as you seem, you are not enough of a skilled warrior.
entries.translation: 你看起来虽然聪明，但还算不上足够熟练的战士。
entries.sampleRaw: As smart as you seem, you are not enough of a skilled warrior.

entries.source: I need you to help me find my home, however dangerous it may be.
entries.translation: 我需要你帮我找到我的家，无论那有多危险。
entries.sampleRaw: I need you to help me find my home, however dangerous it may be.

entries.source: Reach Combat Level XII and come help me again!
entries.translation: 达到战斗等级 XII 后再来帮我！
entries.sampleRaw: Reach Combat Level XII and come help me again!

entries.source: Please tell me where I can go to find my home!
entries.translation: 请告诉我该去哪里才能找到我的家！
entries.sampleRaw: Please tell me where I can go to find my home!

entries.source: So if you keep bugging me you think I'll tell you everything?
entries.translation: 所以你觉得只要一直缠着我，我就会把一切都告诉你？
entries.sampleRaw: So if you keep bugging me you think I'll tell you everything?

entries.source: Well it's working...
You might be getting close to knowing the truth!
entries.translation: 你也许快要接近真相了！
entries.sampleRaw: You might be getting close to knowing the truth!

entries.source: I would like to start growing stronger by killing some of those spiders.
entries.translation: 我想通过杀掉那些蜘蛛来开始变强。
entries.sampleRaw: I would like to start growing stronger by killing some of those spiders.

entries.source: But I've always hated flying through the air.
entries.translation: 但我一直讨厌在空中飞。
entries.sampleRaw: But I've always hated flying through the air.

entries.source: I've heard stepping on those launch pads will send me flying.
entries.translation: 我听说踩上那些发射台就会把我弹飞。
entries.sampleRaw: I've heard stepping on those launch pads will send me flying.

entries.source: It sends shivers down my spine.
entries.sampleRaw: It sends shivers down my spine.

entries.source: I think I am just going to have to learn a different way over there.
entries.translation: 我想我只能学着用另一种方式去那边了。
entries.sampleRaw: I think I am just going to have to learn a different way over there.

entries.source: Have you heard of anything I can use?
entries.translation: 你听说过有什么我能用的东西吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Have you heard of anything I can use?

entries.source: So listen.
The other day I was chumming with my chums.
entries.translation: 前几天我在和伙计们一起撒鱼饵。
entries.sampleRaw: The other day I was chumming with my chums.

entries.source: One of them yaps and I say, "ever tried my tonic"?
entries.translation: 其中一个家伙唠叨起来，我就说：“试过我的药水吗？”
entries.sampleRaw: One of them yaps and I say, "ever tried my tonic"?

entries.source: So yeah, I come back to my crib, right?
entries.translation: 所以呢，我回到我的窝了，对吧？
entries.sampleRaw: So yeah, I come back to my crib, right?

entries.source: And listen, I've never seen anybody down here, but you seem like a nice fellow.
entries.translation: 听我说，我从没在这下面见过任何人，但你看起来是个不错的家伙。
entries.sampleRaw: And listen, I've never seen anybody down here, but you seem like a nice fellow.

entries.source: So just bring me 8 Glowing Mushrooms and I'll show you how to chum, alright buddy?
entries.translation: 所以只要给我带来 8 个发光蘑菇，我就教你怎么撒诱鱼料，好吗伙计？
entries.sampleRaw: So just bring me §a8 Glowing Mushrooms§f and I'll show you how to chum, alright buddy?
entries.numericSource: So just bring me {{N0}} Glowing Mushrooms and I'll show you how to chum, alright buddy?
entries.numericTranslation: 所以只要给我带来 {{N0}} 个发光蘑菇，我就教你怎么撒诱鱼料，好吗伙计？

entries.source: Ok listen now, I practice a secret chumming technique.
entries.translation: 好，现在听好了，我掌握着一门秘密的撒鱼饵技巧。
entries.sampleRaw: Ok listen now, I practice a secret chumming technique.

entries.source: It's reverse-chumming!
Instead of chumming, it's the sea creatures giving you Chums.
entries.translation: 不是你在撒饵，而是海怪把鱼饵送给你。
entries.sampleRaw: Instead of chumming, it's the sea creatures giving you §aChums§f.

entries.source: Listen, it's very easy.
First we trade a Chum Bucket, ok?
entries.translation: 首先我们交易一个诱鱼料桶，好吗？
entries.sampleRaw: First we trade a Chum Bucket, ok?

entries.source: Just click me!
First you place down the bucket near water, right?
entries.translation: 首先你把桶放在水边，对吧？
entries.sampleRaw: First you place down the bucket near water, right?

entries.source: Then use a fishing rod and throw a line in said water.
entries.translation: 然后用钓鱼竿把鱼线抛进那片水里。
entries.sampleRaw: Then use a fishing rod and throw a line in said water.

entries.source: Ok and you wait now. That part is easier with YOUR chums.
entries.translation: 好，现在你就等着。有你的伙伴帮忙，这部分会更容易。
entries.sampleRaw: Ok and you wait now. That part is easier with YOUR chums.

entries.source: Listen, time is shorter with friends.
entries.translation: 听着，有朋友陪着，时间会过得更快。
entries.sampleRaw: Listen, time is shorter with friends.

entries.source: After waiting you kill a sea creature and get a Chum.
entries.translation: 等完之后，你杀死一只海怪，就能得到一个诱鱼料。
entries.sampleRaw: After waiting you kill a sea creature and get a §aChum§f.

entries.source: You put it in the bucket and someday it's filled.
entries.translation: 你把它放进桶里，总有一天桶会装满。
entries.sampleRaw: You put it in the bucket and someday it's filled.

entries.source: Then listen you bring me the filled bucket, ok?
entries.translation: 然后听着，你把装满的桶带给我，好吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Then listen you bring me the filled bucket, ok?

entries.source: Wow ok listen that's good.
You are the chumming expert ok?
entries.translation: 你就是撒饵专家了，好吗？
entries.sampleRaw: You are the chumming expert ok?

entries.source: Listen. I also have some good items for your chumming.
entries.translation: 听着。我还有一些适合你撒饵的好东西。
entries.sampleRaw: Listen. I also have some good items for your chumming.

entries.source: And I have this really good tonic. It's a really good tonic, ok?
entries.translation: 我还有这种非常好的补剂。这是非常好的补剂，好吗？
entries.sampleRaw: And I have this really good tonic. It's a really good tonic, ok?

entries.source: So get mushrooms, fill chum buckets, trade tonics! Easy chums!
entries.translation: 所以去采蘑菇、装满诱鱼料桶、交易补剂吧！轻松搞定，伙伴！
entries.sampleRaw: So get mushrooms, fill chum buckets, trade tonics! Easy chums!

entries.source: Come back with the right amount of items!
entries.translation: 带上数量正确的物品回来！
entries.sampleRaw: Come back with the right amount of items!

entries.source: Listen. Glowing Mushrooms don't seem to be too good for my health. About time I tried something else. You got anything, chum?
entries.translation: 听着。发光蘑菇似乎对我的健康不太好。是时候试试别的了。你有什么好东西吗，伙伴？
entries.sampleRaw: Listen. Glowing Mushrooms don't seem to be too good for my health. About time I tried something else. You got anything, chum?

entries.source: That's good.
You are no chum of mine.
entries.sampleRaw: You are no chum of mine.

entries.source: ✆ Hey chum. Long time no see.
✆ You want my Abiphone Contact?
entries.translation: ✆ 你想要我的 Abiphone 联系人吗？

entries.source: ✆ Ok, listen.
✆ I got all my chums in my phone, ok?
entries.translation: ✆ 我所有的伙伴都在我手机里，好吗？
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fI got all my chums in my phone, ok?

entries.source: ✆ And we're chums too, you and I.
entries.translation: ✆ 而且我们也是伙伴，你和我。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fAnd we're chums too, you and I.

entries.source: ✆ But I only got so many contact slots, you know?
entries.translation: ✆ 但我的联系人名额就那么多，你懂吧？
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fBut I only got so many contact slots, you know?

entries.source: ✆ And who am I to say which of my chums are the most important, you know?
entries.translation: ✆ 而且我哪能说我的哪个伙伴最重要呢，你懂吧？
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fAnd who am I to say which of my chums are the most important, you know?

entries.source: ✆ What kind of chum would that make me?
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fWhat kind of chum would that make me?

entries.source: ✆ So, if you want your digits in my phone, imma need you to get me something...
entries.translation: ✆ 所以，你要是想把号码存进我手机，就得给我弄点东西来……
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fSo, if you want your digits in my phone, imma need you to get me something...

entries.source: ✆ What do you think it is?
✆ Of course it's chum, chum!
✆ Bring me Full Chum Bucket x64 and I'll add you to my Abiphone!
entries.translation: ✆ 给我装满的鱼饵桶 x64，我就把你加入我的 Abiphone！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fBring me §aFull Chum Bucket §8x64 §fand I'll add you to my §3Abiphone§f!
entries.numericSource: ✆ Bring me Full Chum Bucket x{{N0}} and I'll add you to my Abiphone!
entries.numericTranslation: ✆ 给我装满的鱼饵桶 x{{N0}}，我就把你加入我的 Abiphone！

entries.source: ✆ Mates rates!
✆ Hey chum, that's not it.
✆ I asked for Full Chum Bucket x64.
entries.translation: ✆ 我要的是装满的鱼饵桶 x64。
entries.numericSource: ✆ I asked for Full Chum Bucket x{{N0}}.
entries.numericTranslation: ✆ 我要的是装满的鱼饵桶 x{{N0}}。

entries.source: ✆ Not whatever this is.
✆ Wow ok, that's good.
✆ This is the stuff. The good stuff.
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fThis is the stuff. The good stuff.

entries.source: ✆ Here's my contact!
✆ You ever need chumming supplies just give your chum Moby a call!
entries.translation: ✆ 你要是需要诱鱼料补给，随时给你兄弟 Moby 打电话！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fYou ever need chumming supplies just give your chum Moby a call!

entries.source: ✆ Hey chum!
hi
you have elegant taste in fashion
entries.sampleRaw: you have elegant taste in fashion

entries.source: u want to know a secret?
entries.sampleRaw: u want to know a secret?

entries.source: i can hold my breath under lava for 15 seconds!
entries.translation: 我能在熔岩下憋气 15 秒！
entries.sampleRaw: i can hold my breath under lava for 15 seconds!
entries.numericSource: i can hold my breath under lava for {{N0}} seconds!
entries.numericTranslation: 我能在熔岩下憋气 {{N0}} 秒！

entries.source: seems like u can too!
i heard a legend there was a big fish in these waters
entries.translation: 我听说有个传说，这片水域里有条大鱼
entries.sampleRaw: i heard a legend there was a big fish in these waters

entries.source: mayb u could fish it up?
entries.sampleRaw: mayb u could fish it up?

entries.source: try using dat bait u hav
entries.translation: 试试用你手上的那个鱼饵
entries.sampleRaw: try using dat bait u hav

entries.source: anyway... i have a train to catch
entries.sampleRaw: anyway... i have a train to catch

entries.source: im goin 2 da circus
u can join me if u like
entries.translation: 你要是愿意可以跟我一起来
entries.sampleRaw: u can join me if u like

entries.source: ✆ Err, are you sure?
✆ The signal doesn't work too well around here, but suit yourself.
entries.translation: ✆ 这附近信号不太好，不过随你便。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fThe signal doesn't work too well around here, but suit yourself.

entries.source: ✆ Could definitely use some help, if you are willing to trade.
entries.translation: ✆ 如果你愿意交易的话，我确实很需要一些帮助。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fCould definitely use some help, if you are willing to trade.

entries.source: ✆ The Forge doesn't charge users for its fuel, but we're using a mountain of it every day.
entries.translation: ✆ 锻造所不向使用者收取燃料费，但我们每天都要用掉堆积如山的燃料。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fThe Forge doesn't charge users for its fuel, but we're using a mountain of it every day.

entries.source: ✆ I'm a little ashamed to admit it, but we mostly use Foul Flesh nowadays.
entries.translation: ✆ 说来有点不好意思，但我们现在主要用的是污秽腐肉。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fI'm a little ashamed to admit it, but we mostly use §9Foul Flesh §fnowadays.

entries.source: ✆ We tried a bunch of things but that's been working the best so far.
entries.translation: ✆ 我们试过很多种办法，但到目前为止这个效果最好。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fWe tried a bunch of things but that's been working the best so far.

entries.source: ✆ For a stack of Foul Flesh, I'll give you my personal contact.
entries.translation: ✆ 给我一组污秽腐肉，我就把我的私人联系方式给你。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fFor a stack of §9Foul Flesh§f, I'll give you my personal contact.

entries.source: ✆ You don't have what I need! Nice try!
entries.translation: ✆ 你没有我需要的东西！想得美！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fYou don't have what I need! Nice try!

entries.source: ✆ Thanks, I appreciate it!
✆ Hey [player]! Your <item> is ready down here at the forge!
entries.translation: ✆ 嘿 [player]!你的 <item> 已经在下面的锻造所准备好了!
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fHey §7[player]§f! Your <item> is ready down here at the forge!

entries.source: ✆ I can't really hear you right now, the signal is really bad!
entries.translation: ✆ 我现在真听不清你说话，信号太差了！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fI can't really hear you right now, the signal is really bad!

entries.source: ✆ I'm not interested in extending my anvil warranty.
entries.translation: ✆ 我没兴趣延长我的铁砧保修期。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fI'm not interested in extending my anvil warranty.

entries.source: ✆ You're breaking up, I CAN'T HEAR YOU!
entries.translation: ✆ 你的声音断断续续的，我听不见你说话！

I want to see if you can kill at least 5 Enderman.

entries.translation: 开采它们会掉落很酷的战利品！

This will make for the perfect sacrifice.

I need to think. I need to think.

Head over to the desk, there you can browse SkyMart to order some fuel.

entries.source: Oh...Hi.
I like staying here with my spiders, but Arachne started capturing some of them.
entries.translation: 我喜欢和我的蜘蛛待在这里，但阿拉克涅开始抓走其中一些了。
entries.sampleRaw: I like staying here with my spiders, but §4Arachne§f started capturing some of them.

If you want, I can help you gain the strength of spiders!

entries.translation: ✆ 我不怪它们，下面看起来挺热闹的，但结果就是这里变得有点孤单了，你懂吧？
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fI don't blame them, it looks pretty exciting down there, but it's got kinda lonely up here as a result, you know?

entries.translation: ✆ 你知道吗？捕鸟蛛能长得非常大，甚至能捕食一些鸟类，甚至蜥蜴！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fDid you know? Tarantulas can get so big that they can prey on some birds, and even lizards!

entries.translation: ✆ 你知道吗？蜘蛛是蛛形纲动物，不是昆虫！

entries.translation: ✆ 你知道吗？大多数蜘蛛会把食物液化！这样它们就能吃掉比自己还大的东西！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fDid you know? Most spiders liquify their food! That's how they can eat stuff that's bigger than them!

Jacob's brother-in-law and Trevor's cousin!!
It's a small world!
With big farms!
All this farming is making me hungry!

-ing!

Hi friend!

Now I just need enough heat to melt it!

you don't have quite what it takes for the Prism!

entries.translation: 这里简直是个战场，大家都在抢冰！

entries.source: I think we got demoted for some reason...
entries.translation: 我觉得我们因为某些原因被降职了……

entries.source: There always seems to be gifts and other items in these walls!
entries.translation: 这些墙里似乎总有礼物和其他物品！

entries.source: The volcano really seems to bring out more treasure in these walls.

entries.source: Do you really have what it takes to fight Kuudra?
entries.translation: 你真的有实力对抗库德拉吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Do you really have what it takes to fight §cKuudra§f?

entries.source: Because if you don't... I have exactly what you need!
entries.translation: 因为如果你没有……我正好有你需要的东西！
entries.sampleRaw: Because if you don't... I have exactly what you need!

entries.source: I'm the Crimson Essence guy, but you can call me Vulcan.
entries.translation: 我是卖猩红精华的,不过你可以叫我Vulcan.
entries.sampleRaw: I'm the §dCrimson Essence§f guy, but you can call me §cVulcan§f.

entries.source: ✆ Nice to see you're still alive and kicking.
entries.translation: ✆ 很高兴看到你还活蹦乱跳的。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fNice to see you're still alive and kicking.

entries.source: ✆ Hm, my Abiphone Contact?
✆ I suppose I could do that.
✆ Come and see me after completing the INFERNAL tier of Kuudra for the first time, then we can talk.
entries.translation: ✆ 首次完成库德拉的INFERNAL难度后再来找我，到时候我们再谈。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fCome and see me after completing the §c§lINFERNAL §ftier of §cKuudra §ffor the first time, then we can talk.

entries.source: ✆ Looks like you've completed the INFERNAL tier of Kuudra, so I'll consider you worthy.
entries.translation: ✆ 看来你已经完成了库德拉的INFERNAL难度，那我就认为你够格了。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fLooks like you've completed the §c§lINFERNAL §ftier of §cKuudra§f, so I'll consider you worthy.

entries.source: ✆ Here's my contact.
Don't ask how I got this ok?
entries.translation: 别问我怎么弄到的，行吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Don't ask how I got this ok?

entries.source: Ugh fine. Here you go
*cough* woosh *cough*.
Froggers tip: use \/centauri
Pro tip: use \/centauri
Check out the Museum if you haven't already!
entries.translation: 如果你还没去过，去看看博物馆吧！
entries.sampleRaw: Check out the Museum if you haven't already!

entries.source: The Hub has that new car smell!
entries.translation: 中心岛有那种新车的味道！
entries.sampleRaw: The Hub has that new car smell!

entries.source: Things look a lot nicer from up here!
entries.translation: 从这里看，一切都好看多了！
entries.sampleRaw: Things look a lot nicer from up here!

entries.source: It's a fishing update!
MMMMMMMMM... (pro tip: use \/centauri)
Visit Vincent at his house to the left of the Colosseum when you are approaching it from the west to learn about new Dyes!
entries.translation: 从西侧靠近竞技场时，去竞技场左边Vincent的房子里拜访他，了解新的染料！
entries.sampleRaw: §rVisit Vincent at his house to the left of the Colosseum when you are approaching it from the west to learn about new Dyes!§r

entries.source: The Community Center has received a fresh coat of paint, many Mayors have received new perks, and Foxy is now hosting a Carnival!
entries.translation: 社区中心重新粉刷了一遍，许多市长获得了新能力，而且Foxy现在正在举办嘉年华！
entries.sampleRaw: §rThe Community Center has received a fresh coat of paint, many Mayors have received new perks, and Foxy is now hosting a Carnival!§r

entries.source: Play the Chocolate Factory!
Give yourself free Chocolate to help test late-game Chocolate Factory Features!
entries.translation: 给自己免费巧克力，帮助测试后期巧克力工厂功能！
entries.sampleRaw: Give yourself free Chocolate to help test late-game Chocolate Factory Features!

entries.source: Discover the God Mode!
Fight the Primal Dragon!
Go to The End, use the Awakened Summoning Eyes.
entries.translation: 前往末地，使用觉醒的召唤之眼。
entries.sampleRaw: Go to The End, use the Awakened Summoning Eyes.

entries.source: Start the Dragon Rush!
Talk to Hoppity under the Mountain!
entries.translation: 与山峰下的 Hoppity 交谈！
entries.sampleRaw: Talk to Hoppity under the Mountain!

entries.source: Try out the Chocolate Factory in your Events menu!
entries.translation: 在你的活动菜单中体验巧克力工厂！
entries.sampleRaw: Try out the Chocolate Factory in your Events menu!

entries.source: Talk to Gwendolyn in the Dwarven Mines! She may have more information for you!
entries.translation: 去矮人矿坑找 Gwendolyn 谈谈！她可能掌握更多信息！
entries.sampleRaw: Talk to Gwendolyn in the Dwarven Mines! She may have more information for you!

entries.source: Hello.
We're testing Dungeon Balancing changes!
entries.translation: 我们正在测试地牢平衡性改动！

entries.source: Play some dungeons to ensure the changes are working as intended!
entries.translation: 去玩几场地牢，确保改动按预期生效！
entries.sampleRaw: Play some dungeons to ensure the changes are working as intended!

entries.source: Go to the Wizard Portal to join the Rift.
entries.translation: 前往巫师传送门加入裂隙。
entries.sampleRaw: Go to the Wizard Portal to join the Rift.

entries.source: Welcome. Have you met Sam on your private island? I hear she needs help with a farm or something...
entries.translation: 欢迎。你在私人岛屿上见过 Sam 了吗？我听说她需要帮忙打理农场之类的……
entries.sampleRaw: Welcome. Have you met Sam on your private island? I hear she needs help with a farm or something...

entries.source: Hi there! Make sure to talk to Sam on your private island to go to the Garden if you are at least SkyBlock level 5!
entries.translation: 你好！如果你的 SkyBlock 等级至少为 5，记得去私人岛屿找 Sam 交谈，前往花园！
entries.sampleRaw: Hi there! Make sure to talk to Sam on your private island to go to the Garden if you are at least SkyBlock level 5!
entries.numericSource: Hi there! Make sure to talk to Sam on your private island to go to the Garden if you are at least SkyBlock level {{N0}}!
entries.numericTranslation: 你好！如果你的 SkyBlock 等级至少为 {{N0}}，记得去私人岛屿找 Sam 交谈，前往花园！

entries.source: Welcome.
Hello There.
Have you heard of the Garden?
Well I'm sure you'll have your own soon enough.
entries.translation: 嗯，我相信你很快就会拥有自己的花园。
entries.sampleRaw: Well I'm sure you'll have your own soon enough.

entries.source: When you do, come talk to me.
entries.translation: 等你有了，就来找我谈谈。
entries.sampleRaw: When you do, come talk to me.

entries.source: So you've got your own Garden, but are you shotting for the Stars?
entries.translation: 所以你已经有了自己的花园，但你在为星星而奋斗吗？
entries.sampleRaw: So you've got your own §aGarden§f, but are you shotting for the Stars?

entries.source: Serve 3,000 Visitors in your Garden and then come back.
entries.translation: 在你的花园中接待 3,000 位访客，然后再回来。
entries.sampleRaw: Serve §b3,000 Visitors§f in your §aGarden§f and then come back.
entries.numericSource: Serve {{N0}} Visitors in your Garden and then come back.
entries.numericTranslation: 在你的花园中接待 {{N0}} 位访客，然后再回来。

entries.source: From up here I'm able to see all the Gardens in SkyBlock.
entries.translation: 从这里我能看到 SkyBlock 中的所有花园。
entries.sampleRaw: From up here I'm able to see all the §aGardens §fin §aSkyBlock§f.

entries.source: All the crops...all the Visitors...
entries.translation: 所有的作物……所有的访客……

entries.source: Your Garden seems particularly of note, however.
entries.translation: 不过，你的花园似乎格外引人注目。

entries.source: You've accepted offers from well over 3,000 Visitors...
entries.translation: 你已经接受了远超 3,000 位访客的提议……
entries.sampleRaw: You've accepted offers from well over §b3,000 Visitors...
entries.numericSource: You've accepted offers from well over {{N0}} Visitors...
entries.numericTranslation: 你已经接受了远超 {{N0}} 位访客的提议……

entries.source: If you were to invite me to visit, I would not say no.
entries.translation: 如果你邀请我来做客，我不会拒绝。
entries.sampleRaw: If you were to invite me to visit, I would not say no.

entries.source: Man, coming back here after being in space for so long feels really good.
entries.translation: 天哪，在太空待了这么久后回到这里，感觉真好。
entries.sampleRaw: Man, coming back here after being in space for so long feels really good.

entries.source: Something I have been craving for a while is [crop], they unfortunately do not grow in space.
entries.translation: 我一直很想吃[作物]，可惜它们在太空里长不出来。
entries.sampleRaw: Something I have been craving for a while is [crop], they unfortunately do not grow in space.

entries.source: You are amazing, thank you so much.
entries.sampleRaw: You are amazing, thank you so much.

entries.source: I am quite disappointed.
Where I live, vegetables aren't really an option. No sunlight, you see. Could you get me some?
entries.translation: 我住的地方，蔬菜实在不是个选项。你也知道，没有阳光。能帮我弄一些来吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Where I live, vegetables aren't really an option. No sunlight, you see. Could you get me some?

entries.source: You know you should live life in moderation. Too much of anything is no good. Balance is key.
entries.translation: 你知道，生活应当适度。任何东西过量都不好。平衡才是关键。
entries.sampleRaw: You know you should live life in moderation. Too much of anything is no good. Balance is key.

entries.source: Welp. Meat is good too, I suppose.
entries.sampleRaw: Welp. Meat is good too, I suppose.

entries.source: Hello [player]. Glad to meet you here. I need some Bread.
entries.translation: 你好,[player].很高兴在这里见到你.我需要一些面包.

styleMappings.. Glad to meet you here. I need some Bre: .很高兴在这里见到你.我需要一些面包.

entries.sampleRaw: Hello §7[player]§f. Glad to meet you here. I need some Bread.

entries.source: Hello [player]. Glad to meet you here. I need some [item].
entries.translation: 你好,[player].很高兴在这里见到你.我需要一些[item].
entries.sampleRaw: Hello §7[player]§f. Glad to meet you here. I need some [item].

entries.source: Your SkyBlock island is part of a much larger universe... [1\/2]
entries.translation: 你的 SkyBlock 岛屿是一个大得多的宇宙的一部分…… [1\/2]
entries.sampleRaw: Your SkyBlock island is part of a much larger universe... §7[1\/§a2§7]
entries.numericSource: Your SkyBlock island is part of a much larger universe... [{{N0}}\/{{N1}}]
entries.numericTranslation: 你的 SkyBlock 岛屿是一个大得多的宇宙的一部分…… [{{N0}}\/{{N1}}]

entries.source: Wait, how did I get here? [2\/2]
entries.translation: 等等,我是怎么到这儿来的?[2\/2]
entries.sampleRaw: Wait, how did I get here? §7[§a2\/2§7]
entries.numericSource: Wait, how did I get here? [{{N0}}\/{{N1}}]
entries.numericTranslation: 等等,我是怎么到这儿来的?[{{N0}}\/{{N1}}]

entries.source: Gave you: Grand Experience Bottle x32
entries.translation: 已给予你：高级经验瓶 x32
entries.numericSource: Gave you: Grand Experience Bottle x{{N0}}
entries.numericTranslation: 已给予你：高级经验瓶 x{{N0}}

entries.source: The Argofays are not a bad people.
entries.translation: 阿尔戈菲人并不是坏人。
entries.sampleRaw: The §aArgofays§f are not a bad people.

entries.source: They grew from the trees after the Rift opened.
entries.translation: 裂隙开启后，他们从树中生长出来。
entries.sampleRaw: They grew from the trees after the §dRift§f opened.

entries.source: You should try to get a complete Wyld Armor set from them.
entries.translation: 你应该试着从他们那里弄到一整套荒野盔甲。
entries.sampleRaw: You should try to get a complete §aWyld Armor§f set from them.

entries.source: Listen here.
If you want your mind intact when you get out of here...
entries.translation: 如果你想在离开这里时神志完好……
entries.sampleRaw: If you want your §dmind§f intact when you get out of here...

entries.source: ... it's best not to ask too many questions and just accept reality as you see it.
entries.translation: ……最好别问太多问题，就接受你所看到的现实。
entries.sampleRaw: ... it's best not to ask too many questions and just accept reality as you see it.

entries.source: Me eat items, give Motes.
Before, me items, give Coins!
But now, me eat items, give Motes.
entries.translation: 但现在，我吃物品，给裂隙尘埃。
entries.sampleRaw: But now, me eat items, give §dMotes§f.

entries.source: The Argofays have been so kind to welcome me in one of their huts.
entries.translation: 阿尔戈菲人真好，让我住进了他们的一间小屋。
entries.sampleRaw: The Argofays have been so kind to welcome me in one of their huts.

entries.source: It's been rough since I lost my cat.
entries.translation: 自从我丢了猫，日子就很难过。
entries.sampleRaw: It's been rough since I lost my §9cat§f.

entries.source: It just left my sight!
I think it's playing around the Rift!
entries.translation: 我想它正在裂隙附近玩耍！
entries.sampleRaw: I think it's playing around the §5Rift§f!

entries.source: Please!
Please!!
Please!!!
Find my cat Montezuma!
Open my chest and take my Cat Detector!
entries.translation: 打开我的箱子，拿走我的猫咪探测器！
entries.sampleRaw: Open my §6chest§f and take my §9Cat Detector§f!

entries.source: Not that chest!
That's where I store all the pictures of little Monte!
entries.translation: 那里面放的全是小蒙特祖玛的照片！
entries.sampleRaw: That's where I store all the pictures of little Monte!

entries.source: Uh... it's not that one either.
entries.sampleRaw: Uh... it's not that one either.

entries.source: I was talking about the one behind me, silly!
entries.translation: 我说的是我身后那个，小笨蛋！
entries.sampleRaw: I was talking about the one behind me, silly!

entries.source: Now please go and find my dear Montezuma!
entries.translation: 现在请去找我亲爱的蒙特祖玛吧！
entries.sampleRaw: Now please go and find my dear §9Montezuma§f!

entries.source: Hey you're back!
Did you find Montezuma?
I know that!
I'm so glad you found him!
entries.translation: 你找到他了我太高兴了！
entries.sampleRaw: I'm so glad you found him!

entries.source: It's soul fractured into 9 parts when we crossed into the Rift.
entries.translation: 我们穿过裂隙时,它的灵魂碎裂成了9块.
entries.sampleRaw: It's soul fractured into §99 parts§f when we crossed into the §5Rift§f.
entries.numericSource: It's soul fractured into {{N0}} parts when we crossed into the Rift.
entries.numericTranslation: 我们穿过裂隙时,它的灵魂碎裂成了{{N0}}块.

entries.source: I've been living in this cabin with 1\/9th of Montezuma for an eternity now.
entries.translation: 我已经和蒙特祖玛的1/9在这间小屋里住了永恒之久。
entries.sampleRaw: I've been living in this cabin with 1\/9th of §9Montezuma§f for an eternity now.
entries.numericSource: I've been living in this cabin with {{N0}}\/{{N1}}th of Montezuma for an eternity now.
entries.numericTranslation: 我已经和蒙特祖玛的{{N0}}/{{N1}}在这间小屋里住了永恒之久。

entries.source: Find all parts of Montezuma's soul so I can enjoy a full cat again!
entries.translation: 找到蒙特祖玛灵魂的所有部分，好让我再次拥有一只完整的猫！
entries.sampleRaw: Find all parts of §9Montezuma§f's soul so I can enjoy a full cat again!

entries.source: Have you found all of Montezuma's soul yet?
entries.translation: 你找到蒙特祖玛的全部灵魂了吗?
entries.sampleRaw: Have you found all of §9Montezuma§r's soul yet?

entries.source: You found all the pieces of Montezuma's soul?
entries.translation: 你找到了蒙特祖玛灵魂的所有碎片？
entries.sampleRaw: You found all the pieces of §9Montezuma§f's soul?

entries.source: That's amazing!
I'll level with you now.
I'm still sad.
But it's because I'm stuck in an alternate reality...
entries.translation: 但那是因为我困在了一个平行现实中……
entries.sampleRaw: But it's because I'm stuck in an alternate reality...

entries.source: With nowhere to go...
And nothing to do...
I can't sleep and yet I can't get out of bed.
entries.translation: 我睡不着，却又下不了床。
entries.sampleRaw: I can't sleep and yet I can't get out of bed.

entries.source: So how are you doing?
I've been researching Lagoon Leeches.
entries.translation: 我一直在研究泻湖水蛭.

entries.source: I tasked my assistant Kay with a critical component of my research, but clearly she forgot about me!
entries.translation: 我把研究中的一个关键部分交给了我的助手Kay，但显然她把我忘了！
entries.sampleRaw: I tasked my assistant Kay with a critical component of my research, but clearly she forgot about me!

entries.source: She's stuck near the Lagoon Hut, go talk to her.
entries.translation: 她被困在泻湖小屋附近,去和她谈谈吧.
entries.sampleRaw: She's stuck near the §3Lagoon Hut§r, go talk to her.

entries.source: Have you talked to Kay yet?
entries.sampleRaw: Have you talked to Kay yet?

entries.source: She's stuck near the Lagoon Hut.
entries.translation: 她被困在泻湖小屋附近.

entries.source: Mmh...
I see.
I can send you to the Leeches Lair but be warned, it's dangerous down there!
entries.translation: 我可以把你送到水蛭巢穴，但事先警告你，那下面很危险！
entries.sampleRaw: I can send you to the §cLeeches Lair§f but be warned, it's dangerous down there!

entries.source: Zoooooooooooop!
Want to kill some leeches?
Here we go!
I heard the Leech Supreme is dead!
entries.translation: 我听说水蛭至尊已经死了！
entries.sampleRaw: I heard the Leech Supreme is dead!

entries.source: Come back in about # seconds.
Welcome to the Rift Dimension, [player]!
I remember meeting you, out there.
entries.translation: 我记得在外面的世界见过你。

entries.source: We're in a separate dimension.
entries.translation: 我们身处一个独立的维度。

entries.source: An alternative universe of sorts.
entries.translation: 某种意义上的 An 平行宇宙。

entries.source: Both marvelous and dangerous at the same time.
entries.translation: 既奇妙又危险，两者并存。
entries.sampleRaw: Both §dmarvelous§f and §cdangerous§f at the same time.

entries.source: But listen carefully.
Some SkyBlock dwellers feel lost here.
entries.translation: 有些 SkyBlock 居民在这里会感到迷失。

entries.source: Always anxious of laying out their own path.
entries.translation: 总是焦虑于如何规划自己的道路。

entries.source: The supplier?
Yeah, I know who they are.
entries.sampleRaw: Yeah, I know who they are.

entries.source: They're a renowned Argofay alchemist!
entries.translation: 他们是一位著名的阿戈法炼金术士！

entries.source: They should be in their shack up in the trees.
entries.translation: 他们应该就在树上自己的小屋里。
entries.sampleRaw: They should be in their shack §aup in the trees§f.

entries.source: They're always working there.
Who's Dr. Hibble? Never heard of them.
entries.translation: Dr. Hibble 是谁？从没听说过。
entries.sampleRaw: Who's Dr. Hibble? Never heard of them.

entries.source: Oh you mean Dr. Edwin?
Yeah! I finished the research paper!
entries.sampleRaw: Yeah! I finished the research paper!

entries.source: Wow, you made it through the lagoon!
entries.sampleRaw: Wow, you made it through the lagoon!

entries.source: We've been stuck here forever!
Yeet!
Hey there.
See ya!
We don't eat much.
Sometimes we eat Odonatas.
Yes.
Hi.
To collect Odonatas, you need to fly.
entries.translation: 要收集蜻蜓，你需要飞行。

entries.source: Use the larvas to fly.
Talk to Bugshopper, then show me a Larva Hook.
entries.translation: 和虫商谈谈，然后给我看看幼虫钩。
entries.sampleRaw: Talk to §aBugshopper§f, then show me a §aLarva Hook§f.

entries.source: Get a Larva Hook from Bugshopper.
entries.translation: 从虫商那里弄一个幼虫钩。

entries.source: Now use the hook.
Find a larva in the branches.
entries.translation: 在树枝间找到一只幼虫。
entries.sampleRaw: Find a larva in the branches.

entries.source: Hook it until it relinquishes its SILK.
entries.sampleRaw: Hook it until it relinquishes its §f§lSILK§f.

entries.source: Then come back.
Hook it until it relinquishes its silk.
entries.translation: 钩住它，直到它交出丝线。
entries.sampleRaw: Hook it until it relinquishes its silk.

entries.source: Good.
Do not eat the silk.
Otherwise you cannot fly.
Now go and bring back 6 Larva Silk.
entries.translation: 现在去带回 6 个幼虫丝.
entries.sampleRaw: Now go and bring back §a6 Larva Silk§f.
entries.numericSource: Now go and bring back {{N0}} Larva Silk.
entries.numericTranslation: 现在去带回 {{N0}} 个幼虫丝.

entries.source: Bring me 6 Larva Silk.
Great.
You may have noticed...
You can use silk to create wires.
entries.translation: 你可以用丝线来制作线缆。
entries.sampleRaw: You can use silk to create wires.

entries.source: Silkwire.
Use Silkwire to fly.
With this stick.
Now talk to Bugshopper and show me an Odonata Bottle.
entries.translation: 现在去和 Bugshopper 谈谈,并给我看一个蜻蜓瓶.
entries.sampleRaw: Now talk to §aBugshopper §rand show me an §aOdonata Bottle§r.

entries.source: Lost stick?
Now is flying time.
Spot an Odonata out there.
They are very small.
Lay out a Silkwire which crosses the Odonata.
entries.translation: 铺设一条穿过蜻蜓的丝线。

entries.source: Use the Silkwire Stick on the Silkwire to fly.
entries.translation: 用丝线杖对着丝线使用来飞行。
entries.sampleRaw: Use the§9 Silkwire Stick§f on the §eSilkwire §fto §b§ofly§f.

entries.source: Then collect the Odonata using the Empty Odonata Bottle.
entries.translation: 然后用空蜻蜓瓶收集蜻蜓。
entries.sampleRaw: Then collect the §9Odonata§f using the §aEmpty Odonata Bottle§f.

entries.source: I am hungry. Please bring back the Bottled Odonata.
entries.translation: 我饿了。请带回瓶装蜻蜓。
entries.sampleRaw: I am hungry. Please bring back the §9Bottled Odonata§f.

entries.source: Lay out a Silkwire which crosses it.
entries.translation: 铺设一条穿过它的丝线。

entries.source: Please bring a Bottled Odonata.
Very very good.
Very tasty.
Because few words do trick.
I taught you how to capture Odonatas.
entries.translation: 我教会了你如何捕捉蜻蜓。
entries.sampleRaw: I taught you how to capture §9Odonatas§f.

entries.source: Now please bring back 8 Bottled Odonata.
entries.translation: 现在请带回 8 瓶装蜻蜓.
entries.sampleRaw: Now please bring back §98 Bottled Odonata§f.
entries.numericSource: Now please bring back {{N0}} Bottled Odonata.
entries.numericTranslation: 现在请带回 {{N0}} 瓶装蜻蜓.

entries.source: I am very hungry.
There is something in it for you if you do.
entries.translation: 如果你照做，会有好处给你。
entries.sampleRaw: There is §6something in it §ffor you if you do.

entries.source: Please bring me 8 Bottled Odonata.
entries.translation: 请给我带来 8 瓶装蜻蜓.
entries.numericTranslation: 请给我带来 {{N0}} 瓶装蜻蜓.

entries.source: So good.
You are the best.
Take this belt.
It's safer with it.
Lost your belt?
That's unsafe.
Thank you for the Odonatas.
I am not hungry anymore.
Come back when I am hungry again.
entries.sampleRaw: Come back when I am hungry again.

entries.source: I am hungry.
Please bring me 3 Bottled Odonata.
entries.translation: 请给我带来 3 瓶装蜻蜓.
entries.numericTranslation: 请给我带来 {{N0}} 瓶装蜻蜓.

entries.source: I will give you 5,000 Motes if you do.
entries.translation: 如果你照做,我会给你 5,000 裂隙尘埃.
entries.sampleRaw: I will give you §d5,000 Motes §fif you do.
entries.numericSource: I will give you {{N0}} Motes if you do.
entries.numericTranslation: 如果你照做,我会给你 {{N0}} 裂隙尘埃.

entries.source: Thank you.
Here are the Motes.
I'm looking for my Liege, but my Eyes went rogue.
entries.translation: 我在寻找我的君主，但我的眼睛失控了。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm looking for my §6Liege§f, but my §cEyes§f went rogue.

entries.source: If you calm one of them down, I will be able to teleport you to it.
entries.translation: 如果你让其中一只平静下来，我就能把你传送到它那里。
entries.sampleRaw: If you calm one of them down, I will be able to §ateleport§f you to it.

entries.source: Before you venture into The Rift again, I must thank you.
entries.translation: 在你再次踏入裂隙维度之前，我必须感谢你。
entries.sampleRaw: Before you venture into §dThe Rift §fagain, I must thank you.

entries.source: You have calmed all of my eyes.
entries.translation: 你已经让我所有的眼睛都平静下来了。
entries.sampleRaw: You have calmed all of my eyes.

entries.source: I now comprehend my purpose here.
entries.translation: 我现在明白了自己在此处的使命。
entries.sampleRaw: I now comprehend my purpose here.

entries.source: I am but a creation, a link through time, a messenger, a catalyst.
entries.translation: 我不过是一个造物，一条穿越时间的纽带，一名信使，一个催化剂。
entries.sampleRaw: I am but a creation, a link through time, a messenger, a catalyst.

entries.source: Soon, our destinies will intertwine once more.
entries.translation: 很快，我们的命运将再次交织。
entries.sampleRaw: Soon, our destinies will intertwine once more.

entries.source: You must repair the breach, for I am to receive and deliver a vision from it.
entries.translation: 你必须修复裂隙，因为我要从中接收并传递一个幻象。
entries.sampleRaw: You must repair the breach, for I am to receive and deliver a vision from it.

entries.source: Quit it!
Uh... talk to Bughunter first.
Awkward!
I last saw the sea XX years, XX months ago.
entries.translation: 我上次见到大海是在 XX 年 XX 个月之前。
entries.sampleRaw: I last saw the sea §bXX years, XX months §fago.

entries.source: I wish I could remember what it felt like!
entries.translation: 我真希望能记起那是什么感觉！
entries.sampleRaw: I wish I could remember what it felt like!

entries.source: Sadly, my memory is now my worst enemy.
entries.translation: 可悲的是，我的记忆如今成了我最大的敌人。
entries.sampleRaw: Sadly, my memory is now my worst enemy.

entries.source: Please, help me remember the sea!
entries.translation: 求求你，帮我记起大海吧！

entries.source: YES!
Now that you poured an infinite amount of water,
entries.translation: 既然你倒入了无穷无尽的水，
entries.sampleRaw: Now that you poured an infinite amount of water,

entries.source: I can remember the smell of salt water and the beauty of the waves.
entries.translation: 我能记起咸水的味道和波浪的美丽了。
entries.sampleRaw: I can remember the smell of salt water and the beauty of the waves.

entries.source: If only I could recall the smell of a tasty supper with my old warband.
entries.translation: 要是能回忆起和我旧日战团一起享用美味晚餐的气味就好了。
entries.sampleRaw: If only I could recall the smell of a §etasty supper§f with my old warband.

entries.source: That's just... not enough water.
There's as much water here as an ocean.
entries.translation: 这里的水多得像一片海洋。
entries.sampleRaw: There's as much water here as an ocean.

entries.source: If only you could pour it somewhere!
entries.translation: 要是你能把它倒到什么地方就好了！
entries.sampleRaw: If only you could pour it somewhere!

entries.source: I would like to smell a good feast!
entries.translation: 我想闻一闻丰盛盛宴的香味！
entries.sampleRaw: I would like to §esmell §fa good feast!

entries.source: I prefer when the fishes are lively and go splish-splash in the water!
entries.translation: 我更喜欢鱼儿活蹦乱跳、在水中扑通扑通的样子！
entries.sampleRaw: I prefer when the fishes are lively and go splish-splash in the water!

entries.source: *takes a bite*
It definitely... *chomp* tastes good...
But the smell isn't quite right!
entries.sampleRaw: But the smell isn't quite right!

entries.source: MMMMMMmmmMMMMH...
Smells so nice!
You know what I really remember from the sea?
entries.translation: 你知道我真正记得大海的什么吗？
entries.sampleRaw: You know what I really remember from the sea?

entries.source: Fishes splish-splashing around!
entries.translation: 鱼儿在周围扑通扑通地游动！

entries.source: YES! This totally reminds me of the sea!
entries.translation: 太好了！这完全让我想起了大海！

styleMappings.This totally reminds me of the sea!: 这完全让我想起了大海！

entries.sampleRaw: §aYES!§f This totally reminds me of the sea!

entries.source: Although... there were more fishes back then.
EXCELLENT! Just a few more fishes and splashes please!
entries.translation: 太棒了！请再来几条鱼和几下水花！
entries.sampleRaw: §aEXCELLENT!§f Just a few more fishes and splashes please!

entries.source: WOW! This feels just like on my Drakkar!
entries.translation: 哇！这感觉就像在我的长船上一样！
entries.sampleRaw: §a§lWOW!§f This §bfeels§f just like on my Drakkar!

entries.source: I suddenly feel so great!
Thanks for bringing joy to an old viking!
entries.translation: 谢谢你给一位老维京人带来欢乐！
entries.sampleRaw: Thanks for bringing §ejoy§f to an old viking!

entries.source: Take a look at my wares! (Interact with the NPC)
entries.translation: 看看我的货物吧！（与 NPC 互动）
entries.sampleRaw: Take a look at my wares! §7(Interact with the NPC)

entries.source: Wow! Nice move! There just isn't the ambiance to fully appreciate it.
entries.translation: 哇！好手法！只是这里缺少氛围，无法完全欣赏。

styleMappings.There just isn't the ambiance to fully a: 只是这里缺少氛围，无法完全欣赏。

entries.sampleRaw: §eWow! Nice move! §fThere just isn't the ambiance to fully appreciate it.

entries.translation: 要是没有这该死的火焰噪音就好了！

styleMappings.If only there wasn't this infernal fire: 要是没有这该死的火焰噪音就好了！

entries.sampleRaw: §eIf only there wasn't this infernal fire noise!

entries.source: Ooh! That looks exotic!
It wasn't quite what I was looking for, but I'll take it thanks!
entries.translation: 这不太是我想要的，但我还是收下了，谢谢！
entries.sampleRaw: It wasn't quite what I was looking for, but I'll take it thanks!

entries.source: Don't you have some liquid water?
entries.translation: 你难道没有一些液态水吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Don't you have some liquid water?

entries.source: Ouch!
Awesome hat! Does it do anything special?
entries.translation: 好棒的帽子！它有什么特殊功能吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Awesome hat! Does it do anything special?

entries.source: Please don't tell my family that I cry sometimes!
entries.translation: 请别告诉我的家人我有时候会哭！
entries.sampleRaw: Please don't tell my family that I cry sometimes!

entries.source: It's a nice thought, but I don't feel like fishing right now.
entries.translation: 想法不错，但我现在不想钓鱼。
entries.sampleRaw: It's a nice thought, but I don't feel like fishing right now.

entries.source: * sniffs *
Smells weird.
Wow!
A boat!
Throw them at people you hate!
entries.translation: 把它们扔向你讨厌的人！
entries.sampleRaw: Throw them at people you hate!

entries.source: Why do bees hum?
They don't remember the lyrics!
Get up there!
It's way too high.
Speak for yourself, I almost got it!
entries.translation: 你自己才这样吧，我差点就够到了！
entries.sampleRaw: Speak for yourself, I almost got it!

entries.source: Oh yeah? Prove it.
I can't right now. Maybe next time you ask me I will.
entries.translation: 我现在不行。也许下次你问我时我就可以了。
entries.sampleRaw: I can't right now. Maybe next time you ask me I will.

entries.source: WOW!
Impressive! What a jump!
How did you manage to jump that high?
entries.translation: 你是怎么跳到那么高的？
entries.sampleRaw: How did you manage to jump that high?

entries.source: They're a human, dummy. That's why.
entries.translation: 他们是人类，笨蛋。所以才这样。
entries.sampleRaw: They're a human, dummy. That's why.

entries.source: A human! No way!
I don't know how we'll ever reach that high.
entries.translation: 我不知道我们到底要怎么才能到达那么高的地方。
entries.sampleRaw: I don't know how we'll ever reach that high.

entries.source: One small step for frog, one giant leap for frogkind.
entries.translation: 青蛙的一小步，蛙类的一大步。
entries.sampleRaw: One small step for frog, one giant leap for frogkind.

entries.source: Mama Frog always said, "To reach great heights, you must take a leap of faith!".
entries.translation: 青蛙妈妈总是说,“要想达到伟大的高度,你必须勇敢地纵身一跃!”.

styleMappings.\"To reach great heights, you must take: “要想达到伟大的高度,你必须勇敢地纵身一跃!”

entries.source: One small step for frog, one giant leap for frogkind.
entries.translation: 这是青蛙的一小步，却是蛙类的一大步。
entries.sampleRaw: One small step for frog, one giant leap for frogkind.

entries.source: Mama Frog always said, "To reach great heights, you must take a leap of faith!".
entries.translation: 青蛙妈妈总是说,“要想达到崇高的高度,你必须勇敢地纵身一跃!”.

entries.source: Time flows differently in this dimension.
entries.translation: 在这个维度里，时间的流动方式与众不同。

entries.source: A lot of wizards, including me, try and study Time around here.
entries.translation: 包括我在内的许多巫师都试图在这里研究时间。
entries.sampleRaw: A lot of wizards, including me, try and study §eTime§f around here.

entries.source: Tomorrow you might come back here yesterday.
entries.translation: 明天你可能会在昨天回到这里。

entries.source: Maybe we already had this conversation in the future.
entries.translation: 也许我们在未来已经进行过这次对话了。
entries.sampleRaw: Maybe we already §ahad§f this conversation in the §bfuture§f.

entries.source: Is there even a before and an after in this place?
entries.translation: 这个地方真的存在之前和之后吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Is there even a §abefore§f and an §bafter§f in this place?

entries.source: Some speculate that we are in the past, some say in the future, perhaps we're always in the present.
entries.translation: 有人推测我们身处过去，有人说我们在未来，也许我们始终身处现在。
entries.sampleRaw: Some speculate that we are in the past, some say in the §bfuture§f, perhaps we're always in the §epresent§f.

entries.source: A full revolution of events around here is what we here call a "business day".
entries.translation: 这里事件的一次完整循环，就是我们这里所说的“一个工作日”。
entries.sampleRaw: A full revolution of events around here is what we here call a "business day".

entries.source: All you have to decide is what to do with the time that is given to you.
entries.translation: 你唯一要决定的，就是如何利用给予你的时间。
entries.sampleRaw: All you have to decide is what to do with the time that is given to you.
