entries.translation: 不错，只差 # 个胡萝卜了。

entries.source: Very good.
Hopefully our business has been very profitable for the both of us.
entries.translation: 希望我们的生意对我们双方都非常有利可图。
entries.sampleRaw: Hopefully our business has been very profitable for the both of us.

entries.source: Thank you for the carrots.
I don't know where you got them from and at this point I'm too afraid to ask.
entries.translation: 我不知道你从哪儿弄来的，事到如今我都不敢问了。
entries.sampleRaw: I don't know where you got them from and at this point I'm too afraid to ask.

entries.source: Nice, only # Pumpkins to go.
entries.translation: 不错，只差 # 个南瓜了。

entries.source: Thank you for the pumpkins.
They're squishy and disgusting. I don't want to know where you got these from.
entries.translation: 它们又软又恶心。我可不想知道你从哪儿弄来的这些。
entries.sampleRaw: They're squishy and disgusting. I don't want to know where you got these from.

entries.source: Nice, only # Chocolate Bars to go.
entries.translation: 不错，只差 # 个巧克力棒了。
entries.sampleRaw: Nice, only §6# Chocolate Bars§f to go.

entries.source: Thank you for the chocolate.
It is absolutely delicious. By far the best chocolate bars I have ever eaten in my life!
entries.translation: 这绝对美味。这是我一生中吃过的最好吃的巧克力棒！
entries.sampleRaw: It is absolutely delicious. By far the best chocolate bars I have ever eaten in my life!

entries.source: Nice, only # Fine Flours to go.
entries.translation: 不错，只差 # 份精制面粉了。
entries.sampleRaw: Nice, only §6# Fine Flours§f to go.

entries.source: Thank you for the flour.
Nice, only # Mushrooms to go.
entries.translation: 不错，只差 # 个蘑菇了。

entries.source: Thank you for the mushrooms.
Although since they're all half-eaten, you technically brought me half the amount!
entries.translation: 不过既然它们都被吃掉了一半，严格来说你只带给了我一半的数量！
entries.sampleRaw: Although since they're all half-eaten, you technically brought me half the amount!

entries.source: Nice, only # Wartys to go.
entries.translation: 不错，只差 # 个疣猪了。

entries.source: Thank you for the Warty.
Nice, only # Prickly Kisses to go.
entries.translation: 不错，只差 # 个尖刺之吻了。
entries.sampleRaw: Nice, only §6# Prickly Kisses§f to go.

entries.source: Thank you for the Prickly Kisses.
I hope you handle these with care. I got pricked by those once.
entries.translation: 希望你能小心处理这些。我曾经被那些东西扎过。
entries.sampleRaw: I hope you handle these with care. I got pricked by those once.

entries.source: It was NOT a pleasant experience.
entries.translation: 那可不是什么愉快的经历。
entries.sampleRaw: It was NOT a pleasant experience.

entries.source: Nice, only # Cactus to go.
entries.translation: 不错，只差 # 个仙人掌了。

entries.source: Thank you for the cacti.
They're cute but prickly, like my grandmother.
entries.translation: 它们很可爱但浑身是刺，就像我奶奶一样。
entries.sampleRaw: They're cute but prickly, like my grandmother.

entries.source: ✆ I suppose you want my Abiphone Contact.
entries.translation: ✆ 我猜你想要我的 Abiphone 联系人。

entries.source: ✆ Well, what's in it for me?
entries.translation: ✆ 那么，我能得到什么好处？

entries.source: ✆ I'll tell you what - I want a Magma Core.
entries.translation: ✆ 这样吧——我想要一个岩浆核心。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fI'll tell you what - I want a §9Magma Core§f.

entries.source: ✆ Bring me that and I'm sure we can reach an agreement.
entries.translation: ✆ 把它带来给我，我相信我们就能达成协议。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fBring me that and I'm sure we can reach an agreement.

entries.source: ✆ You don't have a Magma Core.
✆ Don't waste my time please, I have things to do and places to be.
entries.translation: ✆ 请别浪费我的时间，我还有事要做，还有地方要去。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fDon't waste my time please, I have things to do and places to be.

entries.source: ✆ That does appear to be a Magma Core.
entries.translation: ✆ 那看起来确实是一个岩浆核心。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fThat does appear to be a §9Magma Core§f.

entries.source: ✆ Well, as per the terms of our agreement, I suppose you can have my contact.
entries.translation: ✆ 好吧，按照我们协议的条款，我想你可以拿走我的联系人了。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fWell, as per the terms of our agreement, I suppose you can have my contact.

entries.source: ✆ Only call me if you've got items to give me, please.
entries.translation: ✆ 只有你有东西要给我时才请打给我。
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fOnly call me if you've got items to give me, please.

entries.source: ✆ Time is money, after all.
100% guaranteed service, spanning any dimension!
entries.translation: 100% 保证服务,跨越任何维度!
entries.numericTranslation: {{N0}} 保证服务,跨越任何维度!

entries.source: You might think it's expensive...
... and it is.
Do you ever feel like we're just programmed to do certain things in life?
entries.translation: 你有没有觉得，我们就像被编程好了，一生中注定要做某些事？
entries.sampleRaw: Do you ever feel like we're just programmed to do certain things in life?

entries.source: I used to, because it seems like everything you CAN do is pre-determined, like a computer program.
entries.translation: 我以前也这么想，因为你能做的一切似乎都是预先定好的，就像一段计算机程序。
entries.sampleRaw: I used to, because it seems like everything you CAN do is pre-determined, like a computer program.

entries.source: Like an all-powerful entity created this world and everything that can exist in it.
entries.translation: 就像一个全能的实体创造了这个世界，以及其中可能存在的一切。
entries.sampleRaw: Like an all-powerful entity created this world and everything that can exist in it.

entries.source: What made you change your mind?
entries.translation: 是什么让你改变了想法？
entries.sampleRaw: What made you change your mind?

entries.source: Well, think of it like a video game.
entries.translation: 嗯，把它想象成一款电子游戏。
entries.sampleRaw: Well, think of it like a video game.

entries.source: The main storyline may be fixed.
entries.translation: 主线剧情也许是固定的。
entries.sampleRaw: The main storyline may be fixed.

entries.source: But that doesn't stop the player from creating their own stories and experiences within the game.
entries.translation: 但这并不能阻止玩家在游戏里创造属于自己的故事和经历。
entries.sampleRaw: But that doesn't stop the player from creating their own stories and experiences within the game.

entries.source: Especially when playing with others!
entries.translation: 尤其是和其他人一起玩的时候！

entries.source: The farmer is sick for a totally unknown reason.
entries.translation: 农夫病了，原因完全不明。
entries.sampleRaw: The farmer is §asick§f for a §ototally unknown §freason.

entries.source: None of the animals here have eaten since they started existing.
entries.translation: 这里的动物从存在以来就没吃过东西。
entries.sampleRaw: None of the animals here have eaten since they started existing.

entries.source: I would become a farmer mooself, but I don't have opposable thumbs.
entries.translation: 我倒是想亲自当农夫，可我没有对生拇指。
entries.sampleRaw: I would become a farmer mooself, but I don't have opposable thumbs.

entries.source: You'll have to do the work. Take this Wand of Farming!
entries.translation: 这活儿只能交给你了。拿着这根农耕法杖！
entries.sampleRaw: You'll have to do the work. Take this Wand of Farming!

entries.source: We will need a lot of stockpiles to survive through an eternity.
entries.translation: 我们需要大量储备，才能熬过永恒。
entries.sampleRaw: We will need a lot of stockpiles to survive through an eternity.

entries.source: Please bring me:
2 Caducous Stem Bunch
2 Wilted Berberis Bunch
2 Agaricus Cap Bunch
Caducous are upside-down plants which grow near humid environmengs.
entries.translation: 早落茎是倒着生长的植物，生长在潮湿的环境附近。
entries.sampleRaw: Caducous are §cupside-down§f plants which grow near §9humid§f environmengs.

entries.source: Simply collect them from top to bottom!
entries.translation: 从顶部到底部采集它们就行了！
entries.sampleRaw: Simply collect them from §atop to bottom§f!

entries.source: There was once a powerful necromancer who lived in the Catacombs.
entries.translation: 曾经有一位强大的死灵法师住在地牢里。
entries.sampleRaw: There was once a §5powerful necromancer§f who lived in the §cCatacombs§f.

entries.source: After a falling out with its administration, she retired to the Rift.
entries.translation: 在与管理层闹翻之后，她隐退到了裂隙。
entries.sampleRaw: After a falling out with §cits§f administration, she retired to the §dRift§f.

entries.source: She started growing Wilted Berberis in the farm plots and operated the Dreadfarm Bed & Breakfast.
entries.translation: 她开始在农田里种植枯萎小檗，还经营着惊惧农场民宿。
entries.sampleRaw: She started growing Wilted Berberis in the §afarm plots§f and operated the §eDreadfarm Bed & Breakfast§f.

entries.source: Sadly, she passed when her brain melted in an unrelated incident.
entries.translation: 可惜，她在一场无关事件中大脑融化，就此离世。
entries.sampleRaw: Sadly, she passed when her §dbrain§f melted in an unrelated incident.

entries.source: Anyway, you can harvest the farm patches around the remnants of her decrepit lifework.
entries.translation: 总之，你可以去她破败毕生事业遗迹周围的农田里收割。
entries.sampleRaw: Anyway, you can harvest the §afarm patches§f around the remnants of her decrepit lifework.

entries.source: If you look at the mushrooms around the Dreadfarm...
entries.translation: 如果你看看惊惧农场周围的蘑菇……
entries.sampleRaw: If you look at the §emushrooms§f around the §eDreadfarm§f...

entries.source: ... You look intently...
... and then POP!
Bada bing, bada boom, you click it when it's red!
entries.translation: 噼里啪啦，叮叮当当，变红的时候点它！
entries.sampleRaw: Bada bing, bada boom, you §aclick it§f when it's §cred§f!

entries.source: I can personally attest, all of this food is very good.
entries.translation: 我可以亲自作证，这些食物都非常好吃。
entries.sampleRaw: §fI can personally attest, all of this food is very good.

entries.source: You've done eggcellent work, [player name].
I want you to have this Proto-Chicken.
entries.translation: 我想让你收下这只始祖鸡。

entries.source: Time is a bit muddy here. I found it when I first spawned in this farm.
entries.translation: 这里的时间有点混乱。我第一次生成在这个农场时就发现了它。
entries.sampleRaw: §fTime is a bit muddy here. I found it when I first spawned in this §efarm§f.

entries.source: Did you lose the first chicken ever?
entries.translation: 你把史上第一只鸡弄丢了？
entries.sampleRaw: §fDid you lose the first chicken ever?

entries.source: Happens. Here's another one.
I'd love to moove around, but I'm stuck here helping the farmer.
entries.translation: 我很想四处挪挪，但我被困在这里帮农夫干活。
entries.sampleRaw: §fI'd love to moove around, but I'm stuck here helping the farmer.

entries.source: As a cow, all I want to do is eat, sleep and moo.
entries.translation: 作为一头牛，我只想吃、睡和哞。
entries.sampleRaw: §fAs a cow, all I want to do is eat, sleep and moo.

entries.source: Sometimes I sleep and dream about touching grass, what about you?
entries.translation: 有时我睡觉会梦见摸草，你呢？
entries.sampleRaw: §fSometimes I sleep and dream about touching grass, what about you?

entries.source: Everybody knows mushrooms pop out when walking nearby.
entries.translation: 大家都知道，在附近走动时蘑菇会冒出来。
entries.sampleRaw: Everybody knows mushrooms pop out when walking nearby.

entries.source: But not everybody knows they stay big longer around here.
entries.translation: 但不是所有人都知道，在这附近它们保持变大的时间更长。
entries.sampleRaw: But not everybody knows they stay big longer around here.

entries.source: I know why, but I'm not telling.
entries.translation: 我知道原因，但我不告诉你。
entries.sampleRaw: I know why, but I'm not telling.

entries.source: You can't teleport here.
It's not allowed.
Us dolphins have to go through heavy training before being sent to space.
entries.translation: 我们海豚在被送往太空之前必须经过严格训练。
entries.sampleRaw: Us §bdolphins§f have to go through heavy training before being sent to space.

entries.source: Want to give it a shot?
entries.sampleRaw: Want to give it a shot?

entries.source: Here you go!
Wow!
Not bad for a human!
I hope the space agency doesn't replace us with birds soon.
entries.translation: 我希望航天局不会很快用鸟来取代我们。
entries.sampleRaw: §fI hope the space agency doesn't replace us with birds soon.

entries.source: Since they can already fly, you know?
entries.translation: 毕竟它们本来就会飞，你懂的？
entries.sampleRaw: §fSince they can already fly, you know?

entries.source: Hey [player]!
It's so great you're here!
I was hired to disinfest this house from the vermin.
entries.translation: 我受雇来给这栋房子除虫,消灭那些害兽.
entries.sampleRaw: I was hired to §adisinfest §rthis house from the vermin.

entries.source: Well, I can't do it myself!
entries.sampleRaw: Well, I can't do it myself!

entries.source: Turns out, I'm scared of insects.
entries.sampleRaw: Turns out, I'm scared of insects.

entries.source: And I'm allergic to dust.
And the cleaning contract was badly negotiated.
entries.translation: 而且清洁合同谈得很糟糕。
entries.sampleRaw: And the cleaning contract was badly negotiated.

entries.source: And I have to watch over the disinfestor crew.
entries.translation: 而且我还得盯着除虫队。
entries.sampleRaw: And I have to watch over the disinfestor crew.

entries.source: And...
Yes, I suffer from arachnophobia, entomophobia and pteronarcophobia.
entries.translation: 是的，我患有蜘蛛恐惧症、昆虫恐惧症和蝗虫恐惧症。
entries.sampleRaw: Yes, I suffer from arachnophobia, entomophobia and pteronarcophobia.

entries.source: You're thinking of Kat the Pet Sitter.
entries.translation: 你说的是宠物保姆 Kat.

entries.source: I'm Kat the Neuroscientist. I'm purple Kat!
entries.translation: 我是神经科学家 Kat.我是紫色的 Kat!

entries.source: Quit stalling!
Am I being investigated?
You have to do this quest!
entries.sampleRaw: You have to do this quest!

entries.source: Take my vacuum cleaner.
Now please deal with the infestation problem.
entries.translation: 现在请去处理虫害问题。

entries.source: Vacuum the silverfishes, spiders and flies in the area.
entries.translation: 吸走这片区域的蠹虫、蜘蛛和苍蝇。
entries.sampleRaw: §fVacuum the silverfishes, spiders and flies in the area.

entries.source: Make sure to empty the vacuum in the Vermin Bin!
entries.translation: 记得把吸尘器里的东西倒进害虫箱！
entries.sampleRaw: §fMake sure to empty the vacuum in the §aVermin Bin§f!

entries.source: How did you lose my vacuum?
entries.translation: 你怎么把我的吸尘器弄丢了？

entries.source: Ok... take this replacement...
It's always good to be well equipped for the job ahead!
entries.translation: 为接下来的工作做好充分准备总是好事！
entries.sampleRaw: §fIt's always good to be well equipped for the job ahead!

entries.source: We found this Ferret when cleaning the house.
entries.translation: 我们打扫房子时发现了这只雪貂。

entries.source: It's very scared and of course I don't know how to deal with pets.
entries.translation: 它非常害怕，而我当然不知道怎么照顾宠物。
entries.sampleRaw: §fIt's very scared and of course I don't know how to deal with pets.

entries.source: I think you should bring it with you to the overworld!
entries.translation: 我觉得你应该把它带到主世界去！
entries.sampleRaw: §fI think you should bring it with you to the overworld!

entries.source: I've had this pile of unused diplomas for a while.
entries.translation: 这堆没用过的文凭我已经放了好一阵子了。
entries.sampleRaw: §fI've had this pile of unused diplomas for a while.

entries.source: Don't ask me why and let's keep it between us.
entries.translation: 别问我为什么，这事就我们俩知道。
entries.sampleRaw: §fDon't ask me why and let's keep it between us.

entries.source: Hey you can't click that yet!
entries.translation: 嘿，你现在还不能点那个！
entries.sampleRaw: Hey you can't click that yet!

entries.source: Help me with the disinfestation and I'll give you a key!
entries.translation: 帮我除虫，我就给你一把钥匙！
entries.sampleRaw: Help me with the §adisinfestation§f and I'll give you a key!

entries.source: I'm Kat's cousin.
If you work hard in school maybe you can wear a yellow suit like me!
entries.translation: 如果你在学校努力学习，也许就能像我一样穿上黄色防护服！
entries.sampleRaw: If you work hard in school maybe you can wear a yellow suit like me!

entries.source: I usually work in a nuclear power plant.
entries.translation: 我平时在一家核电站工作。
entries.sampleRaw: I usually work in a nuclear power plant.

entries.source: I guess I looked the part so Kat hired me.
entries.translation: 我猜我看起来挺像那么回事，所以 Kat 雇了我。
entries.sampleRaw: I guess I looked the part so Kat hired me.

entries.source: Standing here behind this big desk...
entries.sampleRaw: Standing here behind this big desk...

entries.source: Somehow it inspires me...
Like an inner voice telling me...
entries.translation: 就像有个内心的声音告诉我……
entries.sampleRaw: Like an inner voice telling me...

entries.source: Open up a shop.
I am rooted to this tree.
entries.sampleRaw: I am rooted to this tree.

entries.source: But I don't remember...
Was the tree there before me, or was I there before the tree?
entries.translation: 是树先于我存在，还是我先于树存在？
entries.sampleRaw: Was the tree there before me, or was I there before the tree?

entries.source: Am I the tree?
From your point of view, I will always be standing here.
entries.translation: 从你的角度来看，我会永远站在这里。
entries.sampleRaw: From your point of view, I will always be standing here.

entries.source: I ran out of time long ago, probably.
entries.translation: 大概很久以前，我的时间就用完了。
entries.sampleRaw: I ran out of time long ago, probably.

entries.source: Sorry, I can't talk right now.
entries.sampleRaw: Sorry, I can't talk right now.

entries.source: I'm mentally preparing.
* nom nom nom *
* munch munch munch *
* glug glug glug *
About time you arrived, [player]!
Joey is a world-class competitive pizza eater and is trying to break into the hot dog scene.
entries.translation: Joey 是世界级的披萨竞吃选手，现在正试图进军热狗界。
entries.sampleRaw: §cJoey§f is a §aworld-class§f competitive pizza eater and is trying to break into the §chot dog§f scene.

entries.source: Listen, it's simple.
1. I cook the hot dogs.
2. YOU put them on the plate in front of Joey.
entries.translation: 2.你负责把它们放到 Joey 面前的盘子里.
entries.sampleRaw: §a2.§f YOU put §cthem§f on the §eplate§f in front of §cJoey§f.
entries.numericSource: {{N0}}. YOU put them on the plate in front of Joey.
entries.numericTranslation: {{N0}}.你负责把它们放到 Joey 面前的盘子里.

entries.source: 3. He eats.
Ready?
Hey [player], you're ready?
Quick!
Collect the hot dogs!
Oops!
We didn't break the record of 50 hot dogs.
entries.translation: 我们没能打破 50 个热狗的纪录.
entries.sampleRaw: We didn't break the record of §c50 hot dogs§r.
entries.numericSource: We didn't break the record of {{N0}} hot dogs.
entries.numericTranslation: 我们没能打破 {{N0}} 个热狗的纪录.

entries.source: Mmh... maybe call a friend over and let's try again!
entries.translation: 嗯……也许叫个朋友过来，我们再试一次！
entries.sampleRaw: Mmh... maybe call a friend over and let's try again!

entries.source: Mmh... let's try again!
Eggcellent!
Joey ate # hot dogs!
That's more than the record of all the scientists even theorized was possible.
entries.translation: 这比所有科学家理论推测的纪录还要多。
entries.sampleRaw: That's more than the record of all the §bscientists§f even theorized was possible.

entries.source: Wait... come look what I found behind the furnace...
entries.translation: 等等……过来看看我在熔炉后面发现了什么……
entries.sampleRaw: Wait... come look §5what I found§f behind the furnace...

entries.source: Hmm.. I don't think this preview will fit here.
entries.translation: 嗯……我觉得这个预览放不下。
entries.sampleRaw: §aHmm.. I don't think this preview will fit here.

entries.source: ✆ Hey adventurer!
✆ You're looking quite dapper today!
entries.translation: ✆ 你今天看起来相当帅气！

entries.source: ✆ Hm, my Abiphone Contact?
entries.translation: ✆ 嗯，我的 Abiphone 联系人？

entries.source: ✆ Sure, I guess I can do that.
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fSure, I guess I can do that.

entries.source: ✆ Give me a call whenever you want to access Taylor's Shop!
entries.translation: ✆ 想逛泰勒的商店时随时给我打电话！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §f§fGive me a call whenever you want to access §bTaylor's Shop§f!

entries.source: ✆ Hey [player]!
✆ Just to let you know, my [Bundle Name] is now available for purchase!
entries.translation: ✆ 只是通知你一下，我的 [Bundle Name] 现在可以购买了！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fJust to let you know, my §7§l[Bundle Name] §fis now available for purchase!

entries.source: ✆ Give me a call anytime or drop by in person to check out what I've got for sale!
entries.translation: ✆ 随时给我打电话，或者亲自过来看看我在卖什么！
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fGive me a call anytime or drop by in person to check out what I've got for sale!

entries.source: Ah, a Bachelor's Rose? You want to view my exclusive Garden skin collection?
entries.translation: 啊,一朵单身汉玫瑰?你想看看我的专属花园皮肤系列吗?
entries.sampleRaw: Ah, a §cBachelor's Rose§f? You want to view my §oexclusive §rGarden skin collection?

entries.source: Unfortunately I only visit the Gardens of the best farmers in SkyBlock.
entries.translation: 可惜我只拜访 SkyBlock 中最优秀农夫的花园.
entries.sampleRaw: Unfortunately I only visit the §aGardens §fof the §obest §rfarmers in §aSkyBlock§f.

entries.source: Hi adventurer.
I have a pretty dashing cosmetic if you would care to exchange it for some rare crops.
entries.translation: 我有一件相当帅气的装饰品，如果你愿意用一些稀有作物来交换的话。
entries.sampleRaw: §fI have a pretty §odashing §fcosmetic if you would care to exchange it for some rare crops.

entries.source: I can see you value fashion over most farmers!
entries.translation: 我看得出来，你比大多数农夫更看重时尚！
entries.sampleRaw: §fI can see you value §afashion §fover most farmers!

entries.source: Cheers!
Such a shame.
Make sure to check out my Fashion Shop in the Hub to see if there's something you'd like more.
entries.translation: 记得去中心岛看看我的时装店，说不定有更合你心意的。
entries.sampleRaw: §fMake sure to check out my §bFashion Shop §fin the §aHub §fto see if there's something you'd like more.

entries.source: Hello!
You look dashing today!
Are you looking to go to a specific room?
entries.translation: 你想去某个特定的房间吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Are you looking to go to a specific room?

entries.source: I am Dr Emmett, the first human to manage entering the Rift.
entries.translation: 我是 Emmett 博士，第一个成功进入裂隙的人类。
entries.sampleRaw: I am Dr Emmett, the first §e§ohuman§f to manage entering the §5Rift§f.

entries.source: I built the Mirrorverse to better understand portals and their behaviors.
entries.translation: 我建造镜像世界，是为了更好地理解传送门及其行为。
entries.sampleRaw: I built the Mirrorverse to better understand §dportals §fand their behaviors.

entries.source: While I couldn't quite figure out portals, I did manage to let the mirror dimension interact with the real world and vice versa.
entries.translation: 虽然我没能完全弄明白传送门，但我确实设法让镜像维度与现实世界相互影响。
entries.sampleRaw: While I couldn't quite figure out §dportals§f, I did manage to let the §lmirror dimension§f interact with the real world and vice versa.

entries.source: You can learn all of the secrets through the many rooms I built.
entries.translation: 你可以通过我建造的许多房间了解所有秘密。
entries.sampleRaw: You can learn all of the secrets through the many rooms I built.

entries.source: In every room I've placed a button in case you want to back out.
entries.translation: 我在每个房间都放了一个按钮，以防你想退出。
entries.sampleRaw: In every room I've placed a §abutton§f in case you want to back out.

entries.source: Hey! Don't forget the first lever in this room!
entries.translation: 嘿！别忘了这个房间里的第一个拉杆！
entries.sampleRaw: Hey! Don't forget the first lever in this room!

entries.source: Some of the experiments have harder difficulty challenges with unique rewards.
entries.translation: 有些实验设有更高难度的挑战，并带有独特奖励。
entries.sampleRaw: Some of the experiments have §charder difficulty§f challenges with unique rewards.

entries.source: You may activate it in this room using the hidden wooden button.
entries.translation: 你可以在这个房间里用隐藏的木按钮激活它。
entries.sampleRaw: You may activate it in this room using the hidden wooden button.

entries.source: I am actually stuck in the Mirrorverse.
entries.translation: 其实我被困在镜像世界里了。
entries.sampleRaw: I am actually stuck in the Mirrorverse.

entries.source: I do not have a physical representation anymore...
entries.translation: 我已经没有实体形态了……
entries.sampleRaw: I do not have a §ophysical§f representation anymore...

entries.source: Anyway!
In this puzzle experiment, toggle which mirror is active by clicking on it.
entries.translation: 在这个解谜实验中，点击镜子即可切换哪面镜子处于激活状态。
entries.sampleRaw: In this puzzle experiment, toggle which mirror is active by clicking on it.

entries.source: Try to think outside the box...
entries.sampleRaw: Try to think outside the box...

entries.source: Also make sure to check all sides of the box.
entries.translation: 另外，一定要检查盒子的所有面。
entries.sampleRaw: Also make sure to check all sides of the box.

entries.source: If only I had used my head fully, I wouldn't be stuck in a bunch of mirrors.
entries.translation: 要是我当初充分动动脑子，就不会被困在一堆镜子里了。
entries.sampleRaw: If only I had used my head fully, I wouldn't be stuck in a bunch of mirrors.

entries.source: Pro tip! If you have a hard time reaching the iron door, try stepping on the wood above the button.
entries.translation: 专业提示！如果你很难够到铁门，试着踩在按钮上方的木头上。
entries.sampleRaw: Pro tip! If you have a hard time reaching the iron door, try stepping on the wood above the button.

entries.source: I wish someone had given me a pro tip before I started studying the breach.
entries.translation: 我希望在我开始研究裂隙之前，也有人给我一个专业提示。
entries.sampleRaw: I wish someone had given me a pro tip before I started studying the §5breach§f.

entries.source: It was my unbound thirst of knowledge which brought me to the Rift.
entries.translation: 正是我对知识无拘无束的渴求，把我带到了裂隙。
entries.sampleRaw: It was my §dunbound§f thirst of knowledge which brought me to the §5Rift§f.

entries.source: I built the Mirrorverse to better understand the Calamity.
entries.translation: 我建造镜像世界，是为了更好地理解灾厄。
entries.sampleRaw: I built the Mirrorverse to better understand the §4Calamity§f.

entries.source: This is the Tubulator. You will need my lazer pointer.
entries.translation: 这是管道器。你需要我的激光笔。
entries.sampleRaw: This is the Tubulator. You will need my lazer pointer.

entries.source: Go on!
Time is infinite, but you can still run out of it!
entries.translation: 时间无穷无尽，但你仍可能把它耗尽！
entries.sampleRaw: Time is infinite, but you can still run out of it!

entries.source: Congratulations!
You reached the end of the Mirrorverse.
entries.translation: 你到达了镜像世界的终点。
entries.sampleRaw: You reached the end of the Mirrorverse.

entries.source: I hope you gained valuable insights here.
entries.translation: 希望你能在这里获得宝贵的见解。
entries.sampleRaw: I hope you gained valuable insights here.

entries.source: Accept these Motes as a reward for your efforts.
entries.translation: 请收下这些裂隙尘埃，作为你努力的奖励。
entries.sampleRaw: Accept these §dMotes§f as a reward for your efforts.

entries.source: Is there anything else I can assist you with?
entries.translation: 还有什么我能帮你的吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Is there anything else I can assist you with?

entries.source: Very well, may you lead a fulfilling life!
entries.translation: 很好，愿你过上充实的人生！
entries.sampleRaw: Very well, may you lead a fulfilling life!

entries.source: Ask away! I got time...
entries.translation: 尽管问吧!我有的是时间……

entries.source: They were unable to do so because the time distortion at the summit is too intense, while the woods offered a more manageable environment.
entries.translation: 他们无法这样做，因为峰顶的时间扭曲太过强烈，而树林则提供了更可控的环境。
entries.sampleRaw: They were unable to do so because the time distortion at the summit is too intense, while the §awoods§f offered a more manageable environment.

entries.source: Especially stabilized by the aura of the nearby Fairy.
entries.translation: 尤其受到附近仙子的光环所稳定。
entries.sampleRaw: Especially stabilized by the aura of the nearby §dFairy§f.

entries.source: This is highly sensitive information.
It is related to the Precursors, but I cannot say more.
entries.translation: 这与先驱者有关，但我不能多说。
entries.sampleRaw: It is related to the §4Precursors§f, but I cannot say more.

entries.source: While studying the breach at the top of the mountain....
entries.sampleRaw: While studying the §5breach§f at the top of the mountain....

entries.source: ... I made a critical discovery, which MUST remain confidential.
entries.translation: ……我有了一个关键发现，此事必须保密。
entries.sampleRaw: ... I made a §ccritical§f discovery, which MUST remain confidential.

entries.source: I entrusted a letter containing my findings to Lathrop for delivery.
entries.translation: 我把一封写有研究发现的信交给 Lathrop 投递。
entries.sampleRaw: I entrusted a letter containing my findings to §cLathrop§f for delivery.

entries.source: As the letter never reached the wizard, I had Alatar summon an exact copy of it.
entries.translation: 由于信从未送到巫师手中，我便让 Alatar 召唤了一封完全相同的副本。
entries.sampleRaw: As the letter never reached the wizard, I had §eAlatar§f summon an exact copy of it.

entries.source: I threw the letter into the breach, which broke the laws of causality.
entries.translation: 我把信扔进了裂隙，这打破了因果律。
entries.sampleRaw: I threw the letter into the §5breach§f, which broke the laws of causality.

entries.source: I instantly appeared here, shattered by my boneheaded decision-making and eternally trapped.
entries.translation: 我瞬间出现在这里，因自己愚蠢的决定而支离破碎，并被永远困住。
entries.sampleRaw: I §einstantly§f appeared here, §bshattered§f by my boneheaded decision-making and §deternally trapped§f.

entries.source: But I've been continuing my research.
entries.translation: 但我一直在继续我的研究。
entries.sampleRaw: But I've been continuing my research.

entries.source: You're part of it.
May you lead a fulfilling life!
entries.sampleRaw: May you lead a fulfilling life!

entries.source: It's you again.
Yes?
Really? Ramero is about to die?
What fantastic news!
No, unfortunately I do not have it in me to do the deed myself.
entries.translation: 不，很遗憾，我没有亲手动手的胆量。
entries.sampleRaw: §fNo, unfortunately I do not have it in me to do the deed myself.

entries.source: I will gladly sell you the murder weapon however.
entries.translation: 不过我很乐意把凶器卖给你。
entries.sampleRaw: §fI will gladly sell you the murder weapon however.

entries.source: Help yourself.
Nice doing business with you.
Good luck on solving the case.
Hello.
Do you need anything else to solve your case?
entries.translation: 你还需要别的东西来破案吗？
entries.sampleRaw: §fDo you need anything else to solve your case?

entries.source: Brilliant!
You did that so quickly!
I'm glad people like you exist!
entries.translation: 我很高兴有你这样的人存在！

entries.source: Absolutely not.
Why would I do that?
So where is his body?
Are you sure you killed him?
That's very strange because I just saw you leave to the Blacksmith to find more clues.
entries.translation: 那就很奇怪了，因为我刚看到你离开去铁匠铺寻找更多线索。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThat's very strange because I just saw you leave to the Blacksmith to find more clues.

entries.source: I swear.
You bought the Murder Weapon and left just a moment ago.
entries.translation: 你买下了凶器，而且刚刚才离开。
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou bought the §cMurder Weapon §fand left just a moment ago.

entries.source: Maybe you should go there and find out for yourself.
entries.translation: 也许你该去那里亲自查个明白。
entries.sampleRaw: §fMaybe you should go there and find out for yourself.

entries.source: In any case, if Ramero is indeed dead, I have a place to be right now.
entries.translation: 无论如何，如果 Ramero 真的死了，我现在有个地方要去。
entries.sampleRaw: §fIn any case, if §bRamero §fis indeed dead, I have a place to be right now.

entries.source: You lied to me!
I thought you murdered Ramero!
entries.translation: 我还以为是你谋杀了 Ramero！

entries.source: I look like a fool now.
entries.translation: 我现在看起来像个傻瓜。

entries.source: I even sold you the murder weapon!
entries.translation: 我甚至把凶器卖给了你！
entries.sampleRaw: §fI even sold you the murder weapon!

entries.source: Really, you disappoint me.
Don't forget to report bugs on the forums!
entries.translation: 别忘了在论坛上报告漏洞！
entries.sampleRaw: Don't forget to report bugs on the forums!

entries.source: If you find an exploit you can even report it directly to a staff member!
entries.translation: 如果你发现了漏洞，甚至可以直接向工作人员报告！
entries.sampleRaw: If you find an exploit you can even report it directly to a staff member!

entries.source: Have you seen Arthur's Wheat Minion? Witchcraft, I say!
entries.translation: 你见过 Arthur 的小麦仆从吗？要我说，那是巫术！
entries.sampleRaw: Have you seen Arthur's §eWheat Minion§f? Witchcraft, I say!

entries.source: I can hear that cow mooing all the way over here.
entries.translation: 我在这儿都能听到那头牛哞哞叫。
entries.sampleRaw: I can hear that cow mooing all the way over here.

entries.source: I should have thought about that before buying this house!
entries.translation: 买这房子之前我就该想到这一点！
entries.sampleRaw: I should have thought about that before buying this house!

entries.source: WELCOME! Plenty of room here for all of your needs!
entries.translation: 欢迎！这里有充足的空间满足你的一切需求！
entries.sampleRaw: WELCOME! Plenty of room here for all of your needs!

entries.source: Have you been to the Wilderness? I hear there is a creepy bar there.
entries.translation: 你去过荒野吗？我听说那里有一家阴森的酒馆。
entries.sampleRaw: Have you been to the §2Wilderness§f? I hear there is a creepy bar there.

entries.source: Darn it, where did I leave my belongings? Those Fairies must be up to no good.
entries.translation: 可恶，我把东西放哪儿了？那些仙女肯定在搞鬼。
entries.sampleRaw: Darn it, where did I leave my belongings? Those §dFairies§f must be up to no good.

entries.source: If you have more than one of the same type of Accessory in your inventory, only one will work!
entries.translation: 如果你的物品栏里有多个同类型的饰品，只有一件会生效！
entries.sampleRaw: If you have more than one of the same type of Accessory in your inventory, §conly one§f will work!

entries.source: Don't forget to report bugs on the forums!
entries.translation: 别忘了在论坛上报告漏洞！
entries.sampleRaw: Don't forget to report bugs on the forums!

entries.source: If you find an exploit you can even report it directly to a staff member!
entries.translation: 如果你发现了漏洞，甚至可以直接向工作人员报告！
entries.sampleRaw: If you find an exploit you can even report it directly to a staff member!

entries.source: Have you heard of a strange land called Earth? A year here is only 5 days and 4 hours there!
entries.translation: 你听说过一个叫地球的奇怪地方吗？这里的一年在那里只有 5 天 4 小时！
entries.sampleRaw: Have you heard of a strange land called Earth? A year here is only 5 days and 4 hours there!
entries.numericSource: Have you heard of a strange land called Earth? A year here is only {{N0}} days and {{N1}} hours there!
entries.numericTranslation: 你听说过一个叫地球的奇怪地方吗？这里的一年在那里只有 {{N0}} 天 {{N1}} 小时！

entries.source: There are 31 days in a month! Who decided that?
entries.translation: 一个月有 31 天！这是谁定的？
entries.sampleRaw: There are 31 days in a month! Who decided that?
entries.numericSource: There are {{N0}} days in a month! Who decided that?
entries.numericTranslation: 一个月有 {{N0}} 天！这是谁定的？

entries.source: Have you heard of a strange land called Earth? A year here is only 5 days and 4 hours there!
entries.translation: 你听说过一个叫地球的奇怪地方吗？这里的一年在那里只有 5 天 4 小时！
entries.sampleRaw: Have you heard of a strange land called Earth? A year here is only 5 days and 4 hours there!
entries.numericSource: Have you heard of a strange land called Earth? A year here is only {{N0}} days and {{N1}} hours there!
entries.numericTranslation: 你听说过一个叫地球的奇怪地方吗？这里的一年在那里只有 {{N0}} 天 {{N1}} 小时！

entries.source: There are 31 days in a month! Who decided that?
entries.translation: 一个月有 31 天！这是谁决定的？
entries.sampleRaw: There are 31 days in a month! Who decided that?
entries.numericSource: There are {{N0}} days in a month! Who decided that?
entries.numericTranslation: 一个月有 {{N0}} 天！这是谁决定的？

entries.source: I've traveled this far..
And there's nothing here!
Wife asked me to get a can of worms.
entries.translation: 老婆让我去买一罐蠕虫。
entries.sampleRaw: Wife asked me to get a can of worms.

entries.source: So you know, I dig down to the grocery store.
entries.translation: 你知道的，我一路往下挖到了杂货店。
entries.sampleRaw: So you know, I dig down to the grocery store.

entries.source: I must've missed it since I ended up here.
entries.translation: 我肯定是错过了，因为我最后到了这里。
entries.sampleRaw: I must've missed it since I ended up here.

entries.source: Guess things tend to go full circle over time.
entries.translation: 看来事情总会兜兜转转回到原点。
entries.sampleRaw: Guess things tend to go full circle over time.

entries.source: Wanna go full circle?
Jump down to the pillar down there.
entries.sampleRaw: Jump down to the pillar down there.

entries.source: Then the next one...
Surely you'll be here again eventually.
entries.translation: 你最终肯定还会回到这里的。
entries.sampleRaw: Surely you'll be here again eventually.

entries.source: Go ahead.
Jump on the pillar!
If I can see it, you can too!
entries.translation: 如果我能看见，你也一定能看见！
entries.sampleRaw: If I can see it, you can too!

entries.source: See?
Full circle.
Back in my day, booster cookies were 800k.
entries.sampleRaw: Back in my day, booster cookies were §6800k§f.
entries.numericSource: Back in my day, booster cookies were {{N0}}k.

entries.source: Nice day to go fishing, isn't it?
entries.translation: 今天真是钓鱼的好日子，不是吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Nice day to go fishing, isn't it?

entries.source: The crew has been stranded here for so long.
entries.translation: 船员们被困在这里已经太久了。
entries.sampleRaw: The crew has been stranded here for so long.

entries.source: But honestly, the more I get to know these guys...
entries.translation: 但说实话，我越了解这些家伙……
entries.sampleRaw: But honestly, the more I get to know these guys...

entries.source: ...the more I like them!
Oh!
I found this when we arrived, maybe you can use it?
entries.translation: 我们刚到这里时我发现了这个，也许你能用得上？
entries.sampleRaw: I found §5this§f when we arrived, maybe you can use it?

entries.source: I am Wizardman!
How are you doing little fellow?
entries.sampleRaw: How are you doing little fellow?

entries.source: Do you need the help of Wizardman?
entries.translation: 你需要 Wizardman 的帮助吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Do you need the help of Wizardman?

entries.source: All you have to do is scream "Help Wizardman!" and I'll come save you if I'm not too busy.
entries.translation: 你只要大喊“救命啊 Wizardman！”，如果我不太忙的话，就会来救你。
entries.sampleRaw: All you have to do is scream "§bHelp Wizardman!§f" and I'll come save you if I'm not too busy.

entries.source: Ah.
Sorry young companion, someone needs me!
entries.translation: 抱歉，年轻伙伴，有人需要我！
entries.sampleRaw: Sorry young companion, someone needs me!

entries.source: I've got to skedaddle.
Sorry little fellow, I'm busy right now!
entries.translation: 抱歉小家伙，我现在很忙！
entries.sampleRaw: Sorry little fellow, I'm busy right now!

entries.source: Maybe don't disturb me when I'm trying to save the multiverse!
entries.translation: 我在拯救多元宇宙的时候，也许别来打扰我！
entries.sampleRaw: Maybe don't disturb me when I'm trying to save the multiverse!

entries.source: Of course.
Sure thing, little one.
Back off and watch the pro.
My job here is done.
entries.translation: 我在这里的任务完成了。

entries.source: Cya losers.
I knew you'd come.
I've seen hundreds of iterations of you, all from different dimensions, who have come before me seeking to claim the title of Wizardman.
entries.translation: 我见过数百个你,全都来自不同的维度,他们在我面前寻求夺取Wizardman的称号.
entries.sampleRaw: I've seen hundreds of iterations of §c§oyou§r§f, all from different dimensions, who have come before me seeking to claim the title of §5Wizardman§f.

entries.source: If you aspire to take my place, you must first defeat me.
entries.translation: 如果你想取代我，就必须先击败我。
entries.sampleRaw: If you aspire to take my place, you must first defeat me.

entries.source: Are you ready to rise above your predecessors?
entries.translation: 你准备好超越你的前辈了吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Are you ready to rise above your predecessors?

entries.source: Are you prepared to succeed where they have faltered?
entries.translation: 你准备好在前辈们失败的地方取得成功了吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Are you prepared to §asucceed §fwhere they have §cfaltered§f?

entries.source: Excellent. Let's find out if you are merely another echo, or if you are the one.
entries.translation: 很好。让我们看看你只是又一个回声，还是那个唯一。
entries.sampleRaw: Excellent. Let's find out if you are merely another echo, or if you are the §done§f.

entries.source: Choose from the three Trials before you.
entries.translation: 从你面前的三个试炼中选择一个。

entries.source: Each is designed to test your mettle in its own unique way.
entries.translation: 每一个都以独特的方式考验你的勇气。
entries.sampleRaw: Each is designed to test your mettle in its own unique way.

entries.source: You now have enough Fragments to assemble my Armor.
entries.translation: 你现在有足够的碎片来组装我的盔甲了。
entries.sampleRaw: You now have enough Fragments to assemble my Armor.

entries.source: Put on your new armor and speak to me.
entries.translation: 穿上你的新盔甲，然后来和我说话。
entries.sampleRaw: Put on your new armor and speak to me.

entries.source: Well then.
You are the first one of your kind to defeat me and craft this armor.
entries.translation: 你是同类中第一个击败我并制作出这套盔甲的人。
entries.sampleRaw: You are the first one of your kind to defeat me and craft this armor.

entries.source: I, too, once stood in your shoes, having overthrown the Wizardman before me.
entries.translation: 我也曾站在你的位置上，推翻了我之前的Wizardman。
entries.sampleRaw: I, too, once stood in your shoes, having overthrown the Wizardman before me.

entries.source: It is time for you to become Wizardman.
entries.sampleRaw: It is time for you to become Wizardman.

entries.source: Understand this: Wizardman is not merely a person; it is a concept, a legacy handed down through generations, striving towards a singular dream.
entries.translation: 你要明白：Wizardman不仅仅是一个人；它是一个概念，一份代代相传的传承，为了一个共同的梦想而奋斗。
entries.sampleRaw: Understand this: Wizardman is not merely a §5§operson§f; it is a concept, a legacy handed down through generations, striving towards a singular dream.

entries.source: Together, one of us will eventually mend the rift and repair the Breach atop the mountain.
entries.translation: 我们中的一人终将共同修补裂隙，修复山顶上的裂口。
entries.sampleRaw: Together, one of us will eventually mend the rift and repair the Breach atop the mountain.

entries.source: Though I faltered, perhaps you will prevail.
entries.translation: 虽然我失败了，但也许你会成功。
entries.sampleRaw: Though I faltered, perhaps you will prevail.

entries.source: You are only missing one part of the armor to become Wizardman.
entries.translation: 你只差一件盔甲部件就能成为Wizardman了。
entries.sampleRaw: You are only missing one part of the armor to become Wizardman.

entries.source: Take this, the final piece.
Now, wear it.
You're lucky I keep a spare in my back pocket!
entries.translation: 算你走运，我后兜里还留着一个备用的！
entries.sampleRaw: You're lucky I keep a spare in my back pocket!

entries.source: I've been watching over you this whole time...
entries.sampleRaw: I've been watching over you this whole time...

entries.source: I remember when you proved your identity to the Eleanors...
entries.translation: 我记得你向埃莉诺们证明自己身份的时候……
entries.sampleRaw: I remember when you proved your identity to the §dEleanors§f...

entries.source: When your blood was first drained by the Riftstalker Bloodfiend...
entries.translation: 当你的血液第一次被裂隙追猎者血魔吸干时……
entries.sampleRaw: When your blood was first drained by the §4Riftstalker Bloodfiend§f...

entries.source: When you first went to battle with Bacte...
entries.translation: 当你第一次与巴克特交战时……
entries.sampleRaw: When you first went to battle with §aBacte§f...

entries.source: When you first ventured deeper into the Living Cave...
entries.translation: 当你第一次深入活体洞穴时……
entries.sampleRaw: When you first ventured deeper into the §9Living Cave§f...

entries.source: When you first explored the Village Pla-
entries.translation: 当你第一次探索村庄广-
entries.sampleRaw: When you first explored the §eVillage Pla§f-

entries.source: Oh... I actually don't remember this...
entries.translation: 哦……这段我居然不记得了……
entries.sampleRaw: Oh... I actually don't remember this...

entries.source: I watched your back as you vacuumed up vermin...
entries.translation: 你吸走害虫时，我在背后替你望风……
entries.sampleRaw: I watched your back as you vacuumed up vermin...

entries.source: When you murdered the innocent Ramero...
When you raced around collecting hot dogs for Joey McPizza...
entries.translation: 当你四处奔波为Joey McPizza收集热狗时……
entries.sampleRaw: When you raced around collecting hot dogs for §cJoey McPizza§f...

entries.sampleRaw: When you were on the hunt for §5Enigma Souls§f...

entries.source: When you wandered past the Montezuma fragments...
entries.translation: 当你路过蒙特祖玛碎片时……

entries.source: When you first learned to count to 10...

entries.sampleRaw: When you first learned to count to 10...
entries.numericSource: When you first learned to count to {{N0}}...
entries.numericTranslation: 当你第一次学会数到{{N0}}时……

All you have to do is scream "Help Wizardman" and I'll come save you if I'm not too busy.
entries.translation: 你只需要大喊“救命Wizardman”，只要我不太忙，就会来救你。
entries.sampleRaw: All you have to do is scream "§cHelp Wizardman§f" and I'll come save you if I'm not too busy.

entries.source: So, you believe you can outpace me in a Temporal Race?
entries.translation: 所以，你觉得自己能在时间竞速中跑赢我？
entries.sampleRaw: So, you believe you can outpace me in a §9Temporal Race§f?

entries.source: I find that quite ambitious.
Follow me to the Trial Grounds, let's put that confidence to the test.
entries.translation: 跟我去试炼场，让我们检验一下你的自信。
entries.sampleRaw: Follow me to the §5Trial Grounds§f, let's put that confidence to the test.

entries.source: The rules are straightforward. Once you signal readiness, we race.
entries.translation: 规则很简单。你一旦示意准备好，我们就开跑。
entries.sampleRaw: The rules are straightforward. Once you signal readiness, we race.

entries.source: Have you grasped all the details, little one?
entries.translation: 小家伙，所有细节都弄明白了吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Have you grasped all the details, little one?

entries.source: Remember, we race when you signal readiness.
entries.translation: 记住，你示意准备好后我们就开跑。
entries.sampleRaw: Remember, we race when you signal readiness.

entries.source: Let's race! Good luck to you!
entries.sampleRaw: Let's race! Good luck to you!

entries.source: No one can match these raw skillz!
entries.translation: 没人比得上我这身纯熟技巧！
entries.sampleRaw: No one can match these raw skillz!

entries.source: You are proving quite formidable... well played.
entries.translation: 你还真是相当厉害……干得漂亮。
entries.sampleRaw: You are proving quite formidable... well played.

entries.source: You can't catch me!
I'm the best! Me, Wizardman! The best!
entries.sampleRaw: I'm the best! Me, Wizardman! The best!

entries.source: Nicely done! I didn't see that coming.
entries.translation: 干得漂亮！我完全没料到。
entries.sampleRaw: Nicely done! I didn't see that coming.

entries.source: A minor setback...
Ah, a clever tactic! You've set me back.
entries.translation: 啊，好聪明的战术！你让我落后了。
entries.sampleRaw: Ah, a clever tactic! You've set me back.

entries.source: Whoops! That doesn't usually happen!
You saw nothing...
Already? But I haven't finished yet!
entries.translation: 已经结束了？可我还没完成呢！
entries.sampleRaw: Already? But I haven't finished yet!

entries.source: This is a shocking turn of events!
entries.translation: 这真是令人震惊的转折！
entries.sampleRaw: This is a shocking turn of events!

entries.source: Wait, what? How...?
I win. Ha!
That must be a new personal best for me!
entries.translation: 这一定是我新的个人最佳成绩！
entries.sampleRaw: That must be a new personal best for me!

entries.source: I knew I'd win!
<playername>, truly an impressive finish.
You have bested me, this time.
entries.sampleRaw: You have bested me, this time.

entries.source: For your victory, you have earned a Fragment of my armor.
entries.translation: 作为胜利的奖励，你获得了我盔甲的一块碎片。
entries.sampleRaw: For your victory, you have earned a Fragment of my armor.

entries.source: Keep it safe, for it is a piece of my power.
entries.translation: 好好保管它，因为那是我力量的一部分。
entries.sampleRaw: Keep it safe, for it is a piece of my power.

entries.source: Once again, victory eludes you in the face of Wizardman, as it has for your countless predecessors.
entries.translation: 又一次，在Wizardman面前，胜利与你无缘，正如你无数前辈所经历的那样。
entries.sampleRaw: Once again, victory eludes you in the face of Wizardman, as it has for your countless predecessors.

entries.source: Would you care to challenge me again, or would you prefer to attempt a different Trial?
entries.translation: 你想再次挑战我，还是更愿意尝试另一项试炼？
entries.sampleRaw: Would you care to challenge me again, or would you prefer to attempt a different Trial?

entries.source: Oh, you need a moment? Let's go back so you can decide what to do next.
entries.translation: 哦，你需要一点时间？我们回去吧，这样你可以决定接下来做什么。
entries.sampleRaw: §fOh, you need a moment? Let's go back so you can decide what to do next.

entries.source: Very well.
A Brawl, you've chosen.
Very well then, to the Wizard Brawl we go.
entries.translation: 那好吧，我们前往巫师乱斗场。
entries.sampleRaw: Very well then, to the §5Wizard Brawl §fwe go.

entries.source: To aid you in our duel, you will need this magical wand.
entries.translation: 为了协助我们的决斗，你需要这根魔法法杖。
entries.sampleRaw: To aid you in our duel, you will need this magical wand.

entries.source: This legendary item once vanquished a dire menace to humanity in my home dimension.
entries.translation: 这件传说物品曾在我的故乡维度中消灭了一个对人类构成严重威胁的敌人。
entries.sampleRaw: This legendary item once vanquished a dire menace to humanity in my home dimension.

entries.source: Today, it shall serve us in our brawl.
entries.translation: 今天，它将在我们的乱斗中为我们效力。
entries.sampleRaw: Today, it shall serve us in our brawl.

entries.source: The rules here are simple: In this arena, you may fly, like Wizardman.
entries.translation: 这里的规则很简单：在这个竞技场中，你可以像Wizardman一样飞行。
entries.sampleRaw: The rules here are simple: In this arena, you may §d§ofly§r§f, like Wizardman.

entries.source: The first to deplete the other's ❤ Hearts shall be declared the winner.
entries.translation: 先耗尽对方❤颗心的人将被宣布为胜者。
entries.sampleRaw: The first to deplete the other's §c❤ Hearts §fshall be declared the winner.

entries.source: Are you prepared?
Then let our brawl commence!
entries.translation: 那就让我们的较量开始吧！

entries.source: I have people waiting for me. I cannot stay.
entries.translation: 我还有人在等我。我不能久留。
entries.sampleRaw: §fI have people waiting for me. I cannot stay.

entries.source: Come back when you're actually ready!
entries.translation: 等你真正准备好了再来吧！

entries.source: You handle yourself well, but it's far from over.
entries.translation: 你应对得不错，但还远未结束。
entries.sampleRaw: You handle yourself well, but it's far from over.

entries.source: Let's see if your endurance matches your spirit.
entries.translation: 让我们看看你的耐力是否配得上你的斗志。
entries.sampleRaw: Let's see if your endurance matches your spirit.

entries.source: Well done! You've proven more formidable than I had anticipated.
entries.translation: 干得好！你证明了自己比我预想的更加强大。
entries.sampleRaw: Well done! You've proven more formidable than I had anticipated.

entries.source: Remarkable resolve!
But beware, desperation lends me strength.
entries.translation: 但要当心，绝境会赋予我力量。
entries.sampleRaw: But beware, desperation lends me strength.

entries.source: You've pushed me to the brink.
entries.sampleRaw: You've pushed me to the brink.

entries.source: But don't underestimate a Wizardman's last stand.
entries.sampleRaw: But don't underestimate a Wizardman's last stand.

entries.source: It seems I may have met my match.
entries.translation: 看来我或许遇到了对手。
entries.sampleRaw: It seems I may have met my match.

entries.source: You have bested me, a feat none other can claim.
entries.translation: 你击败了我，这是无人能及的壮举。
entries.sampleRaw: You have bested me, a feat none other can claim.

entries.source: Hold this triumph close, as many will look to challenge it.
entries.translation: 好好珍惜这份胜利，因为许多人都会想要挑战它。
entries.sampleRaw: Hold this triumph close, as many will look to challenge it.

entries.source: For your victory, you've earned a Fragment of my armor.
entries.translation: 作为胜利的奖赏，你赢得了一块我盔甲的碎片。
entries.sampleRaw: For your victory, you've earned a Fragment of my armor.

entries.source: It appears you're not quite ready to play in the league of wizards, little fellow.
entries.translation: 看来你还没准备好与巫师们同场竞技，小家伙。
entries.sampleRaw: It appears you're not quite ready to play in the league of wizards, little fellow.

entries.source: Reflect, learn, and try once more.
entries.translation: 反思、学习，然后再试一次。
entries.sampleRaw: Reflect, learn, and try once more.

entries.source: Ah, little fellow, it seems this isn't your moment.
entries.translation: 啊，小家伙，看来这还不是你的时刻。
entries.sampleRaw: Ah, little fellow, it seems this isn't your moment.

entries.source: Return when the gaps in your skill are filled.
entries.translation: 等你弥补了技艺上的不足再回来吧。
entries.sampleRaw: Return when the gaps in your skill are filled.

entries.source: Remember, never let your guard down. Defeat me in battle!
entries.translation: 记住，永远不要放松警惕。在战斗中击败我！
entries.sampleRaw: Remember, never let your guard down. Defeat me in battle!

entries.source: Let's do this.
Ah, the Quad Link Legacy! A personal favorite of mine.
entries.translation: 啊，四连传承！我的个人最爱。
entries.sampleRaw: Ah, the §eQuad Link Legacy§f! A personal favorite of mine.

entries.source: Prepare yourself for a battle of wits.
entries.translation: 准备好迎接一场智力的较量吧。
entries.sampleRaw: Prepare yourself for a battle of wits.

entries.source: Would you like to review the rules?
entries.sampleRaw: Would you like to review the rules?

entries.sampleRaw: Each turn, we will choose a column to drop a colored token into the lowest open slot.

entries.sampleRaw: The first to align §6four tokens §fof their color in a row claims victory!

entries.sampleRaw: Now that you know the rules, let's begin.

entries.source: Very well, let's begin then.
Very well. I will not ask you again.
entries.sampleRaw: Very well. I will not ask you again.

I'm thinking two steps ahead... hmmm...
entries.translation: 我正在思考两步之后的棋……嗯……
entries.sampleRaw: I'm thinking two steps ahead... hmmm...

entries.source: Hmmmm, what can I play to win?
entries.translation: 嗯嗯，我该走哪一步才能赢呢？
entries.sampleRaw: Hmmmm, what can I play to win?

entries.source: Do not rush the almighty Wizardman.
entries.sampleRaw: Do not rush the almighty Wizardman.

entries.source: Well played!
It seems I've underestimated your capacity for foresight and planning.
entries.translation: 看来我低估了你深谋远虑和运筹帷幄的能力。
entries.sampleRaw: It seems I've underestimated your capacity for foresight and planning.

entries.translation: 总有一天我们会下完这盘棋的，小家伙。
entries.sampleRaw: §fWe will complete our match one day, little one.

entries.source: Ah, it seems the depths of wisdom still elude you.
entries.translation: 啊，看来智慧的深渊仍让你难以企及。
entries.sampleRaw: Ah, it seems the depths of wisdom still elude you.

entries.source: Return when the fogs of ignorance have lifted.

entries.sampleRaw: Return when the fogs of ignorance have lifted.

Unfortunately you didn't beat me.
Very well. Let's put your wits to the test.
entries.translation: 很好。让我们来考验一下你的智慧吧。
entries.sampleRaw: §fVery well. Let's put your wits to the test.

He doesn't want to face reality!
entries.sampleRaw: He doesn't want to face reality!

He doesn't want to hear us out!
entries.sampleRaw: He doesn't want to hear us out!

entries.sampleRaw: Prime Minister §bBarry§f should do my homework!!!

If Mary is 10 years old and Jamie is 25.

entries.numericSource: If Mary is {{N0}} years old and Jamie is {{N1}}.

entries.numericSource: And considering that Mary's time flows {{N0}} and a half times faster than Jamie's...

entries.sampleRaw: You'll know when you find it.

entries.sampleRaw: Do you need some items again?

entries.source: The crew and I have been stuck on this islet since we crossed the Rift.
entries.translation: 自从我们穿过裂隙后，我和船员们就一直被困在这座小岛上。
entries.sampleRaw: The crew and I have been stuck on this islet since we crossed the §5Rift§f.

entries.source: We navigated through the infinite ocean to come here.
entries.translation: 我们穿越了无尽之海才来到这里。
entries.sampleRaw: We navigated through the §3infinite ocean§f to come here.

entries.source: Alas, our boat broke into a million pieces when we were attacked by leeches.
entries.translation: 唉，我们遭到水蛭袭击时，船碎成了无数片。
entries.sampleRaw: Alas, our boat broke into a §cmillion pieces§f when we were attacked by leeches.

entries.source: Will you help me repair our boat?
entries.translation: 你愿意帮我修好我们的船吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Will you help me repair our §aboat§f?

entries.source: I'm still missing components to repair our boat.
entries.translation: 我还缺一些修理船所需的零件。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm still missing components to repair our §aboat§f.

entries.source: Will you help me find them?
entries.translation: 你愿意帮我找到它们吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Will you help me find them?

entries.source: We need to get out of here!
entries.sampleRaw: We need to get out of here!

entries.source: Thanks, we're now one step closer to repairing the boat!
entries.translation: 谢谢，我们离修好船又近了一步！
entries.sampleRaw: Thanks, we're now one step closer to repairing the §aboat§f!

entries.source: Excellent!
Our boat is finally repaired!
Kay and I will soon escape the Rift.
entries.translation: Kay和我很快就会逃离裂隙。
entries.sampleRaw: Kay and I will soon escape the §5Rift§f.

entries.source: Until then, I can make a boat for you using leftovers.
entries.translation: 在那之前，我可以用剩下的材料给你造一艘船。
entries.sampleRaw: Until then, I can make a §aboat§f for you using leftovers.

entries.source: For a price of course... he he.
entries.sampleRaw: For a price of course... he he.

entries.source: Thanks for delivering all the boat components.
entries.translation: 感谢你送来所有船零件。

entries.source: In the meantime, I can make a boat for you using leftovers.
entries.translation: 在此期间，我可以用剩下的材料给你造一艘船。
entries.sampleRaw: §fIn the meantime, I can make a §aboat §ffor you using leftovers.

entries.source: Uh... hi!
I'm kinda lonely. :(
If you could sit around with me, then you can get my soul! :)
entries.translation: 如果你能陪我坐一会儿，就能得到我的灵魂！:)
entries.sampleRaw: If you could sit around with me, then you can get my soul! §e:)

entries.source: But please don't do it only for the soul like everyone else. :(
entries.translation: 但请不要像其他人那样只为了灵魂才这么做。:(
entries.sampleRaw: But please don't do it only for the soul like everyone else. §9:(

entries.source: Hi!
It's a strange world uh?
You can pick a chair if you feel like it.
entries.translation: 如果你愿意，可以挑一把椅子。
entries.sampleRaw: You can pick a chair if you feel like it.

entries.source: You can take a seat nearby if you'd like.
entries.translation: 如果你愿意，可以在附近坐下。
entries.sampleRaw: You can take a seat nearby if you'd like.

entries.source: Feel free to keep me company or whatever.
entries.translation: 随便陪我坐坐什么的都行。
entries.sampleRaw: Feel free to keep me company or whatever.

entries.source: I'm sorry but I'm sitting at this table.
entries.translation: 抱歉，但我正坐在这张桌子旁。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm sorry but I'm sitting at this table.

entries.source: Could you go to another table?
[player], you're in my bubble right now.
entries.sampleRaw: §7[player]§f, you're in my bubble right now.

entries.source: Please sit at a different table.
Sorry but I'm sitting at this table.
entries.translation: 抱歉，但我坐在这张桌子旁。
entries.sampleRaw: Sorry but I'm sitting at this table.

entries.source: Can you please sit at a different table?
entries.translation: 你能坐到别的桌子去吗？

styleMappings.Can you please sit at a different table?: 你能坐到别的桌子去吗？

entries.sampleRaw: §cCan you please sit at a different table?

entries.source: I appreciate the company...
But could you sit at another table please?
entries.translation: 但你能坐到另一张桌子去吗？

styleMappings.But could you sit at another table pleas: 但你能坐到另一张桌子去吗？

entries.sampleRaw: §cBut could you sit at another table please?

entries.source: Uh...
I'm sitting at this table.
You're kind of in my bubble.
entries.translation: 你有点闯进我的私人空间了。
entries.sampleRaw: You're kind of in my bubble.

entries.source: Please sit elsewhere.
Sorry, I'm busy right now.
I'm working on the next big thing!
entries.translation: 我正在研究下一个大发明！
entries.sampleRaw: I'm working on the §dnext big thing§f!

entries.source: I finally did it!
Finally figured it out!
By combining the magic of the Rift with the rest of the universe...
entries.translation: 通过将裂隙的魔法与宇宙的其余部分结合……
entries.sampleRaw: By combining the §5magic §fof the §dRift §fwith the rest of the §auniverse§f...

entries.source: ... I'm able to create the most powerful necklace ever devised.
entries.translation: ……我就能创造出有史以来最强大的项链。
entries.sampleRaw: ... I'm able to create the §cmost powerful necklace §fever devised.

entries.source: Of course! But there's one tiny hiccup...
entries.translation: 当然！但有一个小小的障碍……
entries.sampleRaw: Of course! But there's one tiny hiccup...

entries.source: In order to combine the magic, we will need to have the magic.
entries.translation: 为了结合魔法，我们需要先拥有魔法。
entries.sampleRaw: In order to §ocombine §fthe §5magic§f, we will need to §ohave §fthe §5magic§f.

entries.source: But I suppose for an adventurer of your caliber, traversing the weirdest parallel universe...
entries.translation: 但我想，对于你这种水准的冒险者来说，穿越最诡异的平行宇宙……
entries.sampleRaw: §fBut I suppose for an adventurer of your caliber, traversing the §dweirdest §fparallel universe...

entries.source: Avoiding being stuck forever...
Dodging giant, triple-stacked, INSTAKILLING temporal pillars...
entries.translation: 躲避巨大的、三重叠加的、一击必杀的时间柱……

entries.source: Potentially fighting vampires...
entries.translation: 可能还要与吸血鬼战斗……

entries.source: Is NO problem at all?
Very well.
First, bring me the Supreme Timecharm.
entries.translation: 首先，把至尊时间护符带给我。

entries.source: Despite the name, it's not the best one.
entries.translation: 尽管名字如此，它并不是最好的那个。
entries.sampleRaw: §fDespite the name, it's not the best one.

entries.source: It's the first of like 8 Timecharms.
entries.translation: 它是大约 8 个时间护符中的第一个.
entries.numericSource: It's the first of like {{N0}} Timecharms.
entries.numericTranslation: 它是大约 {{N0}} 个时间护符中的第一个.

entries.source: We'll need that before going any further.
entries.translation: 在继续之前我们需要它。
entries.sampleRaw: We'll need that before going any further.

entries.source: Find the Supreme Timecharm somewhere in the Rift.
entries.translation: 在裂隙的某处找到至尊时间护符。

entries.source: And only then can we move forward with the necklace.
entries.translation: 只有到那时，我们才能继续制作项链。
entries.sampleRaw: And only then can we move forward with the §dnecklace§f.

entries.source: Woooooooaaahhhhhh!
You managed to get the Supreme Timecharm!
entries.translation: 你成功拿到了至尊时间护符！
entries.sampleRaw: You managed to get the §cSupreme Timecharm§f!

entries.source: We need to secure it to safety.
entries.translation: 我们得把它安全地保管起来。
entries.sampleRaw: We need to secure it to safety.

entries.source: Use the warp to the gallery.
entries.sampleRaw: Use the warp to the gallery.

entries.source: I will meet you there.
This is the Rift Gallery!
The wizards managed to take control of this section of the dimension for use in my necklace project.
entries.translation: 巫师们设法控制了这个维度的这一区域，用于我的项链计划。
entries.sampleRaw: The §dwizards §fmanaged to take control of this section of the dimension for use in my §dnecklace §fproject.

entries.source: Secure Timecharms here every time you find one!
entries.translation: 每次找到时间护符，就把它安全地存放在这里！
entries.sampleRaw: Secure §cTimecharms §fhere every time you find one!

entries.source: Place the Supreme Timecharm in the right slot of the gallery!
entries.translation: 把至尊时间护符放进展馆右侧的槽位里！
entries.sampleRaw: Place the §cSupreme Timecharm §fin the right slot of the §dgallery§f!

entries.source: Marvelous!
I frankly did not expect that much from you.
entries.translation: 说实话，我没想到你能做到这种程度。
entries.sampleRaw: I frankly did not expect that much from you.

entries.source: Here is the Necklace.
Okay... it might not seem incredible right now...
entries.translation: 好吧……它现在看起来可能没那么了不起……
entries.sampleRaw: Okay... it might not seem §d§oincredible §fright now...

entries.source: But there are two things about it!
First, it becomes way stronger the more Timecharms you secure in the Rift.
entries.translation: 第一，你在裂隙中存放的时间护符越多，它就会变得越强大。
entries.sampleRaw: §eFirst§f, it becomes §away stronger §fthe more §cTimecharms §fyou secure in the §dRift§f.

entries.source: Second, the real power is OUTSIDE, in the "real" universe.
entries.translation: 第二，真正的力量在“外面”，在“真实”宇宙中。
entries.sampleRaw: §eSecond§f, the real power is §aOUTSIDE§f, in the "real" universe.

entries.source: Come and see me in the Wizard Tower in the SkyBlock Hub.
entries.translation: 来 SkyBlock 中心岛的巫师塔找我吧。
entries.sampleRaw: Come and see me in the §dWizard Tower §fin the §aSkyBlock Hub§f.

entries.source: Although, I might not be too kind out there.
entries.translation: 不过，我在外面可能不会那么友善。
entries.sampleRaw: Although, I might not be too kind out there.

entries.source: Simply tell my outside self the keyword CARAMEL and I should understand.
entries.translation: 只要告诉我外面的自己关键词 CARAMEL，我应该就能明白。
entries.sampleRaw: Simply tell my §aoutside self §fthe keyword §6§lCARAMEL §fand I should understand.

entries.source: Have fun!
My mother was a wizard, while my father crafted beautiful jewelry.
entries.translation: 我母亲是巫师，而我父亲则打造精美的珠宝。
entries.sampleRaw: My mother was a §dwizard§f, while my father crafted §bbeautiful jewelry§f.

entries.source: Naturally, I decided to combine their talents!
entries.translation: 于是，我自然而然地决定把他们的才能结合起来！
entries.sampleRaw: Naturally, I decided to combine their talents!

entries.source: Congratulations on obtaining the mrahcemiT esrevrorriM!
entries.translation: 恭喜你获得了符护间时界世像镜！

entries.source: Numerous wizards have ventured into the Rift, but not all are from the world you and I come from.
entries.translation: 许多巫师都曾冒险进入裂隙,但并非所有人都来自你我所处的世界.
entries.sampleRaw: Numerous wizards have ventured into the §dRift§r, but not all are from the world you and I come from.

entries.source: Due to the Rift's nature, we can never be sure if they hail from the past or from a time yet to come.
entries.translation: 由于裂隙的特性,我们永远无法确定他们来自过去,还是来自尚未到来的时代.
entries.sampleRaw: Due to the §dRift§r's nature, we can never be sure if they hail from the past or from a time yet to come.

entries.source: You've collected another Timecharm!
entries.translation: 你又收集到了一个时间护符！

entries.source: As you journey deeper into the Rift, things maybe become more challenging.
entries.translation: 随着你在裂隙中越走越深，事情可能会变得更具挑战性。
entries.sampleRaw: As you journey deeper into the §dRift§f, things maybe become more challenging.

entries.source: My advice? Gather as much ф Rift Time as possible before proceeding further.
entries.translation: 我的建议？继续前进之前，尽可能多地收集ф裂隙时间。
entries.sampleRaw: My advice? Gather as much §aф Rift Time §fas possible before proceeding further.

entries.source: Barry is truly one of the most skilled wizards I've ever met.
entries.translation: Barry确实是我见过的最有本领的巫师之一。
entries.sampleRaw: §9Barry §fis truly one of the most skilled wizards I've ever met.

entries.source: Too bad he's using his powers for all the wrong reasons.
entries.translation: 可惜他把自己的能力全用在了错误的地方。
entries.sampleRaw: Too bad he's using his powers for all the §cwrong §freasons.

entries.source: Don't tell him I said that!
entries.sampleRaw: Don't tell him I said that!

entries.source: There's been enough complaints against him recently.
entries.translation: 最近针对他的投诉已经够多了。
entries.sampleRaw: There's been enough complaints against him recently.

entries.source: Barry was rather downcast before his first election.
entries.translation: Barry在第一次竞选前相当沮丧。
entries.sampleRaw: §bBarry §fwas rather downcast before his first election.

entries.source: But once elected, he discovered he could make a positive impact.
entries.translation: 但当选之后，他发现自己能带来积极的影响。
entries.sampleRaw: But once elected, he discovered he could make a positive impact.

entries.source: He REALLY wanted to become mayor again, to no avail.
entries.translation: 他非常想再次成为市长，却未能如愿。
entries.sampleRaw: He REALLY wanted to become mayor again, to no avail.

entries.source: I guess he found a way...
In any case, without his help, we couldn't have fixed the portal.
entries.translation: 无论如何，没有他的帮助，我们无法修好传送门。
entries.sampleRaw: In any case, without his help, we couldn't have fixed the portal.

entries.source: Honestly, I've made my peace with leaving all the meaning of my life to the past.
entries.translation: 说实话，我已经接受把我人生的全部意义留在过去了。
entries.sampleRaw: Honestly, I've made my peace with leaving all the meaning of my life to the past.

entries.source: If getting here was my purpose in life, then anything beyond that point would've been meaningless anyway.
entries.translation: 如果来到这里就是我人生的目的，那么在那之后的一切本来也就毫无意义了。
entries.sampleRaw: If getting here was my purpose in life, then anything beyond that point would've been meaningless anyway.

entries.source: At least now it's official.
entries.translation: 至少现在这已经正式确定了。

entries.source: But sometimes, when I'm alone in the Gallery...
entries.translation: 但有时候，当我独自待在画廊里……
entries.sampleRaw: But sometimes, when I'm alone in the §dGallery§f...

entries.source: ... I wish I knew what I was sacrificing by stepping into the breach.
entries.translation: ……我希望我知道踏入裂隙时自己牺牲了什么。
entries.sampleRaw: ... I wish I knew what I was sacrificing by stepping into the §5breach§f.

entries.source: The Living Cave is not a place I'm fond of.
entries.translation: 活体洞穴可不是我喜欢的地方。
entries.sampleRaw: The §9Living Cave §fis not a place I'm fond of.

entries.source: It's cold, isolated and utterly confounding.
entries.translation: 那里寒冷、与世隔绝，而且完全令人困惑。

entries.source: I'm relieved you managed to secure the Timecharm from there!
entries.translation: 你成功从那里拿到了时间护符，我松了一口气！
entries.sampleRaw: I'm relieved you managed to secure the §cTimecharm §ffrom there!

entries.source: Best of luck battling the infection in the Colosseum.
entries.translation: 祝你在竞技场对抗感染时好运。
entries.sampleRaw: Best of luck battling the §ainfection §fin the §aColosseum§f.

entries.source: I crossed the breach a little bit after Dante's defeat in our world.
entries.translation: 在我们世界的Dante被击败后不久,我就穿过了裂隙.
entries.sampleRaw: I crossed the §5breach §fa little bit after §cDante's §fdefeat in our world.

entries.source: While I can't be sure if the Slime was there "before" his demise, the resemblance is striking.
entries.translation: 虽然我不能确定那只史莱姆是否在他死"之前"就已存在，但相似之处非常惊人。
entries.sampleRaw: While I can't be sure if the §aSlime §fwas there "before" §chis §fdemise, the resemblance is striking.

entries.source: The wizards believe Shen employed Dante, or perhaps even created him!
entries.translation: 巫师们相信Shen雇用了Dante，甚至可能创造了他！
entries.sampleRaw: The wizards believe §6Shen §femployed §cDante§f, or perhaps even created him!

entries.source: Or did Shen find a way into the Rift before us?
entries.translation: 还是说Shen比我们更早找到了进入裂隙的方法？
entries.sampleRaw: Or did §6Shen §ffind a way into the §dRift §fbefore us?

entries.source: Did he find Dante here?
Unbelievable!
You truly vanquished Bacte?
Perhaps you're the one who can reach the Mountaintop...
entries.translation: 也许你就是那个能抵达山巅的人……
entries.sampleRaw: Perhaps you're the one who can reach the Mountaintop...

entries.source: Have you encountered Julian?
He's been spotted in the Rift on several occasions.
entries.translation: 有人多次在裂隙中目击到他。
entries.sampleRaw: He's been spotted in the §dRift §fon several occasions.

entries.source: While he may seem friendly, be cautious.
entries.translation: 他看似友善，但务必小心。

entries.source: Those in his organization have committed questionable acts.
entries.translation: 他组织里的人干过一些可疑的勾当。
entries.sampleRaw: Those in his organization have committed §oquestionable §facts.

entries.source: One doesn't reach his rank without crossing a few lines.
entries.translation: 不越几条线,是爬不到他那个位置的.
entries.sampleRaw: One doesn't reach §2his §frank without §ccrossing a few lines§f.

entries.source: The vampires have bestowed their Timecharm upon you?
entries.translation: 吸血鬼们把他们的时间护符赐予你了？

entries.source: You must've made a powerful impression on their Coven.
entries.translation: 你一定给他们的集会留下了深刻印象。
entries.sampleRaw: You must've made a powerful impression on their Coven.

entries.source: The Rift holds countless more secrets.
entries.translation: 裂隙中还藏着无数秘密.

entries.source: We may never fully comprehend it, but your assistance has been invaluable so far!
entries.translation: 我们也许永远无法完全理解它，但到目前为止你的帮助无比珍贵！
entries.sampleRaw: We may never fully comprehend it, but your assistance has been invaluable so far!

entries.source: I've heard rumors that the breach on top of the Mountain was made by a massive Dragon.
entries.translation: 我听说山峰顶部的裂口是一条巨大的龙造成的。
entries.sampleRaw: I've heard rumors that the §5breach §fon top of the Mountain was made by a massive §6Dragon§f.

entries.source: But hey, did the breach cause the Rift?
entries.translation: 不过话说回来，是那个裂口造成了裂隙吗？
entries.sampleRaw: But hey, did the breach cause the §dRift§f?

entries.source: Or was the Rift just hanging around before we even had a way in?
entries.translation: 还是说，在我们找到进入方法之前，裂隙就已经存在了？
entries.sampleRaw: Or was the Rift just hanging around before we even had a way in?

entries.source: Guess we might never figure that out...
entries.translation: 看来我们可能永远也弄不明白了……
entries.sampleRaw: Guess we might never figure that out...

entries.source: Nice job getting all the timecharms.
entries.translation: 集齐所有时间护符，干得漂亮。
entries.sampleRaw: Nice job getting all the timecharms.

entries.source: Your Rift Necklace is totally maxed out now.
entries.translation: 你的裂隙项链现在已经完全满级了。
entries.sampleRaw: Your §dRift Necklace §fis totally maxed out now.

entries.source: Really appreciate the help with all this.
entries.translation: 非常感谢你在这件事上的帮助。
entries.sampleRaw: Really appreciate the help with all this.

entries.source: Drop by sometime, it gets pretty lonely out here.
entries.translation: 有空来看看吧，这里挺孤单的。
entries.sampleRaw: Drop by sometime, it gets pretty lonely out here.

entries.source: Please.
If you've made it this far, you're talented.
entries.translation: 能走到这一步，说明你很有天赋。
entries.sampleRaw: If you've made it this far, you're §otalented§f.

entries.source: Me?
I'm trying to solve one of the deepest mysteries of our world.
entries.translation: 我正在试图解开我们世界最深邃的谜团之一。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm trying to solve one of the §9deepest mysteries §fof our world.

entries.source: I'm looking for traces of the Precursors, but there's none anywhere.
entries.translation: 我在寻找先民的踪迹，但哪里都找不到。
entries.sampleRaw: I'm looking for traces of the §4Precursors§f, but there's none anywhere.

entries.source: Zip!
Nada!
Not even anywhere in the Rift!
entries.translation: 连裂隙里也哪儿都没有！

entries.source: If they're trying to return to our world one day, shouldn't they come through here?
entries.translation: 如果他们某天想回到我们的世界,难道他们不该从这里经过吗?
entries.sampleRaw: If they're trying to return to §aour world §fone day, shouldn't §4they §fcome through §dhere§f?

entries.source: Oruo isn't even here.
But I know for a fact he acquired the Blessing of Time right here, in the Château!
entries.translation: 但我确信他就是在城堡这里获得了时间祝福！
entries.sampleRaw: But I know for a fact he acquired the §dBlessing of Time §fright here, in the §cChâteau§f!

entries.source: So many questions left unanswered...
entries.translation: 还有太多问题没有答案……

entries.source: Hey are you looking to get to the castle?
entries.sampleRaw: Hey are you looking to get to the §ccastle§f?

entries.source: All you need is a flying boat!
entries.translation: 你只需要一艘会飞的船！
entries.sampleRaw: All you need is a flying boat!

entries.source: Ghasts produce chemtrails!
We never reached the end!
Minecraft worlds are round!
Biggest of all, Big Mayor is always watching!!!
entries.translation: 最重要的是,大市长一直在看着你!!!
entries.sampleRaw: Biggest of all, §cBig Mayor §fis always watching!!!

entries.source: They hacked me, I'm telling you!
All the cables are gray now!
entries.translation: 现在所有线缆都变成灰色了!

entries.source: I don't want gray, I hate gray!
entries.translation: 我不想要灰色，我讨厌灰色！

entries.source: Take this Visor, follow the cables and hack them back!!!
entries.translation: 拿着这个面罩,沿着线缆走,把它们黑回来!!!

entries.source: Did you lose my visor?
entries.translation: 你把我的面罩弄丢了吗？

entries.source: No problem! I got tons of them!
entries.sampleRaw: No problem! I got tons of them!

entries.source: Quick!
Use the Visor.
Follow the cables real close.
Hack the terminals.
It's not so big brain.
I see you've hacked all the terminals, that's good...
entries.translation: 我看到你已经黑入了所有终端,很好……
entries.sampleRaw: I see you've §chacked §fall the terminals, that's good...

entries.source: But you have to set them to the proper colors so I can hack their nexus!!!
entries.translation: 但你得把它们设置成正确的颜色,这样我才能黑入他们的枢纽!!!
entries.sampleRaw: But you have to set them to the proper §cc§eo§al§9o§5r§ds §fso I can hack §ctheir nexus§f!!!

entries.source: Wow [player], you did it!
Now that their own network is working against them, I can start working on infiltrating Big Mayor.
entries.translation: 既然他们自己的网络现在反过来对付他们了,我就可以开始着手渗透大市长了.
entries.sampleRaw: Now that their own §dnetwork §fis working against §cthem§f, I can start working on infiltrating §cBig Mayor§f.

entries.source: Shouldn't the reward of video games be the fun you've had playing them?
entries.translation: 电子游戏的奖励难道不该是你玩它们时获得的乐趣吗?
entries.sampleRaw: Shouldn't the reward of §5video games §fbe the fun you've had playing them?

entries.source: Alright fine...
Take this old thing.
Thank you for stopping Big Mayor from watching my every moves.
entries.translation: 谢谢你阻止大市长监视我的一举一动.
entries.sampleRaw: Thank you for stopping §cBig Mayor §ffrom watching my every moves.

entries.source: Do you need some items again?
entries.translation: 你又需要一些物品了吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Do you need some items again?

entries.source: Mmh... looks like you have some... weird items.
entries.translation: 嗯……看起来你有一些……奇怪的物品。
entries.sampleRaw: §r§fMmh... looks like you have some... weird items.

entries.source: Here, I moved them to your stash for you!
entries.translation: 来，我把它们移到你的仓库里了！
entries.sampleRaw: §r§fHere, I moved them to your stash for you!

entries.source: Need a Travel Scroll to The Rift?
entries.translation: 需要一张前往裂隙的传送卷轴吗？
entries.sampleRaw: Need a Travel Scroll to §dThe Rift§f?

entries.source: You can't activate it here...too much magic in the air I guess?
entries.translation: 你没法在这里激活它……我猜是空气中的魔力太多了？
entries.sampleRaw: You can't activate it here...too much magic in the air I guess?

entries.source: But it's Rift Transferable! That hand-stand Dark Auction man in the Wyld Woods can help you get it back to the real world.
entries.translation: 但它是可转移至裂隙的！狂野森林里那个倒立的暗黑拍卖行男子能帮你把它带回现实世界。
entries.sampleRaw: But it's §5Rift Transferable§f! That hand-stand §5Dark Auction§f man in the §aWyld Woods§f can help you get it back to the real world.
